jobs.title: CNC Machinist - Programmer / Operator
jobs.description:
Join our team at our climate-controlled Port Arthur facility and play a critical role in producing precision-machined components. We are seeking an experienced CNC Machinist (Programmer/Operator) who can set up, program, edit, and operate CNC equipment while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and productivity.

Key Responsibilities

• Set up, program, edit, and operate CNC machinery, including lathes, mills, drills, and other machining equipment as required.
• Produce precision components while maintaining tolerances as tight as ±0.0003 inches.
• Read and interpret blueprints, work orders, routings, sketches, layout sheets, and written or verbal instructions.
• Develop, modify, and optimize CNC programs to improve efficiency and quality.
• Understand machine parameters and make program or setup adjustments as directed to ensure optimal performance.
• Work with a variety of materials, including stainless steel, alloy steel, cast iron, brass, and specialty alloys.
• Preset tooling and perform tool maintenance, including sharpening when necessary.
• Inspect completed work using precision measuring instruments such as micrometers, bore gauges, calipers, and other quality control tools.
• Perform routine machine maintenance and follow established preventive maintenance procedures.
• Troubleshoot and report equipment issues to supervision promptly.
• Accurately complete labor reporting, production documentation, and time records.
• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment in accordance with company standards and safety policies.
• Support additional operational needs and perform other duties as assigned.
• Why Join Us?
• Climate-controlled manufacturing facility
• Opportunity to work with advanced CNC equipment and precision-tolerance machining
• Stable, growing operation with opportunities for development and advancement
• Safety-focused culture committed to quality and operational excellence
• This role is ideal for a skilled CNC Machinist who enjoys programming, problem-solving, and producing high-quality machined components in a modern manufacturing environment.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; technical school training in machining or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Minimum 3 years of CNC programming and machining experience required; 5+ years preferred.
• Previous experience as a manual machinist is strongly preferred.
• Proficient in the use of precision measuring instruments, including micrometers, calipers, bore gauges, and other inspection tools.
• Demonstrated ability to set up, program, and operate CNC machine tools while maintaining close tolerances and producing quality components.
• Ability to read, interpret, and apply engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications, and machining documentation.
• Strong understanding of CNC machining processes, tooling, feeds and speeds, and material properties.
• Ability to perform mathematical calculations involving geometry, trigonometry, and dimensional analysis to support machining operations.
• Capable of troubleshooting machining issues and resolving routine technical problems independently.
• Ability to safely and effectively operate a minimum of two CNC machine tools.
• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently using sound judgment.
• Excellent verbal, written, organizational, and communication skills.
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing production requirements.
• Able to consistently complete assignments accurately, efficiently, and within established timelines.

With colleagues stretching across the globe, we are proud of our diversity. To foster inclusivity, we run employee resource groups (ERGs) to provide a safe space for employees to connect and support each other. Our cross-business ERGs include Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Women@Work Network, and Neurodiversity.

Across our company, we recognize excellence, culminating in the Smiths Excellence Awards, our annual celebration of the most extraordinary activities, people, and projects that best showcase our strengths and help drive our business forward. We announce these on our annual Smiths Day, a global celebration of Smiths around our network.

Join us for a great career with competitive compensation and benefits, while helping engineer a better future.

We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. We are proud to be an inclusive company with values grounded in equality and ethics, where we celebrate, support, and embrace diversity.

At no time during the hiring process will Smiths Group, nor any of our recruitment partners ever request payment to enable participation – including, but not limited to, interviews or testing. Avoid fraudulent requests by applying jobs directly through our career’s website (Careers - Smiths Group plc)

jobs.title: Продавец-кассир/Продавец-консультант H&M (10-40 часов) ( ТРЦ "Keruen City")
jobs.description:
В качестве Продавца - Кассира в H&M вы сыграете ключевую роль в создании выдающегося покупательского опыта. Вы будете приветствовать покупателей, помогать им ориентироваться в магазине и находить нужные товары, в также представлять нашу продукцию. Действуя в соответствии с нашими ценностями, вы будете способствовать как собственному успеху, так и успеху компании.

Ваши обязанности:

• Использование знаний о моде и товарах для помощи покупателям в выборе.
• Сотрудничество с командой для обеспечения высокого уровня сервиса на всех этапах обслуживания.
• Поддержание порядка и достаточного количества товаров на торговом зале и в складских помещениях.
• Участие в открытии и закрытии магазина.
• Дружелюбное и профессиональное представление себя и бренда при каждом взаимодействии с покупателями.

С КЕМ ВЫ БУДЕТЕ РАБОТАТЬ ​

Наши магазины — это сердце компании, где покупатели впервые знакомятся с брендом. Вы станете частью динамичной команды, включающей Продавцов-Кассиров, Заведующих Отделов, Менеджеров Магазинов, Визуальных Мерчандайзеров, а также Ассистентов Менеджеров Магазина, Менеджеров по Кассовым Операциям и Специалистов по Приему Товаров в Крупных Магазинах. Кроме того, вы будете взаимодействовать с Региональной Area командой, обмениваясь опытом и совместно работая над достижением успеха. Вместе с коллегами вы будете помогать покупателям чувствовать уверенность и выражать свою индивидуальность с помощью модных и стильных решений. Благодаря нашим магазинам мы делаем моду доступной и устойчивой для всех.

КОГО МЫ ИЩЕМ ​

Мы ищем кандидатов с…​

• Опыт работы в сфере обслуживания покупателей в модной индустрии, ритейле или смежных областях.
• Страсть к работе с покупателями и интерес к моде или ритейлу - остальному мы вас научим!

И тех, кто…​

• Комфортно работает в командной и динамичной среде.
• Обладает хорошими коммуникативными навыками, креативностью и готовностью изучать технологии работы магазина.
• Гибок, активен и ориентирован на результат.

КТО МЫ ​

H&M Group — это глобальная компания, объединяющая сильные модные бренды и инновационные проекты. Мы стремимся доказать, что стильный дизайн, доступные цены и устойчивые решения могут идти рука об руку. Мы хотим сделать моду доступной для всех, и наши покупатели находятся в центре каждого принятого решения.​

​Наша команда состоит из тысяч увлеченных и талантливых людей, объединенных общей культурой и ценностями. Вместе мы используем свои возможности, масштаб и знания, чтобы двигать индустрию моды в сторону более инклюзивного и устойчивого будущего. ​

ПОЧЕМУ ВАМ ПОНРАВИТСЯ У НАС РАБОТАТЬ ​

В H&M Group мы гордимся тем, что создаем яркую и дружелюбную рабочую среду. Мы предлагаем нашим сотрудникам привлекательные условия и широкие возможности для профессионального роста по всему миру. ​

• 25% Скидка для сотрудников на все бренды H&M Group, как в магазинах, так и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).​
• Медицинское страхование здоровья

• Реферальная программа
• Безграничные карьерные возможности
• Платформа для обучения Learning Studio

ПРИСОЕДИНЯЙТЕСЬ К НАМ​

Наша уникальность заключается в сочетании многих факторов: инклюзивной и сплоченной культуры, сильных ценностей и возможностей для развития. Но самое главное — это люди, которые делают нас теми, кто мы есть.​

jobs.title: Personal Trainer, SoMa

Equinox is an equal opportunity employer. For more information regarding our career opportunities, please visit one of our clubs or our website at https://careers.equinox.com/

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Product
jobs.description:
About Scribe

Scribe https://scribe.com is where exceptional people come to do the best work of their careers. More than 94% of the Fortune 500 use Scribe to own their specialized intelligence: the unique way their teams work, decide, and get things done. Our Specialized Intelligence platform automatically captures how work happens and turns it into a living asset for people and AI agents.

We're growing fast. Since our founding in 2019, we've reached 7 million users across 600,000 businesses. Based in San Francisco, we're a LinkedIn Top Startup, valued at over $1B, and backed by leading investors. Join us in our mission to transform how people work.



tl;dr – Why this role matters

At Scribe, data is the foundation of how we make decisions — we take it very seriously. With 5M+ users and a fast-growing self-serve business, our product team ships quickly and needs to know what’s working, for whom, and why. We’re looking for our first product data scientist to answer our most important questions about how customers use Scribe, bring rigor to how we experiment, and lay the foundation of product data science that will shape the next generation of product investments.

About the role

As the first Senior Data Scientist for Product, you’ll partner with our product, design, and engineering teams to understand user behavior, identify opportunities, and measure the impact of what we build. Reporting directly to the Head of Data, you’ll define how Scribe approaches product analytics and experimentation, and set the standards that future data scientists will build on. From day one, you’ll also have the opportunity to mentor members of the data team and raise the bar for analytical rigor across Scribe.

This role is highly visible, working directly with executive leadership as well as the product managers and engineers who own each area of the product. You will transform raw data from Scribe’s 5M+ users into clear, actionable insights, and your work will be central to how we grow our self-serve business and decide where to invest next.

Key responsibilities of this role include:

 - Partner with product teams to drive insights, identifying opportunities and understanding user behavior, engagement, retention, and long-term trends across the Scribe product.

 - Own experimentation at Scribe by designing and analyzing experiments, and developing and socializing a rigorous culture of experimentation throughout the company.

 - Lead with hypotheses, developing and testing them with data rather than only looking for patterns in the data already in front of us.

 - Define and monitor key product metrics through consistent tracking, KPIs, and dashboards, and produce new datasets that unlock business opportunities.

 - Play a foundational role in building product data culture at Scribe through reproducible work, improved processes, and better tooling.

 - Help shape the team as it grows, with the opportunity to mentor teammates on statistics, experimentation, and analytical best practices.

What makes you a great fit

You’d be a great fit for this role if this sounds like you:

 - Have 8+ years of experience as a data scientist or data analyst with significant time partnering with product teams on products that customers love

 - Strong knowledge of statistics and experimental design, with hands-on experience running A/B tests and making sound calls when experiments aren’t possible

 - Strong technical proficiency in our tech stack – Snowflake, Sigma, Mixpanel, dbt cloud, and Looker – with expert SQL and fluency in Python or R

 - Customer mindset, adept at balancing quantitative data with qualitative insights to drive product decisions, and an excellent storyteller in writing and visualizations

 - Low ego. You care about building things and recognize that this may require rolling your sleeves up, getting in the trenches, and owning everything from instrumentation to analysis

 - Proactive, high-output orientation. You push insights and data onto teams rather than waiting for requests to emerge from them

 - Outcomes over output. You thrive on creating business value and know when to run a rigorous experiment v/s doing ugly napkin math to bias towards action

 - Experience building technical and semantic infrastructure to power internal natural language agents and agentic automation

Bonus Points

 - Experience working in high-paced Enterprise SaaS startups, with a strong self-serve motion

 - Experience as the first or founding data scientist on a product team

 - Experience creating a step-function change in a product team’s decision-making with the help of AI tooling

 - Experience deploying machine learning models in Production

 - Experience mentoring analysts or data scientists



At Scribe, we celebrate our differences and are committed to creating a workplace where all employees feel supported and empowered to do their best work. Scribe is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.



Our Worker Privacy notice can be found here https://scribe.com/legal/worker-privacy.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Developer Experience
jobs.description:
THE ROLE

Bland is hiring a Product Manager to own the developer experience for building on and with Bland.

Developers use Bland within their own toolkit to send calls through our API, build agents with Codex or Claude, manage them through a CLI and GitHub, and use our models in their own voice products. You’ll bring our APIs, MCP, CLI, plugins, and documentation together into a curated product offering that developers and their coding agents can understand and use.

You’ll own the experience of developers building on and with Bland. Your job is to make that experience exceptional, from a developer’s first integration to a call running in production. You’ll bring our developer tools together into a cohesive platform and define how we bring our models to market, including which capabilities we offer, how customers consume them, and how we package and price access.

You’ll work with engineering, research, Customer Engineering, and marketing to turn those capabilities into products developers adopt and keep using.

We’re looking for a technical product builder who loves working with developers, knows what makes a great self-serve developer experience, and loves to win. You’ll set product direction, lead developers across the stack, and ship improvements yourself. You’ll engage the developer community and shape how people build at the frontier of voice AI.

The outcome objectives for this role are:

 1. Grow the number of developers building on and with Bland.

 2. Increase the share of meaningful usage beyond our UI.

 3. Grow the proportion of ARR driven by Bland’s models.


WHAT YOU'D OWN

 - Our APIs and developer tools. Shape a consistent experience across the API, MCP, CLI, and plugins. Simplify common tasks, make configuration understandable, and establish clear conventions that developers and coding agents can rely on.

 - Documentation and developer enablement. Own the quality and completeness of our API docs, quickstarts, sample integrations, and guides. Make sure new capabilities ship with a documented path to a working result, and keep those materials current as the platform changes.

 - Developer activation and retention. Understand what developers are trying to build, where they get stuck, and why they leave. Instrument the journey from signup to production, work directly with customers, and turn recurring support issues into product improvements alongside Customer Engineering.

 - Model consumption and commercialization. Own the strategy for bringing our voice models to developers building their own voice experiences. Define which capabilities we offer, how developers integrate them, and how we package and price access. Own the APIs and product surfaces through which customers try, configure, and consume our models, and partner with research on the behaviors and controls they need.

 - Developer relationships and the product story. Help developers understand what they can build and why Bland is a good fit. Work with marketing and Customer Engineering on demos, technical content, launches, and internal enablement. Bring developers together through workshops, hackathons, or other events where they help people build and adopt the product.


WHAT YOU'D BE WORKING ON

 - The shortest path to a production agent. Make it possible for a developer to go from nothing to a working agent in production via our developer tools as quickly as possible.

 - A coherent platform developers can navigate. Make it clear which capabilities are available and how to combine them. Build complete examples for common use cases, establish consistent API patterns, and carry that clarity through documentation and every new release.

 - Commercializing our suite of voice models. Build the commercial strategy for developers creating their own voice experiences with individual Bland models. Start with Bland’s Text-to-Speech v3 and shape how we bring future models across the voice stack to market, from choosing the right use cases to packaging, pricing, integration, and adoption.

You’ll explore the range of AI applications in phone calls, from full-duplex models to research into the dynamics of conversation, and help turn those advances into capabilities developers can build with.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A competitive generalist mindset. You love to win, hate to lose, and make progress without waiting for direction. You learn quickly and take failures on the chin. You hold yourself to a very high bar and demand excellence from your teammates. You welcome direct feedback, challenge ideas openly, and assume good intent.

 - An engineering foundation. You’ve worked as a software engineer and have at least three years of experience across engineering, data science, or product management. You’ve used APIs firsthand and built real integrations. You seek out new tools before they’re widely adopted, get unfinished technology working, and build things on your own initiative.

 - Experience building for developers. You’ve built developer-facing products or tools and use APIs, CLIs, MCPs, and coding agents in your own work. You have opinions about what makes a developer experience great and can explain them through examples.

 - Comfort shipping code. You can build sample integrations, test your own assumptions, improve documentation and tooling, and make product changes directly. We welcome engineers moving into product who can demonstrate strong product judgment through what they’ve built.

 - Enthusiasm for working with customers and enabling others. You enjoy watching developers build, understanding their problems, explaining what’s possible, and helping them succeed. You can turn a technical capability into clear documentation, a compelling demo, and a product story that equips both customers and teammates.

 - An active interest in voice AI. You’ve gone out of your way to build with voice products and follow the models, tools, and companies shaping the category.


BONUS

 - You’ve owned developer programs and helped developers adopt and succeed with a product.

 - You’ve curated or participated in events for the developer community, such as hackathons, technical workshops, and speaker series.


HOW WE WORK

This role requires high ownership, pace, and commitment. We expect you to be reachable on weekends, and Fridays are always in person.

You’ll work closely with engineering, research, Customer Engineering, and marketing, coordinating contributions while staying accountable for the developer experience. You should be comfortable with changing priorities and willing to take on product work beyond your initial remit.

jobs.title: Restaurant Manager
jobs.description:

The Restaurant Manager is responsible for supporting the Restaurant Leader in day-to-day operations of the restaurant and upholding Raising Cane’s standards and culture in shift management responsibilities of restaurant operations.

The physical work environment includes working in a fast-paced kitchen environment (which requires extended periods of physical exertion, such as walking, standing, lifting and bending) and interacting with customers. jobs.title: Benefits Program Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE PEOPLE TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Build the people function from scratch, fast enough to keep up with 10x growth. You'll build the systems, programs, and team from nothing, and make them work before we outgrow them.

 - Reinvent people operations around AI. Doing this by hand doesn't scale to a workforce growing this fast on a team this lean. You'll put AI at the core of how the function runs, so a small team supports many times its number.

 - Shape the culture and comms as the company scales. When a company scales this quickly, staying connected and aligned doesn't happen on its own. You'll help shape internal comms, events, and rhythm that keep a multi-site team that's growing fast bound to a shared culture.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Own Fluidstack's benefits program end to end, covering medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D, disability, EAP, FSA, HSA, HRA, commuter, voluntary benefits, and the 401(k) with Fidelity, and decide which new benefits (fertility, family-building, mental health) we add next.

 - Run annual renewal and open enrollment start to finish: model claims, cost trends, and contribution options with Finance, benchmark against AI and technology peers, bring recommendations to leadership well before enrollment, and audit every election across HRIS, payroll, and carrier systems afterward.

 - Keep every plan compliant as we expand into new states and entities, covering ERISA, ACA reporting (1094-C and 1095-C), COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, Section 125, plan documents and required notices, state paid leave laws, and audit readiness.

 - Run benefits operations in our HRIS and carrier feeds so eligibility, deductions, and life events stay accurate every pay cycle, and hold brokers, carriers, and TPAs to their service levels through renewals, RFPs, and implementations.

 - Administer leave and accommodations (FMLA, state paid leave, disability, parental, and military leave) with carriers, Payroll, HR Business Partners, and Legal, and serve as the go-to expert when an employee's benefits question is complex, urgent, or personal.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 

 - You've owned a US benefits program end to end, from broker and carrier renewal through open enrollment and the post-enrollment audit of every election.

 - You've personally handled benefits compliance (ERISA, ACA reporting and affordability testing, COBRA, HIPAA, FMLA, Section 125) and you know exactly where your knowledge ends and benefits counsel begins.

 - You've administered leave and accommodations across multiple states and kept the company compliant as state laws changed underneath you.

 - You've been the primary admin of an HRIS and benefits platform (Rippling), including eligibility rules and carrier EDI feeds, and you reconcile HRIS, payroll, and carrier data in spreadsheets yourself.

 - You've built benefits cost and utilization reporting, modeled renewal and contribution scenarios with Finance, and driven leadership to a decision on cost versus coverage.

 - You write benefits guides and run education sessions employees actually act on, and you can point to the drop in tickets or enrollment errors that followed.

 - You handle confidential health and personal data with discretion, and you build checks so a missed enrollment or payroll error never happens twice.

 - Bonus: Benefits certifications (CEBS, CBP). Hypergrowth benefits builds (headcount doubling or more in a year, new states and entities). International benefits (UK, employer of record). Benefits diligence and integration for acquisitions. AI tools for benefits administration and employee support (chat-based benefits assistants).

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Manufacturing
jobs.description:
About Us

We are Sila, a next-generation battery materials company. Our mission is to power the world’s transition to clean energy. To create this future, our team is building a better lithium-ion battery from the inside out today. We engineer and manufacture ground-breaking battery materials that significantly increase the energy density of batteries, while reducing their size and weight. The result? Smaller more powerful batteries that can unlock innovation in consumer devices and accelerate the mass adoption of electric cars to eliminate our dependence on fossil fuels. We're tackling one of the biggest challenges of our time every day, and together we're redefining what's possible. Are you ready to be a part of a team committed to changing the world?

Who You Are

You are a hands-on engineer with extensive experience in developing new manufacturing equipment and processes. You will leverage your deep technical expertise in equipment, process, and manufacturing to solve interdisciplinary problems on our pilot manufacturing line. You will lead projects to continuously improve throughput, performance and safety, ensuring that our team can consistently meet the demands for quality and quantity of our battery materials. You will help lead operations for our pilot line, working closely with a committed team of process engineers, equipment engineers, technicians, and scientists. You will architect, design, and commission first-of-a-kind manufacturing systems, translating core process chemistry and pilot processes into commercial-ready manufacturing technologies. You will collaborate closely with scientists, process engineers, and external equipment integrators to develop scalable equipment roadmaps, de-risk unit operations, and establish manufacturing platforms that enable the commercialization of our battery materials.

Responsibilities and Duties

• Provide day-to-day technical support for manufacturing equipment and processes on our pilot manufacturing line. Embrace firefighting, analyzing, and addressing each day's operational challenges enthusiastically and rigorously.

• Continuously improve and sustain the pilot manufacturing line by executing on projects that improve process throughput, equipment reliability, performance, and safety.

• Spearhead the scaling of core synthesis, coating, thermal, and material handling processes from bench/lab scale to pilot and high-volume manufacturing lines.

• Develop equipment concepts, 3D CAD models, detailed drawings (GD&T), sizing calculations, and functional specifications for custom automated equipment.

• Act as the technical lead for contract manufacturing transfers; ensure all critical-to-quality (CTQ) process parameters are systematically mapped to vendor equipment specifications, tooling capabilities, and automation architectures.

Knowledge and Skill Requirements

• Minimum 7 years of work experience in a manufacturing environment (or fewer for candidates with an advanced degree)

• BS in mechanical engineering (preferred) or a similar engineering field.

• Strong equipment design principles with advanced proficiency in 3D CAD modeling, drawing standards (GD&T), tolerance stack-up analysis, and mechanical component sizing (actuators, pumps, gearboxes, vacuum/pressure vessels).

• Demonstrated technical understanding of complex production equipment and processes. Ability to independently troubleshoot, problem solve, analyze data and manage controls charts (SPC). Experience with leveraging statistical software to analyze experimental data, identify trends, and drive data-backed decisions.

• Proven track record of managing turn-key equipment builders and custom automation vendors from initial scope through FAT, SAT, and commissioning.

• Can effectively manage multiple responsibilities, is self-motivated and can work autonomously with minimal guidance; comfortable with ambiguity and proactive about creating workflows and manufacturing process structure.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

• Pass a respirator fit test and be able to wear respiratory protection on a periodic basis

• Wear personal protective equipment including, but not limited to, a lab coat, gloves, safety glasses, and steel toe safety shoes

• Move items up to 50 lbs with the assistance of lift equipment and carts

• Move long distances (such as from building to building)

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking a dynamic, organized, and driven Legal Counsel to join our expanding team. As a company at the forefront of space exploration and satellite technology, Apex is looking for a motivated and adaptable lawyer with 2–4 years of legal experience to join our growing legal team. This is a unique opportunity for a self-starter who wants to develop into a true generalist in an in-house environment. The ideal candidate will have a foundation in contract drafting and negotiation, some exposure to government contracting (FAR/DFARS), and ideally a background in or familiarity with litigation. A strong desire to learn new areas of the law such as space law, labor and employment, regulatory compliance, and M&A is essential.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Draft, review, and negotiate a variety of contracts, including commercial and supply chain agreements, non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), consulting and service agreements, and help ensure contractual terms support the company’s broader business goals and legal risk posture.

 - Support and advise on matters involving government contracts, including compliance with FAR and DFARS requirements.

 - Provide legal guidance to internal stakeholders on contractual rights and obligations, including IP rights, indemnities, warranties, and regulatory compliance.

 - Assist in the development and implementation of contract management policies, processes, and playbooks.

 - Collaborate with outside counsel on litigation matters, including discovery, document production, and strategy.

 - Proactively identify legal risks and propose solutions.

 - Participate in the development and training of internal teams on legal and compliance topics.

 - Assist with mergers and acquisitions, including due diligence, negotiation, and integration.

 - Ensure the company maintains compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, updating policies as necessary.

 - Provide timely, business-oriented legal advice to stakeholders across multiple departments.

 - Support sensitive legal matters such as investigations, compliance concerns, and dispute resolution.

 - Collaborate on special projects and assist the Legal team with evolving priorities.

Qualifications:

 - J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar, California preferred.

 - 2–4 years of relevant legal experience, with in-house or corporate setting experience preferred.

 - Experience with commercial contract drafting, review, and negotiation.

 - Familiarity with government contracting regulations (FAR/DFARS) is a plus.

 - Demonstrated interest in expanding knowledge into new legal areas (e.g., employment law, M&A, corporate compliance).

 - Strong organizational and communication skills, with excellent attention to detail.

 - Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.

 - Collaborative mindset and comfort working with cross-functional teams.

 - Strong business acumen and practical approach to legal advice.

 - Demonstrated independent ownership of work, ensuring thorough tracking and completion.

 - Solution-driven, innovative thinker with a passion for improving business outcomes.

 - Superior interpersonal and communication skills, enabling effective collaboration at all organizational levels.

Nice-to-Have

 - Experience in satellite manufacturing or related industries (aerospace, defense, or high-tech) is strongly preferred.


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. You can learn more about ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.

jobs.title: General Counsel (Fractional with Path to Full Time)
jobs.description:
About Pursuit

Pursuit is a social impact organization building the future of economic mobility in the age of AI.

For over a decade, we've transformed lives through immersive training programs that propel adults from low-income backgrounds — often without college degrees — into high-growth tech careers. Our graduates have already generated nearly $1 billion in lifetime wage gains. We've also pioneered the Pursuit Bond, an innovative outcomes-based financing model that aligns investor returns with long-term economic mobility, allowing us to scale impact in a financially sustainable way.

Now, as AI reshapes every industry, Pursuit is evolving into an AI-native organization. We're training AI-native talent, embedding AI into our operations, and building scalable software to extend our impact. From grassroots partnerships to national policy, we're not just filling jobs — we're rethinking how economic opportunity works at scale.

About the Role

Pursuit is hiring a General Counsel to own our legal strategy and function — protecting the organization while clearing the path for our next phase of growth.

Reporting to the CEO, you'll be Pursuit's in-house legal lead, backed by a bench of outside pro bono support that you'll help build and fully manage. You'll advise the CEO, executive team, and board across everything from governance and compliance to contracts and complex financial transactions and guide the legal side of our mission-driven organization All of it sits on top of a hybrid dual-entity structure (a 501(c)(3) and a public benefit corporation) and innovative financing like the Pursuit Good Jobs Agreement.  We are looking for an individual who can innovate and problem solve a complex legal landscape.

The ideal candidate is a business savvy lawyer who also understands the nuance of the non profit space and can move from strategy to execution, and who sees great legal work as a way to help the mission scale, not slow it down.

Key Responsibilities

• Build, refine, and oversee Pursuit's legal strategy in partnership with senior leadership, the board of directors, and outside counsel — and provide strategic legal advice to the CEO, executive team, and board that balances legal needs with our values and objectives.

• Build a lean, high-leverage legal function anchored by managing world-class elite pro bono legal counsel and top-tier firms for high-stakes, specialized work. You'll build and fully own this bench while managing paid outside counsel when warranted.

• Guide Pursuit through the legal elements of key initiatives including the AI Jobs Institute and our pilots in new regions and revenue streams — from entity and partnership structures to contracts and regulatory questions.

• Drive execution across governance, contracts, and policy, and ensure Pursuit complies with all federal, state, and local regulatory requirements — including managing any litigation and arbitration matters.

• Manage the interactions among our 501(c)(3), public benefit corporation, and other legal entities.

• Manage and execute Pursuit's financial transactions, including the Pursuit Good Jobs Agreement, charitable donations, recoverable grants, fee-for-service contracts, and other impact investment financing.

• Serve as Pursuit’s in-house counsel for intellectual property and technology matters, advising on ownership, licensing, and use of our curriculum, software, data, and AI tools.

• Shape our commercial structures and translate business requirements into sound partnership contracts with vendors, sponsors, employment partners, funders, and donors.

• Create and manage agreements, contracts, and policies with staff, Builders, volunteers, and other community stakeholders.

• Provide legal advice on Employee and Employment Relations issues.

• Use AI to multiply a lean legal function — contract review and redlining, first drafts, clause libraries and templates, compliance tracking — and help set practical guardrails for how Pursuit uses AI responsibly.

About You

• 8+ years of corporate legal experience, including leading legal in-house at a small or midsize organization through a period of growth. Deep transactional expertise — contract law is your sweet spot.

• You've built legal and compliance processes from scratch, and your proactive, pragmatic counsel has helped the business innovate and scale.

• You've defined, shaped, and scaled revenue partnerships.

• You're equal parts strategic and tactical — happy to wear many hats and roll up your sleeves, switching from organization-level strategy to day-to-day execution without losing the thread.

• Solutions-oriented: you find the path that manages risk without slowing the organization down.

• You're excited to take on a critical leadership role, partnering with senior leadership on our most important cross-functional priorities in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.

• Comfort using AI tools to draft, analyze, and move work forward quickly, and an informed perspective on the legal questions AI raises.

• You're in good standing with the New York Bar, or have the ability to immediately qualify for Registered In-House Counsel (RIHC) status.

• Deep alignment with Pursuit's mission and genuine interest in the intersection of technology, AI, and economic mobility.

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of 501(c)(3)s and benefit corporations.

• Experience in the tech industry.

• Experience with regulatory agencies and matters at the federal and state level.

Where You'll Work

This role offers a flexible, outcome-driven schedule equivalent to ~3 days/week, following our hybrid pattern with on-site work in Long Island City on core days and work-from-anywhere flexibility.

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation for this fractional role (~3 days/week equivalent) is $135,000–$150,000, including full benefits and a clear path to full-time as the organization scales.

The compensation range above reflects the expectations laid out in this job description; however, we're often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than posted. If that's the case, the updated salary range will be communicated to you as a candidate.

Pursuit Offers

• An opportunity to work at the intersection of tech and social impact, and make a direct impact on the communities we serve

• Competitive compensation in base, plus bonus and a full benefits package

• 401k match

• Unlimited PTO and an all-Pursuit summer break the last week of August, plus a week-long holiday the last week of December

• Hybrid schedule: Tuesday–Thursday on-site in Long Island City, Monday and Friday work-from-anywhere

• Catered lunches once a week and delicious snacks

• Dedicated time to build in AI and hone your AI skills

Pursuit Values Diversity

Our team has a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we value the richness that diversity brings to our organization. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuit is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Onsite - Medical Assistant (MA) / Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) / Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN)
jobs.description:
FLAGLER HEALTH IS BUILDING THE CLINICAL OPERATING SYSTEM FOR MODERN MUSCULOSKELETAL CARE.

We partner with MSK provider groups and specialty clinics to help them grow, operate more efficiently, and deliver better longitudinal care across patient acquisition, clinical workflows, and ongoing patient engagement. Our platform sits at the intersection of care delivery and clinic operations, helping providers capture more value across the full patient lifecycle.

We’ve recently raised our Series B https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260810011327/en/Flagler-Health-Raises-%2450-Million-Series-B-to-Build-the-AI-Operating-System-for-Musculoskeletal-Care and are entering our next phase of growth. 


ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a dedicated and clinically grounded MA, LPN or LVN to serve in a dual-function role at our WI facility. You will serve as the on-site point of contact for our Medicare 855B site inspection process and support our Chronic Care Management (CCM) program.

 

This position is currently 5 days per week, on-site at NEW JERSEY | FLAGLER MEDICAL OF NEW JERSEY P.C. at 101 Eisenhower Pkwy, Suite 300, Roseland, NJ 07. As our clinical program scales and staffing grows, a hybrid schedule (rotating in-office and remote days) will become available. That transition will be communicated in advance with clear expectations.

 

Physical presence during the 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM window is mandatory. Our facility is subject to unannounced CMS / MAC site inspections as part of a pending 855B application. A missed inspection results in automatic application denial. Punctuality and consistency are non-negotiable in this role.

 


ON-SITE RESPONSIBILITIES


MEDICARE SITE INSPECTION COMPLIANCE

 - Serve as the sole dedicated physical presence at the facility during all posted operating hours.

 - Act as the immediate, professional point of contact when a MAC field inspector arrives unannounced.

 - Escort inspectors through the facility and respond to operational questions factually and without elaboration.

 - Confirm each morning that the facility is open, utilities are operational, and equipment is functioning before 10:00 AM.

 - Verify that external business signage is visible and in compliance.

 - Maintain strict physical HIPAA compliance, including locked medical records storage and secured server areas.

 - Maintain the Readiness Binder at the front desk at all times, containing:

 - Active state facility licenses

 - IRS CP-575 forms

 - Current building lease

 - Copy of the submitted 855B application

 


CLINICAL RESPONSIBILITIES: CHRONIC CARE MANAGEMENT (CCM)

These duties are performed during on-site hours when inspection coverage permits and will expand to full-time remote clinical work as the hybrid schedule is introduced.

 

 - Facilitate patient enrollment into Flagler's CCM portal.

 - Make daily outbound calls and send text messages to patients to document health status and maintain engagement.

 - Collect and document patient health information, including medical histories, current health status, and new or evolving symptoms.

 - Send evidence-based health support resources to patients, including stretching guides, light exercise videos, and meditation content.

 - Participate in ongoing company training sessions and team check-ins.

 - Maintain strict patient confidentiality in full compliance with HIPAA regulations and Flagler company policies.

 


REQUIREMENTS


CREDENTIALS

 - Active LPN or LVN license in good standing in the state of WI.

 


EXPERIENCE

 - Minimum 3 years of experience as an LPN or LVN in a clinical office or remote care setting.

 - Background in healthcare administration, clinic operations, or front-desk management is a plus.

 


TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Proficiency with Zoom, Slack, and online patient enrollment platforms.

 - Personal laptop with a working microphone, camera, and reliable internet connection.

 - Quiet, dedicated workspace available for remote work when the hybrid schedule is introduced.

 


PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES

 - Calm, articulate, and professional conduct when interacting with federal auditors or healthcare officials.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with an emphasis on empathy and patient support.

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple simultaneous responsibilities.

 - Ability to work independently and take initiative without close supervision.

 - Demonstrated commitment to HIPAA compliance and patient privacy.

 


PREFERRED CLINICAL BACKGROUND

Candidates with experience in any of the following specialties are strongly preferred:

 

 - Orthopedics

 - Physical and Rehabilitation Medicine

 - Sports Medicine

 - Neurology

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Contractor position at $24.00 to $26.00 per hour, negotiable based on experience.

 - A path toward a hybrid schedule as the clinical program grows and staffing expands.

 - Opportunities for professional growth within a Series B technology-driven healthcare company.

 - A direct, collaborative team culture that values precision, ownership, and patient outcomes.


OUR VALUES:

This is what you can expect of your teammates at Flagler:

 - Owner: We own our work like founders. We don't wait to be asked, and we pick up the problem nobody else has.

 - Builder: We like making things from scratch. We don't need a playbook to start, and we'd rather ship a rough first version than wait on a perfect spec.

 - Fast: We make quick decisions. We favor progress and respect process.

 - Transparent: We communicate directly. We value merit and honesty, and we challenge assumptions, including our own.

 - Curious: We explore new approaches and ask "why" often.

The successful candidate will have an understanding and experience in electrical engineering design and technology principles. She/he will be expected to work successfully within a team environment and be able to communicate effectively with other project team members and customers. He/she will have a high level of initiative, motivation, and displays drive, energy and enthusiasm for getting things done with an excellent attention to detail.

The responsibilities of this role also include, but may not be limited to, the following:

• Responsible for the electrical engineering design work on assigned projects

• Generate basis of design documentation for protection settings and relay configurations

DCS—Energy

Our understanding of the big picture – and the interconnection between generation, distribution, storage, and the demand side of the meter – allows us to deliver holistic strategies that improve and modernize next generation energy infrastructure. We connect knowledge and experience across our global framework to bring together a unique combination of engineers, planners, scientists, and project managers who advance cleaner, secure, and more sustainable energy solutions.

Job Title: Recovery Technician Supervisor

Reports To: Clinical Director

Location: Loveland, CO

Facility: Northpoint Colorado (Adult inpatient)

Schedule: Friday-Tuesday 8am-5pm

Compensation: $55,000-70,000/year

Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC began 2009 as Ashwood Outpatient and officially launched the Northpoint platform in 2015. Now celebrating 10 years of growth in 2025, Northpoint is a leading behavioral healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment for adults with substance use and co-occurring disorders through the Northpoint Recovery brand, and mental health treatment for adolescents through Imagine by Northpoint. Operating under an in-network, commercial insurance model, Northpoint has grown exclusively through de novo expansion—from two facilities to seventeen across the Western U.S.—with more planned in both existing and new markets. We’re guided by core values of humility, heart, inspiration, and conviction. Our mission is simple: saving lives and restoring relationships by helping people get their lives back, and treating every individual with empathy and respect.

POSITION SUMMARY: As a key member of the Northpoint team, the Recovery Technician Supervisor is responsible for assisting with facility operations, championing on-boarding efforts of new staff and ongoing training efforts for all staff, attending to the safety and wellbeing of patients, and working with a multidisciplinary treatment team in accordance with policy and procedure, to provide the best possible patient care. In this supervisory role this position is responsible for auditing, training, and managing Recovery Tech processes and compliance with all of the following; observation checks for all shifts, facility checklists, room cleanliness and safety, patient transportation, patient and belongings search, patient consents, and admissions processes. This position plays an important role in the implementation of programming and care plans by providing direct and indirect patient care that complies with Northpoint policies and procedures for unlicensed staff. This person will also serve as the subject matter expert on the Rec Tech role. This position will actively support the structure of the milieu through appropriate resource allocation and supervision of patients. The Recovery Technician Supervisor works in a variety of settings throughout the week, including onsite at the facility and other community activities as directed by the Clinical Director.

• Facilitate and support new hire training efforts to ensure they receive the appropriate training and education needed, compliance with policies and procedures, and the safety and wellbeing of patients

• Identify opportunities to train and develop Recovery Tech staff to improve moral, efficiency, safety, patient wellbeing, experience, and outcomes

• Manage schedules, coverage and team needs

• Safely transport patients in Company provided vehicle

• Interact routinely with patients, observe behaviors and communicate significant observations to clinical staff

• Follow reporting and communication guidelines when interacting with staff and patients

• Timely completion and accuracy of paperwork, including daily logs and forms

• Solely responsible to complete and manage observation checks for all shifts on a regular basis

• Facilitate referrals to other healthcare providers

• Assist patients with their needs and collaborate with onsite clinical and medical staff as necessary

• Facilitate and assist with selected activity and education group sessions; document timely and accurately according to established policies and procedures

• Assist in orientation of new patient admissions

• Utilize therapeutic communication skills and maintain professional boundaries with patients and their families

• Participate in the inventory process and monitor delegated vendor supplies

• Be a role model for patients and create a positive culture with staff by emulating professional attitude, language, and communication

• Assist with treatment planning and discharge planning

• Document information regarding client care and behavior as required in established policies and procedures

• Utilize de-escalation skills when exposed to volatile clients in an effort to maintain personal safety while also ensuring safety for the clients, and other individuals in the program

• Assist counseling and administrative staff in responding to emergency situations

• Maintain confidentiality in accordance with established policies and procedures and standards of care

• Adhere to all Company policies and procedures

• Perform other job-related duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be at least twenty-one (21) years of age

• 2+ years of management experience required

• 2+ years of relevant work experience

• Enthusiasm, passion for working with people, and an internal drive to improve the lives of individuals in our care

• Knowledge and skills in English usage, interpersonal relationships and excellent communication skills

• Must have the ability to implement and interpret the programs, goals, objectives, policies, and procedures of the department

• Demonstrated ability to hold strong personal boundaries and ability to build rapport with patients

• Knowledge of surrounding geographic area to ensure effective and efficient routing

• Ability to organize and prioritize competing priorities and work time to balance demands

• Must perform proficiently in all competency areas including but not limited to: patient rights, and safety and sanitation

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

• Excellent organizational abilities

• Excellent written and oral communication skills

• Attention to detail and accuracy

• Client service oriented (both internal and external)

• Ability to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of organization

• Strong interpersonal skills to handle sensitive situations and confidential information

• Ability to multi-task and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment

• Proficiency with PC and Microsoft Office Suite

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.



What You'll Do

As Hadrian's first product marketer you will drive how the market understands what we build and the impact it has. You'll work closely with Brand, Federal, Sales, Recruiting, and Hadrian leadership. This is a new function that you will have the opportunity to help shape from the ground up.

 - Set the positioning for every Hadrian offering: what we call it, who it’s for, and why it beats the alternatives. Embed with our engineers and customers until you can make the technical case to a customer’s engineering team as well as their executives.

 - Translate technical differentiation into mission impact. Write the copy and make the media that show what our offerings do and why they matter. Find the proof in schedule, quality, and throughput, keeping positioning connected to customer results.

 - Equip every team that carries Hadrian's story with the narratives, competitive positioning, and product demos they need. Run win/loss reviews with Sales and share what you learn with Product to sharpen the story.

 - Build the product marketing team: hire the specialists who join you, and develop a bench of design, video, and writing contractors you can call on.

What We're Looking For

 - You've defined positioning and go to market for technically complex products. For most people that means 8+ years, but we care more about what you've owned than how long you've been doing it. You learn complex systems quickly and turn them into clear, credible narratives. Engineers trust your technical explanations, whether they work here or at a customer. Your path may run through product marketing, technical marketing, engineering, or technical design.

 - You use AI every day to move faster on research, writing, design, and production. Be ready to walk us through a workflow you rebuilt with AI and what it changed.

 - High agency builder. You've been first or early in a function, found what was missing, and built it without waiting for a brief. You have a portfolio of work you personally made and can tell us which parts were yours.

 - Driven by the mission and the tempo. Rebuilding the industrial base matters to you, and you care about shipping at the pace our customers and teams need.

What Will Set You Apart

 - Experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defense, robotics, or industrial hardware, including selling to government customers or large primes.

 - You write sharp copy and design strong slides, diagrams, and product graphics yourself, and you have the taste to direct designers and video editors when the work calls for a specialist.

 - A background in engineering, industrial design, or technical design.

 - A track record of content and positioning you can tie to business outcomes, such as pipeline, closed deals, or hires.

 - Video editing, motion design, or 3D skills.

 - Experience hiring contractors and growing a team around your work.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the role

Flex is on a mission to change the way bills get paid, starting with rent. We give renters more flexibility and control over one of their biggest monthly expenses, and we give the property management companies we partner with a modern, easy way to offer that flexibility to their residents. As we grow, we're looking for our next SDR to help bring more Property Management Companies into the Flex family.

This is a foundational role on a high-performing sales team, and it's designed to be the start of a real career, not just a first job. You'll be on the front lines building the pipeline that fuels our growth — and you'll be developed deliberately from day one through the Flex Sales Onboarding & Enablement, not just thrown into the deep end.

Where you'll work: This role is hybrid out of our Salt Lake City office (Lehi, UT), and you'll be in with the team 3 days a week. We're big believers that some of the best coaching, energy, and deals happen in person (and honestly, the team is pretty fun to be around). As a bonus, you'll get a Grubhub credit for lunch on the days you're in the office.

Where you'll travel: Beyond SLC, you'll get out of the office for company offsites in Mexico and our Sales Kickoff in Florida as well as onboarding in NYC , both built for big wins, big energy, and time to connect with the team outside the day to day grind.

What You’ll Do

• Win new client relationships, driving revenue and market share across the rental real estate space.

• Manage a robust pipeline in our CRM, keeping it sharp and up to date.

• Tailor creative prospecting approaches for different personas across each business you target.

• Establish relationships with senior executives and decision-makers through smart, persistent outbound efforts.

• Follow up quickly and efficiently on every inbound lead you receive.

• Educate prospective customers on how Flex helps property management companies offer their residents real financial flexibility.

• Collaborate with our Accounts team to shape strategic adoption plans for new customers.

• Take initiative, jumping into ad-hoc projects across the sales org.

You Could Be a Great Fit If

jobs.title: Senior Contracts Specialist
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

Nobody has written the contracts for manufacturing in orbit and returning product to Earth at hypersonic speeds. You will.

As Senior Contracts Specialist, you’ll own first-of-kind agreements across microgravity pharmaceutical manufacturing, hypersonic reentry vehicles, and novel government space programs. You’ll work directly with the Contracts Manager on a lean team, where one person’s work visibly moves the company. When you remove a blocker, a mission moves forward. When you protect Varda’s interests well, we can take on bigger bets.

You’ll manage the full contract lifecycle across government and commercial customers: pre-award strategy and proposal support, negotiation, FAR/DFARS compliance, export-control management, and post-award execution and closeout. Your judgment and cross-functional communication will directly determine how fast Varda can move.

What You’ll Do

• Represent Varda as the counterpart contracting officer for government and commercial missions

• Lead or support negotiations with customers, building strong working relationships while protecting the company’s interests

• Clear the path to signature quickly, finding the structure that works for both sides

• Keep mission management, operations, proposals, sales, product, and leadership aligned with signed contracts and regulations

• Own compliance with the FAR, DFARS, and export-control regulations

• Run contract closeout, including final deliveries, payments, and resolving open issues

• Maintain accurate contract and business files

• Advise leadership on Varda’s rights and obligations under its agreements

• Draft, review, and negotiate NDAs, customer agreements, partnership agreements, and other contracts

What You Bring

• BA/BS in law, business, finance, or a related field (equivalent professional experience considered)

• 4–6 years of hands-on contract management experience, with an emphasis on government contracts

• Experience with Firm Fixed Price (FFP) and Other Transaction Authority (OTA) agreements

• Working knowledge of compliance under the FAR, DFARS, and NASA FAR Supplement (NFS)

• Experience negotiating NDAs

• A track record of making persuasive written and verbal arguments in negotiations

• The ability to juggle competing priorities and hit aggressive deadlines

• Experience with export-controlled materials under ITAR and EAR

• Willingness to travel up to 10% as needed

• Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret clearance

• This is a full-time, 100% on-site role in El Segundo, CA

Bonus Points

• Active Top Secret/SCI eligible clearance

• Experience structuring commercial agreements in dual-use or regulated technology environments, including IP licensing, data rights, or export-controlled deliverables

• Hands-on experience in spacecraft integration, satellite manufacturing, or GMP/regulated pharmaceutical production, where process discipline and documentation integrity are non-negotiable

Compensation

• Base salary: $155,000–$175,000 per year

• Stock options and/or long-term cash awards, so you share in what we build

• On-site in El Segundo, CA

• Leveling and base salary are determined by job-related skills, education, experience, and performance

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.title: Ground Software Engineer, Top Secret Clearance
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

As a Software Engineer on our Ground Software team, you are responsible for creating the software that is used to build, test, and fly our satellites and customer payloads. You will build upon the mission software platform used to fly K2's Gravitas satellite, developing new capabilities and automation as we scale to support multiple constellations. You will collaborate closely with internal Mission Operations and Flight Software teams to define and implement our overall mission architecture, and you will work with external customers to scope and deliver software that meets their payload needs.

You will have the opportunity to work in exciting, interdisciplinary domains like: satellite command and control, constellation operations, mission automation, radio communications, astrodynamics, and more.

**This role requires in person presence at our headquarters in Torrance, CA.**

Responsibilities

• Design and implement software that facilitates the build, test, and operations of K2's vehicles and our customers' payloads

• Collaborate with Mission Operators and Engineers across the company to identify and scope software solutions to complex technical and business problems

• Facilitate software design reviews, architecture discussions, and code reviews to align stakeholders on technical direction

• Work across our stack (Rust backend, TypeScript/Vue frontend) to support development, test, and operations milestones

• Support internal and external customers in an on-call capacity as your software is used to drive ground test activities and on-orbit spacecraft operations

• Mentor other engineers to build a strong team culture and software engineering practices

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, math, or a STEM discipline or 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering

• Top Secret Clearance

Nice-to-Have

• Experience working on space missions and/or the satellite ground segment

• Experience with Rust or another statically-typed backend programming language (Go, C++, Java, C#, TypeScript)

• Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend development tooling (Vue, React, Svelte)

• Experience with version control, continuous integration, build, deployment, monitoring

• Experience developing HTTP or gRPC APIs

• Experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL or similar)

• Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures

• Experience developing reliable, scalable systems

• Experience with Docker and/or Kubernetes

• Experience with WebSockets and/or Server-Sent-Events (SSE)

• Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices and relevant certifications/standards (SOC2, FedRAMP)

• Familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, UDP, QUIC)

• Familiarity with data streaming technologies such as NATS, Pulsar, or similar

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range for this role is $123,000 - $150,000 + equity in the company

• Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

ABOUT REDUCTO
