Core Expectations

• Problem-solving mindset: You structure ambiguous problems precisely before reaching for a tool, AI or otherwise

• Ownership mentality: You take responsibility for your work from framing the question through delivering the recommendation and tracking its impact

• AI-native working style: You use AI tooling (Claude Code or equivalent) as a genuine development partner: delegating discrete tasks, reviewing outputs critically, and running parallel workstreams

• Curiosity and initiative: You ask whether the product is making people’s lives meaningfully better, not just whether a feature moved a metric

Desired Experience & Qualifications

• 5+ years in an analytics, data science, or decision science role at a consumer tech company

• Advanced degree in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, quantitative social science, operations research) or equivalent practical experience

• Demonstrated experience with causal inference methods in applied settings (e.g., difference-in-differences, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, synthetic controls, propensity score matching)

• Track record of influencing product or business strategy through data, with specific examples of cross-functional impact

• Experience with experimentation platforms (Statsig, Optimizely, or similar)

• Proficiency in SQL and Python/R for statistical analysis

• Experience building dbt models or contributing to analytics engineering workflows

• Experience with retention analytics driven by a high quality product experience

• Experience with subscription or freemium business models

• Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns

• Learning & Development programs

• Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment

• Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

• Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.

• Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

• Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.

Our Commitment to Belonging

We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT STUUT

Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank.


Over 150 companies, spanning the mid-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date.


Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai http://stuut.ai. 




THE ROLE

We're hiring our first Design Engineer to own how Stuut looks, feels, and works — from first sketch to production code. Reporting to the Head of Product & Design, you'll work alongside our engineers and Product Manager across every surface finance teams touch.

Stuut's design problem is a systems problem. AI agents act on behalf of AR teams — sending outreach, triaging disputes, answering questions in Ask Stuut. Finance teams configure how those agents behave through Playbooks, Payment Plans, and approval rules. And collectors spend all day in dense, data-heavy worklists of invoices, customers, and cash. Your job is to make all of it legible: agents a controller can trust with their cash, thousands of invoices that scan in seconds, and configuration that is powerful without being intimidating.

Engineers at Stuut own features end to end and have historically pulled design in when they need it. This role closes that gap. You'll design and ship the work yourself, and raise the bar for everyone else's UI through shared patterns and components.

What Success Looks Like

Within 12 months, Stuut's core surfaces — agent activity, collections worklists, Ask Stuut, and configuration — share one coherent component system and interaction model. Engineers ship new UI from those patterns without waiting on design, and customers can see what Stuut's agents did, why, and what needs their approval.

What You'll Do

 - Own design and frontend end to end: Take product areas from customer problem to shipped code across the Stuut dashboard and the payer-facing experiences our customers' customers see.

 - Make AI agents legible: Design how agent actions, reasoning, approvals, and audit trails show up so finance teams trust automation with their cash.

 - Tame data-heavy workflows: Make invoices, disputes, payment plans, cash application, and customer hierarchies scannable and fast — without hiding the advanced controls power users need.

 - Build the design system: Own Stuut's component library, tokens, and interaction patterns so every engineer ships consistent UI by default.

 - Settle debates with prototypes: Put working prototypes in front of customers in days, not weeks, before we commit engineering time.

 - Stay close to customers: Join calls with collectors, AR managers, and controllers, and use product analytics to define success and guide tradeoffs.

 - Own post-launch quality: Craft, accessibility, performance, empty/loading/error states, instrumentation, and edge cases are yours after launch, not just before it.

 - Build with agents: Use coding agents daily to prototype and ship quickly, while owning the testing and debugging of what they produce.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU…

 - Show shipped work: Your portfolio shows things you identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned from.

 - Write production frontend: You have strong production experience with React and TypeScript and are comfortable in a large existing codebase.

 - Design with craft: You bring strong visual and interaction design, and have made complex, data-dense B2B products clear.

 - Move across the stack: You're comfortable reasoning about APIs, data models, and implementation details, not just the UI layer.

 - Decide with evidence: You use customer research and product data to make decisions — and to revise them.

 - Work agent-native: You use coding agents every day and can explain and stand behind their output.

 - Thrive in ambiguity: You've done your best work at a fast-growing startup with high ownership and incomplete information.

There's no required background. We care about shipped work and judgment.

Nice to Have 
You've designed AI agent or copilot experiences — human-in-the-loop approvals, explainability, or conversational analytics.

 - You've worked in fintech, B2B payments, ERP, or AR/AP workflows.

 - You've built a design system or component library that other engineers adopted.

 - You've designed data visualization or operational dashboards.

 - You've built enterprise configuration surfaces: permissions, org hierarchies, or rules engines.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Datacenter Engineering
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here.  We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Physical Infrastructure Engineering who is passionate about the electrical, mechanical, and controls engineering that keeps leading-edge AI/GPU infrastructure running reliably at scale.

As Senior Manager of Physical Infrastructure Engineering, you will lead a multidisciplinary engineering team — electrical, mechanical, controls/automation, and infrastructure engineering and construction — responsible for the standards, specifications, and technical decisions that every new build, retrofit, and deployment across DigitalOcean's global footprint must meet. You are the technical authority for data center infrastructure: Design & Deployment executes floor layouts and installs against your team’s standards; you own the standards themselves, the engineering judgment behind them, and the reliability outcomes that follow. This role reports directly to the VP of Data Center Operations & Engineering.

What You’ll Do:

• Lead and grow a multidisciplinary team covering electrical, mechanical, controls/automation, and data center infrastructure engineering and construction.

• Develop and own engineering standards and specifications for AI/GPU data centers, including liquid cooling (CDU sizing, secondary loop design, leak detection), power distribution, and controls/automation.

• Serve as the technical authority and final engineering escalation point for infrastructure issues that Site Operations and Design & Deployment cannot resolve at their level.

• Provide engineering due diligence on new colocation and build-to-suit facilities before signing — power capacity, cooling topology, electrical infrastructure condition, and expansion feasibility.

• Own vendor and OEM infrastructure engineering relationships (e.g., CDU, UPS, generator, and switchgear manufacturers) — drive root-cause engagements when infrastructure fails, and hold vendors accountable for design defects, not just field service.

• Lead or sponsor root-cause analysis for infrastructure-driven incidents, and own the resulting engineering corrective actions through to verified completion, not just documentation.

• Own infrastructure specifications, technical documentation, and change governance — nothing changes at the infrastructure layer without engineering sign-off.

• Partner with Site Operations, Deployment, Construction, and Design organizations to ensure engineering standards are practical to build and operate, not just technically correct on paper.

• Track and report on infrastructure reliability metrics across the fleet, and prioritize engineering investment against the highest-risk, highest-recurrence failure modes.

• Lead compliance review of infrastructure standards against relevant codes and safety requirements (e.g., NFPA 70E, electrical code, two-person energized work rules) in partnership with Legal and EHS.

• Build and maintain an audit process for reviewing existing sites against current engineering standards, and prioritize remediation of out-of-compliance assets.

• Manage outsourced engineering talent where required to keep up with workload

• Develop engineering and construction talent on your team and build a succession plan for key technical authority roles

Travel: Expect 20–30% travel for new-site due diligence, commissioning support, and vendor/OEM engineering reviews.

Key Metrics:

• Reduction in infrastructure-driven incidents and repeat failure modes (risk-to-reoccur trending down, not flat).

• Standardization coverage — percentage of fleet reviewed and brought into compliance with current engineering standards.

• Time-to-root-cause and time-to-corrective-action on infrastructure engineering escalations.

• Reliable engineering support of new-site expansion (due diligence turnaround time, defect-free commissioning).

• Scalability of the engineering organization relative to footprint growth.

What You’ll Add to DigitalOcean:

• BS in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or related Engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 10+ years in mission-critical engineering, including direct experience with data center infrastructure.

• 5+ years leading engineering teams, including hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical talent.

• 5+ years experience managing outsourced engineering teams

• Deep hands-on experience with liquid cooling systems (chillers, heat exchangers, pumps, CDUs, secondary loop design, leak detection and mitigation), UPS, generators, switchgear, and controls/automation platforms.

• Experience running or directly supporting root-cause analysis with OEMs on infrastructure component failures, and translating vendor findings into engineering decisions (e.g., accept, mitigate, or mandate replacement).

• Working knowledge of relevant electrical, mechanical, and safety codes (NFPA 70E, local electrical code) and experience partnering with Legal/EHS on compliance reviews.

• Experience conducting technical due diligence on data center facilities (colocation or build-to-suit) prior to lease or construction commitment.

• Track record of building engineering standards that scale across multiple sites and hold up under rapid, concurrent expansion.

Compensation Range:

• $156,800 - $196,000

• AI Enablement: We help developers at ZipRecruiter leverage AI as a part of their tech stack by building and maintaining an agentic AI data exploration and analysis tool to democratize access to data, collaborate on insights, and accelerate data driven decision making. Starting from a natural language chat interface, the AI assisted tool assists with every aspect of using data, from finding the right data sources and writing queries to using them to visualize and analyze the results. We also manage an LLM Gateway which powers all of ZipRecruiter’s LLM usage in our customer facing products.

• Big Data Processing: You'll tackle challenges with large, evolving datasets, using a mix of batch and streaming techniques to make critical trade-offs between speed, efficiency, and reliability.

• MLOps: Design, build, deploy, and maintain frameworks and systems that accelerate ML development across teams and products at ZipRecruiter, with the goals of improving the velocity, quality, observability, and reliability of ML development and ML powered products.

• Experience deploying and operating containerized services and batch jobs

• Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and testing

This product specialist internship will be an opportunity to contribute to the web and mobile experiences that drive audience engagement, action, and giving. jobs.title: Manager of Pricing
jobs.description:
We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions.

As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem.  With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace.

Position summary

The Manager of Pricing leads pricing administration for RxSense's Enterprise clients and pharmacy partners, with MAC management as the core of the role. This person owns the creation and maintenance of MAC lists and MAC pricing adjustments, monitors pricing performance against client and pharmacy guarantees, and ensures pricing is applied accurately across clients. The Manager of Pricing is the team's go-to resource for pricing strategy and complex problem-solving, and a trusted advisor to the business on pricing decisions. The role partners closely with Client Experience, Network Operations, Clinical, Underwriting, and our AI and data teams, who support the reporting and technical tooling behind our pricing processes. The Manager of Pricing also leads and develops the pricing team and performs ad hoc analysis on client and pharmacy performance.

Responsibilities

• Own MAC management for the Enterprise book: create, maintain, and update MAC lists, including client-specific and dedicated lists, so pricing is accurate, competitive, and aligned with client and pharmacy contracts.

• Manage MAC factor and multiplier adjustments across clients, with quality assurance on every pricing export and upload before it goes live.

• Monitor client and pharmacy pricing performance against contractual guarantees, surface gaps early, and develop pricing strategies to close them before year-end reconciliation.

• Build and administer pricing for new and renewing clients, partnering with Client Experience and implementation teams so pricing is set up correctly and on time for each go-live.

• Resolve MAC pricing escalations, appeals, and complex pricing tickets, and serve as the escalation point for pricing questions across the business.

• Review client and pharmacy contract terms for pricing implications, and maintain accurate contract and pricing information as the basis for performance tracking.

• Support quarterly and annual reconciliation of client and pharmacy contracts, and produce reporting and analysis for leadership on contract compliance and pricing performance.

• Prioritize the inbound flow of pricing requests, set clear turnaround expectations with the business, and keep the team focused on the highest-value work.

• Partner with Network Operations, Clinical, and Underwriting on pricing decisions that affect pharmacy networks, formulary, and new-business proposals.

• Partner with the AI and data teams, who own the technical tooling, to define requirements for and adopt automated pricing tools, including algorithmic MAC management for a broader set of clients.

• Lead, coach, and develop the pricing team, building documented, repeatable processes so MAC management has no single point of failure.

• Perform ad hoc analysis on client and pharmacy performance, including volume trends, drug seasonality, and financial results.

What success looks like

• MAC management runs reliably, with documented processes and no single point of failure.

• Client and pharmacy guarantees are tracked and on plan, including through new client implementations.

• The pricing team has a clear go-to for strategy and problem-solving, and the business has clear turnaround expectations.

• Automated pricing tools from the AI and data teams are part of the team's regular workflow.

Qualifications

• Hands-on experience owning MAC management in a PBM or pharmacy setting: building and maintaining MAC lists, managing MAC factor adjustments, and quality-checking pricing before it goes live.

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business, Economics, or a related field;

• 5 + years of PBM or retail pharmacy pricing experience, including direct MAC management, with at least two years in a supervisory or lead capacity; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Working knowledge of PBM pricing economics, including client and pharmacy contract terms, pricing guarantees, and reconciliation.

• Experience monitoring pricing performance against guarantees and turning variance into corrective pricing actions.

• Experience setting up pricing for client implementations and renewals on tight timelines.

• Ability to explain pricing clearly to non-technical partners and serve as a steady, credible resource to the business on pricing decisions.

• Experience leading, coaching, or mentoring analysts and building documented, repeatable processes.

• Advanced Excel skills.

• SQL, Tableau, or other BI tools experience is preferred.

• Experience adopting automated or AI-enabled pricing tools as a business owner, not necessarily as a builder is preferred.

• Experience in a high-growth healthcare technology company is preferred.

Salary Range: $110,000 - $140,000

RxSense believes that a diverse workforce is a more talented and productive workforce. As such, we are an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. Our recruitment process is free from discriminatory hiring practices and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, or national origin.  Neither will qualified applicants be discriminated against on the basis of disability or protected veteran status.  We believe in the strength of the collaboration, creativity and sense of community a diverse workforce brings.

La ACLU de Puerto Rico busca una persona bilingüe para ocupar el puesto de pasante en el área de Legales y Comunicaciones, con el fin de apoyar su labor en la promoción de los derechos civiles. Esta posición tiene ubicación híbrida y es tiempo parcial.

Los solicitantes que califiquen deben ser actualmente estudiantes de derecho matriculados. El solicitante debe estar ubicado en los EE. UU. durante toda la duración de la pasantía.

Descripción general

La ACLU de Puerto Rico es una filial de la Unión Americana por las Libertades Civiles (ACLU). La ACLU es una organización nacional, sin fines de lucro y no partidista, dedicada a proteger las libertades fundamentales y los derechos civiles básicos garantizados por la Constitución de los Estados Unidos y sus leyes de derechos civiles.

La ACLU de Puerto Rico tiene un interés permanente en los derechos civiles y democráticos de las personas dentro de la jurisdicción del archipiélago y otros territorios estadounidenses, quienes deben tener pleno derecho a las protecciones y derechos constitucionales, ya sea que residan en los territorios federales o en cualquiera de los cincuenta estados o el Distrito de Columbia.

La persona pasante de Asuntos Legales y Comunicaciones trabajará en estrecha colaboración con los departamentos de comunicaciones y asuntos legales. Durante la pasantía, la persona candidata seleccionada tendrá la oportunidad de adquirir experiencia práctica en la preparación y el seguimiento de solicitudes de información pública; desarrollar habilidades de investigación y redacción legal mediante apoyo supervisado en litigios; desarrollar un proyecto de investigación que evalúe la transparencia gubernamental en Puerto Rico; participar en el desarrollo de materiales y talleres de educación pública; y aprender cómo la defensa legal, las comunicaciones estratégicas y la participación ciudadana pueden trabajar juntas para promover los derechos civiles y la rendición de cuentas del gobierno.

Responsabilidades clave

• Apoyo en litigios Asistir al Departamento Legal en la identificación e investigación de posibles casos relacionados con violaciones del derecho de acceso a documentos e información pública Realizar investigaciones legales y preparar memorandos, resúmenes de casos y materiales de apoyo para litigios en curso o potenciales. Apoyar la preparación de presentaciones legales, apelaciones y otros documentos bajo la supervisión de una persona abogada

• Investigación y análisis Apoyar la elaboración de un informe que evalúe el estado del acceso a documentos e información públicos en Puerto Rico tras las enmiendas más recientes a la Ley de Transparencia Recopilar y organizar información sobre las prácticas de las agencias, las solicitudes de acceso a registros públicos, los avances legales y las controversias relacionadas con la transparencia

• Comunicación y educación pública Ayudar a desarrollar talleres bilingües y materiales educativos sobre el derecho de acceso a documentos e información públicos Apoyar la divulgación a periodistas, estudiantes, organizaciones comunitarias y otros grupos interesados en presentar solicitudes de acceso a documentos e información públicos

Requisitos

• Estar cursando actualmente el tercer o cuarto año de un programa de Doctorado en Jurisprudencia (Juris Doctor) o ser egresado de una facultad de derecho acreditada

• Gran interés en los derechos civiles, el derecho constitucional, la transparencia gubernamental y la libertad de expresión e información

• Excelentes habilidades de investigación, redacción y análisis jurídico

• Se requiere dominio profesional del español y el inglés, tanto escrito como hablado

• Excelentes habilidades organizativas y atención al detalle

• Capacidad para gestionar tareas de forma independiente y cumplir con los plazos

• Demostrar conocimiento de los procesos bajo la Ley de Transparencia de Puerto Rico y la Ley federal de Libertad de Información (FOIA, por sus siglas en inglés)

Detalles de la pasantía

Horario: A tiempo parcial; el horario se determinará según las necesidades de la organización y la disponibilidad académica, con un mínimo de 10 horas semanales.

Duración: A partir del 11 o' 25 de Enero de 2027.

o A tiempo parcial: 12 semanas consecutivas / 10, 15 o 20 horas semanales.

· Remuneración: Los estudiantes de derecho o recién graduados recibirán un estipendio de $24 por hora.

· Documentos para la solicitud: Currículum, carta de presentación y cualquier publicación, muestra de redacción, caso legal u otro documento que demuestre su experiencia o conocimientos en materia de derechos civiles.

Por qué la ACLU:

Durante más de 100 años, la ACLU ha trabajado para defender y preservar los derechos y libertades individuales garantizados por la Constitución y las leyes de los Estados Unidos. Ya sea poniendo fin al encarcelamiento masivo, alcanzando la igualdad total para la comunidad LGBTQ+, estableciendo nuevas protecciones de privacidad para nuestra era digital, o preservando el derecho al voto o el derecho a abortar, la ACLU se encarga de los casos y temas de libertades civiles más difíciles para defender a todas las personas.

Nuestro Compromiso con la Accesibilidad, la Equidad, la Diversidad y la Inclusión

La accesibilidad, la equidad, la diversidad y la inclusión son valores fundamentales de la ACLU y centrales en nuestro trabajo para promover la libertad, la igualdad y la justicia para todos. Para nosotros, la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión no son solo actividades para marcar casillas, sino una oportunidad para generar un cambio significativo a largo plazo. Somos una comunidad comprometida con el aprendizaje y el crecimiento, la humildad y la gracia, la transparencia y la responsabilidad. Creemos en una responsabilidad colectiva para crear una cultura de de inclusión para todas las personas dentro de nuestra organización, que respete y valore las diferencias; trate a todos de manera equitativa; y empodere a nuestros colegas para hacer el mejor trabajo posible. Estamos tan comprometidos con la lucha contra la opresión y el racismo internamente como lo estamos externamente. Porque ya sea en los tribunales o en la oficina, creemos que 'Nosotros, el Pueblo' significa todos nosotros. Con este compromiso en mente, alentamos fuertemente las solicitudes de todas las personas calificadas sin importar su raza, color, religión, género, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, edad, origen nacional, estado civil, ciudadanía, discapacidad, condición de veterano y antecedentes de arresto o condena, o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley aplicable.

Con este compromiso en mente, animamos mucho a que todas las personas calificadas presenten su solicitud, sin importar su raza, color, religión, género, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, edad, origen nacional, estado civil, ciudadanía, discapacidad, condición de veterano y antecedentes de arresto o condena, o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley aplicable.

Para mantener la integridad de nuestro proceso de evaluación, por favor evita usar chatbots con inteligencia artificial, motores de búsqueda o herramientas de asistencia en tiempo real para generar tu CV, carta de presentación o muestra de escritura (si se requiere). Queremos entender mejor tus habilidades individuales y tu proceso de pensamiento. Si necesitas herramientas de IA u otra tecnología de asistencia como ajuste razonable debido a una discapacidad, por favor completa el Formulario de Solicitud (Accommodation Request Form ) de Ajuste para que podamos garantizar una experiencia accesible y equitativa.

Para ser considerado para este puesto, todos los candidatos deben enviar formalmente una solicitud. La ACLU no acepta llamadas o correos electrónicos no solicitados de los candidatos sobre el estado de su solicitud.

jobs.title: Head of Operation Transformation and Excellence
jobs.description:
Prudential’s purpose is to be partners for every life and protectors for every future. Our purpose encourages everything we do by creating a culture in which diversity is celebrated and inclusion assured, for our people, customers, and partners. We provide a platform for our people to do their best work and make an impact to the business, and we support our people’s career ambitions. We pledge to make Prudential a place where you can Connect, Grow, and Succeed.

ROLE PURPOSE

This role leads large-scale transformation of the operations value chain — new business, underwriting, policy servicing, claims, and customer management — toward a digital-first, automated, and data-driven operating model, while simultaneously driving continuous improvement, service quality, and operational reengineering in day-to-day operations. The mandate spans changing the machine and keeping it running at peak: transformation programs deliver step-change capability, and the excellence discipline measures, stabilizes, and continuously optimizes the results.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operations Transformation

· Define and own operations transformation roadmap aligned to company strategy and growth targets

· Lead end-to-end delivery of transformation programs: digital onboarding, straight-through processing (STP), workflow automation core policy admin system modernization, and paperless servicing.

· Redesign target operating models—including organizational structures and end-to-end process architectures—to deliver a seamless customer journey through an integrated, one-stop service model.

· Build business cases for transformation investments; secure budget and track benefits realization (cost savings, TAT reduction, NPS uplift…)

· Manage transformation governance: steering committees, program status reporting, risk and dependency management across workstreams

· Lead change management and adoption — communications, training, and capability building for impacted operations teams

· Scan the market for Insurtech, automation, and AI capabilities; run pilots and scale proven solutions

Operations Excellence

· Own the operations performance management framework: KPIs/SLAs for turnaround time, accuracy, productivity, unit cost, and customer satisfaction across all operations functions

· Lead continuous improvement programs using Lean Six Sigma methodology; build and manage a pipeline of improvement projects with quantified impact.

· Conduct in-depth process reviews and root cause analyses to address pain points and increase the straight-through processing (STP) rate across the Operations value stream.

· Standardize operational processes; maintain comprehensive SOP libraries, process maps, and control documentation; and own the quality assurance framework

· Design and run capacity planning and workforce management models to balance service levels against cost

· Partner with Risk and Compliance to strengthen operational controls and support audit readiness.

· Leverage AI-powered solutions to reengineer ways of working and accelerate Operations modernization.

Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

· Partner with IT, Distribution, Actuarial, and Compliance Risk, Legal to ensure solutions meet regulatory and risk requirements.

· Collaborate with regional teams on roadmap alignment, adoption of Group platforms and standards, benchmarking, and best-practice sharing

· Produce management reporting and insights on operational health and transformation progress for CO and executive committee.

· Build and lead a combined team of program managers, business analysts, process engineers, and quality analysts; manage vendors and system integrators

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

· *Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent preferred.

· 12–15+ years of experience spanning insurance operations, transformation, and process improvement, with 5+ years in senior leadership; life insurance domain strongly preferred

· Proven track record delivering large, cross-functional transformation programs (process digitization, core system replacement, automation at scale).

· Demonstrated results in operational excellence: measurable improvements in cost, quality, and turnaround time; Lean Six Sigma Black Belt strongly preferred

· Strong knowledge of life insurance processes: new business, underwriting, policy servicing, claims, and distribution support.

· Experience with automation and digital technologies: RPA, OCR/IDP, workflow platforms, AI/GenAI use cases in operations

· Advanced analytical skills; proficiency with BI tools (Power BI..) for performance analytics.

· Experience in a matrixed multinational environment and program management certification (PMP, Prince2, SAFe) are advantages

COMPETENCIES

· Strategic thinking with hands-on execution discipline — equally comfortable setting multiyear direction and diving into daily operational detail

· Strong stakeholder management up to C-level; ability to influence without authority

Financial acumen — business case development, benefits tracking, and cost management

· Rigorous analytical problem-solving (DMAIC, root cause analysis) with strong control and compliance orientation.

· Change leadership in legacy-heavy environments; coaching skills to build improvement capability in others

· Data-driven decision-making and comfort with ambiguity

jobs.title: Senior Translational Immunologist, Translational Science Hub
jobs.description:
About the job

• Job title: Senior Scientist, External Innovation
• Location: Woolloongabba, Australia
• Job type: Permanent, Full time

We are seeking an exceptional Senior Scientist, External Innovation to serve as a critical bridge between Sanofi's TSH and the vibrant academic and research ecosystem across Queensland and Australia. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of translational science by identifying, evaluating, and fostering strategic collaborations that bring cutting-edge academic expertise and capabilities into Sanofi's innovation pipeline.

As a key member of the TSH team, you will be an opportunity seeker and scientific scout—proactively engaging with academic institutions, research centers, and scientific experts to identify breakthrough technologies, methodologies, and research programs that align with Sanofi's strategic priorities in immunology, infectious diseases, vaccines, and beyond.

Our Team

Sanofi's Translational Science Hub (TSH) connects the external academic and research ecosystem with Sanofi's vaccines R&D innovation pipeline. We act as the bridge between breakthrough science happening in universities and research institutes, and the strategic priorities of our global vaccines business — turning promising discoveries in immunology, infectious diseases and related fields into real partnerships that advance human health.

What You'll Do

Strategic External Engagement & Opportunity Identification

• Build and maintain relationships with leading academics, research institutions, and scientific experts across Queensland, Australia, and APAC

• Serve as Sanofi's "eyes and ears" in the external scientific community, identifying emerging capabilities, technologies, and research programs with potential value for Sanofi vaccines R&D

• Assess scientific quality, strategic fit, and commercial potential of external opportunities, working closely with the Global Scientific and Strategic Partnership team

• Represent Sanofi at scientific conferences, symposia, and academic forums

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

• Work transversally across departments of vaccines R&D to align external innovation with internal priorities and capability gaps

• Translate complex scientific concepts for diverse audiences, from bench scientists to senior leadership

• Champion and facilitate external collaborations, including research proposals, agreements, joint publications, and knowledge exchange

• Monitor ongoing collaborations to ensure delivery of value and scientific excellence

Scientific Leadership

• Stay at the forefront of advances in immunology, infectious diseases, vaccines, chemistry, bioinformatics, and physiology

• Contribute insights on emerging trends and technologies to shape Sanofi's scientific strategy

• Mentor junior scientists and foster a culture of external innovation within the TSH

About You

Essential Qualifications & Experience

• PhD in immunology, infectious diseases, vaccinology, or related life sciences discipline (or equivalent research experience)
• Minimum 10+ years of experience in academic research (or industry?), with a strong publication record and demonstrated scientific excellence
• Deep scientific expertise in immunology, infectious diseases, and/or vaccines, with proven ability to work effectively across diverse scientific disciplines
• Demonstrated track record of building and maintaining productive collaborations with academic institutions, research organizations, or industry partners
• Strong understanding of the academic research landscape in Australia and internationally, with established networks in relevant scientific communities

Key Competencies & Attributes

• Independent yet collaborative: Ability to work autonomously with minimal supervision while thriving in team environments and fostering a highly collaborative mindset
• Transversal influencer: Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries, influence without authority, and build consensus among diverse stakeholders
• Opportunity seeker: Entrepreneurial mindset with a keen eye for identifying high-value scientific opportunities and translating them into actionable partnerships
• Proactive networker: Natural relationship builder who actively seeks out and engages with academic leaders, researchers, and scientific experts
• Strategic thinker: Ability to connect scientific opportunities to business value and articulate the strategic rationale for external collaborations
• Scientific versatility: Intellectual curiosity and ability to quickly grasp complex scientific concepts outside your core expertise
• Excellent communicator: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present complex scientific information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
• Cultural agility: Experience working in multicultural, global organizations and ability to navigate different organizational cultures (academic vs. industry)

Highly Desirable

• Experience in industry, translational research or bridging basic science to clinical applications
• Familiarity with mRNA technology platforms or vaccine development
• Prior experience in industry-academic partnerships or technology transfer
• Understanding of intellectual property, research agreements, and collaboration frameworks
• Experience with grant writing and research funding mechanisms
• Knowledge of Australian research funding landscape (NHMRC, ARC, MRFF, etc.)
• Established network within Queensland's biomedical research ecosystem

Pursue progress, discover extraordinary

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - Supply (12 months)
jobs.description:
Job Description :

Who are we:

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to local favourites like Bundaberg, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

About the Function:

Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

About the Role:

The Executive Assistant – Customer Service Director is a high-impact role supporting the Customer Service Director while helping coordinate key activities across the Huntingwood Supply organisation. You’ll be a trusted partner who keeps a complex executive agenda moving, anticipates priorities and ensures meetings, travel, communications and business activities run seamlessly.

Alongside executive support, you’ll play a key role in coordinating leadership visits, site events and employee engagement initiatives, connecting people and priorities across the site.

This is a fixed-term opportunity covering family leave from 1 December 2026 to 1 December 2027.

Role Responsibilities:

• Proactively manage the Customer Service Director complex calendar, priorities, meetings and follow-ups, ensuring time is focused on the most critical business priorities.
• Coordinate domestic and international travel, expenses, invoices and other executive administration with accuracy and confidentiality.
• Coordinate Supply Leadership meetings, workshops, town halls and key site activities, including agendas, meeting materials, rooms, technology and catering.
• Manage logistics for regional and global leadership visits to Huntingwood, coordinating site access, transportation, PPE, tours, agendas and stakeholder requirements.
• Support employee engagement activities including site celebrations, recognition, raffles, employee store initiatives and other events that contribute to a positive site experience.
• Prepare and coordinate executive presentations, meeting packs, correspondence and communications for the Supply Director and Leadership Team.
• Act as a proactive coordination point across Supply, site, regional and global stakeholders, anticipating needs, resolving issues and continuously improving ways of working.

Experience / Skills Required:

• Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Team Coordinator, Senior Administrator or similar role supporting senior leadership.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Conference Financial Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
The Manager for Global Conference Financial Strategy & Operations will support the Conference Production teams by managing the process and templates associated with monthly expense forecasting for over 50+ conferences. The associate will also evaluate trends of Gartner conferences in order to better plan for future events. A qualified candidate must be process driven, analytical, have the ability to multi-task and take pride in their work while being able to work in a fast-paced, self-directed, and collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Management of monthly financial forecast, assessing P&L to maintain global profit margins while guiding team on maximizing conference financials.

• Implementation of budget processes and templates for global team including annual budget creation, regular reporting and year-end closing of expense budget.

• Definition and guidance of strategic budget priorities, setting actions and timelines, coordinating internal meetings and acting as a point person for conference managers and planners.

• Creation of projection tools and analysis of key conference metrics to help grow and develop the conference portfolio.

• Presentation of accurate, consistent and actionable analysis and reports.

• Management of training sessions and creation of manuals to implement globally streamlined budgeting processes across multi-functional teams reaching over 120 peers.

• Cross-functional collaboration with multiple business units including Finance, Procurement, Marketing, Sales, and Research.

• Travel onsite approximately 10% to conferences.

Qualifications

• 4+ years of conference or event management experience, ideally large-scale production

• Proven budgeting and financial controls skills

• Project management experience

• Advanced Excel skills, comfortable in complex spreadsheets

• Communication and public relations skills

• Bachelor's Degree

This position will provide conference budget planning and analysis support to the Conference Operations team. Excel testing will be required. Candidates must be adept at advanced Excel, including pivot tables, data sorting, formula generation, and error correction of basic formulas. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Marketing Technology
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Our mission at Marketing Technology is to provide a state-of-the-art platform and measurement capabilities to enable marketing and product teams to engage with our customers effectively. Every day, millions of Airbnb customers are reached via our streamlined platform over comprehensive marketing channels such as Email, Push, SMS, Google Ads, and Facebook Ads. We deliver substantial business impact by enabling numerous stakeholders across the company, including Marketing (Brand and Performance), Guest, Host, Airbnb Org, Policy, and more.

The Difference You Will Make:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Segmentation & Insights Platform team, you’ll lead projects end-to-end and help shape how Airbnb reaches its guests and hosts. Our team builds the high-scale backend systems that segment guests, hosts, and other entities. These systems handle 100k+ requests per second and power marketing, in-app experiences, and many other use cases across Airbnb. We’re also building the agentic workflows behind the future of Marketing Technology and Airbnb’s autonomous Growth Engine. You’ll take on ambiguous problems across both areas, driving them independently from design through launch.

A Typical Day:

• Scale the core platform so it stays highly available, low-latency, and observable. You’ll debug hard problems, find bottlenecks, and optimize systems to keep up with growing demand.

• Build agentic features for Airbnb's autonomous Marketing Growth Engine, contributing primarily to campaign ideation and refinement.

• Lead projects across the full development lifecycle: technical design, implementation, testing, experimentation, and production rollout.

• Work with Product, Design, Data, Marketing Operations, and other partners to turn marketing goals into platform capabilities.

• Partner with other engineering teams across Marketing Technology to build integrated systems.

• Help teams across Airbnb onboard to our services by advising them on use cases, guiding integrations, and improving our systems so they’re easier to adopt.

• Take part in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-mortems to keep systems that serve millions of guests and hosts reliable.

• Use AI tools to work efficiently and run multiple workstreams in parallel, while still owning the quality, correctness, and long-term health of everything you ship.

Your Expertise:

• 5+ years of software engineering experience

• Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience

• Expertise in backend systems with large-scale service-oriented architecture

• Experience building agentic systems or LLM-powered applications

• Proficiency in one or more modern languages such as Go, Rust, Java, or Kotlin

• Passionate about learning, driving impact, and moving fast without sacrificing quality

• Strong communication skills with experience driving initiatives that cross teams, organizations, and leadership

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$196,000—$227,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - SF based
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.



About the Role:

As a Mid-Market Account Executive at Teleport, you will own the full sales cycle for mid-sized organizations looking to secure their infrastructure in an AI-driven world. Teleport unifies identity across humans, machines, workloads, and AI agents — replacing fragmented, credential-based access with a hardware-rooted, cryptographic identity layer that scales zero trust across cloud and on-prem environments. You'll work closely with Sales Engineering, Account Development and Marketing to identify, qualify, and close new business, building a repeatable, high-velocity motion across a defined territory or vertical. This role is ideal for a driven, autonomous seller who thrives on prospecting and closing deals in a fast-paced, high-growth environment — while helping customers eliminate credential sprawl, reduce identity-based attack surface, and prepare their infrastructure for the demands of agentic AI.



What You'll Do:

 - Communicate effectively with Engineering, InfoSec teams, and business stakeholders.

 - Develop a territory plan and relentlessly execute against it in order to exceed your quota.

 - Understand the nuances of selling open source technology.

 - Help us foster our open source community and grow our commercial offering.

 - Identify and excite champions at your key accounts so they become your executive sponsors.

 - Navigate complex deals involving several stakeholders across engineering and InfoSec without coming across as "Salesy."

 - Mentor our Sales Development Reps. You will collaborate with them in order to break into your target accounts.

 - Strong listening and storytelling skills.



What We're Looking For:

 - 3+ years of quota attainment at a software startup in the infrastructure, security, open source space

 - 1+ year experience working at a growing start up selling to scaling AI, fintech or e-commerce companies

 - Experience in articulating the value of a product, aligning with the specific needs and compliance requirements amongst complex organizations

 - Humility, curiosity, resilience, and a sense of humor.

 - You're not afraid of prospecting.

 - Based SF Bay Area



How We Hire — Instructions

Our process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time. We skip performative rounds and focus on what matters: understanding how you think and what you can do.

You'll start with a 30-minute recruiter screen, followed by a 30-minute interview with the hiring manager and four team member, a presentation including clear instructions.



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities



Teleport is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classifications protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
Legend Biotech is a global biotechnology company dedicated to treating and, one day, curing life-threatening diseases. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, we are advancing the next generation of cell therapy through a portfolio of innovative technologies, including autologous, allogeneic, and in vivo cell therapy approaches. Our research spans chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T), T-cell receptor (TCR-T), natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies, and other emerging platforms designed to transform the treatment of serious diseases. From our global network of research and development sites, we are committed to discovering and developing safe, effective, and cutting-edge therapies for patients worldwide.

Legend Biotech entered into a global collaboration agreement with Johnson & Johnson to jointly develop and commercialize CARVYKTI® (ciltacabtagene autoleucel; cilta-cel). Through this strategic partnership, we combine complementary expertise and capabilities to advance innovative immunotherapies for patients living with multiple myeloma.

Role Overview

Legend Biotech is seeking a Senior Engineer to provide technical leadership for facilities, utilities, and commercial cell therapy manufacturing process equipment, and technical support of capital projects and manufacturing investigations. The role partners with Manufacturing, Quality, Validation, Facilities, Supply Chain, Automation, and Maintenance organizations to ensure reliable, compliant, and efficient operation of critical process equipment and plant systems while driving continuous improvement and operational excellence.

• Provide engineering ownership and lifecycle management for GMP facilities, utilities, and cell therapy manufacturing process equipment.

• Lead troubleshooting, root cause investigations, deviation support, CAPAs, and change controls for manufacturing equipment and support systems.

• Identify, lead, and deliver Cost of Goods Manufactured (COGM) reduction and Operational Excellence (OpEx) initiatives.

• Develop and optimize preventive and predictive maintenance strategies.

• Support commissioning, qualification, validation, startup, and turnover activities.

• Monitor system performance and identify improvement opportunities.

• Author and review SOPs, technical reports, and specifications.

• Lead cross-functional projects and manage contractors and vendors.

• Ensure compliance with cGMP, EHS, and regulatory requirements.

• Support audits and inspections.

• Mentor junior engineers.

Requirements

• BS in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial Engineering or related discipline; MS preferred.

• Minimum 7+ years of engineering, facilities, maintenance, or operations experience in a GMP-regulated environment.

• Experience supporting biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or cell therapy manufacturing preferred.

• Experience leading equipment and utility projects from concept through implementation.

• Knowledge of commissioning, qualification, validation, change control, and deviation management processes.

• Strong project management and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience mentoring engineers and leading cross-functional initiatives.

• Proven Lean/TPS implementation experience and Operational Excellence leadership experience preferred.

Legend Biotech is seeking a Sr. Specialist, Quality IT as part of the Quality IT team based in Bridgewater, NJ.

Role Overview

The Sr Specialist, IT Quality provides IT Quality oversight and hands-on support for the implementation, validation, operation, and lifecycle management of GxP computerized systems within Legend Biotech. The role interprets applicable regulatory requirements, applies IT Quality Assurance standards, and supports compliant processes and documentation. The position helps ensure that GxP electronic systems and records comply with company procedures and applicable requirements for electronic records, electronic signatures, data integrity, cGMP, GCP, GLP, FDA 21 CFR Parts 210, 211 and 11, EU Annex 11, and GAMP 5 guidance.

Key Responsibilities

• Ensure assigned GxP IT systems, processes, and records comply with Legend CSV/CSA and SDLC procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Provide IT Quality review and oversight for GxP system implementations, enhancements, upgrades, validation activities, and associated change controls.

• Review validation and lifecycle documents, including validation plans, system risk assessments, user requirements, test protocols and reports, traceability matrices, release documentation, and retirement records.

• Partner with IT, business, Validation, Quality, and system owners to support system maintenance, upgrades, issue resolution, and compliant operation.

• Support the development, revision, and implementation of SOPs, work instructions, templates, and standards governing GxP computerized systems.

• Assess and document risks associated with GxP computerized systems and processes and support implementation of appropriate risk controls.

• Support investigations of system or application issues, deviations, data-integrity concerns, and recurring error trends; contribute to root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.

• Track assigned audit observations, deviations, CAPAs, and remediation actions to timely completion in accordance with internal procedures.

• Support the IT supplier qualification and annual supplier audit program, including assessment documentation, audit preparation, follow-up, and record maintenance.

• Provide Quality oversight for system periodic reviews, access reviews, backup and recovery evidence, security and audit-trail reviews, and other lifecycle controls, as applicable.

• Support inspection readiness and participate in internal audits, supplier audits, and regulatory inspections by retrieving records, explaining controls, and coordinating responses.

• Monitor relevant regulatory and industry developments and help translate new expectations into practical improvements to procedures and controls.

• Provide guidance and training to IT personnel and key stakeholders on GxP, data integrity, CSV/CSA, electronic records and signatures, and internal Quality requirements.

• Support continuous improvement through process metrics, trend analysis, lessons learned, and risk-based simplification of validation and Quality processes.

• Manage multiple assignments with limited day-to-day direction, escalate significant compliance risks promptly, and seek management guidance for complex or precedent-setting decisions.

• IT leadership and delivery teams; Quality Assurance and Validation; system and business process owners; project management; Information Security; Data Integrity; internal audit and inspection-readiness teams; and external software, service, and consulting suppliers.

• Bachelor’s degree in Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.

• An advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.

• A minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical-device industry, including at least 4 years supporting Quality Assurance, computerized system validation/assurance, IT Quality, or regulated computerized-system lifecycle activities.

• Working knowledge of global GxP requirements and expectations for computerized systems, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, data integrity, and GAMP 5.

• Experience reviewing or authoring validation and lifecycle deliverables such as risk assessments, requirements, test protocols, traceability matrices, validation reports, change controls, deviations, and CAPAs.

• Experience with one or more enterprise or regulated platforms, such as QMS, document management, validation management, change control, LIMS, Veeva, ERP, or SAP.

• Strong technical writing, documentation-review, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent assignments while maintaining documentation quality and meeting commitments.

Ginkgo is constructing, editing, and redesigning the living world in order to answer the globe’s growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. Ginkgo Introduction

Ginkgo is a high-growth, well-capitalized public biotech company headquartered in Boston that is redesigning the living world to solve some of the globe's growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more. Ginkgo is constructing, editing, and redesigning the living world in order to answer the globe's growing challenges in health, energy, food, materials, and more.
