We're looking for motivated, curious, and detail-oriented engineers who are excited by the challenges of scaling and improving our Autonomous Lab Technology. The Automation Team is developing an industry-leading autonomous lab, integrating robotics, lab equipment, and industrial manufacturing processes into a novel modular platform for accelerating the pace of scientific discovery.

Ginkgo is hiring a Mechatronics Engineer I to join our in-house automation and integration team. This team is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying automation solutions to both internal labs and external automation customers, as well as providing expertise and support for deployed systems.

Job Description

As a Mechatronics Engineer I, you will learn about all aspects of our RAC system’s technology while contributing design work towards new RAC accessories, new instrument integrations, and even new product areas that will support the advancement of our Autonomous Lab. You will work hands-on in our Boston headquarters supporting Nebula (the world’s largest autonomous lab) and developing new tech for our internal initiatives and for our external customers. You’ll collaborate hand-in-hand with biologists, software developers, and other engineers to advance the hardware and aid in the development of software infrastructure that enables walkaway automation for various laboratory applications.

Ideal candidates will demonstrate keen attention to detail, excitement for learning, and a passion for producing high-quality work. Our systems are complex and multidisciplinary; being able to work across domains (e.g., mechanical, electrical, software) will ensure success in this role. You will be responsible for developing custom hardware solutions, participating in robot trajectory design and programming, managing the fabrication, inventory, and assembly of parts, gathering test data and performing deep evaluations, and producing design documentation for integrating your work into our product line. Experience with Solidworks is a plus. Coding or robotics experience is also a plus.

Like all Mechatronics engineers on the team, you will have tasks sourced from a number of different projects on your to-do list. You should expect variety in your day-to-day work, along with an agile environment where priorities shift quickly in response to new projects and updated customer needs. You will be expected to fully own your projects, from concept, to delivery, to second tier support.

Responsibilities

-Lead the design, development, and deployment of projects that support Ginkgo’s autonomous lab product

- Own end-to-end SolidWorks CAD design for custom mechatronic assemblies, including detailed drawings and PDM Vault management

- Manage mechanical BOM accuracy and revision control within Aligni PLM

- Participate in team design reviews, both providing and receiving feedback, and provide detailed asynchronous review and feedback on both 3D designs from peer engineers and 2D drawings from our Drafting team

- Design, program, and optimize robot trajectories for industrial six-axis robot arms, ensuring safe, repeatable, and efficient motion in workcell environments

- Collaborate with biologists on automation equipment design and operation to translate scientific requirements into robust engineering solutions

- Work with vendors to source components, and to build understanding of vendor needs and capabilities

- Support change management and upgrade/retrofit deployment across our existing fleet of deployed enclosures and hardware configurations, helping balance standardization goals with the practical realities of a diverse installed base

- Support the performance evaluation, optimization, and maintenance of Nebula, the world’s largest autonomous lab

- Support RAC deployment efforts as we deliver new systems to external customers and expand our in-house RAC installations

Minimum Requirements

- BS or MS in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Systems, Robotics Engineering or equivalent

- Experience designing a complex custom mechatronic system, including mechanical and electronic component specification and selection, custom part design, and assembly

- Experience using a 3D CAD tool such as Solidworks, Autodesk Inventor, or OnShape for from-scratch modeling of parts and assemblies

- Experience reading and producing 2D manufacturing drawings

- Experience with basic electronics debugging and system troubleshooting techniques

- Experience with data collection and analysis techniques

- Windows proficiency, and fluency in productivity software tools including spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation tools

We do not expect that any one candidate will have all of the following experiences - each is independently a preferred or "nice-to-have" capability.

- Familiarity with lab automation equipment fundamentals (liquid handlers from Agilent, Hamilton, and Beckman/Labcyte; plate sealers, bulk dispensers, etc.)

- Experience with conveyor or transport systems (e.g., MagneMotion or similar)

- Demonstrable fabrication experience or hands-on 'workshop' skills

- Experience with robot teaching, programming, or simulation

- Experience with scripting or coding in a language like Python or JavaScript, command line navigation, and familiarity with version control and code repositories such as Git

Closing

We also feel that it's important to point out the obvious here - there's a serious lack of diversity in our industry, and that needs to change. Our goal is to help drive that change. Ginkgo is deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all of its practices, especially when it comes to growing our team. Our culture promotes inclusion and embraces how rewarding it is to work with people from all walks of life.

We're developing a powerful biological engineering platform, so we must remain mindful of the many ways our technology can - and will - impact people around the world. We care about how our platform is used, and having a diverse team to build it gives us the best chance that it's something we'll be proud of as it continues to grow. Therefore, it's critical that we incorporate the diverse voices and visions of all those who play a role in the future of biology.

It is the policy of Ginkgo Bioworks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and employment applicants.

Special Requirements / Materials to be Provided by Candidates

- Portfolio or examples of SolidWorks designs and/or robot trajectory programming work are strongly encouraged

- In all applications, application source and EEO (equal employment opportunity) data fields along with links (LinkedIn, GitHub) are included in the post for the candidate to populate.

Ginkgo has implemented a return to office policy effective October 1, 2025 with required in office days 5x per week.  Some teams may require to be onsite 4-5 days per week and this will be discussed as part of the interview process.  This policy applies to all employees who live within 50 miles of Ginkgo’s offices in Boston, MA, Emeryville, CA and West Sacramento, CA.

It is the policy of Ginkgo Bioworks to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees, employment applicants, and EOE disability/vet.

Privacy Notice

I understand that I am applying for employment with Ginkgo Bioworks and am being asked to provide information in connection with my application. I further understand that Ginkgo gathers this information through a third-party service provider and that Ginkgo may also use other service providers to assist in the application process.  Ginkgo may share my information with such third-party service providers in connection with my application and for the start of employment.  Ginkgo will treat my information in accordance with Ginkgo's Privacy Policy.  By submitting this job application, I am acknowledging that I have reviewed and agree to Ginkgo's Privacy Policy as well as the privacy policies of the third-party service providers used by Ginkgo's associated with the application process.

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Fortera is transforming one of the world’s largest industries by reinventing how cement is made. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Fortera has developed next-generation cement technology that delivers high performance while reducing CO₂ emissions by up to ~70%. By mineralizing CO₂ and turning it into a productive feedstock, Fortera converts emissions into a valuable building material, creating a more sustainable path for modern construction.

With our commercial ReCarb® plant operating in Redding, California, and a growing global project pipeline, Fortera is moving from first-of-a-kind deployment to scaled commercialization. Our technology is already being used in real-world infrastructure applications, bringing next-generation cement into use today while expanding toward broader adoption.

At Fortera, you’ll work alongside scientists, engineers, operators, and industry experts who are turning cutting-edge materials science into real-world impact. We’re looking for curious thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers who want to help tackle one of the biggest challenges facing our planet.

This is more than a job. It’s an opportunity to help shape the future of sustainable construction.

Build What’s Next.

Visit www.forteraglobal.com to learn more.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Controls System Engineer will contribute to successful design and operation of control system hardware and software for all Fortera processes including mineral grinding, kiln operation/calcination, mineral dissolution, gas absorption, precipitation, solids dewatering, and drying.

This is a hands-on role requiring a driven engineer who would be versatile enough to bridge the gaps between R&D, internal core process design, and outside engineering firms or equipment suppliers.

The position is best suited for someone with an engineering degree who understands plant operations, can bridge the gap between theory and practice, enjoys the challenges of a fast-paced work environment and will be eager to use emerging technologies to tackle old and new problems.

This individual must be able to deal with the unknown challenges brought on by implementing new technology and manufacturing processes and is comfortable with not knowing all the answers but be able to make decisions and recommendations as we go.

Travel: Up to 15% travel is required.

READY TO BUILD WHAT’S NEXT?

Do you want to turn ambitious ideas into reality as part of a team that designs, buys, builds, tests, and runs its own facilities?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, challenges change, and you are willing to adapt, step into gaps, solve problems, and do what is needed to help the team deliver?

Do you take ownership, contribute to decisions, act with urgency, and stay accountable through to the outcome?

Do you believe in building collective strength through collaboration, sharing knowledge, supporting others, and putting the success of the team ahead of individual boundaries?

Are you motivated to work at the forefront of innovation, push what is possible, bring ideas to life, and use technology, AI, and continuous improvement to deliver better performance and results?

If this sounds like you, we’d like to hear from you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Detailed Design/Project Execution:

• Contribute to the development of control philosophy, sequence logic, state machine, etc.

• Review the PLC code written by system integrator and third-party vendors.

• Review the HMI objects and faceplates developed by system integrator and test them extensively for bug free operation.

• Pre-deployment testing of the PLC and HMI software.

• Help with preparing project deliverables including control narrative, operation/maintenance manual, etc.

• Collaborate with process, R&D, project, and business development teams to define the I&C requirements for the project.

• Review the design documents including PFDs, P&IDs, Instrumentation list, IO list, logic diagrams, wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, control enclosure layouts, and interlock schematics.

• Review the specifications documents and datasheets. Participate in procurement activities including vendor selection and communication, vendor visits, FATs, SATs, etc.

• Communicate effectively with EPCs, suppliers and external vendors to source automation equipment, components, and systems, ensuring that specifications, timelines, and quality standards are met.

• Manage supplier relationships, conduct technical discussions and resolve any issues that may arise during procurement, testing, and integration stages.

Commissioning and Plant operation Support:

• Setup, calibrate, and troubleshoot industrial sensors and transmitters

• Support general activities of commissioning and troubleshooting for the commercial plant.

• Efficiently troubleshoot complex SCADA and controls issue using relevant tools.

• Support the project team for implementing an effective Management of Change (MoC) procedure specifically tailored to PLC and SCADA software modifications.

• Diagnosing root causes of system issues, distinguishing between mechanical, electrical, and software-related problems

• Categorize, systematize, and address gaps in automated system behavior

• Tune control gains and calibrate systems, documenting the process for future reference

• Identify and address gaps in system performance, ensuring continuous improvement through utilization of advanced control methods (MIMO, MPC, etc.)

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum B.S. in Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical Engineering or relevant field.

• 5+ years engineering experience designing, scaling, building, and commissioning commercial control systems.

• Well versed in engineering design utilizing PFDs, P&IDs, and Process Hazard Analyses (PHA).

• Familiarity with one or more of the Industrial control platforms (Beckhoff, Siemens, Allen-Bradley, CODESYS); Allen-Bradley preferred.

• Familiarity with IEC 61131-3 programming languages.

• Familiarity with SCADA software (Ignition, Wonderware, FT View, etc.); Ignition preferred.

• Familiar with industrial communication protocols such as ethernet/IP, OPC, MQQT, Modbus, etc.

• Experience of code development with Python, MATLAB/Simulink, etc.

• Experience of interacting with external engineering firms, contractors, and equipment suppliers.

• Experience with process control schemes and implementation.

• Background in control systems theory.

COMPENSATION:

The compensation package for this role includes a competitive base salary commensurate with experience of $190,000 - $120,000.

Fortera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other status protected by applicable law. Diverse candidates are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Channel Sales Manager - LATAM
jobs.description:
About Teleport

Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it.

Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Teleport's Channel team builds the partner ecosystem that helps our Enterprise Account Executives source more deals and close them faster. As a Senior Channel Sales Manager, LATAM, you'll own that ecosystem across Latin America from a US base: recruiting and onboarding partners, building joint business plans, and driving the co-sell motion that turns partner relationships into sourced pipeline and revenue. This is a quota-carrying role. You'll also help decide which partners we invest in and how we show up with them.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the partner-sourced pipeline and revenue number for LATAM - this is a building from scratch position

 - Recruit, onboard, and manage regional partners (resellers, distributors, MSPs, and cloud partners) to drive co-sell

 - Build joint business plans for a focused set of go-to partners that line up with regional sales goals

 - Run account mapping and regional sales meetings that connect partner reps with Teleport AEs on real accounts

 - Quarterback co-sell deals between Teleport AEs and partner sellers, from registration through close

 - Present the Teleport portfolio and partner program benefits to partner leadership

 - Work with Product, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to train, enable, and certify partner sales and technical teams in the region

 - Own regional partner MDF plans and budgets, and report on results against OKRs




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of partner or channel sales experience at a B2B SaaS or technology company, covering the LATAM market

 - Background selling security, infrastructure, or DevOps tooling

 - Fluency in Portuguese is a must

 - Deep understanding of how channel partners work with ISVs to co-sell, and an existing network among partners in Latin America, Brazil specifically

 - Proven ability to work cross-functionally and earn the trust of internal sellers, so AEs want to work with you

 - Self-motivated, hands-on, and comfortable in a lean, fast-moving environment (start-up experience is a plus)

 - Based in the United States, comfortable traveling, with a Bachelor's degree or equivalent




NICE TO HAVE

 - Additional fluency in Spanish

 - MSP and distribution experience

 - Experience co-selling with AWS, including registering opportunities through ACE




HOW WE HIRE

Our process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time. We skip performative rounds and focus on what matters: understanding how you think and what you can do.

You'll start with a 30-minute recruiter screen, followed by a 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager, a series of 30 to 45-minute conversations with members of our Channel and Sales teams, and a 45-minute presentation to a panel of Teleport leaders.



Why Teleport

You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for.

Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building.



The Benefits

At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career.

- Extensive health coverage

- Annual expense budget

- Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge

- Investment in your future with retirement savings plans

- Professional development opportunities



Teleport is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classifications protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Director, Business Development - Air & Strike Warfare
jobs.location: Arlington, Virginia, United States; Fort Walton Beach, Florida, United States; San Luis Obispo, California, United States; United States
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Zone 5 Technologies is seeking a technically grounded Director of Business Development to lead the company's precision deep strike weapons business, anchored by the RUSTY DAGGER (AGM-188) product line. This role is built for a U.S. Air Force (USAF) or U.S. Navy (USN) strike warfare professional: a strike, fighter, or bomber aviator; a Weapons Systems Officer (WSO) or Naval Flight Officer (NFO); a Weapons and Tactics Instructor (WTI); a U.S. Air Force Weapons School (USAFWS) or Navy Fighter Weapons School (TOPGUN) graduate; a Test Pilot School (TPS) graduate or test squadron veteran; or a weapons acquisition and test leader who can speak fluently to engagement envelopes, carriage and release integration, mission planning, kill-chain integration, and program-of-record pathways because they have employed, tested, or fielded air-launched weapons, not simply sold around them. Operational experience employing these weapons in combat or in large-force exercises is strongly desired in addition to the technical and acquisition background described below.

The Director will own the domestic precision deep strike weapons pursuit portfolio, engaging directly with USAF and USN requirements owners, program offices, operational and test organizations, and government-funded research and development (R&D) organizations, and will serve as the senior technical sales authority and point of contact as relationships mature into substantive capability and integration discussions. This individual's operational and engineering credibility will be leveraged to strengthen capture strategy and proposal development, ensuring technical narratives are accurate, defensible, and compelling. The role requires close, sustained cross-functional integration to keep messaging, positioning, and pursuit strategy aligned across the company.

The Director is the accountable owner of the precision deep strike weapons pipeline: the Director sets probability of win (Pwin) and probability of go (Pgo) assessments, makes bid/no-bid recommendations directly to executive leadership, serves as capture lead with direction over the proposal and technical staff assigned to each pursuit, and is the company's accountable voice to USAF and USN customers for this portfolio. Within 24 months, the Director is expected to have advanced at least one RUSTY DAGGER pursuit to a funded program-of-record transition or production contract with the USAF or USN and to have secured Zone 5 Technologies participation in at least one service-led affordable mass or stand-off strike experimentation campaign.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Business Development and Capture Leadership

• Own the precision deep strike weapons opportunity pipeline, Pwin assessments, and Pgo assessments from identification through award; set pursuit priorities, capture strategy, and bid/no-bid recommendations for executive leadership.

• Serve as the subject matter expert on air-launched precision deep strike weapons, translating the RUSTY DAGGER (AGM-188) program into terms relevant to USAF and USN requirements, concepts of operations (CONOPS), tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTP), carriage platforms, and program-of-record maturation paths.

• Engage directly with USAF requirements, acquisition, and test stakeholders, including Air Combat Command (ACC), Air Force Global Strike Command (AFGSC), Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC), Headquarters Air Force A5/7 (Air Force Futures), the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC) Armament Directorate (AFLCMC/EB) and Program Executive Office (PEO) Weapons at Eglin Air Force Base, the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) Munitions Directorate (AFRL/RW), Air Force Rapid Capabilities Office (AFRCO), the 53rd Wing, the 96th Test Wing and Air Force Test Center (AFTC), Air Force Operational Test and Evaluation Center (AFOTEC), Air National Guard and Air Force Reserve Command Test Center (AATC), USAFWS at Nellis Air Force Base, and Big Safari.

• Engage directly with USN requirements, acquisition, and test stakeholders, including Office of the Chief of Naval Operations (OPNAV) N98 (Air Warfare) and N96 (Surface Warfare), Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) and PEO Unmanned Aviation and Strike Weapons (PEO(U&W)) and its Program Manager, Air (PMA) offices PMA-201 Precision Strike Weapons, PMA-242 Direct and Time Sensitive Strike, and PMA-280 Tomahawk, Naval Air Warfare Center Weapons Division (NAWCWD) at China Lake and Point Mugu, Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division (NAWCAD) at Patuxent River, Naval Aviation Warfighting Development Center (NAWDC) and TOPGUN at Fallon, Air Test and Evaluation Squadrons VX-9, VX-23, and VX-31, and Commander, Operational Test and Evaluation Force (COMOPTEVFOR).

• Engage U.S. Marine Corps (USMC) aviation and joint stakeholders where RUSTY DAGGER employment overlaps, including Marine Aviation Weapons and Tactics Squadron One (MAWTS-1) at Yuma, the Deputy Commandant for Aviation, U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) Special Operations Forces Acquisition, Technology, and Logistics (SOF AT&L) and PEO Fixed Wing, joint program offices, Defense Innovation Unit (DIU), Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA), and government-funded R&D organizations, including service laboratories, Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDCs), and University Affiliated Research Centers (UARCs), to identify emerging requirements and shape early opportunity development.

• Build and sustain relationships with operational, technical, and program stakeholders that position Zone 5 Technologies as a credible, informed partner rather than a transactional vendor.

• Track and interpret evolving adversary threats, doctrine, force design, and acquisition strategy relevant to long-range and stand-off strike, affordable mass, and munitions industrial base priorities, including the USAF Extended Range Attack Munition (ERAM) and Franklin Affordable Mass Missile (FAMM) lines of effort.

International Sales Support

• Provide senior technical sales expertise to the international business development team, supporting partner-nation engagements as they progress beyond introductory conversations into substantive Letter of Request (LOR), request for proposal (RFP), and integration discussions, especially those involving unique CONOPS or non-U.S. launch platforms.

• Partner with international sales to tailor technical positioning of RUSTY DAGGER to partner-nation air force and naval aviation requirements, threat environments, and export considerations.

Proposal and Capture Execution

• Leverage operational and engineering background to lead technical volume development, win themes, and discriminator articulation on proposals across domestic and international pursuits.

• Serve as capture lead, directing proposal writers and technical contributors to ensure technical accuracy, credibility, and consistency across proposal, white paper, and request for information (RFI) and RFP responses.

• Lead development of technical exchange meetings (TEMs), capability briefings, and government stakeholder demonstrations, including captive-carry, separation, and live-fire events.

Cross-Functional Integration

• Maintain close, ongoing coordination with portfolio and engineering leadership to ensure business development activity reflects current product maturity, roadmap, and technical constraints.

• Partner with marketing on the development of technically accurate capability collateral, briefing materials, and messaging for air and strike warfare audiences.

• Coordinate with international sales leadership to align technical engagement strategy with country-level pursuit plans and export posture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior USAF or USN service (uniformed or civilian) in a strike warfare role: strike, fighter, or bomber aviator; WSO or NFO; WTI, USAFWS, or TOPGUN graduate; TPS graduate or operational or developmental test squadron veteran; or a weapons acquisition, test and evaluation, or systems engineering role directly tied to air-launched weapons. Operational employment experience in combat or large-force exercises is strongly desired.

• Deep technical understanding of the effects required for the missions of interest to USAF and USN audiences: strategic attack, air interdiction, offensive counter-air (OCA), suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD) and destruction of enemy air defenses (DEAD), maritime strike and anti-surface warfare (ASuW), close air support (CAS), dynamic targeting, and long-range stand-off strike, derived from a genuine operational and engineering background, not solely a sales career.

• Working knowledge of air-launched weapons integration and certification: MIL-STD-1760 aircraft and store electrical interconnection, MIL-STD-1553 data bus, MIL-STD-3014 Universal Armament Interface (UAI), MIL-STD-8591 airborne stores suspension equipment, MIL-STD-1316 fuze safety, MIL-STD-2105 insensitive munitions and hazard assessment, MIL-STD-882 system safety, MIL-STD-810 environmental and MIL-STD-461 electromagnetic compatibility testing, MIL-HDBK-244 aircraft and stores compatibility, the SEEK EAGLE certification process, mission planning, carriage and release constraints, and platform operational flight program (OFP) cycles.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate credibly with engineers, program managers, and operators on system performance, integration, and employment considerations, and to brief at the general officer, flag officer, and Senior Executive Service (SES) level.

• Exceptional writing skills: demonstrated ability to produce clear, precise, and persuasive technical prose, including proposal volumes, white papers, capability statements, and correspondence for general officer, flag officer, and SES audiences, with minimal editing. Writing samples will be requested.

• Experience leading or writing technical content for proposals, capture efforts, or government-facing technical documentation; familiarity with Other Transaction Authority (OTA), Middle Tier of Acquisition (MTA), and traditional Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) pathways.

• Ability to travel 25 to 50 percent, domestically (primarily) and internationally, to support client engagement, demonstrations, and industry events.

• Active U.S. Secret clearance required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance.

• Direct engineering, test, or operational experience with air-launched precision strike effectors: AGM-158 Joint Air-to-Surface Standoff Missile (JASSM) and Long Range Anti-Ship Missile (LRASM), AGM-154 Joint Standoff Weapon (JSOW), AGM-84 Harpoon and Standoff Land Attack Missile-Expanded Response (SLAM-ER), GBU-31/38/54 Joint Direct Attack Munition (JDAM) and JDAM-Extended Range, GBU-53/B Small Diameter Bomb II (StormBreaker), AGM-114 Hellfire and AGM-179 Joint Air-to-Ground Missile (JAGM), Hypersonic Attack Cruise Missile (HACM), or AGM-183 Air-launched Rapid Response Weapon (ARRW); or with extended-range loitering munition and one-way attack (OWA) systems.

• Graduate of USAFWS, TOPGUN, the Strike Fighter Weapons and Tactics program, or the MAWTS-1 WTI course; or graduate of USAF TPS, USN TPS, or the U.S. Army Experimental Test Pilot program.

• Prior experience engaging government-funded R&D organizations, service laboratories, FFRDCs, or UARCs on emerging weapons system requirements.

• Experience supporting international or Foreign Military Sales (FMS) engagements alongside a business development team.

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering, systems, or physical science discipline; advanced degree a plus.

• Previous employment with DIU or DARPA.

• Previous employment within USAF operational flying units (fighter, bomber, or special operations wings), operational test, developmental test, or rapid acquisition organizations: 53rd Wing, 96th Test Wing and AFTC, AFOTEC, AFRCO, AATC, AFRL/RW, AFLCMC/EB, USAFWS, or Big Safari.

• Previous employment within USN operational strike fighter squadrons or carrier air wings, naval aviation test, tactics, or acquisition organizations: NAWDC, TOPGUN, NAWCWD, NAWCAD, VX-9, VX-23, VX-31, COMOPTEVFOR, PMA-201, PMA-242, PMA-280, or OPNAV N98 and N96 staff.

• USSOCOM SOF AT&L, PEO Fixed Wing, or AFSOC weapons and tactics experience.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• Technical credibility: speaks the language of engineers and operators, not just program managers and contracting officers.

• Relationship building: establishes trust quickly with operational, technical, and program stakeholders across the services, R&D organizations, and partner nations.

• Cross-functional leadership: operates fluidly across portfolio, engineering, marketing, and international sales without losing message discipline, and sets direction for supporting business development and capture staff.

• Exceptional writing: produces clear, precise, decision-quality prose for proposals, white papers, and executive correspondence with minimal editing.

• Verbal communication: briefs general and flag officers, SES leaders, and partner-nation delegations with precision and brevity.

This role is eligible for performance bonuses in addition to the base salary.

Pay range for this role (base salary)

$138,000 — $178,000 USD

Pay range with eligible performance bonuses

$241,500 – $311,500 USDUSD with eligible performance bonuses. Bonus components are variable and not guaranteed.

Pay range for this role

$138,000—$178,000 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

• Competitive total compensation package

• Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.

• 401k with company-match

• 3 weeks of paid time off each year

• 40 hours of sick time

• 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

• Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.

• Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

Zone 5 Technologies is a federal contractor and participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. As required by law, we will verify the identity and employment authorization of all new employees using the E-Verify system. Learn more about your rights and responsibilities under E-Verify: https://www.e-verify.gov.

jobs.title: CRM / Data Platform Consultant
jobs.description:
Part-Time |  Project-Based




🚀 ABOUT OUR CLIENT

Our client is developing a next-generation MarTech platform designed to help businesses unlock new revenue opportunities and scale through smarter technology.

As part of its product expansion, the team is developing an advanced iGaming player data platform and looking for an experienced industry professional to help shape its strategy, architecture, and roadmap.




🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an opportunity to put your iGaming CRM / CDP expertise into practice and directly influence the development of a new player data platform.

Our client is looking for an experienced consultant who understands how leading iGaming operators manage player data, retention, segmentation, promotions, and multi-brand ecosystems.

You'll help evaluate the market, identify the right technology solutions, and define what should be built in-house versus sourced from third-party providers.




💡 WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON

 - Industry & Market Research: Analyze existing iGaming CRM, CDP, and PAM solutions, identify leading providers, compare capabilities, and share industry best practices.

 - Product Strategy: Help define the vision and priorities for a unified player data platform across multiple brands.

 - Build vs. Buy Assessment: Evaluate third-party solutions, their features, pricing, and suitability versus developing an in-house platform.

 - Roadmap Development: Define key functionalities, technical requirements, resources, priorities, and implementation timelines.

jobs.title: Process Engineer, Wafer Preparation & Assembly (Starlink/Akoustis)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROCESS ENGINEER, WAFER PREPARATION & ASSEMBLY (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)

Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary, while also connecting the world through Starlink. Our work helps further the impact that Starlink is already making on millions of users around the world, while allowing us to broaden that reach dramatically and continue connecting the unconnected here on earth.

We are looking for a hands-on Process Engineer to develop, optimize, qualify, and implement the full wafer-to-die preparation flow: wafer thinning and backside processing, dicing, die cleaning and handling, laser marking, inspection, and final package singulation. You will work directly with equipment and cross-functional partners (package engineering, assembly, test, reliability, quality, and external manufacturers) to deliver high-quality die that support downstream yield and reliability.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and qualify wafer back-grinding, thinning, stress-relief, and backside finishing processes; set thickness, TTV, bow, warp, and roughness targets while minimizing chipping, cracking, subsurface damage, and edge defects

• Develop and optimize mechanical wafer dicing (including thin wafers and difficult materials such as SiC); select blades, tapes, and parameters (speed, feed, depth, coolant, dressing, single- or multi-pass) and control chipping, sidewall quality, delamination, and street/exclusion requirements

• Establish post-dice die cleaning, drying, handling, tape mount/release (UV and non-UV), pick, sort, and presentation methods that protect die integrity, orientation, and traceability for flip-chip, wire-bond, and other assembly flows

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROCESS ENGINEER, GOLD-TO-GOLD INTERCONNECT & FLIP-CHIP ASSEMBLY (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS)

Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary, while also connecting the world through Starlink. Our work helps further the impact that Starlink is already making on millions of users around the world, while allowing us to broaden that reach dramatically and continue connecting the unconnected here on earth.

We are looking for a hands-on Process Engineer to develop, optimize, qualify, and implement advanced IC assembly processes, with a focus on Gold-to-Gold Interconnect (GGI) and thermosonic flip-chip bonding. You will take processes from early prototype through production ramp, working directly with equipment and with package engineering, design, manufacturing, reliability, materials, and supply-chain partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and qualify GGI and thermosonic flip-chip / die-attach processes, including bond force, temperature, ultrasonic energy, bond time, alignment, parallelism, and tool selection; establish process windows with DOE to control bond integrity, contact resistance, and mechanical strength

• Develop gold stud bump, gold bump, and gold-to-gold interconnect processes and evaluate bond quality and process capability

• Develop and optimize vacuum mold lamination and related encapsulation (material selection, vacuum, temperature, pressure, time, and cure); troubleshoot voiding, delamination, die shift, warpage, incomplete fill, and bleed

• Support related assembly steps as needed: wafer/die handling, placement, plasma/surface cleaning, underfill, reflow, singulation, laser marking, and inspection

• Select and characterize assembly materials (adhesives, mold compounds, substrates, interconnect materials) for impact on bond strength, adhesion, thermal performance, warpage, and reliability

• Specify, evaluate, install, and qualify assembly equipment (flip-chip bonders, thermosonic bonders, vacuum laminators, plasma, and inspection tools) with suppliers

• Run DOEs, capability studies, and SPC on critical parameters; write process specs, work instructions, control plans, FMEAs, and qualification reports

• Drive NPI from prototype through qualification and production release; perform root-cause analysis and support failure analysis (X-ray, SAM, optical, cross-section, SEM)

• Correlate process settings to electrical, mechanical, and reliability results; apply DFM and own schedules, risks, and production readiness for assigned technologies

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in chemical engineering, materials science, mechanical engineering, or other engineering discipline

• 2+ years of hands-on semiconductor assembly, IC packaging, or electronics manufacturing experience (Internship or extracurricular experience is applicable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• 3+ years of hands-on IC assembly or advanced packaging experience, including direct GGI or similar gold-based interconnect work

• Hands-on thermosonic flip-chip bonding (force, temperature, ultrasonic power, time, alignment, tooling) and gold stud bumping, gold bumps, or gold-to-gold interfaces

• Vacuum mold lamination or advanced encapsulation with mold sheets, thermally conductive or epoxy molding compounds, or underfills

• Understanding of plasma/surface preparation, organic/ceramic/leadframe/wafer-level substrates, warpage, CTE mismatch, thermal-mechanical stress, adhesion, and delamination

• DOE, SPC, Cp/Cpk, root-cause analysis, FMEA, Six Sigma, and control plans

• Inspection and metrology (X-ray, SAM, optical microscopy, profilometry, cross-section) and interconnect characterization (contact resistance, shear/pull, bond integrity)

• Package reliability testing and standards (JEDEC, IPC), plus experience supporting OSATs or contract manufacturers through development, qualification, and ramp

• CAD (AutoCAD) and familiarity with simulation tools (ANSYS, COMSOL, or similar) is a plus; data analysis with JMP, Minitab, MATLAB, or Python is a plus

• Experience qualifying new assembly equipment and tooling and troubleshooting issues directly on the manufacturing floor

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Onsite in Bastrop, TX (not remote or hybrid)

• Up to 20% domestic and international travel for supplier and manufacturing support

• Willingness to work extended hours or weekends to support key milestones

• Ability to work in a semiconductor manufacturing environment, follow safety and cleanroom requirements, and perform light physical tasks (including lifting up to 25 lbs and handling wafers, substrates, packages, tooling, and assembly samples)

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and management

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II - Boston, MA
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

As a Customer Success Manager II at OpenGov, you own and manage a portfolio of ~80 customers, ensuring they don’t just use our software but transform how they serve their communities. This is not a passive support role; it is a proactive, commercially-driven position designed for a high-achiever who thrives on organization, relationship-building, and hitting retention targets.




WHAT YOU’LL DO (RESPONSIBILITIES)

 - Strategic Portfolio Management: Own the end-to-end lifecycle for your customers, moving beyond reactive support to become a proactive partner in their success.

 - Risk Mitigation & Retention: Use data-driven insights to identify "at-risk" accounts early. You will develop and execute  plans to stabilize usage and secure renewals on time.

 - Commercial Ownership: Manage the full renewal cycle. You are responsible for maintaining high Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and identifying expansion opportunities where our solutions meet evolving customer needs.

 - Adoption Mastery: Conduct regular executive business reviews (EBRs) to align OpenGov’s value proposition with the customer’s changing legislative or budgetary goals.

 - Internal Advocacy: Act as the "Voice of the Customer" for our Product and Engineering teams, ensuring the frontline reality of government work shapes our roadmap.

 - Process Excellence: Contribute to the "playbook." As a CSM II, you’ll help refine our workflows for churn prevention and onboarding efficiency.




WHAT YOU BRING (REQUIREMENTS)

 - Proven SaaS Experience: Minimum 1.5+ years of experience in Customer Success or Account Management within the SaaS industry. You understand what it means to carry a quota or a retention target.

 - Passion for CS: Demonstrated experience in Customer Success or equivalent research completed; strong desire to build a sustainable career in Customer Success

 - High-Volume Proficiency: You have experience managing a large book of business (50+ accounts) and have mastered the "art of the scale"—knowing when to automate and when to pick up the phone.

 - Commercial Acumen: You are comfortable discussing budgets, navigating renewal contracts, and handling objections.

 - Resilience & Grit: You enjoy the challenge of turning a frustrated customer into a brand advocate. You are comfortable in the "gray areas" of problem-solving.

 - GovTech Passion (Preferred): Experience working with (or selling to) local/state government is a significant plus.

 - Analytical Skills: Ability to look at a health score or usage dashboard and translate that data into an actionable outreach strategy.



Compensation: 

Boston, MA: $80,000 - $90,000



On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.



The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II - Dallas, TX
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

As a Customer Success Manager II at OpenGov, you own and manage a portfolio of ~80 customers, ensuring they don’t just use our software but transform how they serve their communities. This is not a passive support role; it is a proactive, commercially-driven position designed for a high-achiever who thrives on organization, relationship-building, and hitting retention targets.




WHAT YOU’LL DO (RESPONSIBILITIES)

 - Strategic Portfolio Management: Own the end-to-end lifecycle for your customers, moving beyond reactive support to become a proactive partner in their success.

 - Risk Mitigation & Retention: Use data-driven insights to identify "at-risk" accounts early. You will develop and execute  plans to stabilize usage and secure renewals on time.

 - Commercial Ownership: Manage the full renewal cycle. You are responsible for maintaining high Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and identifying expansion opportunities where our solutions meet evolving customer needs.

 - Adoption Mastery: Conduct regular executive business reviews (EBRs) to align OpenGov’s value proposition with the customer’s changing legislative or budgetary goals.

 - Internal Advocacy: Act as the "Voice of the Customer" for our Product and Engineering teams, ensuring the frontline reality of government work shapes our roadmap.

 - Process Excellence: Contribute to the "playbook." As a CSM II, you’ll help refine our workflows for churn prevention and onboarding efficiency.




WHAT YOU BRING (REQUIREMENTS)

 - Passion for CS: Demonstrated experience in Customer Success or equivalent research completed; strong desire to build a sustainable career in Customer Success

 - High-Volume Proficiency: You have experience managing a large book of business (50+ accounts) and have mastered the "art of the scale"—knowing when to automate and when to pick up the phone.

 - Commercial Acumen: You are comfortable discussing budgets, navigating renewal contracts, and handling objections.

 - Resilience & Grit: You enjoy the challenge of turning a frustrated customer into a brand advocate. You are comfortable in the "gray areas" of problem-solving.

 - GovTech Passion (Preferred): Experience working with (or selling to) local/state government is a significant plus.

Dallas, TX: $80,000 - $90,000

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

jobs.title: Director, Business Development, Integrated Air & Missile Defense
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Strategic Defense builds the command and control and fire control software for integrated air and missile defense. We work the hard end of the problem: ballistic missiles, hypersonic glide vehicles, cruise missiles, and saturation raids that arrive faster than any human-paced decision cycle can absorb.

The US air and missile defense enterprise was assembled over four decades, one program at a time. Army air defense runs on one battle manager, short range air defense on another, the ballistic missile defense system on a third, and the fleet on a fourth. Each of them was engineered well for the threat it was scoped against. None of them was designed to be extended by anyone other than the prime that built it, which is why adding a sensor or an effector to an existing architecture is still a multi-year integration program rather than a software release.

That is the opening we are working. A software-defined fire control layer, built on Lattice, with interfaces open enough that a new sensor, a new interceptor, or a new effects chain can be brought in at the pace software moves rather than the pace a hardware program moves. The technical case is strong and the early programs are real. What we need now is someone who can turn that into share inside programs of record.

ABOUT THE JOB

You will own Anduril's business development across US integrated air and missile defense: Army, Navy, Air Force, the Missile Defense Agency, and the Joint programs that cut across them. You will carry the pipeline, the forecast, and a bookings commitment.

The work starts earlier than the RFP. By the time a requirement is written, the architecture it assumes has usually already been chosen, and the useful work happened eighteen months before that in requirements documents, analyses of alternatives, and conversations with program offices and operational units about what is actually limiting them. You will spend a substantial share of your time there, and you will be measured on whether the programs that eventually get written have room in them for what we build.

You will also spend real time arguing internally. Customer requirements that are worth winning but that the roadmap does not yet serve are the most valuable thing you can bring back, and bringing them back usefully means understanding our product well enough to say what would have to change and what it would cost.

Expect to travel up to 65%, concentrated in Huntsville, the National Capital Region, and the test ranges and operational units where this capability actually gets exercised.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own the US IAMD pipeline and the number. Set the pursuit strategy, maintain the pipeline of record, build the forecast, and own the bookings commitment for the portfolio.

• Shape programs before they are written. Engage program offices, requirements sponsors, capability development organizations, and operational units early enough to influence the architecture a future solicitation assumes.

• Run captures end to end. Lead competitive assessment, black hat analysis, teaming strategy, price-to-win posture, and proposal strategy across multi-year pursuits, working with Capture and Proposal Operations.

• Translate customer requirements into the product roadmap. Bring back what the customer actually needs in a form Product and Engineering can build against, including the parts that are inconvenient for the current baseline.

• Build the teaming relationships. Structure partnerships with primes and subsystem suppliers who are, in most cases, also competitors. Know when subcontracting is the right path to a position and when it forecloses one.

• Work the full range of acquisition pathways. Other Transaction Agreements, Commercial Solutions Openings, middle tier acquisition, software pathway programs, and traditional programs of record, including when each is the faster route to a fielded position.

• Represent Anduril. Serve as a senior technical and commercial voice for the company with general officers, SES-level acquisition leadership, and at the forums where this community gathers.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 10 to 15 years of relevant business development, capture, program management, requirements, or defense acquisition experience, with the majority of it spent in air defense, missile defense, or integrated fires.

• Demonstrated success shaping and capturing US air and missile defense programs, with specific awards you can speak to in detail, including your role and the competitive discriminator.

• Working command of the US IAMD portfolio. You should be able to discuss, with specificity, systems and programs including the Integrated Battle Command System, Patriot and PAC-3 MSE, the Lower Tier Air and Missile Defense Sensor, Sentinel A4, THAAD and AN/TPY-2, Indirect Fire Protection Capability Increment 2, Forward Area Air Defense C2, Maneuver SHORAD and the Marine Air Defense Integrated System, Aegis Baseline and Aegis BMD with the SM-3 and SM-6 families, Command and Control Battle Management and Communications, and the Ground-based Midcourse Defense system with the Next Generation Interceptor.

• Understanding of the organizations that own those programs, including US Army PAE Fires (formerly PEO Missiles and Space), the Missile Defense Agency, Navy PEO Integrated Warfare Systems, and the Air Force program offices responsible for air base air defense.

• Fluency in why fire control quality track data is a different problem from situational awareness quality track data, and familiarity with the data links that carry it, including Link 16 and the J-series message set, JREAP, VMF, and the Cooperative Engagement Capability.

• Familiarity with modular open systems approaches and the policy behind them, including SOSA, CMOSS, FACE, and the modular open system approach requirements in 10 U.S.C. 4401.

• Excellent written and verbal communication. You will present to general officers, senior executive service acquisition leadership, and Anduril's executive team.

• High ownership and initiative. You will be effective in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with limited structure and will build the process you need rather than waiting for it.

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

• Must be willing to travel up to 65%.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Currently possesses and is able to maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance, with SCI eligibility.

• Prior service in an air and missile defense program office, an operational air defense artillery or Aegis unit, or the Missile Defense Agency.

• Experience selling software or software-defined capability into a portfolio where the customer's buying habits are built around hardware deliverables.

• Experience at a company displacing an incumbent prime on an established program, including the protest and incumbency dynamics that come with it.

• Working familiarity with the modeling, simulation, and operational analysis used to justify air and missile defense requirements, sufficient to read an analysis critically.

• Experience with Other Transaction Agreements and consortium-based acquisition.

• Based in or willing to relocate to Washington DC, Huntsville AL, Colorado Springs CO, or Costa Mesa CA.

US Salary Range

$181,000—$240,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:

This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

We are looking for a Senior LIMS Engineer to join our Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) team in support of clinical patient testing in our high-throughput CLIA lab. The Sr. LIMS Engineer will be responsible for (1) Deepening integration between existing BTO software and our clinical LIMS, (2) taking ownership of critical portions of the LIMS sample processing pipeline, and (3) maintaining, improving, and building LIMS applications, tools, and infrastructure.

This role will help to build upon the strong technology and execution found at BTO. This is considered an onsite role at our Union City lab, with flexibility to work from home or at our Menlo Park site when applicable.

Requirements:

• Experience with both Python and AI-assisted development

• 5+ Years experience with developing LIMS, apps, or customer-facing tools

• Ability to troubleshoot and diagnose advanced technical issues

• Experience developing scripting solutions to automation problems

• Strong attention to detail and ability to work flexibly and well under accelerated timeframes

• Highly organized, strong written and verbal communication skills

• Creative problem-solver who enjoys a variety of daily tasks

Nice-To-Haves:

• Experience working in CLIA Lab, medical device, or pharma

• Experience with data analysis using Python, SQL, or Excel

• Familiarity with Quality Management Systems and related regulations (CFR 21 Part 11, ISO 13485, etc)

Benefits And Perks:

• Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients

• Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings

• The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patients

• Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%

• Daily on-site lunches provided from top eateries

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™ enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers for 2025 and we're Great Place to Work certified, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.

Our Future

Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.

Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com

jobs.title: CDL Delivery Driver - Roll Off/Containers

jobs.title: Lead/ Senior Machine Learning Scientist, Integrative Phenotyping
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

insitro is a physical AI company dedicated to unlocking causal human biology and accelerating the delivery of better medicines to patients. Our unique Virtual Human™ platform identifies novel, high-impact genetic intervention points, which our TherML™ platform translates into therapeutics—whether small molecules, biologics, or oligos. With multiple programs in metabolic disease and neuroscience advancing toward the clinic, and our first IND submission slated for the second half of this year, we are at a pivotal inflection point.

As a Lead/ Senior Machine Learning Scientist on the Integrative Phenotyping team, you will develop, productionize, and deploy cutting-edge ML approaches to build precise phenotypes from large-scale multimodal datasets — clinical imaging, electronic health records, longitudinal outcomes, biomarkers, and multi-omic readouts — and use them to understand patient state, predict clinical endpoints, and identify therapeutic targets. 

You’ll work alongside machine learning scientists, statistical geneticists, life scientists, software engineers, and clinicians, and your expertise will shape how the company builds rigorous ML on complex human data.

Based in South San Francisco, this position reports directly to the Head of Integrative Phenotyping and offers an in-person hybrid schedule of three days per week.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

ML Methods & Platform

 - Build Precise Phenotypes: Develop and deploy ML methods that extract biological insight from complex, high-dimensional human cohort data such as MRI and functional genomics.

 - Model Patient State: Develop models that characterize patient state and predict outcomes and clinical endpoints from multimodal data including clinical imaging, EHRs, longitudinal outcomes, biomarkers, and multi-omic readouts.

 - Set the Bar: Ensure modeling strategies are rigorous, effective, and aligned with best practices in the field.

 - Engineer Reusable Components: Build robust, reusable platform components in partnership with the software engineering team.

Target Discovery & Translation

 - Integrate Causal Evidence: Combine causal, multimodal analyses across diverse phenotypic readouts to select better therapeutic targets.

 - Biomarkers & Endpoints: Partner with Therapeutic Area and Clinical Development colleagues to develop new biomarkers for patient selection and clinical endpoints.

 - Connect Genetics to Phenotypes: Work with the Statistical Genetics team to associate human genetics with ML-derived phenotypes.

 


ABOUT YOU

Experience & Qualifications

 - Proven Tenure: PhD in computer science, machine learning, or a related field, or 5+ years of equivalent applied ML research experience.

 - Modern ML Expertise: Hands-on experience developing and deploying state-of-the-art ML methods, including multimodal techniques, to extract clinically relevant signals from complex data.

 - Clinical Data Depth: Experience with several of: clinical imaging (e.g., MRI, DEXA, CT, echocardiography), clinical records (e.g., EHRs, medications, outcomes), physiological recordings (e.g., EEG, ECG), or biobank-scale human genetic data.

 - Multimodal Experience: Experience with high-content modalities such as single-cell or bulk omics, genetic perturbation screening, spatial proteomics, or pooled optical screening.

 - Publication Record: Meaningful, high-quality contributions in ML, ML for health, computational biology, or biomedical venues.

 - Engineering Fluency: Strong Python in a cloud environment and modern deep learning frameworks, with a track record of reusable, tested, version-controlled ML code.

Core Competencies

 - End-to-End Delivery: You work with other ML scientists and engineers to take a real-world problem from sourcing and qualifying training data through model design, testing, and benchmarking.

 - Cross-Functional Translator: You collaborate well with statistical geneticists, life scientists, software engineers, and clinicians, and can make ML results legible to each.

 - Biology-Curious: You want to understand the physiology behind the data, and prior exposure to cardiovascular disease, neuroscience, or metabolism is a plus.

 


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS AT INSITRO

Our target starting salary for successful US-based applicants for this role is $183,000 - $224,000. To determine starting pay, we consider multiple job-related factors including a candidate's skills, education and experience, market demand, business needs, and internal parity. We may also adjust this range in the future based on market data.

This role is eligible for participation in our Annual Performance Bonus Plan (based on company targets by role level and annual company performance) and our Equity Incentive Plan, subject to the terms of those plans and associated policies.

 

In addition, insitro also provides our employees:

 - 401(k) plan with employer matching for contributions

 - Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage as well as mental health and well-being support

 - Open, flexible vacation policy

 - Paid parental leave of at least 16 weeks to support parents who give birth, and 10 weeks for a new parent (inclusive of birth, adoption, fostering, etc)

 - Quarterly budget for books and online courses for self-development

 - New hire stipend for home office setup

 - Monthly cell phone & internet stipend

 - Access to free onsite baristas and daily lunch for employees who are either onsite or hybrid

 - Access to a free commuter bus network that provides transport to and from our South San Francisco HQ from locations all around the Bay Area

 

insitro is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

We believe diversity, equity, and inclusion need to be at the foundation of our culture. We work hard to bring together diverse teams–grounded in a wide range of expertise and life experiences–and work even harder to ensure those teams thrive in inclusive, growth-oriented environments supported by equitable company and team practices. All candidates can expect equitable treatment, respect, and fairness throughout the interview process.

#LI-Onsite

Please be aware of recruitment scams: we never request payments, all recruitment communications are from @insitro.com http://insitro.com, and if in doubt, contact us at info@insitro.com. 



About insitro

insitro is a drug discovery and development company using machine learning (ML) and data at scale to decode biology for transformative medicines. At the core of insitro’s approach is the convergence of in-house generated multi-modal cellular data and high-content phenotypic human cohort data. We rely on these data to develop ML-driven, predictive disease models that uncover underlying biologic state and elucidate critical drivers of disease. These powerful models rely on extensive biological and computational infrastructure and allow insitro to advance novel targets and patient biomarkers, design therapeutics and inform clinical strategy. insitro is advancing a wholly owned and partnered pipeline of insights and therapeutics in neuroscience and metabolism. Since launching in 2018, insitro has raised over $700 million from top tech, biotech and crossover investors, and from collaborations with pharmaceutical partners. For more information on insitro, please visit www.insitro.com http://www.insitro.com.
