• Wearing proper PPE, to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety footwear, and other protective equipment based on assigned work conditions

• Handling of Beryllium (Be), nuclear materials, and other unique hazards

Travel

Certification

Additional Requirements

jobs.title: People Operations Lead
jobs.description:
About Juicebox

Juicebox is on a mission to help teams win the talent war.

In the age of AI, human ingenuity is the ultimate scarce resource. Recruiting is a zero-sum game where you either compete or lose.

Teams at Ramp, Notion, and leading AI labs use Juicebox to power their hiring, alongside 5,000+ customers from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 companies.

We are on the path to $100M in ARR with 20%+ monthly growth, powering thousands of searches every day and making Juicebox one of the fastest-growing AI SaaS companies in the world.

Juicebox has raised over $116M in funding from lead investors including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and NFDG. Read more about our $80M Series B https://juicebox.ai/blog/series-b here. Additional investors in Juicebox include Y Combinator, Coatue, Bond, Lux, Verified Capital, and Committed Capital.



About the Role

We're looking for a People Operations Lead to build and own our People function as Juicebox continues to scale. You'll be responsible for the full employee experience, spanning onboarding, benefits, performance management, culture, and employment compliance across the US and UK, reporting into the Company’s General Counsel.

As our first dedicated People hire, you'll have the opportunity to build foundational processes and systems from the ground up. From implementing performance reviews and feedback cycles to developing employee policies and ensuring compliance as we grow, you'll help create the infrastructure that supports our team at every stage.

You'll work closely with leadership and have significant ownership over how we attract, develop, and retain talent. This is a highly hands-on, generalist role where speed matters, good judgment is essential, and you'll have the autonomy to make things happen.



You Will…

 - Own day-to-day People Operations, including onboarding, benefits administration, employee support, and offboarding

 - Build and improve performance management processes, including feedback cycles, annual reviews, promotions, and employee development

 - Implement and manage People systems and tools to streamline employee workflows and processes

 - Own employee policies and documentation, ensuring offer letters, handbooks, leave policies, and office policies stay accurate and up to date

 - Manage employment compliance across the US and UK, staying ahead of changes to labor laws and regulatory requirements

 - Partner with leadership to strengthen culture, employee engagement, and the overall employee experience

 - Build scalable People processes and infrastructure to support a rapidly growing team

 - Leverage AI tools and automation to streamline People workflows and improve operational efficiency




You Have…

 - 4–7 years of experience in People Operations, HR, or a related generalist role

 - Hands-on experience across core HR functions, including benefits, onboarding, employment compliance, and performance management

 - Strong understanding of US employment laws, UK employment law (or ability to ramp quickly), and HR compliance, including leave policies, employee classification, and regulatory requirements

 - Experience building or managing performance programs, including feedback cycles, promotions, and annual reviews

 - Highly autonomous, scrappy, and comfortable building processes from scratch in a fast-moving environment

 - Exceptional judgment and discretion, with the ability to handle highly sensitive employee and business information with strict confidentiality

 - Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with employees and leadership

 - A proactive, detail-oriented approach and the ability to balance strategic initiatives with day-to-day execution

Perks & Benefits for all Full Time Employees

 - Top-of-market compensation with meaningful equity, because everyone should share in our success.

 - Daily meals provided: breakfast catering, lunch order via DoorDash corporate, and for those who like to work late, dinner if staying after 7pm

For US Employees:

 - Comprehensive healthcare with 100% employer-paid medical coverage for employees (PPO Platinum plan with $0 deductible). 90% employer contribution for dependents. Dental & Vision: 90% employer covered; 85% for dependents.

 - $2,000 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 - $300/month commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

For UK Employees:

 - Comprehensive private medical insurance with £0 excess, full outpatient cover, comprehensive cancer care, mental health treatment, and 24/7 GP access.

 - £1,500 annual wellness stipend to support your physical, mental, and financial well-being

 - £3,500/year commuting stipend to help cover the cost of getting to and from the office.

jobs.description:
Baya Systems is inspired by the baya bird, also known as the weaver. Baya birds weave very unique and intricate hanging nests from different materials. The nests are robust and safe while being extremely lightweight and efficient.

Baya is a fast-moving Series B startup built by serial entrepreneurs with a vision to accelerate intelligent computing in the emerging chiplet era.  We focus on software-driven, unified fabric solutions for single-die and multi-die systems. We design and license disruptive intellectual property for use in semiconductor chips, with software development platforms to simplify the design process and reduce the time to market for complex System-on-Chip (SoC) and multi-chiplet systems. This enables our partners to innovate and deliver compelling solutions for data center, infrastructure, AI, Automotive, and Edge IoT markets. We are looking for energetic and dedicated individuals share our passion for enabling innovation and excellence in the semiconductor industry that empowers game-changing products and services!

Job Title: Sr. Physical Design Engineer

Location: Santa Clara, CA

About the role: We are seeking a seasoned Physical Design Engineer with a strong background in all aspects of Physical Design and Implementation flows. The ideal candidate will play a key role in shaping our technology portfolio, bringing expertise and creativity to our solutions

Responsibilities:

Own RTL to GDS physical implementation flows for synthesis, floor-planning, place and route, clock tree synthesis, timing & power closure, EM/IR, PDV and final PD sign off

Own physical design & implementation of high-performance designs from block level to system level components

Deep collaboration with Micro-architects to explore performance, power and area trade-offs for high performance and low power designs

Physical implementation feasibility studies and design recommendations for best PPA

Develop methodologies and recipes for various stages of physical implementation

Perform various physical design validation (PDV) flows for Timing, Power, EM/IR, etc. to ensure physical design quality

Perform design rule checking (DRC), (LVS) checks, and other physical verification tasks

Qualifications:

BS, MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering or related degree

Experience in all aspects of physical design including synthesis, floor planning, place & route, timing & power closure, EM/IR, physical design validation, etc

Experience with synthesis, place & route, static timing analysis and PDV tools

Experience in implementing clock trees and power grids

Experience with scripting for physical design flow automation

Experience with Synopsys Design Compiler, Prime Time, ICC, Fusion Compiler etc.

Good knowledge of high-performance and low-power microarchitecture and logic design principles

Understanding of modern (sub 7nm) sub-micron technology nodes and device physics

Basic knowledge of System/SoC Architecture and System Verilog RTL coding

Strong communication and collaboration skills

Compensation:

• Salary commensurate with experience

• Performance incentives

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401(k) retirement plan

• Equity

jobs.description:
As a Onboarding Project Manager at Remarcable, you’ll be the trusted guide for new customers stepping into our platform for the first time. You’ll ensure every customer has a smooth, confident, and successful start — setting the tone for a lasting partnership.

Your mission: help our customers realize value fast, empower them through great training and support, and hand them off to our Customer Success team fully equipped to thrive. You’ll be the critical bridge between our product and the real-world success of our users.

What You’ll Do

 - Lead onboarding journeys – Guide new customers through setup and configuration of our platform, ensuring a smooth and timely implementation.

 - Train and empower – Deliver engaging product demos, onboarding calls, and group webinars to teach customers best practices and help them see quick wins.

 - Create resources – Develop and maintain onboarding materials, training guides, and self-serve documentation to scale your impact.

 - Be the customer’s go-to – Serve as the primary contact during onboarding, addressing questions, resolving setup issues, and ensuring customers feel supported.

 - Collaborate across teams – Work closely with Sales to ensure a seamless handoff, and partner with Customer Success to transition accounts post-onboarding.

 - Drive improvement – Capture feedback from new customers to help refine our onboarding experience and influence product enhancements.

Who You Are

 - 2+ years of Project Management experience OR 4+ years of experience in customer onboarding, implementation, training, or account management (B2B SaaS preferred).

 - Experience or familiarity with the construction industry (electrical, mechanical, or general contracting) or construction technology is strongly preferred.

 - Excellent communicator and presenter, comfortable leading customer sessions individually or in groups.

 - Strong project management and organization skills — you can juggle multiple onboardings without dropping details.

 - Quick learner with technical aptitude; you love diving into new tools and helping others master them.

 - Collaborative team player with a customer-first mindset and a passion for helping people succeed.

Who We Are

 - At Remarcable, we’re transforming how the construction industry works.

 - Our cloud-based platform helps electrical contractors and distributors streamline purchasing and tool management — saving time, money, and frustration while improving visibility and efficiency.

 - We’re a fast-growing company with deep roots in the contractor and distribution space, backed by a passionate team and expanding nationwide with a growing hub in Omaha. If you’re energized by innovation, impact, and growth, you’ll fit right in.

Apply now and be part of a team that’s making construction more connected, efficient, and—well—Remarcable.

jobs.title: Head of Social
jobs.description:
Substack is building a new economic engine for culture, giving the brightest, most interesting, and most creative people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack empowers independent writers, artists, videographers, podcasters, and creators of all types to create, share, and make a living off their work through subscriptions, while offering them creative freedom, ownership, and a direct connection to their audiences.



We’re looking for a Head of Social to own how Substack shows up on external social channels, and turn social into a driver of consumer discovery, creator growth, and cultural credibility. This is a leadership role on the Brand & Communications team. You will set the vision, hire and develop a small team across social strategy, creative, and community, and stay close enough to the work to shape what ships each day.



The ideal candidate is a creative thinker with deep fluency across social platforms. This person will define Substack's social vision and platform-by-platform strategy, tied to company goals for creator growth, reader acquisition, and brand perception. They will partner with the editorial, partnerships, and product teams to determine which channels make sense for amplifying which moments, in service of promoting creator stories and positioning Substack as the home for great culture.



This role will sit on the Brand & Communications team and will report directly to the Head of Brand & Communications.



Core responsibilities

 - Lead the team and the work. Hire, manage, and develop a multidisciplinary social team, and set a high bar for craft and judgment.

 - Manage proactive storytelling. Turn the brand’s positioning into a consistent point of view across daily posts. Build and execute larger social moments as part of major brand campaigns.

 - Build a rapid response strategy. Build systems and a perspective on rapid response, so the team can effectively move fast and weigh in on stories relevant to the brand.

 - Turn creators into heroes. Partner with the Partnerships & Editorial teams to spotlight the writers, podcasters, and video creators who make Substack distinctive.

 - Product storytelling: Work with product and growth to turn launches and features into stories that travel on relevant social platforms.

 - Measure what matters. Define the metrics that connect social to business outcomes, and report on them to leadership. Use data, testing, and audience insight to decide what to make more of, and what to stop.



About You

 - 8+ years in social media. Including 3+ years leading teams, ideally at a media, publishing, creator-economy, or consumer technology company.

 - Exceptional Audience Building. A track record of building a recognizable voice and growing an audience on social platforms.

 - Strong editorial instincts. Know what makes a post worth sharing, and you can say why a draft isn't there yet. Move quickly, while holding a high bar for excellence.

 - Fluency in Platforms. Deeply familiar with how platforms work today, from short-form video to text-first feeds, and have the judgment to know which stories can cut through.

 - A data-literate approach: Set clear goals, test, and report honestly on what worked. Leverage data to inform strategy, and adjust when things aren’t working.

 - Exceptional Writer and Communicator. Sharp, clear communicator with a strong sense of the voice and tone for the brand.

 - Substack Literate. A genuine interest in independent media and the culture around it. Being a Substack creator is a plus.



Substack offers a competitive compensation package that includes salary, equity, and exceptional benefits. The salary range for this role is $180k-$240k with final offers based on experience and expertise.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Substack's collection and use of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here https://docs.google.com/document/d/1UjmY1acxnd27iIde83PxR7XdecR29aIyfkkmEOwAMGY/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.a0wuzmt3mjmm.

jobs.title: Regional Director
jobs.description:
Area Director, Sales

York Company Owned HVAC Distribution (OEM-Owned)

Position Summary

The Area Director, Sales, is responsible for driving top-line revenue growth, market share expansion, and sales performance across a designated geographic region within a York Company Owned OEM HVAC distribution network. This role leads the regional sales organization and is accountable for achieving equipment, parts, supplies, and accessory sales targets through contractor development, account penetration, and market growth initiatives.

The Area Director serves as the senior sales leader for the region, partnering with Branch Managers and sales teams to increase contractor loyalty, expand the York brand preference, and accelerate sales growth. While working closely with operations and branch leadership, the primary accountability for this position is sales revenue generation and market share growth.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Revenue Growth Leadership

• Develop and execute regional sales strategies to achieve annual revenue targets.
• Drive profitable sales growth across residential, light commercial, and commercial HVAC product lines.
• Establish annual, quarterly, and monthly sales objectives for sales teams.
• Monitor sales performance and implement corrective action plans when results fall below expectations.
• Lead initiatives that increase equipment, parts, and accessory sales.

Market Share Expansion

• Increase York equipment market share throughout the assigned territory.
• Identify opportunities to convert competitive accounts and contractors.
• Expand contractor participation in York loyalty and growth programs.
• Develop territory-specific growth strategies based on local market conditions.
• Monitor competitive activity and recommend actions to improve market position.

Contractor & Customer Development

• Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key contractors and strategic accounts.
• Conduct regular customer visits with branch and territory sales personnel.
• Support customer business development efforts through training, dealer programs, and growth initiatives.
• Resolve significant customer issues impacting sales performance.
• Promote long-term contractor loyalty and customer retention.

Sales Team Leadership

• Lead, coach, and develop Sales Managers, Territory Managers, and Account Representatives.
• Establish clear sales performance expectations and accountability measures.
• Conduct regular business reviews focused on revenue growth and pipeline development.
• Develop succession plans and identify high-potential sales talent.
• Foster a high-performance sales culture focused on growth and execution.

Business Planning & Forecasting

• Develop annual sales plans, forecasts, and growth initiatives.
• Analyze sales trends, market conditions, and customer opportunities.
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts and pipeline visibility.
• Recommend resource allocation and market investments to maximize revenue opportunities.
• Participate in strategic planning and annual operating reviews.

York Company Owned Program Execution

• Ensure successful implementation of York sales programs and initiatives.
• Drive adoption of new products, technologies, and product launches.
• Promote strategic product categories and growth initiatives.
• Provide market intelligence and contractor feedback to senior leadership.
• Support pricing and promotional strategies designed to increase sales performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Operations, Product Management, Marketing, and Finance teams to support revenue growth objectives.
• Work with branch leadership to align sales strategies and customer service initiatives.
• Collaborate with York leadership on regional growth opportunities.
• Support training and educational programs that enhance contractor engagement.

Qualifications

Education

• Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field preferred.
• Equivalent industry experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

Experience

• 10+ years of progressive HVAC distribution or HVAC manufacturing sales leadership experience.
• Minimum 5 years leading multi-location sales organizations.
• Proven track record of consistently achieving and exceeding revenue growth objectives.
• Experience managing large contractor relationships and strategic accounts.
• Strong understanding of HVAC equipment, parts, distribution channels, and contractor business models.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Sales Leadership

• Strategic sales planning
• Territory management
• Market share growth
• Contractor relationship development
• Business development

Business Acumen

• Revenue forecasting
• Sales analytics
• Market analysis
• Opportunity pipeline management
• CRM utilization focused on Salesforce

Leadership Competencies

• Coaching and development
• Performance management
• Communication and influence
• Change leadership
• Executive presence

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Area Director will primarily be measured on:

• Total Revenue Growth (% and Dollars)
• Equipment Sales Revenue
• Parts and Supplies Sales Revenue
• York Market Share Growth
• New Contractor Acquisition
• Strategic Account Growth
• Sales Forecast Accuracy
• Dealer Program Participation
• Customer Retention
• Territory Sales Productivity

Reporting Structure

Reports To: Executive Director of Sales & Marketing

Direct Reports:

• Account Managers
• Sales Managers
• Inside Sales Representatives
• Commercial Specialists

Geographic Responsibility:

• Multiple branch locations within an assigned territory
• Regional responsibility ranging from $50M to $500M+ in annual sales revenue
• Travel required to store or region locations monthly

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Machine Learning) - Economy ML
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The Economy ML team is building the machine learning backbone for Roblox’s virtual economy - from intelligent pricing and personalized storefronts to dynamic layout optimization and avatar content understanding. We partner closely with Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization to deliver ML systems that drive long‑term value across engagement, retention, and creator earnings.

As a Senior ML Software Engineer on the team, you will build the infrastructure and backend services that train, serve, and integrate the models powering ranking, personalization, and pricing across Roblox’s economic surfaces, including Marketplace, Developer Monetization, and Payments. Your work determines how quickly we can take new models from idea to production, and how well they perform once they are serving millions of users.

You Will

• Build and operate the training infrastructure behind Economy ML’s ranking, recommendation, and pricing models: distributed training jobs, efficient data loading, and reproducible pipelines from raw data to trained model.

• Co-design models and systems with ML engineers: profile and optimize training and inference for our ranking and recommendation models, improving GPU utilization, memory, throughput, and latency (e.g., moving models to GPU serving, request batching, mixed precision, faster request-time feature processing).

• Design and build the backend services and APIs that bring model predictions into Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization, with clear latency budgets and graceful fallbacks.

• Build and scale the batch and real-time data and feature pipelines that feed training and serving, with a focus on freshness, correctness, and training/serving consistency.

• Own the path from trained model to production serving: packaging, deployment, versioning, shadow and canary rollouts, and integration with A/B experiments on Roblox’s ML platform.

• Make the systems you own reliable and observable, and set the team’s best practices for logging, monitoring, alerting, and on-call across ML services.

• Partner with Roblox’s central ML platform and data infrastructure teams, and with Marketplace / Economy backend teams, to adopt shared infrastructure and contribute improvements back to it.

• Contribute to the technical direction of the Economy ML team: help shape our training and serving stack, infrastructure roadmap, and the tradeoffs between model quality, latency, and cost.

• Mentor other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on guidance, helping raise the technical bar of the broader Economy organization.

You Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years building and operating ML infrastructure or ML-backed production services at high scale. Experience with recommendation, search, or ads systems is a strong plus.

• Solid engineering fundamentals in Python and at least one other backend language, with a track record of designing and operating distributed, low-latency services.

• Hands-on experience training and serving deep learning models in production with PyTorch, including scaling training across GPUs and nodes and deploying models on GPU inference servers. Comfortable profiling and optimizing for utilization, memory, latency, and cost.

• Experience building batch and streaming data pipelines and feature stores (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka), with attention to data quality and training/serving skew.

• You build systems that are easy to debug and operate, and you take ownership of production health, from monitoring and alerting to incident response.

• You enjoy working closely with ML engineers, platform teams, product managers, and data scientists across Marketplace, Payments, and Developer Monetization, and you can drive alignment in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.

• You understand how infrastructure choices (latency, freshness, cost) affect model quality and product metrics, and you prioritize work by its impact on users, creators, and the business.

• BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Your primary focus will be developing and delivering two training types, DCS System and DCS Software (Datum). This will include clear, practical training on Datum functionality, software workflows, and system operation for Maintenance and Operations teams. As part of our Customer Service team, you’ll create training plans and user guides, identify learning gaps, and help customers understand system functionality and workflows while building lasting relationships and delivering on our promises.

In this role, you will…

• Train Operations teams on their overall system components and functions.

• Build manuals and presentations to support System Training.

• Develop and deliver customer training on Datum, our warehouse execution system (WES), with a focus on software functionality, system navigation, operating workflows, and troubleshooting. Explain how Datum works with automated conveyor and PLC control systems and use technical documentation and operating instructions to build clear training plans and user guides.

• Coordinate vendor-led software and systems training during projects and collect and organize documentation to support customer learning.

• Communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing, with Maintenance and Operations teams to align software and systems training with customer needs and contract obligations.

• Maintain records of completed customer training and use participant feedback to identify knowledge gaps and improve software and systems training.

• Sell and schedule additional software and systems training as needed, determine service charges, and coordinate billing.

• Travel up to 50% (30% Typical) to customer and vendor locations to deliver and receive software and systems training.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have at least two years of experience working with fully automated conveyor and PLC control systems, including the software interfaces used to operate, monitor, and troubleshoot them.

• You have a working knowledge of high- and low-voltage electrical systems and understand how software and controls interact with conveyor equipment.

• You can plan and manage software and systems training schedules with clear learning objectives and practical, task-based instruction.

• You can explain technical software and systems concepts clearly, demonstrate workflows, and help Maintenance and Operations teams apply what they learn.

• You bring strong customer service skills, listen effectively, and collaborate with customers, vendors, and teammates to understand training needs and support learning.

• You can manage competing priorities and adapt training plans to changing schedules, customer needs, and system requirements.

jobs.title: Commercial Legal Director
jobs.description:
DAVE VS. GOLIATH. WE’RE DAVE.

Dave is a financial app on a mission to build products that level the financial playing field. It is redefining the financial landscape by leveraging technology to create an affordable, transparent, and user-centric access to liquidity for millions of Americans. As a leading innovator in the U.S. financial services sector, Dave’s digital financial platform offers products designed to meet the credit needs of those underserved by traditional financial institutions. Dave’s offerings include its flagship ExtraCash product, providing members up to $500 within minutes. The company is on track to launch several new product offerings in 2026, including a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) option.



Dave is focused on serving Americans who are financially vulnerable or living paycheck to paycheck. Dave is leading the charge in creating a new era of credit products that prioritizes speed, affordability, and accessibility, making it the go-to financial partner for those who need it most.



As Commercial Legal Director, you'll be a trusted legal advisor across Dave, bringing deep expertise in technology transactions, AI, and commercial contracting to some of our most important business decisions.

You'll own complex negotiations, establish scalable contracting standards, and help teams navigate novel legal questions with sound judgment and practical solutions. This is an opportunity to influence how we operate across product, engineering, finance, marketing, and other functions while balancing business priorities, legal risk, and long-term impact.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Lead complex commercial transactions: Own strategy, negotiation, and execution for high-impact agreements, including SaaS, technology licensing, partnerships, marketing, services, agency, and other commercial arrangements.

 - Shape our legal frameworks: Develop and evolve negotiation standards, playbooks, templates, and contracting policies that support consistency, sound risk management, and business growth.

 - Guide emerging technology decisions: Advise on complex legal issues involving AI, machine learning, intellectual property, data privacy, security, and evolving regulatory considerations.

 - Build scalable legal operations: Improve contracting workflows, governance, and analytics using Ironclad and AI-enabled tools to make legal processes more effective, measurable, and sustainable.

 - Advise across the business: Partner with leaders across engineering, product, marketing, finance, and people teams to evaluate risk, resolve complex challenges, and enable informed decisions.

 - Advance legal strategy: Identify emerging legal and commercial risks, develop forward-looking solutions, and engage outside counsel when specialized expertise is needed.


THE IMPACT

Your work will help Dave pursue new opportunities, strengthen commercial relationships, and navigate emerging technologies responsibly. By building thoughtful legal frameworks, you'll enable teams to move forward with clarity while protecting our members and supporting sustainable growth.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - J.D. and 8+ years of relevant law firm and/or in-house legal experience, with substantial ownership of complex technology transactions and commercial matters.

 - Demonstrated expertise negotiating sophisticated SaaS, licensing, partnership, and technology agreements.

 - Deep understanding of AI-related commercial legal issues, including enterprise risk, intellectual property, data privacy, and security.

 - Experience establishing legal contracting standards, playbooks, and scalable operational frameworks.

 - Hands-on experience with Ironclad or comparable contract lifecycle management platforms.

 - Strong commercial judgment, with the ability to evaluate complex risks and communicate practical recommendations to senior stakeholders.

 - Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Bonus points for: Experience in fintech or financial services, AI/ML technologies, cloud services, and advertising or marketing transactions.




WHAT MAKES SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL HERE

You bring independent judgment to complex decisions and take responsibility for outcomes, not just agreements. You understand how legal decisions connect to our products, members, and broader business. You care about building solutions that hold up over time and know when to challenge assumptions, make thoughtful trade-offs, or recommend a different path.

You also recognize that strong legal counsel depends on partnership. You build trust across functions, welcome different perspectives, and communicate complex issues clearly. When priorities or regulations evolve, you adapt your approach while maintaining sound legal principles and helping others move forward confidently.




WHAT TO EXPECT

You'll have meaningful autonomy, access to senior decision-makers, and the opportunity to shape practices across Dave. The work involves evolving business priorities and emerging legal questions, with decisions informed by data, thoughtful analysis, and collaborative problem-solving.




WHY JOIN DAVE?

At Dave, you'll work on meaningful challenges at the intersection of financial technology, AI, and commercial innovation. You'll have the scope to influence important decisions, build better systems, and contribute to a mission that directly impacts millions of members.



Ready to build for the underdog?

Reports to: Senior Director, Assistant General Counsel



Don’t let imposter syndrome get in the way of an incredible opportunity. We’re looking for people who can help us achieve our mission and vision, not just check off the boxes. Why you’ll love working here:

jobs.title: Boilermaker
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BOILERMAKER

Starbase is standing up on-site power generation for the Starbase supercomputer. This boilermaker role builds the plate, duct, and tank side of that plant. You fit, align, and weld turbine exhaust duct, selective catalytic reduction (SCR) casings and stack shell, and aqueous ammonia tanks. Where the steam side is set, you also install HRSG or steam-generator casing, modules, and pressure parts so the packages can be tied in and tested.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Fit and weld turbine exhaust duct from the package outlet to the SCR, including spools, expansion joints, dampers, and turning vanes

• Assemble SCR housing, stack shell, liner plate, and casing; land sections on the structural steel and bolt and weld them per drawings and specs

• Erect and weld aqueous ammonia storage tanks and other field-erected or shop tanks; fit nozzles so pipefitters can tie in

• When HRSG or steam-generator parts are on the job, install casing, modules, headers, and tubes; align and weld pressure parts to the weld map and WPS

• Lay out, cut, bevel, and fit plate; set gaps, hi-lo, and alignment before weld-out, including purge and preheat where the WPS requires it

• Support hydro and pneumatic tests of tanks, duct, and pressure parts: install blinds and test packs, walk the seams, and repair weld leaks

• Rig and signal crane picks of duct, casing, stack cans, tank courses, and modules; keep every pick inside the lift plan

• Read arrangement, plate, tank, and weld-map drawings; flag conflicts with steel, piping, and equipment before a section is landed

• Work with millwrights at the turbine exhaust flange, ironworkers on supports and stack steel, and pipefitters at nozzles and tie-ins

• Stage plate, weld consumables, and tools; keep laydown yards and work fronts orderly

• Open and close work areas, including confined-space setups: protection, debris removal, scrap segregation, and end-of-shift reset so the next crew can start immediately

• Follow fall protection, confined-space, LOTO, PPE, and permit rules; do not work under a suspended load or on live systems without authorization

• Report damaged plate, bad fit-up, unsafe conditions, and drawing conflicts immediately

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 2+ years of hands-on boilermaker experience; OR completion of a recognized boilermaker apprenticeship; OR equivalent military experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Journey-level boilermaker card, NCCER Boilermaker, or equivalent credential

• Experience fitting and welding power-plant exhaust duct, SCR or stack plate, HRSG modules, or field-erected tanks

• Current ASME Section IX welder qualification (SMAW, FCAW, and/or GTAW) on plate or tube

• Tube welding to a WPS, including mirror welding, backing purge, and preheat

• AWS D1.1 for structural attachments where the weld map calls for it

• Qualified rigger and/or crane signalperson (NCCCO, NCCER, or equivalent)

• OSHA 10 or equivalent training, and a current confined-space qualification

• Ability to read arrangement drawings, plate details, tank drawings, and weld maps

• Experience working around aqueous ammonia or other power-plant emissions equipment

• Strong safety mindset; willing to follow fall protection, confined-space, LOTO, and permit rules

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to work all shifts, overtime and/or weekends as needed

• Must be able to work at heights and in confined spaces inside duct, stacks, tanks, and casings

• Able to stand for long periods; climbing, bending, kneeling, crouching, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching are required

• Able to lift at least 50 lbs. unassisted

• Must be able to work outdoors in South Texas heat, wind, and rain, and around 19% aqueous ammonia SCR equipment

• Must wear required PPE, including fall protection, confined-space gear, and respiratory protection when specified

• Able to work under adverse conditions (e.g., dirty, noisy, hot, confined, or at height)

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: Medical Assistant - Silver Lake
jobs.description:
About Tia

Tia is building a new model for women’s healthcare, one that treats women as whole people, not separate conditions or life stages. By integrating primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across both in-person and virtual settings, Tia is improving outcomes, lowering costs, and creating a better experience for patients and providers alike.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Medical Assistant to support day-to-day clinical care and patient flow at our TIA Silver Lake clinic.

As a Medical Assistant at Tia, you’ll help keep the clinic running smoothly by rooming patients, collecting health information and vitals, supporting providers, preparing exam rooms, performing phlebotomy, and helping ensure each patient feels seen, heard, and cared for. This role is a great fit for someone who is highly organized, calm under pressure, detail-oriented, and energized by delivering an excellent patient experience.

Why Tia

• Opportunity to help reimagine women’s healthcare

• Collaborative clinic environment with providers, MAs, and front-of-house teams

• Mission-driven team focused on high-quality, personalized patient care

• Hands-on role supporting both clinical care and clinic operations

• Opportunity to build experience in an integrated women’s health model

What You’ll Do

• Patient Rooming & Clinical Support: Room patients, collect relevant health information, review health summaries, take vitals, and document accurately in the medical record.

• Provider Support: Help providers prepare for patient visits by reviewing upcoming schedules, capturing relevant patient context, and communicating important updates throughout the clinic day.

• Patient Flow & Clinic Coordination: Monitor the schedule, help move patients smoothly from front of house to back of house, and partner with the care team to keep clinic flow on track.

• Labs, Imaging & Follow-Up: Support lab and imaging workflows, including entering orders, confirming diagnosis codes, updating pharmacy information, and helping ensure follow-up items are completed in a timely manner.

• Phlebotomy & Clinical Procedures: Perform phlebotomy and specimen collection as needed while following Tia’s clinical guidelines and safety standards.

• Clinic Readiness: Prepare, clean, disinfect, and restock exam rooms throughout the day, including supply management, expiration checks, autoclaving, and ordering supplies as needed.

• Personalized Patient Care: Capture relevant patient preferences, needs, and context to help the broader care team deliver thoughtful, individualized care.

What You’ll Bring

Requirements

• Medical Assistant certification or completion of a Medical Assistant training program, as required by applicable state or payer requirements

• 1-2 years of experience in a clinical, ambulatory, primary care, women’s health, or patient-facing healthcare setting

• Phlebotomy experience

• Experience taking and documenting vitals

• Comfort using electronic medical record systems and clinical documentation tools

• Strong attention to detail and ability to follow clinical workflows and documentation standards

• Highly organized, calm under pressure, and able to manage multiple priorities in a busy clinic environment

• Strong patient service orientation and ability to communicate with empathy, professionalism, and discretion

• Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements

• Authorization to work in the United States

• Ability to work Monday-Friday opening or closing shifts, with rotating Saturdays as needed

Nice to Have

• Experience in women’s health, primary care, gynecology, dermatology, or integrated care settings

• Experience supporting LGBTQ+ patients or patients from diverse backgrounds and communities

• Experience with DrChrono, TiaMD, or similar EMR systems

• Experience with autoclaving, disinfecting, supply management, and clinical inventory workflows

• Strong understanding of data security protocols and healthcare privacy requirements

Work Location

This role is based onsite in TIA Silver Lake

This role requires an onsite clinic schedule

• Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM–4:30 PM, with one day per week scheduled from 10:30 AM–7:00 PM.

• Rotating Saturdays: 7: 30 am -4 pm

Compensation & Benefits

Tia is committed to pay equity and pay transparency. Compensation for this role will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, location, role leveling, business needs, and market conditions.

The expected compensation range for this role is: $20 - $24 per hour

You may also be eligible for:

• Medical, dental, and vision benefits, if applicable

• Paid time off, sick leave, and holidays, if applicable

• Professional development support

• Other role-specific benefits

About Tia

Tia is on a mission to transform healthcare for women by increasing access, improving outcomes, and delivering a better care experience. Our “Whole Woman, Whole Life” model integrates primary care, gynecology, mental health, dermatology, and wellness across in-person care and a national virtual platform.

We are a Series D, venture-backed company trusted by more than 120,000 women across four markets. Through our technology-enabled care model and partnerships with leading health systems, Tia is building one of the most comprehensive preventive care models for women.

About Tia’s Culture

Tia is building a culture of excellence in people, process, and product. For us, excellence is not perfection. It is the ongoing pursuit of improvement through learning, reflection, experimentation, curiosity, grit, and care for ourselves and others. We are looking for people who are energized by building, iterating, asking why, and helping create a fundamentally better healthcare experience for women.

This position may require attendance at company and team off-sites.

Scam Notice

Tia will never ask for payment, gift cards, or sensitive financial information during the hiring process. All communication from our team will come from an official company email address ending in @asktia.com. If something feels off, please contact peopleservices@asktia.com.

Equal Opportunity

Tia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity of experience, perspectives, and background leads to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users and patients. We strongly encourage people of color and members of the LGBTQ+ community to apply.

If you are committed to collaborative problem solving, high-quality work, and making waves in women’s healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Fully Licensed Therapist - Eating Disorder (Remote Hawaii)
jobs.description:
About Equip 

Equip is the leading virtual, evidence-based eating disorder treatment program on a mission to ensure that everyone with an eating disorder can access treatment that works. Created by clinical experts in the field and people with lived experience, Equip builds upon evidence-based treatments to empower individuals to reach lasting recovery. All Equip patients receive a dedicated care team, including a therapist, dietitian, physician, and peer and family mentor. The company operates in all 50 states and is partnered with most major health insurance plans. Learn more about our strong outcomes https://equip.health/outcomes and treatment approach at www.equip.health. http://www.equip.health

Founded in 2019, Equip has been a fully virtual company since its inception and is proud of the highly-engaged, passionate, and diverse Equipsters that have created Equip’s culture.  Recognized by Time https://time.com/collection/time100-companies-2023/6285207/equip/ as one of the most influential companies of 2023, along with awards from Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2022-50-us-companies-rise-linkedin-news/ and Lattice https://lattice.com/blog/announcing-the-2023-finalists-for-lattices-people-success-awards, we are grateful to Equipsters for building a sustainable treatment program that has served thousands of patients and families.

About the Role

The Licensed Therapist will be responsible for working closely and effectively with a multidisciplinary care team (including nutrition, medical, psychiatry, and mentorship) and utilize evidence-based based care modalities (such as FBT and CBT-E). The Licensed Therapist will be responsible for evidence based treatment delivery, quality documentation, and ongoing assessment of patients’ and families’ needs.

The Licensed Therapist role involves emotionally rewarding but inherently difficult work. To ensure continuity of care for both patients and providers, we are committed to offering benefits that support long-term well-being and job satisfaction. The Licensed Therapist has Flex PTO (recommended 3-5 weeks), which we encourage all providers to take, as well as company holidays. They also have access to an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a company-paid resource for mental health, legal services, financial support, and more. We know this work is hard, and strive to take care of our people who work so hard taking care of others.

Working Hours:

Equip’s working hours are Monday - Friday, between 8am-8pm in Therapist’s respective patient care time zone*.

 - Ability to provide 30 hours a week of availability for direct patient care, including new patients and follow-up sessions.

 - Ability to commit to a minimum of 16 hours of direct patient care after 2 pm in Therapist’s respective patient care time zone throughout the week (3pm if you live in the Mountain Standard Time Zone to accommodate Pacific Time Zone patients).

 - Ability to commit to working until 8pm two evenings per week (you choose which evenings and you can start later in the day on these days).

 - Ability to attend mandatory meetings (i.e Group Supervision, Treatment Huddles, Labs/All Hands, Individual Supervision, etc.).

 

Responsibilities 

 - Provide evidence-based family, individual, and group therapy for eating disorders and comorbid diagnoses in a virtual clinic (i.e. telehealth) setting.

 - Implement family-based treatment (FBT), enhanced cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT-E), cognitive behavioral therapy for ARFID, and other evidence-based treatments for patients across the lifespan with eating disorders and their loved ones.

 - Maintain a caseload of 30-40; with the expectation being 20-26 hours of direct care and remaining time dedicated to administrative tasks. 

 - Participate in initial and ongoing trainings.

 - Assess and diagnose mental health conditions.

 - Collaborate with a multidisciplinary treatment team of physicians, dietitians, patient mentors, and family mentors, along with outside providers.

 - Utilize between-session messaging to support patients and communicate with the treatment team through Equip’s EMR in accordance with Equip’s policies and procedures.

 - Engage and collaborate in Treatment Team meetings, supervision, and department meetings.

 - Maintain licensure in home state and obtain licensure in other states as requested by Equip (licensure costs will be covered by Equip).

 - Perform other duties as assigned.

 

Qualifications

Must Haves

 - Active, unrestricted, and independent license to practice psychotherapy in Hawaii. 

 - Ability to support a caseload of patients of all ages, co-occurring conditions, backgrounds and cultures, and with varying degrees of acuity.

 - Passion for evidence-based care and treatment.

 - Ability to provide care 2 evenings per week (meaning being available until 8pm in your patient caseloads primary time zone).

 - Enthusiastic, strong team player.

 - Ability to safely and effectively deliver care in a virtual setting.

 - Passion for mental health and eating disorder treatment and expanding access to treatment.

Nice to Haves (preferred but not required)

 - Experience in Family-Based Treatment and/or eating disorder treatment.

 - Experience with evidence-based treatment and/or intensive treatment settings.

 - Experience supporting patients with suicidal ideation and trauma.

 - Case management experience and/or experience working closely with a multidisciplinary care team. 

Compensation & Benefits Package

Compensation: 

 - Earning Potential Range: $71,000 to $95,000 Annually+ 15% Performance-Based Bonus Potential

Time Off:

 - Flex PTO policy (3-5 wks/year recommended) + 11 paid company holidays.

 - Generous Parental Leave Benefits.

Core Benefits:

 - Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and AD&D insurance.
   
   - Equip pays for a significant percentage of benefits premiums for individuals and families.

 - Spring Health, a 100% employer-paid mental health benefit through Guardian.
   
   - You can receive 5 free therapy sessions and 5 free coaching sessions per year for you and each of your dependents.

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP), a company paid resource for mental health, legal services, financial support, and more!

 - HealthJoy, a 100% employer-paid platform connecting you to a healthcare concierge who can help you navigate your benefits.

 - 401K Option!

Other Benefits

Student Loan Repayment:

 - $500/quarter for employees under a year of tenure.

 - $1,000/quarter for employees over a year of tenure.

Continuing Education:

 - Robust training in evidence-based treatments for eating disorders, including Family-Based Treatment, Enhanced Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, and Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for ARFID. Comparable training workshops and supervision in these modalities are valued over at $3,000 per training.

 - For therapists and medical providers, unlimited online courses through NetCE.

 - Up to $1,000/year stipend for continuing education.

Licensing:

 - Equip reimburses fees associated with initial licensure and license renewals (e.g., exam fees, application to the state board, exam study materials, etc.) for any Equip-required licenses and/or cross-licensure requests.

Work From Home Additional Perks:

 - $50/month stipend added directly to an employee’s paycheck to cover home internet expenses.

 - Initial work-from-home stipend of up to $500.
   
   - Reload of $200 on the home office stipend at the 3-year mark and then every other year after that (year 5, year 7, etc.).

 - Company Laptop.

Physical Demands 

Work is performed 100% from home with no requirement to travel. This is a stationary position that requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards as well as to talk or hear by telephone. Sit or stand as needed. 

At Equip, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) are woven into everything we do. At the heart of Equip’s mission is a relentless dedication to making sure that everyone with an eating disorder has access to care that works regardless of race, gender, sexuality, ability, weight, socio-economic status, and any marginalized identity. We also strive toward our providers and corporate team reflecting that same dedication both in bringing in and retaining talented employees from all backgrounds and identities. We have an Equip DEIB council, Equip For All; also referred to as EFA. EFA at Equip aims to be a space driven by mutual respect, and thoughtful, effective communication strategy - enabling full participation of  members who identify as marginalized or under-represented and allies, amplifying diverse voices, creating opportunities for advocacy and contributing to the advancement of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging at Equip.

As an equal opportunity employer, we provide equal opportunity in all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, compensation, training and promotion, termination, and any other terms and conditions of employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, familial status, age, disability, weight, and/or any other legally protected classification protected by federal, state, or local law. 

Our dedication to equitable access, which is core to our mission, extends to how we build our "village." In line with our commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging (DEIB), we are dedicated to an accessible hiring process where all candidates feel a true sense of belonging. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, interview, or perform the essential functions of a role, we invite you to reach out to our People team at accommodations@equip.health.

jobs.title: GTM Lead, APAC
jobs.description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI?

We're the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $1B in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

About the role

Higgsfield AI is looking for a GTM Lead, APAC to build and own our commercial business across Asia-Pacific (excluding Japan, which has its own dedicated lead). APAC is already one of our largest regions by creators and generations; this role turns that usage into agency, brand and enterprise revenue.

You will define the APAC go-to-market, source and close the region's first lighthouse accounts yourself, open the partner routes to market that matter in Asia, and set the playbook that the next wave of APAC hires will follow. You will work closely with our Asia-based Growth team, our US-based Enterprise team, and directly with company leadership.

The ideal candidate has sold creative, marketing or AI technology across at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures, knows when a partner is the right route in and when direct is, and is energised by owning a region from zero.

What you'll do

Open the APAC market

 - Build and execute Higgsfield's APAC go-to-market strategy, tiered by market: active selling in Singapore, Australia and New Zealand, Korea and Hong Kong; relationship building in Southeast Asia, India and Taiwan; later investment elsewhere.

 - Segment the region by readiness to buy: advertising and creative agencies, consumer brands, production companies, broadcasters and streamers, K-content, gaming and sports media.

 - Personally source, run and close the region's first enterprise and agency deals, from first touch through negotiation and signature, adapting to how each market buys: procurement-led in ANZ, relationship-first in Korea and Greater China, partner-led and price-sensitive in Southeast Asia and India.

 - Convert high-usage APAC creators, teams and agencies already on the platform into team and enterprise accounts.

Build pipeline and revenue

 - Own APAC pipeline, forecast and bookings; keep 3x+ pipeline coverage and report weekly to leadership.

 - Run an outbound-first motion in markets where inbound is thin, alongside platform-driven inbound where it is strong: executive outreach, events, partner introductions and creator-community referrals.

 - Lead commercial negotiations, enterprise agreements, and multi-year, usage-based and local-currency deal structures.

 - Build regional references and case studies that make the next APAC deal easier than the last.

Work the ecosystem

 - Build relationships with senior decision-makers at regional agency holding-company offices, independent agencies, consumer brands and media groups.

 - Identify and activate the partners that are the primary route to market in Asia (regional agency networks, telcos and platforms, production studios, system integrators, local resellers) with the Head of Partnerships.

 - Represent Higgsfield at APAC industry events and in regional media as the leading AI video platform for creative work.

 - Localise positioning, pricing packaging and campaigns for APAC buyers with Marketing and Product, and coordinate with our existing APAC content and community efforts.

 - Surface market, competitive, platform and regulatory signals from the region to Product, Legal and leadership.

 - Define what the APAC team should look like at 5 and 15 people, and help hire it.

What success looks like in year one

 - A tiered APAC market plan and sales playbook that leadership has signed off.

 - Marquee customers live in production in at least two active-selling markets, with public references.

 - Two or more partner channels producing qualified pipeline.

 - A forecast that is accurate within 15% quarter over quarter.

Requirements

 - 8+ years in enterprise sales, business development, partnerships or GTM leadership, including 3+ years selling SaaS, AI, creative technology, marketing technology or media technology in APAC.

 - A track record of sourcing and closing six- and seven-figure deals yourself, not only through a team.

 - Multi-country APAC experience: you have sold or led commercial efforts in at least three APAC markets with distinct buying cultures.

 - Partner and channel experience in APAC markets where partners are the primary route to market.

 - An existing network of senior buyers in APAC agencies, brands, media or entertainment companies.

 - Comfortable opening a region alone and far from HQ: no local marketing, SE or RevOps bench on day one, and independent decision-making across time zones.

 - Fluent English; Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, Bahasa or Thai is a strong plus.

 - Based in, or willing to relocate to, Almaty; or based in Singapore, Australia, Hong Kong or Korea with the right to work there and able to travel across the region and to Almaty regularly.

 - Genuine enthusiasm for generative AI and hands-on fluency with Higgsfield or comparable creative AI tools.

Nice to have

 - Experience at an AI-native company, a creator platform, a social or short-video platform, or a usage-based software business.

 - Relationships in K-content, gaming, or broadcaster and streamer ecosystems in Asia.

 - Prior experience as a first or founding commercial hire in a region.

What we're not looking for

 - A strategy-only leader who needs a team before they can produce results.

 - Someone whose success has depended on a large inbound brand and a full supporting bench.

 - A single-market seller; APAC is too diverse for one-country experience.

What we offer

 - Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role.

 - Equity participation through the company's stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield's long-term growth.

 - Relocation support for candidates moving from another city or country.

 - A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company.

 - Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales.

Location and working model

We would prefer this person to be based in Almaty, where much of our Growth team sits and which keeps workable overlap with every APAC time zone. We are equally happy with a fully remote hire based in Singapore, Sydney, Hong Kong or Seoul, with regular travel to customers across the region and to Almaty and San Francisco for planning sessions and company events. Team members are expected to maintain sufficient overlap with the Growth team's working hours and to be active, responsive and close collaborators across time zones.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for automotive mechanics with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Auto Technician, you will perform a full range of automotive repairs—from light maintenance to heavy engine work—and diagnostics on our vehicles, including:

If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Pay Range: $22.00 - $35.00 hourly (based on level of experience)

jobs.title: Designer, Research and Experiments
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Designer to lead hands-on design for research and experimental creative work. You’ll help define a project’s visual direction, build prototypes, and carry promising ideas through to finished work across research communications, demos, and experiences.

This role combines strong graphic design craft with an experimental approach to making. You’ll work closely with researchers, creative leads, and production partners, bringing structure to open-ended briefs and helping collaborators turn technical concepts into work people can understand and engage with.

In this role, you will:

 - Partner with researchers and creative leads to define the design problem, identify the essential story, and establish a clear visual direction.

 - Translate research concepts, methods, and findings into accurate visual narratives, checking interpretations and limitations with subject-matter experts.

 - Develop concepts and prototypes for experiments, demos, and experiences, using iterative making to test and refine creative possibilities.

 - Design across web, editorial, social, film, and experiential formats, maintaining a coherent visual idea as work moves between media.

 - Build reusable graphic systems, templates, and design patterns that support research communications and make future work easier to develop.

 - Guide design contributions from collaborators, give specific feedback, and maintain a high standard of typography, composition, and information design.

 - Own design delivery for complex workstreams, align priorities with partners, and adapt scope as research findings and production requirements evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 8+ years of relevant experience

 - A portfolio demonstrating senior-level design judgment, strong conceptual thinking, and polished work that makes complex ideas understandable.

 - Experience shaping visual direction and delivering projects from early exploration through final production, with substantial hands-on contribution.

 - Strong graphic design fundamentals and experience creating flexible visual systems across digital or physical applications.

 - An experimental practice that includes prototyping, testing approaches, and learning new tools or formats as the idea requires.

 - The curiosity to understand unfamiliar research, ask precise questions, and preserve technical meaning rather than simplify it inaccurately.

 - The ability to guide collaborators, explain design decisions, synthesize feedback, and maintain momentum when a brief is still developing.

 - Experience with research storytelling, creative technology, interactive or experiential work, motion systems, or AI-assisted making is especially relevant.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

In a Montessori environment designed to nurture concentration, confidence, and deep learning.

Montessori guides carefully prepare their classrooms to spark curiosity and independence. Through close observation, individualized lessons, and intentional language, you’ll support each child’s academic, social, and emotional development meeting them where they are and helping them grow.

Children in Montessori classrooms have the freedom to choose meaningful work, repeat activities until mastery, and take pride in their accomplishments. Your guidance helps every child develop focus, confidence, and a strong belief in their own abilities.

We believe children are capable. Our mission is to transform education by designing learning environments that cultivate independence, joy, and lifelong curiosity for children, families, and educators alike.

imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process to ensure each

vehicle meets Carvana’s vehicle quality standards. The qualifying candidate must love helping people

and possess the drive to achieve superior customer satisfaction. They must be goal-oriented,

enthusiastic, energetic, self-motivated, with the ability to interact and communicate with all levels of the organization.

The Technician, Inspection, will report to the Line Lead, Inspection, and will be an hourly full-time

position. No travel is required.

What you’ll be doing

departure, Bluetooth, etc.

in the vehicle reconditioning process

throughout the Inspection department.

• Report any safety issues or accidents to management immediately.

What you should know

This position requires a minimum of 6 months of Automotive Technician experience or an automotive

trade school degree and requires someone with an entry-level understanding of vehicle repair while

having an interest in continuing a career as a Technician in the automotive industry.

• Minimum 6 months of Automotive Technician experience including basic inspections

• A positive, can-do attitude with a desire to work in a team setting

• A quality-first mentality that takes pride in upholding Carvana’s vehicle quality standards

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes

being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Strong communication skills to engage with all departments at the Inspection Center

It would be great if you also had

• ASE Certifications

• Experience working in a high-end automotive facility or dealership

• Experience working in a lean manufacturing environment

• Experience working for a fast-paced hyper-growth company

What we’ll offer in return

• Competitive hourly wages (NO FLAT RATE)

• On the job training

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums for employees

• Excellent schedules that allow for work/life balance

• 401k with company match

• ASE and Tool Reimbursement Programs

• Tuition Reimbursement and Student Loan Repayment

• Vehicle Discount

• A company culture of growth, with a start-up atmosphere, allowing for varied and rapid career

development

• A leadership team that listens and is geared toward teammate engagement

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Must have a valid driver's license

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the

essential functions of their jobs.

Physical demands

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder

heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet

• Requires standing for an extended period of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking

and stooping, pushing and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet

and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles,
