Learn more at www.RapidSOS.com.

What this role is about:

Every legal request at RapidSOS comes through one front door, and this role owns it. As our Legal Operations & Paralegal Specialist, you’ll be the operating backbone of a lean, AI-native legal team that supports four Business Units. You’ll make sure every matter lands with the right owner on day one, that public-sector deals don’t stall waiting on paperwork, and that no insurance, filing, or compliance deadline is ever missed. This is an individual contributor role reporting to our Lead Corporate Counsel, and you’ll have real ownership from the start.

What you’ll do:

• Run Legal’s intake for 10+ new requests every business day. Triage each one and route it to the right owner the same day, with every required field filled in.

• Own corporate insurance end to end: work with our broker, drive the renewal timeline, and deliver certificates of insurance within two business days.

• Run the corporate compliance calendar, including annual reports, entity good standing, registered agent, Data Privacy Framework recertification, and our SAM.gov and GSA Schedule administration.

• Own the legal tech stack (our legal tracker, Ironclad, and the template library), and partner with our AI team to build intake rules, templates, and AI agents for work like order-form review, NDAs, and vendor review.

• Use GC AI, the Claude suite, Ironclad, and Coworker for first-pass checks of order forms, NDAs, and RFP requirements, and to compare customer insurance requirements against our coverage. You’ll confirm accuracy before anything leaves Legal.

• Keep Legal’s operating data clean and trusted, and deliver an automated weekly scorecard that shows leadership volume, turnaround, and bottlenecks at a glance.

• Handle sensitive matters, including HR investigations, litigation, M&A, and criminal justice data, with complete discretion.

What we’re looking for in our ideal candidate:

• 4+ years of experience as a paralegal or legal operations professional. In-house experience at a SaaS or government-contracting company is a strong plus.

• Hands-on experience with a CLM or matter-management system (Ironclad or similar).

• A track record of owning certificates of insurance, corporate filings, and entity maintenance.

• Fluency with AI tools for drafting, review, and workflow. You’ve built at least one automation or AI workflow yourself, and no-code tools count.

• Strong follow-through. You own deadlines across a high-volume queue without needing reminders.

• Sound judgment about what’s routine and what needs an attorney.

• Discretion with privileged and highly sensitive information, including criminal justice data and HR matters.

• Minimal to no travel required.

Nice-to-have experience (but not required!):

• Experience with SAM.gov, the GSA Schedule, or public-sector RFPs.

• A paralegal or legal operations certification.

What we offer:

• The chance to work with a passionate team on solving one of the largest challenges globally

• Competitive salary and benefits and equity participation

• A dynamic, flexible and fun start-up work environment with a highly talented team

If you're curious to learn more about RapidSOS, you can check out https://rapidsos.com/blog/

jobs.title: Commercial Strategy & Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.



Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.



To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers http://www.industriousoffice.com/careers.





ABOUT INDUSTRIOUS

Industrious is the largest premium flexible workspace company in the world, operating over 250 locations across 10 countries as part of the CBRE portfolio. We design workplaces where teams feel welcomed, supported, and able to do their best work. The same principle guides how we work together as a company.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Industrious forecasts revenue across a global network of flexible workspace locations, and the next step is making that forecasting predictive rather than reactive, while building equally strong visibility into the sales pipeline that feeds it. That is the challenge this role exists to solve.



As Manager, Commercial Analytics, based in New York and reporting into Commercial Strategy & Analytics leadership, you will own the models, data, and narrative that let Finance and commercial leadership see what is coming before it shows up in the numbers. The role calls for Strategic Thinking, because the real value here is spotting what pricing and pipeline trends mean before they hit the topline, and Problem Solving, because the data you need rarely arrives clean or connected.



If you want to build a capability rather than maintain one, and you want your forecasts to be the thing leadership actually plans around, this is a role where that is the job itself.




WHAT MIGHT YOUR DAY LOOK LIKE

Your Tuesday starts with a half-built forecast model open on one screen and a message from Finance on the other, asking whether this quarter's number still holds. You pull fresh data from Salesforce and Looker, reconcile it against what Snowflake is telling you, and start testing whether a slowdown you're seeing in one region is noise or signal.



By mid-morning you're on a call with Finance, walking through where the forecast and the budget target diverge and what would need to be true to close the gap: a stronger renewal pricing assumption here, a faster lease-up there. You're not setting the prices yourself, but you are turning what pricing and sales are already seeing into a number Finance can plan against.



In the afternoon you turn to pipeline: which deals are moving, which are stalling, and whether a particular product tier is underperforming across the portfolio. You build the view that did not exist before, the one that lets commercial leadership see sales velocity and conversion the way Finance already sees revenue.



You close the day writing a short memo, not a dashboard dump: here is what we're confident about, here is what's shifting, here is what we'd watch next. It lands in front of people who will act on it without needing to double check your work.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN

 - Build and continually refine the models that forecast revenue performance across the global network, so the business can act ahead of a slowdown rather than react to one.

 - Stand up clear visibility into pipeline health, conversion rates, and sales velocity, turning a gap in the current picture into a view commercial leadership can actually use.

 - Partner with Finance to connect commercial forecasts to company-level budgets and planning cycles, bridging the gap between target and forecast with assumptions both sides trust.

 - Shape decisions on pricing, unit economics, and marketing and sales efficiency by turning raw data into analysis people can act on.

 - Pull disparate, often messy data out of Salesforce, Looker, and Snowflake into one reliable, defensible picture of the business.

 - Translate models and analysis into memos and presentations that Finance and commercial leadership can act on directly, without needing it re-explained.
   
   

This role rewards Ownership, since you will be building much of this analytical foundation yourself, and Communication, since none of it creates value until leadership can understand and act on it.




YOU WILL LOVE THIS ROLE IF

 - You love finding the signal in messy data more than you mind the mess itself.

 - You are energized by owning a forecast end to end, from the raw numbers to the story leadership acts on.

 - You thrive partnering with Finance and sales leadership directly, without needing a manager to broker the relationship.

 - You are more motivated by building something that does not exist yet than maintaining something that already runs smoothly.

 - You love translating a complicated model into a few clear sentences someone can actually use.

 - You thrive working across global markets, not just the one you can see from your desk.
   
   


THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You need a fully built playbook before you start: revenue operations analytics is the newer, less mature half of this function, and you will be building much of that foundation yourself.

 - You prefer one deep, narrow technical build over moving between forecasting, pricing input, and pipeline analysis in the same week.

 - You want a team of analysts around you to divide the work: this is an individual contributor role where you own the output end to end.

 - You would rather hand off a messy dataset to someone else than be the one who makes sense of it.
   
   


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - A track record building and maintaining forecasting models that have actually guided revenue decisions, not just produced reports.

 - Demonstrated comfort working with operational and financial metrics side by side, such as pipeline, conversion, and unit economics.

 - A record of turning messy, disparate data into reliable analysis largely on your own, without needing a data team to do the heavy lifting first.

 - Proven ability to translate complex analysis into memos and presentations that non-technical stakeholders can act on.

 - Working fluency with Excel or Google Sheets, Salesforce, Looker, and Snowflake, or directly equivalent tools; experience in a multi-unit portfolio or recurring-revenue business such as hospitality, retail, commercial real estate, or SaaS is a plus.
   
   


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS


The base salary for this role is $125,000 to $135,000, depending on experience, skills, and role alignment. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus and participation in our long term incentive program.


At Industrious, we believe a good workplace supports the whole person. Our benefits include:

 - Heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans to support you and your family

 - Flexible paid time off, to maintain balance

 - Paid parental leave to help you welcome a new child and focus on what matters most

 - Annual professional development grants so you can keep learning and growing

 - 401(k) retirement savings program to support long-term financial wellbeing

 - Wellness initiatives and additional employee support programs
   

Specific benefits may vary by role, location, and eligibility requirements.



Equal Employment Opportunity: Industrious is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: PCB Layout Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About Eridan

Eridan connects the robots powering the physical AI era. It's how we're delivering on our mission: connect the planet to empower a sustainable, shared future. Our patented transmitter delivers the fast, reliable wireless that robots depend on, while transforming the economics of connectivity, slashing costs and energy footprint by 10x at a global scale. Beyond robotics, our private 5G networks serve campuses, cities, industry, and defense. From our headquarters in Sunnyvale to our office in Zagreb, we're a team that owns our work, speaks candidly, and moves with focus and urgency. Learn more about our mission here.

About the role

Lay out the boards that connect today's robots and power the physical AI era.

We're looking for a hands-on PCB layout engineer to lead the end-to-end physical layout of our complex, high-density boards: GaN RF power stages up to 10 GHz sitting next to FPGAs, DDR4 and high-current power. The layout decisions you make (board size, stackup, thermal paths, RF isolation) become the size, power and link reliability that robots and physical AI depend on. You'll work directly with system architects, RF engineers and our manufacturing partners, have real say in our design rules, libraries, vendors and layout workflow, and help lay out the first generation of Eridan hardware designed to live on the robot itself.

What you'll do

PCB layout and design

• Execute high-density, multilayer PCB layouts in Altium Designer, from stackup and placement through routing, review and release.

• Route complex mixed-signal circuits, including high-speed digital interfaces (FPGA/BGA fanout, DDR4) and RF paths up to 10 GHz.

• Apply constraint management and advanced routing rules to protect signal and power integrity across sensitive RF/analog and digital domains.

Vendor collaboration and manufacturing

• Work directly with PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly partners to select vendors, confirm capabilities, establish stackups and streamline production.

• Incorporate design for manufacturability, assembly and test (DFx) feedback to reduce cost and maximize yield.

• Match design tolerances and material choices to vendor capabilities for robust quality at the right cost.

Process improvement and workflow

• Build and maintain schematic symbols and footprints from datasheets to IPC and Eridan library standards.

• Contribute to internal PCB design standards and layout guidelines.

• Take part in formal schematic and layout design reviews to keep raising hardware quality.

What you'll bring

• 3+ years of professional PCB layout experience in Altium Designer.

• A track record of mixed-signal PCB designs that include RF layout up to 10 GHz.

• Strong skills routing complex FPGA/BGA footprints and high-speed digital buses (DDR4).

• Solid knowledge of stackup design, impedance control, grounding and plane partitioning, and signal/power integrity fundamentals.

• Experience creating component libraries from datasheets to IPC standards.

• Direct work with PCB/PCBA vendors through selection, NPI and production ramp.

• A good grasp of DFx principles and cost-optimization in complex board layouts.

• Demonstrated adaptability and proactive problem-solving in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

Nice to have

• Thermal management in high-power-density designs, especially GaN or RF power amplifiers.

• Experience as an ECAD or PCB librarian, owning a central, IPC-compliant component library (part creation standards, review and release, and lifecycle management).

• IPC CID or CID+ certification.

How we work

We are a small team doing hard hardware. Priorities shift as products move from lab to field, so we value people who learn fast, solve problems before they're asked, and keep their teammates informed along the way.

Perks of working at Eridan

• Work on new technology that will make a significant impact on global infrastructure

• Ability to learn, develop, and advance within a flexible environment

• Collaborate with smart, passionate, and helpful co-workers

• Celebrate progress company-wide

• Pre-IPO equity

• 401K with automatic match

• Health, Vision and Dental insurance

Salary Range

Given our anticipated growth, we are open to hiring individuals with varying levels of experience to fill this role. Salary will be commensurate with job-related skills, experience and other relevant factors. The base salary range for the primary location of this role is between $135,000 and $175,000 plus stock options and benefits.

Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship or visa transfers

Eridan is an equal opportunity employer. We value and celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Data Center Operations (DCO) Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team. This is a remote role in Houston, TX, reporting to the Director of Network Infrastructure in the Network Infrastructure department. In this role, you will be instrumental in deploying, maintaining, and scaling the critical physical server, network, and cabling infrastructure powering our global production data center environments.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Execute physical rack-and-stack deployments, structured cabling, and infrastructure lifecycle management across production data centers

• Triage, troubleshoot, and remediate hardware and network faults while repairing or replacing failing components

• Manage and resolve operational ticket queues, driving scheduled corrective maintenance and break/fix activities

• Coordinate and partner with engineering teams, system owners, and third-party Remote Hands technicians to validate installations

• Maintain comprehensive asset tracking documentation and support up to 50% domestic and international travel

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You are a disciplined infrastructure specialist committed to maintaining pristine, highly available production data center environments.

• You are an adept problem-solver who excels at diagnosing and resolving complex physical hardware and network connectivity issues.

• You are a proactive collaborator skilled at directing third-party remote hands and cross-functional engineering partners.

• You are detail-oriented and take pride in precise documentation, structured cable plants, and operational rigor.

• You are adaptable and energized by hands-on technical fieldwork, balancing travel requirements with dynamic operational demands.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Experience leveraging modern AI tools, automation, or scripting to streamline data center operational workflows and diagnostics

• 5 or more years of experience working within production data center environments, with a proven track record engaging and directing remote data center vendors

• U.S. citizenship, required due to the nature of the customers assigned to this role

• Deep technical understanding of diverse server platforms, network hardware, optics, fiber plants, and copper cabling

jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Director, Cardiac Market Development, is a regional leadership role that collaborates closely with the Cardiac Sales Director in US by translating global cardiac procedure and product strategies into market-ready plans, programs, and tools. This role also serves as the US implementation partner to the Vice President, US Cardiac, helping bring key global programs, training processes, and global KOL development initiatives to life across markets with different customer needs, operating models, and development stages.

Working closely with the Cardiac Sales Director and the VP of Cardiac, this role localizes global programs and content, supports training and KOL development execution, tracks performance metrics, and improves quality and matrix efficiency. Commercial priorities and Market-level decisions remain with the US VP of Marketing and the Global Cardiac Vice President and this role is accountable for enabling and accelerating their execution.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Regional Procedure and Product Lifecycle Strategy

• Support the Cardiac Sales Directors and VP, Cardiac in developing and executing cardiac procedure strategies using market insights, customer needs, competitive dynamics, clinical pathways, and commercial priorities.
• Translate global portfolio, product launch, lifecycle, and procedure strategies into focused roadmaps, priorities, and activation plans.
• Coordinate with sales, clinical, capital, key accounts, customer training, marketing, market access, regulatory, and enabling functions to support readiness, sequencing, and execution.
• Identify adoption barriers, unmet needs, and growth opportunities and convert them into recommendations and action plans for the Cardiac Sales Directors and VP, Cardiac.
• Provide structured feedback to global teams on US/Canada Market requirements, customer needs, evidence gaps, positioning, and future portfolio opportunities.

Market Development and Marketing Localization

• Localize cardiac marketing programs, value propositions, messaging, content, media, and field tools consistent with US Marketing Standards, while maintaining brand, clinical, regulatory, and legal requirements.
• Provide direct leadership to the US Cardiac marketing manager and plan for clinical marketing team expansion aligned to market growth.
• Develop integrated market development plans spanning segmentation, account activation, peer education, society engagement, digital channels, and stakeholder awareness.
• Enable teams to build sustainable programs with surgeons, care teams, hospital leaders, key opinion leaders, training centers, and reference sites.
• Ensure content and media plans are insight-led, audience-specific, reusable, and aligned to the customer journey and sales execution needs.
• Capture, codify, and scale effective practices and share US learnings with other regional marketing leaders, the VP, Global Cardiac, and other Global partners.

Program Support, Metrics, and Operating Cadence

• Support the operating rhythm for cardiac Market development and marketing, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, initiative tracking, and performance reporting.
• Define leading and lagging indicators for program effectiveness, adoption progress, launch readiness, content utilization, and return on investment.
• Work with FSO to create dashboards and decision forums that help leaders assess progress, resolve barriers, redirect low-value work, and scale successful programs.
• Support initiative portfolio tracking by clarifying owners, milestones, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
• Support budget planning, tracking, and forecasting for cardiac Market development and marketing programs, in partnership with the Cardiac Sales Directors, VP US Marketing, and VP, Global Cardiac.

Quality, Process, and Matrix Effectiveness

• Design scalable processes, standards, and ways of working that increase execution quality, speed, consistency, and accountability.
• Clarify interfaces and handoffs across Global, Regional, and local Market teams to reduce duplication, scale best practices, close gaps, and improve matrix efficiency.
• Establish quality controls for plans, programs, content, metrics, and launch deliverables, so work is compliant, decision-ready, and fit for use.
• Facilitate cross-functional problem-solving and remove barriers that limit field execution or customer impact.
• Contribute to a culture of disciplined experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement using data and field feedback.

Partnership and Collaboration

• Act as the US point of contact for the VP, Global Cardiac on implementation of key global society initiatives, programs, training curricula, and global KOL development initiatives.
• Capitalize on synergies with US Thoracic Marketing Team to maximize opportunities at accounts, society meetings, and other marketing plans.
• Serve as a close working partner to the Cardiac Sales Directors in each Market on execution of growth priorities, programs, and training, with market commercial decisions remaining with the Sales Directors and VP/General Managers.
• Partner with US commercial teams to drive alignment through influence and collaboration.
• Act as the US point of contact for the VP, Global Cardiac on implementation of key global society initiatives, programs, training curricula, and global KOL development initiatives.
• Communicate progress, insights, and performance clearly to the Cardiac Sales Directors, VPs/GM US, and the VP Global Cardiac.

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:

·       Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, life sciences, healthcare, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

·       15+ years of progressive experience in medical devices, healthcare, or another complex regulated industry, including experience in sales, marketing, market development, or commercial operations.

·       Demonstrated success translating global strategies into market-specific cardiac commercial plans and measurable execution and scaling best practices across multiple regions.

·       Experience with procedure development, product launch and lifecycle management, customer segmentation, integrated marketing, and commercial planning.

·       Strong business and financial acumen, including budget tracking, forecasting support, and performance management.

·       Proven ability to lead through influence across functions, and organizational levels in a complex matrix.

·       Advanced analytical capability, including defining metrics, leading operating reviews, interpreting results, and turning insights into decisions.

·       Strong process design, program management, and continuous improvement capability.

·       Executive-level communication and presentation skills across clinical, technical, financial, and commercial audiences.

·       Cardiac surgery, cardiovascular, robotic-assisted surgery, or related clinical-commercial experience is strongly preferred.

·       Experience supporting or delivering global training curricula, surgeon proctoring or mentoring programs, or key opinion leader (KOL) development initiatives is strongly preferred.

·       Demonstrated cross-cultural agility and experience supporting multiple Asia Markets.

·       Must live in the US region and be able to travel internationally as needed; expected travel of 50%.

·       English proficiency is required.

·       Fluency in other languages is a plus.

jobs.title: Principal, Programs and Policy (Coalitions)
jobs.description:
About Omidyar Network (ON):

Omidyar Network (ON) is a philanthropic organization whose mission is to bend the arc of the digital revolution toward shared power, prosperity, and possibility. Digital technology is a powerful and ubiquitous force that, harnessed wisely, makes wondrous things happen. We believe in working together to guide tech’s trajectory intentionally. Our vision is for our shared humanity to steer our digital future.

So far, we have committed more than $1.94 billion to initiatives that share our vision. We engage, partner with, and fund some of the world’s brightest thinkers and innovators to guide our digital future toward the greatest good for the greatest number of people.

About the Programs and Policy team:

Our Programs and Policy team focuses on the key drivers of our shared digital future: the culture, the governance, and the business of digital tech. Through grantmaking, advocacy, and funder partnership, we aim to shape more intentional societal governance and amplify our shared agency. We work with a broad range of stakeholders, including investors, tech firms, policymakers, consumers, and workers, to guide tech’s trajectory and build coalitions and counterweights to concentrated power in civil society. Our team members come from policy, advocacy, nonprofits, community organizing, technology, consulting, philanthropy, education, and the arts.

About the Role:

ON seeks a Principal on our Programs and Policy team to steward our coalitions portfolio through a mix of catalytic grantmaking, strategic advising, network weaving, and funder partnership. Our coalitions portfolio takes a big tent approach that sees broad-based collective action as an essential part of ensuring that digital technology is designed, deployed, and governed in the public interest.

From social media to artificial intelligence, we know that it takes parents and young people, college students, older adults, workers organized across occupations and industries, faith communities, artists, and storytellers, engaging alongside builders, researchers, and policy experts to put technology in service of humanity rather than the reverse. “The kind of society that emerges from the [technological] revolution,” the economists Chris Freeman and Francisco Louçã write, “depends on the strength and programmes of contending social groups and political forces far more than on the technologies.” (As Time Goes By: From the Industrial Revolutions to the Information Revolution)

You will own most of the day to day grantmaking in Omidyar Network’s second largest portfolio, working in tandem with the Senior Director and in close collaboration with our Policy team.

This role is built for someone who believes that everyone should have a say over the trajectory of artificial intelligence. You grasp its far-reaching implications and what it takes to bring different communities off the sidelines. You are a strategist and connector. You build relationships with and among coalition leaders, link efforts that don’t yet know they share a cause, and spot early openings others may overlook.

This role reports to the Senior Director, Programs and Policy, who is based remotely in Los Angeles, CA.

How You’ll Contribute to our Impact:

• Manage a grant portfolio. Contribute to strategic planning, diligence, grantmaking, and ongoing relationship management for the Coalitions portfolio. Deploy programmatic budget on time, in close collaboration with our grant operations teams, and work with colleagues across ON on strategy, learning, and evaluation to understand the impact of our grants.

• Support the success of grantees. Meet regularly with grantee organizations as a strategic collaborator and trusted thought partner. Help them gain traction by facilitating connections, problem-solving, and sharing funding opportunities.

• Build and convene coalitions. Bring coalition leaders together across issues and constituencies, help new and emerging coalitions form and mature, and design convenings that turn shared concern into shared strategy.

• Collaborate with other funders. Build close working relationships with other funders, understand their priorities, and advance opportunities for aligned grantmaking.

• Advance our point of view. Establish a regular cadence of writing for key audiences, represent Omidyar Network at convenings, and organize funder briefings to share what we are learning and make the case for the importance of investing in coalitions.

• What success looks like in your first year: Your work contributes to existing grantees gaining traction in their respective domains and collaborating on key issues. You have identified the next set of portfolio opportunities. You develop a network of peer funders.

Location:

This is a hybrid role, with employees working in the office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. This position will be based out of our San Francisco or Washington, DC office. Employees must reside within 100 miles of their assigned office location. This role will require low to moderate travel (10-25%).

Candidates must have a current U.S. work authorization to be considered. ON does not sponsor or provide support for visas or work authorization, including H-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, and other temporary work authorization programs.

Compensation:

This is a full-time, salaried position that features competitive pay and benefits, including health care (medical/dental/vision), paid time off, and a generous employer 401(k) contribution. The starting salary range for this role is $171,400-$214,200 in San Francisco and $154,200-$192,800 in Washington, DC. ON manages pay equity seriously and new hires generally start at the midpoint of this range.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

• Minimum of 7 years of experience building coalitions or aligning diverse stakeholders. Strong candidates may come from organizing, civic engagement, advocacy, campaigns, consulting, communications, or government. We care more about evidence than sector. You can point to three or four major examples from your career of bringing very different constituencies together (e.g., parents, young people, workers, or artists). Prior grantmaking experience is not required.

• Range across issues and communities. You have worked across more than one issue and more than one sector, and you are comfortable moving between them in the same week. You’re comfortable with small, informal, community-led organizations as well as established institutions.

• Fluency in the societal implications of AI and digital technology. You don’t need technical expertise, but you do have a track record of teaching yourself across several threads of the tech/AI and society conversation (e.g., kids’ online safety, job automation, human connection, concentration of power). You can engage credibly with community groups, funders, and policymakers, and you know what to ask, and who to ask, when you’re outside your depth.

• The ability to build trust across differences. You establish credibility quickly with people from very different communities and perspectives, including across political and ideological lines. You sustain those relationships over time, and help others find shared objectives.

• Sound judgment about where to place bets. You can spot promising early-stage efforts that others overlook and you know what early promise looks like in a coalition. You can assess what a group needs to succeed, size the right investment, and make well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information, explaining your reasoning to colleagues. You’re comfortable making small early bets, saying no, and changing course when the evidence changes.

• A track record of strong execution. You can turn a broad strategy into a concrete work plan, manage a portfolio and budget, and follow through, on time and in close collaboration with colleagues.

• Excellent writing and communication skills. A meaningful share of your impact will come through memos, briefings, op-eds, and decks, and through how you show up in rooms.

Omidyar Network is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes people from all experiences, abilities, and perspectives to apply. We fundamentally believe that people are inherently capable but often lack opportunity. We know that a diverse workforce reflecting a broad range of backgrounds and views allows us to see problems in more nuanced ways, creating the thought leadership needed to elevate humanity and evolve the culture, governance, and business of technology. We actively recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people from a broad candidate pool. We are committed to an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please let us know at recruitment@omidyar.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, Private Market Indexes
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
At PitchBook, a Morningstar company, we are always looking forward. We continue to innovate, evolve, and invest in ourselves to bring out the best in everyone. We’re deeply collaborative and thrive on the excitement, energy, and fun that reverberates throughout the company.

Our extensive learning programs and mentorship opportunities help us create a culture of curiosity that pushes us to always find new solutions and better ways of doing things. The combination of a rapidly evolving industry and our high ambitions means there’s going to be some ambiguity along the way, but we excel when we challenge ourselves. We’re willing to take risks, fail fast, and do it all over again in the pursuit of excellence.

If you have a good attitude and are willing to roll up your sleeves to get things done, PitchBook is the place for you.

About the Role:

PitchBook Institutional Research Group is a provider of research services to private market investors, advisors and market participants. The group provides investment strategy, fund performance and industry research through a differentiated, framework-driven approach. In addition, the group provides custom research and data analytics to subscribing clients. Morningstar Indexes builds and maintains index solutions that span public and private markets, and partners with PitchBook to bring private capital data and methodology to institutional benchmarking. This role will have a dotted line to the Head of Product & Research, Indexes.

As the Senior Analyst, Private Market Indexes, you will serve as the dedicated subject matter expert and in-house voice of the Morningstar Indexes team within PitchBook’s Institutional Research Group. You will pair deep private markets knowledge with index construction and benchmarking expertise to publish differentiated research, represent the index franchise externally at industry events and with clients, and channel market feedback back into index design and product strategy. This is a highly visible, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of research, product, and commercial teams: internally you will act as the connective tissue and advocate between Morningstar Indexes and PitchBook, and externally you will be a credible, recognizable authority on how private market performance is measured and benchmarked.

Primary Job Responsibilities:

• Subject matter expertise: Serve as the recognized private markets and indexing expert bridging Morningstar Indexes and the Institutional Research Group — advising on index construction, eligibility criteria, weighting, rebalancing, valuation lag, and performance measurement conventions specific to private capital

• Published research: Author and publish analyst notes, methodology explainers, and thematic research on private market benchmarking, index-based performance measurement, and the growing role of indexes in private markets — meeting PIRG editorial standards and publication cadence. In many cases, research will be co-created with the Morningstar Index team

• Industry engagement & speaking: Represent the index franchise externally by attending, speaking on, and moderating panels at industry conferences, client events, webinars, and in media engagements; build a visible external profile that reinforces the credibility of the index platform

• Client engagement & voice of the customer: Engage directly with institutional clients — including allocators, asset managers, wealth platforms, consultants, and GPs — to understand benchmarking needs, use cases, and gaps; systematically capture, synthesize, and prioritize that feedback for the index and product teams

• Cross-functional liaison: Act as the primary point of contact between the Morningstar index team and PitchBook stakeholders across Research, Product, Data Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships, ensuring alignment on roadmap, methodology changes, and go-to-market activity

• Internal advocacy & enablement: Champion the index platform internally — educating research, sales, and client success teams on index methodology, positioning, and use cases through briefings, training materials, and enablement content

• Index development input: Contribute private markets expertise to the design, testing, and launch of new index families and enhancements to existing ones, including input on data inputs, coverage, and methodological trade-offs

• Competitive & market intelligence: Collaborate with the Morningstar Index Product Management team to monitor the competitive benchmarking landscape, regulatory and industry developments, and evolving client standards, and translate those findings into recommendations for the index roadmap and research agenda

• Support the vision and values of the company through role modeling and encouraging desired behaviors

• Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field — CFA or CAIA designation a plus

• 5+ years’ experience in private markets research, index or benchmark research, investment research, performance measurement, or a closely related field

• Must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Preferred Qualifications:

• Demonstrated subject matter expertise in index construction, benchmark methodology, or performance and risk measurement — ideally with exposure to private asset classes

• Strong understanding of private capital fundamentals, including fund structures, capital call and distribution dynamics, IRR, TVPI and PME, NAV and valuation practices, and emerging vehicle types such as secondaries and evergreen funds

• Track record of publishing research for external institutional audiences, with writing samples available

• Confident public speaker with experience presenting at industry events, on panels, or with the media

• Client-facing experience with institutional investors and the ability to translate client needs into product and methodology requirements

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority across research, product, and commercial teams

• Working proficiency with quantitative analysis and data tools

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex methodologies to technical and non-technical audiences

• Critical thinker with a detail-oriented, analytical mindset and a high standard for methodological rigor

• Proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite and the ability to quickly learn new systems and software

Benefits + Compensation at PitchBook:

Physical Health

• Comprehensive health benefits

• Additional medical wellness incentives

• STD, LTD, AD&D, and life insurance

Emotional Health

• Paid sabbatical program after four years

• Paid family and paternity leave

• Annual educational stipend

• Ability to apply for tuition reimbursement

• CFA exam stipend

• Robust training programs on industry and soft skills

• Employee assistance program

• Generous allotment of vacation days, sick days, and volunteer days

Social Health

• Matching gifts program

• Employee resource groups

• Subsidized emergency childcare

• Dependent Care FSA

• Company-wide events

• Employee referral bonus program

• Quarterly team building events

Financial Health

• 401k match

• Shared ownership employee stock program

• Monthly transportation stipend

*Please be aware the above PitchBook benefit and perk offerings are subject to corresponding plan and policy documents and may change during the course of your employment.

Compensation

• Annual base salary: $135,000-$175,000

• Target annual bonus percentage: 10%

Working Conditions:

At the heart of our company is a belief in the power of in-person collaboration. Being together in the office fuels our creativity, strengthens our connections, and drives the innovation that sets us apart. Our culture is built on spontaneous moments—those hallway conversations, whiteboard brainstorms, and shared celebrations in each of our global offices—that simply can’t be replicated remotely. This role is expected to be in the office 5 days a week.

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

We are excited to get to know you and your background. Concerned that you might not meet every requirement? We encourage you to still apply as you might be the right candidate for the role or other roles at PitchBook.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
About us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About the role

As an Inside Sales Rep, you’ll help drive user adoption of Shipstation for e-commerce shipping processing and automation. They are responsible for clear communication to prospective ShipStation users and will assist merchants throughout the trial process - showing ShipStation value, understanding their business objectives, and helping turn trial users into subscribers. ISRs will interact with Sales, Marketing, and Support teams, and will be customer advocates in regards to future product enhancements.

Successful candidates will be comfortable making a high volume of phone calls to interested merchants, and can concisely show the value of ShipStation to their business. They will become product experts and will be enthusiastic about interacting with entrepreneurs and their growing businesses daily.

This position is hybrid (3 days per week in office) and is located in Austin, TX.

About the team

The Inside Sales team is a growing team of Inside Sales representatives that help ecommerce sellers fulfill their products to their buyers using the most efficient and economical path. Inside Sales Representatives conduct demonstrations and manage opportunities in their pipelines. We are looking for driven folks with inside sales experience or someone looking to grow in their sales career to join our growing Inside Sales team. The Inside Sales Representative position reports to our Inside Sales Manager.

What will you be doing?

• Assess needs and interests of new trial merchants to determine if they are a good fit for Shipstation. This involves understanding a customer's pain points and the value that Shipstation can bring to their business.

• Work to close deals by overcoming objections and persuading customers to become long term customers.

• Have a deep understanding of the product and its features so that the ISR can articulate features, benefits, and unique selling points effectively.

• Maintain relationships throughout the trial period, encourage repeat business, and upsell additional features.

• Often collaborate with peers and other departments such as marketing, support, and product development to maintain a competitive advantage and improve their performance.

• Keep detailed records of sales activities, performance metrics, and provide regular reports to your Inside Sales Manager on results, trends, and opportunities.

• Be proficient in using sales automation tools, CRM software, and other technology platforms to streamline processes and enhance productivity.

What are we looking for?

• Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field of study a plus

• Minimum of 1-2 years of SaaS sales experience working as an inside sales representative.

• Track record of over-achieving sales goals

• Tenacity to make high volumes of calls to warm leads - this is a call driven role

• Excellent telephone and personal demeanor

• Strong ability to work cooperatively on a team with other sales representatives

• Effective listening and presentation skills

• Must have strong organizational, written, and oral communication skills

• Must be able to describe products and match their advantages to customer needs

What will make you stand out?

• Industry experience in eCommerce, transportation and/or logistics preferred

The Tech

• Experience with Salesforce and Salesloft

What do we offer?

• 🏠 We are a hybrid company. All team members at Auctane in Austin come into the office Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays.

• 🛬Take the reins of your time off with our Flex Time Off policy – because work-life balance should always be in your hands!

• 🌅 We offer 12 paid holidays for all of our US employees!

• 💰401k employer matching program – because your future deserves a friendly boost!

• ⭐️We conduct annual merit reviews to recognize and reward your hard work and achievements.

• 🏟️ Company events, we work hard, play hard! We do our best every day, even at our regular team-building events.

• 🏢 Attractive office space in the heart of central Austin, Texas (free drinks, snacks…).

• 🍽Indulge in weekly catered lunches at our office – a delicious perk to fuel your work.

• 🏐 Health and Wellness: The well-being of our team is super important to us. Choose from different options that include medical, dental, and vision plans.

• 🏋🏾‍♀️Fitness center in the office with Tonal Mirrors, Pelotons, free weights, etc.

• 🧠Employee Assistance Program. We offer up to 8 free mental health sessions.

• 💪🏽We offer gym discounts to help you stay fit and healthy!

• 📚We offer education reimbursement to all employees, ensuring that you can pursue your educational goals while excelling in your career with us. Invest in your future and let us support your growth every step of the way.

• 🔗 Employee Referral Program! We reward employees helping us find top talent!

• 💜 An inclusive, casual and upbeat work environment. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid; we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.

Additional Position Duties: (The following is a list of what all employees, except those with medical accommodation, may be regularly required to do.)

• Sit for prolonged periods of time

• Utilize wrist and hands for a prolonged period of time

• Walk short distances

• Stand for short periods

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Position Summary

At Ripple Treasury, we empower finance and treasury teams around the world to work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence. Our cloud-based treasury and risk management platform helps organizations gain real-time insight to their cash, liquidity, and risk positions, enabling better decisions and stronger financial outcomes. We believe in delivering not just software, but transformative solutions that make a measurable difference for our clients.

We are looking for a Project Manager to guide client implementations within our Latin America region, with a secondary focus on the United States. In this role at Ripple Treasury, you will collaborate with internal and external team members to control project scope, set timelines and deliverables, coordinate resources, encourage communication among participants, lead the process to achieve client goals, and proactively bring up risks as needed.

Based in Miami, New York, San Francisco, or Chicago, this role demands robust project oversight, a process-focused approach, and client engagement skills to ensure structured planning and delivery across several simultaneous projects throughout Latin America and the United States. Outstanding organizational, problem-solving, and leadership capabilities are crucial to achieving high-quality results.

What You Will Do

• Lead end-to-end delivery of client-facing Ripple Treasury solution implementations, managing scope, timelines, budgets, and deliverables to agreed standards.

• Serve as the point of contact for client project team members, building trust and ensuring alignment on goals, achievements, and expectations.

• Create and maintain detailed project plans in accordance with Ripple Treasury’s project management methodology.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Implementation, and Customer Success teams to align project objectives and execution.

• Coordinate delivery across multiple Latin American countries and the United States, spanning time zones and languages.

• Manage bank connectivity and integration workstreams across Latin American and US banking partners.

• Define and supervise critical success factors for each engagement, ensuring alignment with client business objectives.

• Identify and mitigate project risks, clarify roles and responsibilities, and bring up issues to leadership as needed.

• Establish project governance, ensuring oversight and compliance with delivery standards.

• Lead project communication, including regular status updates to client executives, internal collaborators, and business units.

• Find opportunities for process improvement, automation, and efficiency enhancements across the delivery lifecycle.

Who We Are Looking For

• 3+ years of experience in client-facing project management, preferably within a SaaS or B2B enterprise software environment.

• Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage and influence client team members at multiple levels of an organization.

• Experience leading multiple sophisticated projects simultaneously, often with remote resources and global teams.

• Technical competence and understanding of Treasury Management Systems (TMS) or financial software products is advantageous.

• Demonstrated capability to proactively recognize, monitor, and handle project risks and issues.

• Strong listening, presentation, and consultative communication abilities with the capacity to customize messages for diverse audiences.

• Highly organized with a demonstrable track record of delivering projects on time and within budget.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while balancing multiple priorities.

• Experience leading projects for clients across Latin America and the United States, with awareness of local business customs and regulatory frameworks.

• Familiarity with Latin American and US bank connectivity standards and payment schemes is helpful.

• Business-level fluency in Spanish is required.

• Business-level proficiency in Portuguese is a strong advantage.

• Existing right to work in the United States.

For positions that will be based in IL, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.

IL Annual Base Salary Range

$112,000—$140,000 USD

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

• The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders

• A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.

• Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.

• In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.

• Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team

• We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

• Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity

• Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support

• Employee giving match

• Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

• R&R days so you can rest and recharge

• Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming

• Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it

• Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.

• Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

jobs.description:
We’re looking for automotive mechanics with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

Pay Range: $21-$32 hourly

As an Experienced Auto Technician, you will perform a full range of automotive repairs—from light maintenance to heavy engine work—and diagnostics on our vehicles, including:

• Performing general to complex repairs on all makes and models, ranging from timing belts and suspension systems to heavy engine work.

• Diagnosing and repairing advanced vehicle electrical issues, including work on electric and hybrid vehicles.

• Completing repairs for wheel bearings and axles, as well as vehicle climate control systems including ACs and heater cores.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including but not limited to: 100% company paid healthcare, dental & vision insurance, a 401(k with a Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers.

• Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

• Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available across our Inspection Center network. Check out our Careers site to learn more!

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

jobs.title: CDL Driver (Roll Off)
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a CDL Driver (Roll Off)

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a CDL Delivery Driver at our rental facility in Odessa, TX, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction.

Salary range: $22-34/hr. Factors including past experience and location may affect final compensation rate.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (This role is subject to on-call scheduling with additional compensation provided)

Primary Responsibilities

We don’t just deliver equipment - we deliver innovation. At EquipmentShare, our technology ensures that our drivers work efficiently and effectively by providing real-time access to fleet locations, work orders, and delivery details.

• Operates vehicle according to applicable state and federal transportation laws

• Safely operate a roll-off truck to deliver, exchange, and pick up containers and/or scrap boxes

• Secure and tarp loads in compliance with DOT regulations

• Transports loads safely and in a timely manner over required route, obeying all traffic laws and observing all safety regulations

• Deftly maneuvers truck and trailer into loading and unloading areas; follows loading crew signals

• Assists with loading of or loads and unloads goods and materials, using specialized equipment when warranted; unloads empty skids and returns all equipment to designated area

• Maintains signed invoices, shipping bills of lading, and other required paperwork; delivers documentation to shipping office or other appropriate staff when delivery route is complete

• Facilitates routine service on trucks, which may include checking oil, water, gasoline, and air; reports maintenance malfunctions to Shipping Supervisor

• Arranges trailers in shipping yards for optimum loading patterns

• Performs other related duties as assigned

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• 401(k) + company match

• Tool and boot reimbursements (role dependent)

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

• Company events, food truck nights, and monthly dinner nights

• 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

A Workplace For All

jobs.title: Manufacturing Automation Engineer, Solar (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MANUFACTURING AUTOMATION ENGINEER, SOLAR (STARLINK)

Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers and the software that brings it all together.

As a member of the Starlink Solar Automation Team you will work with a cross-disciplinary team of engineers developing the next generation Starlink solar array and the production system that will create it.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Design, build, qualify and implement projects spanning machine design, robotics and manufacturing processes from initial ideation to production use.

• Architect, write, and debug PLC code.

• Implement vision systems for robotic guidance, quality control and data collection.

• Design systems to control processes, track factory performance and collaborate across teams to increase manufacturing efficiency in a data driven way.

• Design user interfaces that make complex machines easy to use and troubleshoot.

• Create electrical, pneumatic and fluid schematics for control panels.

• Keep our factories safe by implementing ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA compliant systems.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering or another STEM field.

• 1+ years’ experience in the design and commissioning of automation and controls systems for manufacturing (internships/co-ops can apply).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Hands on experience with at least one of the specific disciplines below and interest in learning the other areas you are not yet strong in:

Industrial Automation:

• Automation Hardware: PLC’s, COTS Robots, servo motion, machine vision, distributed IO, pneumatic controls, etc.

• Field Bus Networking protocols: EtherCAT, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, etc.

• Machinery and processes: dispenser, pick and place, fastener installation, automated bonding, thermo-compression, soldering, ultrasonic welding, temperature & position control, injection molders, die casters, etc. and design for manufacturing.

• Applied Statistical Process Control and other data tools (descriptive, inferential, regression, correlation) to improve manufacturing processes.

• Safely testing and commissioning integrated systems

Software:

• PLC programming, preferably Beckhoff TwinCAT structured text, state machines, applying Object Oriented Programming to mechanical assemblies, electrical systems, sensors, pneumatics/hydraulics, etc.

• Robotics programming, preferably ABB Rapid.

• HMI, SCADA, IoT (MQTT, OPC-UA), SQL, C#, .NET, Python.

• Industrial machine vision, Cognex Vision Pro preferred, Halcon & OpenCV acceptable.

Electrical:

• Electrical sizing of motors, cables, circuit protection, VFD’s, motor starters, various other motion systems.

• Design of fail-safe electrical circuits using both safety logic controllers and safety-rated relays.

• Hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial electrical systems using tools like multimeters, oscilloscopes, EMI probes.

• Proficiency in understanding and creating electrical schematics and single line diagrams (EPLAN preferred).

• Analog signal integrity and EMI reduction.

• Hands-on experience designing and commissioning high quality electrical panels and electro-mechanical systems with appropriate safety considerations in mind.

• Knowledge of NEC, NFPA, UL508A codes with ability to ensure compliance with control system safety standards.

• Proven ability to solve complex problems with simple solutions and little supervision.

• Excited by a fast-paced environment, strong desire and ability to learn quickly and adapt.

• Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed to meet mission critical deadlines.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $100,000.00 - $135,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $165,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.
