jobs.title: Senior Hiring & Internal Mobility Partner
jobs.description:
SimSpace serves as an AI Proving Ground where organizations can confidently train, test, and outmaneuver adversaries in any environment. Trusted by allied governments, militaries, enterprises, and research institutions worldwide, SimSpace enables adaptive, AI-ready defenses that stay ahead of evolving threats. Founded in 2015 by experts from U.S. Cyber Command and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the platform unifies training, testing, and validation in a realistic, live-fire simulation—helping teams evaluate security investments, optimize performance, and compress cyber readiness cycles from months to days.



Why join SimSpace? We are an organization that is focused on building our culture and mindfully enhancing our atmosphere every day which is why we have collaborated on an integral value system. Our governing philosophy of being Human Centered is deeply embedded within our value system. We apply this philosophy to every one of our internal team members, external clients, and their customers.



How Do We Work? We believe that people are at the center of everything we do. SimSpace fosters a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. That belief shows up in action: in-house training, internal and external learning platforms, cyber conferences, industry events, and dedicated time for skill development. Our people are empowered to shape their careers - and it shows. Year over year, SimSpace consistently outperforms industry benchmarks in internal mobility, promotions, and total rewards growth.



Who Thrives Here? We are a team of innovators, protectors, and problem-solvers. We believe diversity of thought and experience fuels better solutions, and we’re committed to building teams that reflect the communities we serve. Whether you’re remote or office-based, you’ll collaborate with talented colleagues across departments and time zones, united by the mission to create a safer digital world.



We invite you to apply today!




👋 HI, I'M ASHLYN, MANAGER OF HIRING & INTERNAL MOBILITY AT SIMSPACE!

At SimSpace, we believe hiring is more than filling roles. It's about building relationships, creating exceptional experiences, and helping people and teams grow thoughtfully.

I'm looking for a Senior Hiring & Internal Mobility Partner to join my team and help us deliver a thoughtful, responsive, and high-quality hiring experience across our global organization.

This role is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys recruiting, takes pride in delivering a white-glove candidate and hiring manager experience, and knows how to balance quality, speed, and thoughtful execution in an environment where priorities and business needs can evolve quickly.

We're looking for someone with a strong recruiting foundation, sound judgment, and a flexible mindset. Someone who can confidently manage their own searches, build trusted relationships, and adapt when circumstances change without losing sight of the details that matter.

A quick note about this job description: You'll notice it's a little more detailed than most, and that's intentional! I believe hiring should be a two-way conversation, and I want you to have a clear picture of the role, our team, and what success looks like before you decide whether it's the right opportunity for you.

If you enjoy connecting people with opportunities, working across different teams, and finding thoughtful, practical ways to keep things moving, I'd love to meet you!




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Hiring & Internal Mobility Partner, you'll independently manage full lifecycle recruiting across a variety of technical and nontechnical functions, including R&D, Product, Go-to-Market, G&A, and Professional Services.

While much of our anticipated hiring will be Engineering-focused, our team's priorities evolve with the needs of the business. We're looking for someone with a strong foundation in technical recruiting who is equally willing and able to support searches across other functions.

You'll serve as the primary hiring partner for your assigned requisitions, guiding hiring managers and candidates through each stage of the process, from intake and sourcing through interviews, selection, and offer.

Some searches will involve direct sourcing and pipeline development, while others will be supported by external recruiting agencies. Regardless of how candidates enter the process, you'll maintain ownership of their experience and progression through the hiring process.

You'll also support onboarding, orientation, and internal mobility activities, helping create a positive and connected experience for both new and existing SimSpacers.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with a strong emphasis on white-glove service, responsiveness, relationship management, and operational excellence. You'll be trusted to manage your workload independently, advise hiring managers, navigate competing priorities, and deliver a personalized, high-quality experience for candidates and stakeholders.

We believe great hiring requires both urgency and intention. You'll need to recognize when speed matters, move processes forward efficiently, and make thoughtful decisions about where additional time and attention are warranted. The goal isn't simply to fill roles quickly, but to create a hiring experience that's efficient, thorough, and respectful of everyone's time.

Flexibility and adaptability are especially important in this role. As our business continues to evolve, hiring priorities, team needs, and processes may change. You'll need to be comfortable adjusting course, learning as you go, and maintaining momentum even when the original plan shifts.

We're not looking for someone who has every answer or needs everything to be perfectly defined. We're looking for someone who approaches change with curiosity, communicates openly, exercises good judgment, and works collaboratively to figure out the best path forward.

This position requires consistent availability during Eastern Time (ET) business hours to support collaboration across our distributed organization.




AS A SENIOR HIRING PARTNER, YOU'LL:


OWN FULL LIFECYCLE RECRUITING & HIRING PARTNERSHIPS

 - Independently manage full lifecycle recruiting for assigned requisitions, from hiring manager intake through offer acceptance.

 - Support hiring across technical and nontechnical functions, with an anticipated emphasis on Engineering roles.

 - Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, align on role requirements, establish interview processes, and develop practical hiring plans.

 - Source, engage, screen, and assess candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, referrals, networking, and targeted outreach.

 - Conduct thoughtful candidate interviews to evaluate experience, qualifications, motivations, and alignment with role requirements.

 - Manage agency-supported searches as needed, including interviewing submitted candidates, coordinating feedback, and maintaining ownership of the hiring process and candidate experience.

 - Manage candidate pipelines, interview progression, feedback collection, and next steps to keep hiring processes moving.

 - Adapt recruiting approaches and priorities as business needs, hiring plans, and role requirements evolve.

 - Provide thoughtful guidance to hiring managers on candidate evaluation, hiring decisions, and process challenges.

 - Support structured, equitable, and consistent hiring practices across teams and geographies.


DELIVER A WHITE-GLOVE CANDIDATE & HIRING MANAGER EXPERIENCE

 - Deliver a personalized, high-touch hiring experience that makes candidates and hiring managers feel informed, supported, and valued throughout the process.

 - Serve as a reliable, accessible, and responsive point of contact, anticipating communication needs and ensuring stakeholders understand progress, expectations, and next steps.

 - Balance speed and quality by moving hiring processes forward with appropriate urgency while maintaining thoughtful candidate assessments and consistent hiring standards.

 - Build trusted relationships through attentiveness, follow-through, professionalism, transparency, and a genuine commitment to helping others succeed.

 - Identify and address scheduling challenges, process delays, and communication gaps before they negatively impact the hiring experience.

 - Recognize when a situation calls for quick action versus additional consideration, collaboration, or escalation.

 - Navigate sensitive conversations, unexpected changes, and competing priorities with empathy, discretion, and sound judgment.

 - Collaborate with interviewers, People Operations, and other partners to ensure a coordinated, seamless hiring experience.

 - Support onboarding, orientation, and internal mobility activities as needed.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Ability to consistently work Eastern Time (ET) business hours.

 - Strong full lifecycle recruiting experience, including experience supporting technical or Engineering searches.

 - Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple requisitions from intake through offer acceptance.

 - Experience partnering with hiring managers to understand role requirements, evaluate candidates, and navigate hiring decisions.

 - Ability to recruit across different functions or quickly develop familiarity with new roles, skill sets, and candidate markets.

 - Demonstrated adaptability in environments with evolving priorities, changing business needs, or shifting hiring plans.

 - Strong sourcing and candidate engagement skills, including experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and direct outreach.

 - Strong candidate interviewing and assessment skills.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a commitment to responsiveness, professionalism, and candidate care.

 - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.

 - Sound judgment and the ability to navigate sensitive or challenging situations independently.

 - Comfort working within applicant tracking systems and using recruiting data to manage pipelines, communicate progress, and maintain accurate records.

 - Comfort using AI-enabled tools, or a willingness to learn, to support everyday recruiting activities while maintaining sound judgment, accuracy, and a human-centered candidate experience.

 - Experience recruiting within cybersecurity is a plus.

 - Experience with Ashby is strongly preferred.
   
   


YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF:

🤝 You believe in white-glove service. You take pride in creating an exceptional experience for the people you support. You're attentive, responsive, and thoughtful in your approach, and you understand that the little things, from a timely update to a well-managed interview process, can make a lasting impression.

⚡ You balance urgency with intention. You understand that hiring timelines matter and know how to keep things moving without sacrificing quality. You can distinguish between what needs to happen quickly, what deserves deeper consideration, and where unnecessary complexity may be slowing things down.

🔄 You're adaptable and comfortable with change. You understand that business priorities can shift, sometimes quickly. You're able to adjust your plans, remain open to new approaches, and move forward constructively when things don't go as expected.

🎯 You take ownership of your work. You're comfortable independently managing requisitions, organizing competing priorities, and being accountable for outcomes.

🔍 You're a versatile recruiter. You have a strong recruiting foundation, including experience with technical roles, and you're comfortable learning about new functions, teams, and candidate markets.

💬 You're a thoughtful communicator. You keep people informed, adapt your communication to different audiences, and handle difficult or sensitive conversations with professionalism and care.

⚖️ You have strong judgment. You can distinguish between situations that require immediate attention, additional context, a recommendation, or escalation. You're also comfortable setting expectations and constructively challenging a request when it's in the best interest of the hiring process.

⚙️ You value operational excellence. You appreciate organized processes, accurate data, clear documentation, and consistent execution.

🧩 You're collaborative and open-minded. You enjoy being part of a team, welcome different perspectives, and are willing to adjust your approach when circumstances or priorities change.

🌎 You think globally. You're comfortable working with candidates and stakeholders across different locations, time zones, functions, and cultures.

💡 You're AI-forward and people-first. You're curious about emerging technology and comfortable using tools like ChatGPT and Ashby's AI-powered features to work more efficiently. You see AI as an opportunity to reduce administrative work and spend more time building relationships, supporting candidates, and partnering with hiring managers.




WE’RE PROUD TO OFFER A COMPETITIVE AND COMPREHENSIVE PACKAGE DESIGNED TO SUPPORT YOUR WELL-BEING, GROWTH, AND SUCCESS:

 - Compensation. Base salary range: $90,000 – $145,000, reflecting our confidence in your expertise and impact, with the opportunity for annual bonuses tied to company performance and individual contributions.

 - Health & Wellness. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, plus savings plans—coverage starts on day one!

 - Mental Health Support. Access to company-paid counseling, coaching, and resources for you and your family through Spring Health.

 - Financial Well-Being. Plan for your future with a 401(k)-retirement savings plan featuring a company match.

 - Flexible Time Off. Take the time you need with unlimited vacation and dedicated health & wellness days. SimSpace provides flexible solutions to meet the diverse work-life needs of team members.

 - Parental Leave. Paid leave plans to support you and your loved ones during life’s most important moments.

 - Ownership Opportunities: Equity stock options at hire, with annual performance-based grants—become an invested stakeholder in our shared success.

 - Referral Rewards: Earn $1,500–$3,500 for every qualified hire through our employee referral program.

 - Peloton Interactive Wellness Program: Full- and partial- subsidized membership plans and equipment discounts to help you reach your personalized fitness goals.

 - Continuous Learning: Access a LinkedIn Learning membership to prioritize your personal and professional development.

 - Social Connections: Monthly reimbursements for meaningful connections with teammates through our SocialSpace Community.

 - Extra Perks: Legal plan coverage, pet insurance, wellness reimbursements, and more to simplify life’s details.



 
 
 
 

SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.



SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, clients, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.



Research shows that women and people from underrepresented groups only apply to jobs if they meet all of the qualifications. However, no one ever meets 100% of the qualifications. SimSpace encourages you to break that statistic and to apply. We look forward to your application!



We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, in accordance with applicable law. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, please contact careers@simspace.com.



SimSpace does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies.



Actual compensation for the position is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to affordability, skills, qualifications and experience, and may vary from the range.

jobs.title: Sr. Client Transition Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

Savvy is scaling fast, and the transition team is how new advisors get from signed to fully live on our platform. As a Senior Client Transition Specialist, you will own the most complex advisor book transitions end-to-end (large books, advisor teams, Broker Protocol moves, multi-custodian repapers) and act as an extension of the Onboarding Manager across every onboarding in flight. You will set transition plans, assign and balance work across the specialists, coach them day to day and assist the Onboarding Manager with people management (formal direct reports expected in 2027), partner with the manager on complex issues and escalations, and build the processes and automation that let the team absorb more advisors without adding headcount at the same rate. You will run your own book and raise the bar for everyone else's.

Who you are:

 - You've done this before. You've owned advisor transitions end-to-end at a custodian, RIA, broker-dealer, or fintech, and you know what breaks a repaper or an ACAT before it breaks.

 - You're a step ahead. You see which transition is about to slip before anyone says so, and you act on it.

 - You're detail-obsessed, and you spread it. You catch the error others miss, and you teach the people around you to catch it too.

 - You make calls. Given incomplete data and a go-live date, you decide what blocks, what waits, and who needs to know, without waiting for permission.

 - You build leverage. You turn a one-off fix into a repeatable workflow, document it, and use AI as a default tool while knowing exactly when to verify it.

 - You communicate directly. You keep advisors, custodians, and teammates calm and informed under pressure, and you say the hard thing early.

 - You have a humble, “can do” attitude and extreme ownership. You want to be part of a winning team, and you embrace being pushed out of your comfort zone.

You will report to the Client Service Onboarding Manager.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own the end-to-end transition of Savvy's most complex advisor books across custodians (Schwab, Fidelity), from transition planning and paperwork generation through completed account transfers and handoff to steady state.

 - Act as an extension of the Onboarding Manager: own assignment of new onboardings to specialists based on complexity and capacity, maintain visibility across all in-flight onboardings, run the weekly portfolio review, and rebalance work as risks and volume shift.

 - Solve complex issues and escalations (NIGO, custodian, vendor, data, advisor) together with the Onboarding Manager: own the first response, resolve or route quickly, and keep the advisor informed throughout.

 - QA paperwork, transition spreadsheets, and trackers on high-risk books before submission; run root-cause reviews on NIGOs and turn findings into fixes.

 - Assist the Onboarding Manager with people management of the Transition Specialists: regular 1:1s, coaching on process, custodial platforms, and judgment calls, performance input, and onboarding new team members. Formal direct reports expected in 2027.

 - Lead pre-go-live transition planning with Sales and the advisor's team: data readiness, sequencing, standing instructions, and go-live risks.

 - Own and maintain the transition playbook; identify, build, and document process and automation improvements (including AI workflows) in partnership with Product and Operations.

 - Report on transition health (turnaround, NIGO rate, stalled accounts) and flag risk early to leadership.


MUST HAVE:

 - 5 to 8+ years in client operations, advisor transitions, onboarding, or account management in wealth management, with at least one full advisor book transition owned end-to-end.

 - Hands-on experience with Schwab and/or Fidelity custodial platforms and a deep grasp of account transfer, repaper, LPOA, and ACAT paperwork and NIGO resolution.

 - A track record of operating across many concurrent, deadline-driven workstreams and seeing risk before it surfaces.

 - Demonstrated judgment: you've made consequential calls with incomplete information and can explain how you decided.

 - Experience coaching, training, assigning work to, or QA'ing the work of others, with or without formal authority, and the desire to manage people formally.

 - Strong data hygiene and spreadsheet skills (lookups, validation, cleaning messy custodian exports) and the discipline to catch errors before they compound.

 - At least one process or automation improvement you built that other people adopted.

 - Fluent, daily use of AI tools for data and document work, with clear judgment about when to trust versus verify output.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to keep advisors and custodians calm and informed under pressure.

 - A collaborative, low-ego, self-starter attitude with extreme ownership, and comfort in a high-growth, constantly changing environment.


NICE TO HAVE:

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer (Power & Mixed-Signal)
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer based in Costa Mesa, CA to develop and test cutting edge electronics for avionics propulsion systems. We are looking for a self-starter with deep technical experience in defense or aerospace hardware development to apply these skills in propulsion flight controllers, power electronics, high-efficiency motor controllers, and electromagnetic actuators.

This individual will be responsible for the electrical design, rigorous analysis, test, and integration of propulsion-subsystem electronics from concept to production, while ensuring alignment with strategic business goals. The engineer will also be involved in managing key vendor relationships, and ensuring performance, thermal management, and reliability in our cutting-edge propulsion technologies.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Full Cycle PCB Design: Translate system-level propulsion requirements into robust designs. Perform schematic capture and high-density PCB layouts (with a strong preference for Altium), component selection, bring-up, test, debug, and integration with the propulsion system.

• Engine System Electronics: Design and optimize flight controller circuits, power distribution/supplies, motor controller circuits, and electromagnetic actuator circuits.

• Rigorous Analysis: Conduct circuit simulations, worst-case analysis (WCA), thermal analysis, DFMEA, and component derating to ensure reliability under extreme vibration and temperature environments.

• Comprehensive Testing: Lead board bring-ups, Design Verification Testing (DVT), qualification (Qual) testing, and functional testing.

• Collaborative Design: Provide electrical support and collaborate closely with mechanical, thermal, software, test, quality, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams for development.

• Peer Reviews: Conduct peer-level and cross-discipline design reviews.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform root cause and failure analysis in support of engine test and field operations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) with 5+ years of experience designing, testing, and troubleshooting complex board designs.

• Technical Fundamentals: Solid engineering fundamentals across Analog, Digital, and Power Electronics.

• Software & Tools: Deep proficiency with electronic design tools, specifically Altium Designer (or equivalent for schematic and layout) and LTSpice (or equivalent for circuit simulation).

• Laboratory Equipment: Competence with laboratory test equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, thermal chambers, spectrum analyzers, function generators, DMMs, electronic loads, power supplies, and test automation.

• Interfaces & Protocols: Familiarity with standard interfaces (CAN, I2C, SPI, Ethernet) and common MCU/CPU architectures.

• Security Clearance: Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Education: Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (MSEE).

• Advanced Tools: Experience with MATLAB / Simulink for data analysis, control loop modeling, or system simulations.

US Salary Range

$183,000—$234,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Staff UX/UI Designer
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview

CHAOS is looking for a Staff UX Designer to establish and lead the UX function from the ground up. This is a staff-level role: you'll operate with significant autonomy and influence, setting the direction for how UX is practiced across the company rather than working within an established function. You'll bring best-in-class UX practices to CHAOS — research, interaction design, information architecture, and usability — and apply them to the tools and interfaces our teams rely on. You'll work closely with engineering day-to-day, shaping how products and internal tools are designed from a user's perspective, while also building the foundation (processes, standards, research practices) that the UX function will run on as it grows. Over time, you'll be expected to bring in user research capabilities as part of maturing that foundation.

This role is for an experienced, senior individual contributor who wants to define a function, not just execute within one — someone who can operate independently at a high level, exercise strong judgment with minimal oversight, and set the bar for UX at CHAOS from day one.

Responsibilities

• Lead UX design for key products and internal tools, from early concept through shipped experience, operating as the senior-most UX voice in the room

• Partner closely with engineering to design and refine interfaces, workflows, and interactions, balancing user needs with technical constraints

• Introduce and establish user research practices at CHAOS — usability testing, user interviews, and other methods to ground design decisions in real user needs

• Define and advocate for UX best practices, standards, and processes across the company, with the authority to set direction

• Build the foundation for a growing UX function, including processes, standards, and practices that can scale over time

• Translate complex, technical, or novel workflows into intuitive, well-designed user experiences

• Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, product, leadership) to align on priorities and advocate for the user's perspective in high-level decision-making

• Create and maintain design systems/UX standards that scale across products as the company grows

• Communicate design rationale and research findings clearly and persuasively to technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership

Minimum Qualifications

• 10+ years of UX design experience, with a demonstrated track record operating at a staff/principal level on complex products

• Experience conducting or overseeing user research (usability testing, interviews, or similar) and using it to inform design decisions

• Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX work at a senior level — research, interaction design, and polished execution

• Experience working closely and effectively with engineering teams, including translating technical constraints into good design solutions

• Proficiency in Figma and standard UX/prototyping tools

• Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and influence skills — proven ability to set direction and build buy-in in an organization where the function is new

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently with a high degree of ownership and ambiguity, particularly in the early stages of building out a function

• Ability to work hybrid (3 days/week in-office) out of either our El Segundo or San Francisco office

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience designing for technical, engineering-heavy, or hardware-adjacent products

• Experience designing map-based, geospatial, or location-based interfaces

• Experience in defense or government, especially with command and control (C2) systems

• Experience establishing design systems from scratch

• Bachelor's degree in design, HCI, psychology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• U.S. Citizen

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary: $160,000 - $220,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. jobs.title: Lead Manager, Sustainer Giving
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Our vision is to grant the wish of every eligible child. Through our mission, we are uniting communities to grant life-changing wishes. As the world’s largest wish-granting organization, we strive to create a sense of community and an environment where we warmly embrace our wish families, volunteers, and colleagues.

Joining Make-A-Wish means becoming part of a mission that believes in the power of a wish.

Location:

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We do not sponsor employment visas or other immigration processes to attain or maintain employment eligibility.

Remote positions are open to applicants based anywhere in the continental U.S. Hybrid positions are open to applicants based in the Phoenix, Arizona area.

Position Summary:

The Lead Manager, Sustainer Giving leads the strategy and growth of Make-A-Wish’s recurring giving program. The role is responsible for transforming the program from a largely passive enrollment model into an actively managed fundraising program that systematically acquires new sustainers, retains and reactivates existing sustainers, and grows donor value over time.

The Lead Manager owns the national sustainer strategy and program roadmap and is accountable for overall program performance. The role identifies campaign strategies, investment opportunities and audience priorities and partners with Integrated Fundraising channel managers, agency partners and cross-functional teams to plan and execute fundraising campaigns across direct mail, paid media, email, SMS and telemarketing. Success requires strong strategic judgment, analytical capability and the ability to align partners around shared goals without direct authority over channel execution.

Core Responsibilities:

Audience Strategy & Program Development

• Develops and owns the annual national sustainer giving strategy and program roadmap, including acquisition goals, retention and reactivation targets, upgrade milestones, stewardship priorities and investment recommendations.

• Establishes audience segmentation frameworks that drive differentiated messaging and treatment strategies across the sustainer lifecycle, from first gift through long-term retention, reactivation and upgrade.

• Identifies opportunities to grow the active sustainer base through channel-specific acquisition, conversion of one-time donors and new prospect audiences; brings prioritized recommendations to channel managers and agency partners for integrated execution.

• Partners with the Senior Manager, Midlevel Giving to define the giving threshold and experience for sustainers transitioning into the midlevel program and ensures a seamless, coordinated donor journey.

• Monitors recurring giving trends and brings forward relevant best practices, innovations and investment opportunities to guide program evolution.

Cross-Channel Execution & Stakeholder Alignment

• Translates the sustainer strategy into clear, channel-specific briefs and campaign direction for direct mail, paid media, email, SMS and telemarketing; partners with channel managers to align priorities, sequencing and execution.

• Serves as the organization’s primary sustainer subject matter expert, ensuring channel managers and agency partners have the context, priorities and performance expectations needed to incorporate sustainer objectives into their programs.

• Reviews and provides strategic feedback on creative, copy, offers and audience selection for sustainer campaign elements and coordinates decisions across internal and agency stakeholders.

• Builds and maintains productive relationships with direct mail, digital, data and other agency partners to ensure sustainer activity is coordinated and coherent across channels.

• Advises chapters on sustainer strategy, national program standards, audience approaches and best practices while maintaining clear accountability for the national program.

• Collaborates with the Integrated Fundraising team and broader Development organization to identify acquisition, conversion, retention and upgrade opportunities and align sustainer priorities with enterprise fundraising goals.

Analysis, Reporting & Optimization

• Leads ongoing analysis of sustainer program performance, including acquisition volume and cost, active sustainer growth, recurring revenue, retention and reactivation rates, average gift, upgrade performance and lifetime value.

• Develops and maintains reporting on program health, translates performance data into strategic recommendations, and communicates results and decisions clearly to internal stakeholders and leadership.

• Develops the cross-channel testing roadmap and partners with channel managers and agencies to execute, evaluate and document tests that improve sustainer acquisition, retention, reactivation and upgrade performance.

• Partners with Data and Operations teams to ensure accurate gift processing, reporting, audience selection and campaign tracking.

• Develops sustainer investment recommendations and performance forecasts and partners with the Director of Integrated Fundraising and channel managers on annual budget planning and in-year resource allocation.

• Measures success through growth in active sustainers and recurring revenue, acquisition efficiency, retention and reactivation performance, donor value and effective integration of sustainer priorities across fundraising channels.

• Performs other related job duties as assigned.

Knowledge and Abilities:

• Knowledge of sustainer or recurring giving programs, including acquisition, conversion, retention, reactivation, upgrade and stewardship strategies.

• Ability to develop channel-agnostic strategy and translate it into actionable direction across direct mail, paid media, email, SMS, telemarketing and other direct-response channels. Canvassing or face-to-face fundraising experience is a plus.

• Builds trusted relationships across key stakeholders, including cross functional teams, agency partners and channel managers. Demonstrates ability to influence decisions to meet commitments and advance organizational fundraising goals

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret program performance, identify trends and opportunities, develop forecasts and present recommendations clearly to peers and leadership.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information and adapt messages for agency partners, channel peers, cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership.

• Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, clarify ownership, prioritize effectively and meet deadlines in a remote, fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; experience with fundraising CRM, payment, or marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Fundraise Up or Luminate Online preferred.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience..

• A minimum of five years of experience in direct-response fundraising or marketing, including at least two years supporting sustainer or recurring giving programs.

• Demonstrated experience working in a cross-functional or matrixed environment where results depend on collaboration and influence across teams.

• Experience managing or collaborating with external agencies or vendors required.

• Prior experience in a nonprofit organization preferred.

Working Environment:

• Ability to thrive in a fully remote work environment.

• Some travel required, up to 10%.

• May occasionally require work outside of the traditional Monday through Friday work week, including evenings and weekends.

This Role's Hiring Range

$70,000—$85,400 USD

What We Offer:

Benefits

• Comprehensive benefit package, effective day 1: Medical, Vision*, Dental*, Wellness

• Competitive compensation with annual incentive potential

• Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account Options

• Health Reimbursement Account fully funded by Make-A-Wish America

• Short Term Disability*, Long Term Disability* and Life Insurance

• Additional Insurance Plans: Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance through Figo

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 5% match after one year of service

• Eligibility for student loan forgiveness through the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program

• The organization will send a laptop, 24” monitor, and a docking station/adaptor to new hires

Time Off

• Competitive PTO starting at 15 days, with enhanced time off for senior roles

• 10 Sick Days

• 11 Paid Holidays

• 2 Volunteer Days after one year of service

• 2 Personal Days accrued annually

• Parental Leave

Also...

• Employee Awards and Recognition Programs

• Individual and Leadership Development

• Discounts and special offers for theme parks, events, hotels, concerts, and movie tickets

• Monthly premiums paid for the employee for vision, dental, and short/long term disability.

We are committed to creating an accessible and inclusive workplace. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the application process, please email hr@wish.org. We are happy to review your needs.

jobs.title: Senior IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to ensure the 24x7 availability and performance of our infrastructure through secure, scalable cloud solutions and automation. This is a hybrid architectural, implementation, and support role. You will design and manage production monitoring, streamline workflows, contribute to documentation, and write efficient, maintainable code. With 8+ years of experience, strong Unix/Linux expertise, and knowledge of networking protocols, you’ll collaborate across teams to solve complex problems, improve system reliability, and proactively address security risks. You will work within a team of mid-level and senior IT engineers and developers spanning the network and systems infrastructure, identity management, security, and integration spaces, expanding our service portfolio following business needs and iterating and improving upon our existing infrastructure. This role offers the opportunity to tackle new challenges and grow within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Ensure 24x7 responsiveness of services and infrastructure, including on-call rotation for production services.

• Design and manage production system monitoring, using ExtraHop wire data products and conventional tools.

• Add to our internal and stakeholder-facing knowledge bases, including design documents, playbooks, diagrams, and documentation.

• Design and construct secure, future-proof, hybrid/multi-cloud services and networks.

• Implement and improve human and automated workflows for operations and support.

• Write elegant, extensible, sustainable code to solve current and future problems as simply as possible, but no simpler.

• Learn and grow as an engineer and as a colleague.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in Unix/Linux systems administration and software development.

• Proficiency in using Shell/Bash and other automation tools within a Linux/Unix environment.

• Familiarity with a distributed version-control workflow in a team setting (e.g., Git).

• Competency in web infrastructure operations, including development and deployment.

• Experience or strong interest in cloud and serverless infrastructure.

• Understanding of virtualization platforms such as Linux KVM.

• In-depth knowledge of enterprise networking and application protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP, SSH, DNS, LDAP, TLS.

• Strong communication skills (verbal and written), with an ability to collaborate effectively across teams.

• Self-directed problem-solving ability, with skills in building consensus among peers and partners.

• Security-focused mindset across all operational activities.

• Ability to express and defend well-formed opinions on technical topics, even in respectful disagreement (e.g., emacs vs. vi).

• Willingness to take on new, undefined challenges and explore innovative solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with cloud virtualization platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Our team doubles as an escalation point for desktop support, and we manage the Active Directory environment; Windows and/or MacOS competency is a plus.

• Experience with Google Workspace administration is an asset.

• Understanding of firewall and security management principles.

• Understanding of secondary networking and application protocols: UDP, SMTP, NTP, SNMP, Finger.

• Hands-on experience with Linux configuration management systems (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef).

• Familiarity with network switching and routing equipment, including configuration and deployment.

• Strong attention to detail, especially regarding grammatical nuances such as the Oxford comma and double sentence spacing.

Skills and Competencies

• Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of Linux/Unix systems, networking protocols, and automation tools.

• Collaboration: Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills, working effectively across cross-functional teams.

• Problem-Solving: Ability to diagnose complex systems and offer clear, actionable solutions.

• Security Mindset: Proactively identifies and mitigates security risks in operational workflows.

• Communication: Articulate communicator, capable of explaining technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and excited to learn new technologies and approaches.

• Critical Thinking: Open-minded yet decisive, with an ability to analyze different perspectives and make informed decisions.

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $149,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

BENEFITS

Employees' wellbeing is top of mind for the ExtraHop team. Employees and their families will have the option to participate in the following benefits:

• Health, Dental, and Vision Benefits

• Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time

• Educational Reimbursement

• 401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable

• Pet Insurance (US Only)

• Parental Leave (US Only)

• Hybrid and Remote Work Model

Our people are our most important competitive advantage, leading the charge against cyber criminals. Join the fight today!

To learn more, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Federal
jobs.description:
ABOUT FACTORY



Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).




ABOUT THE ROLE

Factory is looking for innovative Software Engineers to join our founding Federal team. You will build and evolve cutting-edge AI systems that transform how government software organizations accelerate their productivity and innovation. You will work directly with the Department of War, the Intelligence Community, and federal civilian agencies to bring Factory to secure, classified, and air-gapped environments, helping the nation's most critical software teams operate as autonomous software factories.




WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE

 - Innovate at the forefront of AI by designing, developing, and deploying AI-driven agentic systems that enhance Factory's core AI capabilities for federal missions

 - Deploy and harden the Factory Platform in secure government environments, including GovCloud, on-premises, classified, and fully air-gapped networks, so it runs with limited or no internet connectivity and with self-hosted or government-approved models

 - Build security and compliance into everything you ship, partnering with Security and Infrastructure to achieve and maintain authorizations such as FedRAMP High and DoD Impact Levels (IL5/IL6), including access controls, audit logging, and continuous monitoring

 - Build multi-layered guardrails, observability, and explainability into our agents so government users can trust, audit, and understand how an agent reached its output

 - Engage directly with federal customers, on-site when needed, to understand their missions and workflows, define requirements with stakeholders, and own delivery from first prototype to accepted production deployment

 - Integrate Factory with the tools government engineering teams already rely on, including on-premises source control, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and DoD software factories

 - Work with product, engineering, and Federal go-to-market teams to integrate emerging AI research findings into practical, mission-focused solutions

 - Engage in iterative development processes, rapidly prototyping and refining AI functionalities based on real-world feedback to meet the evolving needs of government developers and program offices

 - Take the initiative in identifying and addressing product stability and scalability challenges, ensuring the Factory Platform reliably supports large-scale operational demands in high-consequence and resource-constrained environments

 - Lead the exploration and integration of large-scale data processing techniques to improve the reliability and effectiveness of our AI systems

 - Serve as the voice of the federal customer, bringing field insights back into Factory's core platform so that capabilities built for one mission become reusable across the public sector

 - Help build our Federal team from the ground up, partnering with leadership on technical proposals, capture strategy, and the product roadmap for our public sector business


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 2+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering roles post-acquisition of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, or a related technical field.

 - Demonstrated proficiency with LLMs and a track record of applying AI/ML techniques to solve complex, unstructured problems, ideally within the domain of software engineering or related areas.

 - Self-motivated and autonomous, with a proven ability to navigate ambiguous projects from conception to impactful deployment, ideally as part of a founding team, a new initiative, or a forward-deployed engineering group.

 - Strong communication skills that enable you to articulate technical concepts and strategies clearly at all levels, including to non-technical government stakeholders, coupled with a strategic mindset oriented towards innovation.

 - Comfort working directly with customers, including time on-site at customer locations.

 - A passion for public sector work and a belief in the potential of government institutions to deliver better outcomes through technology.

 - Experience deploying software in regulated or secure environments (e.g., AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels, or classified and air-gapped networks) is highly desirable, though not mandatory.

 - Familiarity with government work and its complexities, including procurement, compliance, and the accreditation (ATO) process, is a plus.

 - Experience with data-intensive applications and familiarity with the software development lifecycle are highly desirable, though not mandatory.

Location: 

We offer location flexibility for this role, with a preference for candidates based in our San Francisco, CA (HQ) or Washington, D.C. (remote).

jobs.title: Director of Product, Ecosystem
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, California, United States; United States
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Director of Product, Ecosystem

Nebius builds the infrastructure serious AI teams run on — GPU clusters, inference runtimes, development environments, and data pipelines purpose-built for demanding AI workloads.

We’re looking for a hands-on product leader to help shape our platform for the next generation of AI applications. Your focus will be agentic infrastructure: the capabilities developers and enterprises need to build, run, and scale systems that reason, use tools, and take action.

As Director of Product, Ecosystem, you will identify emerging customer needs, explore new product opportunities, and turn promising ideas into capabilities developers choose to build on. You will combine product judgment, technical experimentation, and close relationships across the AI ecosystem to shape what Nebius builds and how it works with other platforms and tools.

Your responsibilities

Define product direction

• Own the product vision, priorities, and roadmap for emerging opportunities in agentic infrastructure.

• Work directly with developers and enterprise teams to understand their workflows, technical constraints, and unmet needs.

• Translate customer insights and ecosystem developments into clear product decisions and scoped releases.

• Partner with engineering and design throughout discovery, development, launch, and iteration.

• Define success through developer adoption, production usage, customer outcomes, and business impact.

Explore and build hands-on

• Build prototypes, sample applications, and integrations to test ideas and make product decisions concrete.

• Use Nebius and relevant ecosystem tools firsthand to understand the developer experience and identify gaps.

• Work through technical tradeoffs with engineering, including performance, reliability, security, and cost.

• Validate new concepts with customers and turn successful experiments into production offerings.

• Help create reference architectures and examples that make it easier for developers to get started.

Connect the ecosystem to the platform

• Build close relationships with founders, technical leaders, and developers shaping how AI applications are built.

• Evaluate emerging tools and technologies through direct experimentation and customer feedback.

• Identify where Nebius should build, integrate, or partner to deliver a stronger product experience.

• Lead the product side of selected partnerships, from initial concept through integration, launch, and adoption.

• Bring external insights into platform planning and help leadership prioritize investments.

Drive adoption and iteration

• Work with developer relations, marketing, sales, and field teams to bring new capabilities to market.

• Stay close to early users, resolve adoption barriers, and feed production learnings into the roadmap.

• Develop a repeatable path from customer discovery and experimentation to products with sustained usage.

Product scope

This role spans the infrastructure and developer experience that support agentic applications. Opportunities may include how applications access models and tools, manage context and state, execute workloads, connect to data, and operate reliably in production.

Your scope will evolve with customer needs and the platform’s direction. We value the ability to find the right problems, develop a clear product thesis, and deliver useful capabilities across this landscape.

We expect you to have

• 8+ years of relevant experience building technical products, with meaningful ownership of AI infrastructure, cloud platforms, or developer tools.

• A track record of taking products from an ambiguous customer problem to production adoption, with measurable outcomes.

• Strong technical fluency and the ability to work through architecture and implementation decisions with engineers.

• A hands-on approach: You can use APIs and SDKs, explore unfamiliar tools, and build working prototypes to test your thinking.

• Experience designing developer experiences across APIs, integrations, documentation, and operational workflows.

• Familiarity with how AI applications are built and an informed perspective on the infrastructure needs of increasingly agentic systems.

• Strong customer discovery skills and sound judgment about which needs can support a repeatable product.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including product proposals, technical tradeoffs, and investment recommendations.

• Comfort setting direction, making decisions, and delivering in a fast-moving environment.

It will be an added bonus if you have

• Founded a company or served as an early product or engineering leader at an AI or infrastructure startup.

• Built products used by developers to create or operate AI applications.

• Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or production AI workloads.

• Contributed to open-source projects or worked closely with developer communities.

• Built technical partnerships that led to successful integrations or new product capabilities.

Key Employee Benefits:

• Health Insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.

• 401(k) Plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.

• Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.

• Remote Work Reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.

• Disability & Life Insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term, and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$228,000—$285,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

You will also carry out performance-tuning and quality assurance operations on critical infrastructure components to ensure high level of data quality, availability, and security across the enterprise. In fulfilling this role, you will be expected to collaborate with the team to develop and implement strategies for improved data center operations.

• Manage complete lifecycle for data center hardware, including deployment, operation, and decommission.

• Track and logically organize the physical storage of incoming data center equipment.

• Perform quality assurance testing and resolve recurring issues.

• Schedule and track hardware maintenance tasks.

• Update port maps and rack layouts and create operational procedures.

• Monitor the environmental conditions and power/cooling systems of a data center to ensure they are optimum for servers, switches, storage arrays, and other devices.

• Run hardware diagnostics and replace failing parts in a timely manner.

• Upgrade internal system components, including CPUs, memory, and storage.

• Setup and operate common Linux and Windows servers.

• Document processes and keep event logs.

• Work with the purchasing department on the procurement of new data center equipment.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline and 1+ year of data center experience; OR 3+ years of data center experience in lieu of a degree.

• Professional experience working in a data center or with IT hardware.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Certifications related to IT infrastructure such as CompTIA Server+, CompTIA Network+, and CCNP.

• Experience with data center infrastructure management (DCIM), including tools to monitor, measure, manage, and/or control data center utilization.

• In-depth knowledge of data center environments, servers, and network equipment.

• Extensive experience in installing, monitoring, and maintaining data center equipment.

• Linux and Windows OS system administration experience.

• Power and data center cooling capacity planning experience.

• Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Experience working with multiple vendor hardware architectures.

• Experience working with server management tools such as HPE iLO, Cisco CIMC and Dell iDRAC.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed (to respond to network and server errors after hours).

jobs.title: Senior RF Engineer II (Hardware)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Neros is a defense technology company rebuilding America’s drone industrial base. We design and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are tested in combat, iterated at startup speed, and built at massive scale. Our team culture is fast, hands-on, and obsessed with closing the gap between design and deployment.

As drones transform the character of warfare, Neros is delivering the systems the West needs to compete on the modern battlefield and deter the adversaries of democracy. We’re hiring engineers, operators, and builders who want to move fast, take on extreme ownership, and get capability into the hands of warfighters in months, not years.

What you will be doing

As a Senior RF Engineer II (Hardware), you will own the technical direction and final sign-off for RF hardware implementation across all Neros products involving wireless links. You will ensure link budgets, cascade analysis, spectral performance, subsystem-level requirements, and validation strategies are technically sound before programs move forward. You will serve as the company's deepest RF hardware technical resource for complex connectivity performance issues and guide responsible engineers across platforms as they implement and validate wireless systems.

Responsibilities

• Own final technical sign-off for RF hardware implementations across Neros products involving wireless links

• Review and approve link budgets, cascade analysis, spectral performance, and RF subsystem-level requirements

• Set the technical direction for how responsible engineers implement, verify, validate, and production-test RF hardware systems

• Use SystemVue, HFSS, ADS, MATLAB, Simulink, and related tools to model, simulate, and validate RF architectures

• Drive root cause analysis for complex RF/connectivity performance issues including interference, desense, link margin, spectral compliance, and system-level coexistence

• Propose, model, and validate RF architectural decisions, component selections, and implementation trade-offs across platforms

• Provide deep technical guidance to responsible engineers and cross-functional teams so design proposals are technically sound before execution

You should have the following

• Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) required; Master of Science (MSEE) or PhD highly preferred

• 8+ years of professional experience in RF hardware design, RF systems engineering, or wireless product development

• Expert-level ability to build, review, and defend link budgets, cascade analysis, receiver sensitivity analysis, spectral performance analysis, and RF subsystem requirements

• Proven expertise using RF/system simulation tools such as SystemVue, HFSS, ADS, MATLAB, Simulink, or similar for architecture, PCB, antenna, fixture, and system-level analysis

• Deep knowledge of RF hardware architecture, radio standards, antennas, component selection, filtering, gain planning, noise, linearity, and system-level trade-offs

• Demonstrated experience serving as a technical authority or final design reviewer for complex RF hardware implementations

• Strong understanding of verification, validation, production acceptance testing, DFM, and DFT

Nice to have

• Advanced Degree: MS or PhD in EE with a focus on RF/microwaves, electromagnetics, communications, or a related field

• SystemVue / ADS / HFSS Depth: extensive experience using these tools to make product architecture decisions, not just run isolated simulations

• Antenna and Platform Integration: antenna integration, embedded wireless products, desense, coexistence, EMI/EMC, and mechanical/RF coupling

• Production RF Experience: defining production RF acceptance tests, tuning strategy, yield monitoring, and manufacturing feedback loops

• Technical Leadership: acting as final technical reviewer or principal engineer across multiple products, platforms, or programs

US Salary Range

225,000 - 315,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
About Supermove
Supermove builds software and AI for moving companies. We've raised $30M from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and other investors. We started in 2019 as the system that runs a moving business: sales, operations, crews, billing. Today that system runs moving companies across the US, Canada and Australia, from single-location movers to some of the largest van lines and franchise systems in North America.
Now we're putting AI to work on top of it. Our voice agents answer and call leads, book moves, and hand off to a person at the right moment. Autopilot, our agent platform, goes further. It answers questions about the business in plain language, flags what needs attention, and handles work that used to take a person's whole day, from working the inbox to updating jobs.
The role
When a major account signs with us, someone has to make sure it delivers. It goes live on time, it hits the results the customer bought us for, and it renews bigger than it started. That's you.
You're the quarterback for our largest accounts from signature through first renewal, but this is not a role where you manage the project from the sidelines. You'll own the plan and coordinate implementation managers, support engineers, product, and sales, while also getting directly into the work yourself.

That might mean configuring and testing a Voice Agent, rewriting a playbook after listening to calls, tracing an integration issue, building an ROI analysis, testing a new workflow with the customer, or jumping into Supermove to figure out why something isn't working. You should be comfortable moving between an executive meeting and hands-on troubleshooting in the same afternoon.

We have specialists you'll work with, but we want someone whose instinct is to dig in, understand the problem firsthand, and help get it solved—not just assign it to someone else.
Enterprise moving is complicated work. A large account can mean hundreds of locations, franchisees or agents with their own ways of doing things, several systems that need to talk to each other, and a leadership team that expects results in months, not years. Getting AI to work inside an operation like that is the hard part. We want someone who enjoys that problem.
What you'll do
Own the relationship and the results for a small number of our largest accounts, from the executive sponsor to the ops leads who use Supermove every day.
Run implementations as real projects: discovery, scope, plan, milestones, go-live. Keep the teams moving and hold them to their dates, including people who don't report to you.
Plan and lead onsite working sessions. Get the right people in the room and leave with decisions made.
Design how AI fits into each customer's operation. Decide which calls a voice agent should take, which workflows Autopilot should run, and where a person still belongs in the loop.
Stay hands-on with the agents once they're live. Review calls and agent sessions, find where things break down, tune the playbooks, and measure again.
Be the customer's voice inside Supermove as Autopilot grows. Our largest customers will be among the first to push it into new parts of their business, and what you learn with them will shape what we build next. Turn it into clear, prioritized input for product and engineering.
Prove ROI with data. Know what we're generating for each account before they ask, and build the dashboard or analysis that shows it.
See risk early and act on it. Work with sales before the handoff so what we sold is what we deliver, and drive expansion once the account is healthy.
What we're looking for
4+ years in management consulting, enterprise implementation, solutions or technical account management, or a similar client-facing role where you owned complex projects end to end.
You've run programs with many stakeholders and moving parts, and you can walk us through how you kept one on track.
You're technical enough to go deep. You understand APIs, webhooks, and data flows, and you're at home with engineers. You can read an integration spec and tell us what's missing. SQL or light scripting is a plus. Production code is not required.
You use AI seriously in your own work. Ideally you've built, tuned, or evaluated an LLM-based agent or workflow, and you have a view on what makes one trustworthy enough to run a real business process.
You're credible with a CEO or COO and just as useful with a dispatcher. When the answer isn't the one a customer hoped for, you give it straight and keep their trust.
You write clearly. A lot of this job happens in writing.
Moving, logistics, or field-services experience is a plus. We'll teach you the industry.
Why this role matters
Our largest accounts are where AI in this industry gets proven, one real operation at a time. How well they go shapes our product, our reputation, and our growth. You'll work directly with our CEO and leadership team, and you'll help decide how Supermove runs enterprise accounts from here on.
Process
Intro call → hiring manager interview → case exercise (plan a realistic enterprise rollout) → founder interview.
