jobs.title: Lead School Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
Cortica is looking for a Lead Behavior Technician – School Based Support to join its growing team!

The Lead School Behavior Technician provides direct behavior-analytic services to students with autism spectrum disorder and other neurodevelopmental differences in school settings. In addition to delivering direct student support, the Lead BT serves as the direct supervisor, providing administrative support and performance management for School Behavior Technicians, modeling best practices and offering guidance in the implementation of behavior intervention strategies. This role is essential in ensuring consistent, high-quality, neurodiversity-affirming support for students and school teams.

We are a rapidly growing healthcare company pioneering the most effective treatment methods for children with neurodevelopmental differences. Our mission is to design and deliver life-changing care – one child, one family, one community at a time. Ultimately, we envision a world that cultivates the full potential of every child. At Cortica, every team member is instrumental in helping us achieve our mission.

Our culture and values guide how we work and treat one another. Cortica celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive environment, seeking ideas and opinions from everyone on the team. We safeguard equal rights and respect for all individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, creed, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status or other applicable, legally protected characteristics. All Cortica employment decisions are made based on an individual’s qualifications and ability to successfully perform the job responsibilities.

What will you do?

• Provide direct implementation of behavior-analytic services to students in one-on-one and group settings within school environments.

• Lead by example in implementing individualized behavior intervention plans (BIPs) and skill acquisition programs aligned with students’ IEPs and educational goals.

• Support and mentor school-based BTs by modeling strategies, answering questions, and troubleshooting implementation challenges.

• Substitute in schools as needed to ensure continuity of services and provide high-quality support in the absence of assigned BTs.

• Collaborate with Behavior Analysts, educators, and school teams to integrate behavioral strategies into classroom routines.

• Support students' growth in communication, social interaction, emotional regulation, and adaptive skills as appropriate to the school setting.

• Utilize a strengths-based, neurodiversity-affirming approach to service delivery.

• Collect and review data to monitor student progress and support BTs in accurate data collection practices.

• Provide feedback and coaching to BTs as delegated by supervising Board Certified Behavior Analysts BCBAs).

• Participate in classroom observations, team meetings, and school-based training sessions; help facilitate training for new BTs.

• Demonstrate professionalism, flexibility, and leadership in dynamic school environments. Oversee the day-to-day administrative supervision of school behavior technicians (SBTs) in the areas of performance management, nonclinical administration, clinical accountability, leave of absence and workplace accommodations support, workers’ compensation case support, separation of employment, and time and schedule management.

• Establish working relationship with all direct reports throughout the teammate lifecycle from orientation through employment separation.

• Complete daily administration of SBT time off management, SBT callout management in conjunction with scheduling department, approval of additional indirect time, approval and review of SBT serious incident reports (SIRs), SBT availability changes.

• Complete and/or assist with audits for administrative or indirect time (weekly), meal and rest break penalties – California only (per pay period), unconverted sessions (weekly). Report findings to ABA site manager and work with SBTs to rectify any discrepancies.

• Ensure SBTs have completed all compliance requirements, including required clinical training through collaboration with the site’s lead behavior technician trainers (LBTs). Responsible for ensuring that all SBTs meet compliance standards.

• Responsible for the performance management of SBTs by providing and documenting timely feedback, including synthesizing clinical feedback through collaboration with the Director of School Operations.

• Effectively manage and navigate electronic medical record (EMR) systems and Microsoft Office products to ensure accurate documentation, reporting, and communication.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation, including session notes, incident reports, and mentoring logs as assigned.

• Adhere to all school safety protocols, including proactive behavior supports, de-escalation techniques, and mandated reporting.

• Demonstrate professionalism, flexibility, and leadership in dynamic school environments.

• Travel between school sites within the designated service area.

We’d love to hear from you if:

• You hold a high school diploma or equivalent.

• You bring 1+ years of experience leading and managing direct reports.

• You bring 1+ years of experience providing ABA services in school or clinical settings.

• You can obtain assigned safety training certification within 30 days of employment.

• You can obtain and maintain Board Certified Autism Technician (BCAT) or Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) credential within 30 days of employment, where required by the district.

• You can maintain reliable transportation and travel between work sites.

• You can obtain a first aid/CPR certification and a tuberculosis (TB) clearance.

Cortica cares deeply about the well-being of each member of our team, and we have created a passionate, caring, and growth-minded culture that helps teammates to thrive! We offer a wide range of benefits for full-time teammates, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching and rapid vesting, paid holidays and wellness days, life insurance, disability insurance options, tuition reimbursements for professional development and continuing education, and referral bonuses. We value our teammates and the experience they bring to their roles, and are proud to provide a compensation and benefits package designed to enhance all aspects of our teammates' lives.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer, Solid Rocket Motor Nozzles
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa Major’s solid rocket motor (SRM) team is hiring multiple Senior Design Engineers to support the design, development, and qualification of solid rocket motor nozzles and associated insulation systems. This role has substantial technical responsibility and autonomy, with support from subject matter experts where needed.

You will be a key contributor for SRM nozzle design at Ursa Major, defining nozzle architectures and interfaces, leading shell and insulator design, and driving test campaigns. You’ll help refine the design methods, standards, and processes that enable scalable, high-rate production of solid rocket motors.

This isn't purely a desk job. You’ll be expected to be on the build floor working with technicians, integrating hardware, and resolving build issues in real time. Our engineers work across a variety of programs and roles, so you’ll have the opportunity to contribute beyond your title and take on new challenges as they arise.

What You’ll Do

• Lead the design of solid rocket motor nozzles, including shells, insulators, and interfaces with minimal guidance from subject matter experts.

• Translate customer requirements and mission needs into robust, manufacturable nozzle designs that meet performance, reliability, cost, and schedule targets.

• Lead design trades across materials, manufacturing processes, and nozzle architectures.

• Plan and support development test campaigns to derisk new concepts and mature them into qualified products.

• Review test data and post-test hardware to verify performance against predictions, identify anomalies, and drive design or process changes when needed.

• Provide hands-on support during builds and tests by integrating hardware, resolving build issues in real time, and closing the loop between design and manufacturing.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration with analysis, manufacturing, test, systems, and supply chain teams to ensure nozzle designs meet all stakeholder needs.

• Maintain aggressive but realistic project schedules, identifying key risks early and working with technical leads to implement mitigation plans.

• Generate and review CAD models and engineering drawings in accordance with internal standards and ASME Y14.5‑2009/2018.

• Maintain clear, organized technical documentation, including requirements, design reviews, test plans and reports, and verification/validation evidence.

• Provide day‑to‑day technical guidance to junior engineers, contributing to the team’s growth in nozzle design, materials, and manufacturing.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in rocket propulsion, high temperature structures, or closely related hardware.

• Demonstrated experience with erosive and nonerosive nozzle designs and associated manufacturing practices.

• Ability to execute clean-sheet nozzle designs, including first‑order fluids and thermal analyses to inform geometry, materials, and insulation strategies.

• Proficiency with CAD and engineering analysis tools (e.g., structural, thermal, and fluid/CFD analysis).

• Strong engineering fundamentals, including in-depth knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, heat transfer, and structural mechanics.

• Ability to work autonomously within a defined scope, while knowing when to pull in subject matter experts or technical leads.

• Clear, effective written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional collaboration, design reviews, customer discussions, and documentation.

• Eligibility for a U.S. DoD Secret Clearance is required and maintaining that eligibility is a condition of employment.

Desired Experience

• Master’s degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience architecting and designing electromechanical systems (e.g., actuators, gimbal mechanisms) for nozzle vectoring.

• Direct experience with vectorable nozzle technologies (e.g., splitline designs, jet tabs, flexseals).

• Hands-on involvement in rapid product development environments (prototype‑heavy, fast‑iteration programs).

• Experience designing hardware for high-rate, automated production, including design for manufacturing/assembly and process automation.

• Proficiency with Siemens NX (CAD) and Ansys (FEA/CFD) tools.

• Active DoD Secret clearance or higher.

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $105,840 - $132,300, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

Classification: Full-time Exempt

Benefits Include: (Please note, Interns are not eligible for benefits)

• Unlimited PTO - Vacation, Sick, Personal, and Bereavement

• Paid Parental and Adoptive Leave

• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance

• Tax Advantage Accounts (HSA/FSA)

• Additional Benefit Options Including Voluntary Life and Emergency Medical Transport

NOTE: Research suggests that women and BIPOC individuals may self-select out of opportunities if they don't meet 100% of the job requirements. We encourage anyone who believes they have the skills and the drive necessary to succeed here to apply for this role.

jobs.description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.

• Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.

• Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.

• Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

• Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.

• Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent

• Experience using computers

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.

• Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.

• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.

• Ability to work overtime and on weekends.

• Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Position with a competitive salary

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally

The team comprises legal professionals from diverse fields, including technology, privacy, IP, corporate, cybersecurity, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation.

jobs.title: Driver (Dallas-Fort Worth)
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The last mile delivery driver handles the final leg of delivery and installation getting Base Power battery systems to members' homes on time and setting them up right. Day-to-day work includes operating a 26ft box truck with a passenger team member, loading products, driving a route, installing ground-mounted batteries systems, and keeping accurate delivery records in our in-house app. 

What You'll Do

 - Deliveries: Transport and hand off products to residential and business addresses safely and on time

 - Equipment operation: Use electric pallet jacks and dollies to move pallets in and out of the truck

 - Battery installation: Stack batteries, complete light assembly, and commission the app-based system at each site

 - Member interaction: Answer or direct questions and address concerns on-site with clear, professional communication

 - Site cleanup: Remove all packaging and debris from the member's property before leaving

 - Route management: Follow efficient routes to hit delivery windows consistently

 - Vehicle upkeep: Keep the delivery vehicle clean and organized. Run basic maintenance checks before each shift

 - Delivery logging: Record delivery times, addresses, product, and notes accurately in the delivery app

 - Inventory: Assist with loading and unloading. Run truck cycle counts when requested

 - Safety: Follow all driving and product-handling safety protocols

 - Issue reporting: Flag delays, damages, missing items, or road issues to dispatch or a supervisor promptly

 

What You'll Bring

 - Valid driver's license with a clean record

 - Ability to pass a DOT physical

 - Experience driving box trucks, vans, or commercial vehicles preferred

 - Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with members

 - Able to learn and use apps, systems, and tech platforms required for the role

 - Able to lift and carry 50+ lbs

 - Comfortable navigating routes using GPS or mapping software

 - Self-directed and reliable in a fast-paced environment

 - Basic vehicle maintenance knowledge

 - Able to work outdoors year-round in all weather conditions

 

About the Team

Our delivery and warehouse team ensures solar batteries, inverters, and installation equipment reach residential job sites on time and in perfect condition. We handle the last-mile logistics that determine whether thousands of families get their clean energy systems installed on schedule. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale—every efficient route, properly kitted job, and damage-free delivery means another home powered by renewable energy instead of the grid.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

jobs.title: Director, Performance Nutrition
jobs.description:
Title: Director, Performance Nutrition
Reports to: Director, Performance
Status: Full-Time Salaried, Non-Exempt
Location: Philadelphia, PA

Position Overview:

The Philadelphia Phillies are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking leader to serve as our Director of Performance Nutrition. This position will lead the organization’s nutrition strategy and operations across the Major Leagues, Minor Leagues, training complexes, and rehabilitation environments, with the goal of maximizing player health, development, and performance.

Reporting to the Director of Performance, this individual will have significant autonomy to shape the long-term vision and direction of the Phillies Nutrition Department. The Director will oversee an established team of multiple full-time direct reports, provide leadership, mentorship, and strategic direction while building upon the department’s existing foundation.

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise in performance nutrition with the leadership skills, creativity, and organizational perspective necessary to drive a department forward. The successful candidate will be comfortable developing people, building scalable systems, collaborating across disciplines, and translating emerging research into practical solutions that positively impact players throughout the organization.

While the position has an established foundation of responsibilities, we recognize that the Nutrition Department will continue to evolve. The individual selected for this role will play a central role in shaping that evolution, working in partnership with the Director of Performance to refine departmental priorities, responsibilities, and the long-term vision for performance nutrition across the organization.

Responsibilities:

• Help build departmental values and core principles that will usher the Phillies Nutrition Department into the future of performance enhancement in professional baseball.

• Create and manage processes that assess and analyze dietary practices, body composition, and energy balance (intake and expenditure) of players in the context of athletic performance.

• Oversee a team of dietitians directed toward the ultimate goal of using nutrition concepts toward improving the health and performance of the players in the organization.

• Work alongside other performance departments as well as baseball staff to implement processes that are most effective in achieving the highest levels of performance for the organization and its players.

• Oversee processes that ensure this organization and its staff remain in front of the emerging curve of nutrition research regarding injury risk reduction and baseball performance enhancement.

• Evaluate the latest trends with nutritional supplements, including natural herbals, for legality, safety, quality, and efficiency. Monitor the use of supplements by each athlete, and promote the NSF Certified for Sport program.

• Continue to evaluate the roles of the dietitians to ensure the highest level of impact on the athletes while creating a healthy, progressive professional culture for each.

• Manage the Nutrition budget throughout the fiscal year including the Major League season, each affiliate Minor League season, various camps throughout the year, Rehab, and any other Phillies Nutrition-related programs.

• Ensure the professional development and continued education of each dietitian in the organization.

• Continue to uphold and progress the Philadelphia Phillies culture and employee standards.

Food Service and Menu Development:

• Ensure high-quality meals are provided at each level of the Philadelphia Phillies organization.

• Oversee catering, meal plans, and nutritional guidance for the Major League team, all Minor League affiliates, various camps, and Rehab.

• Continue to evaluate new trends in nutrition, hydration products, and ingredients related to enhancing performance.

• Monitor each affiliate for athlete satisfaction, performance trends and staff integration.

• Monitor and oversee healthy relationships between the organization and its staff with outside vendors, caterers and any other food suppliers.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in clinical nutrition, food and nutrition, food science, sports nutrition or related expertise required.

• Master’s degree in nutrition, food science, or exercise physiology preferred.

• Current Registered Dietitian (RD) or Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) credential through the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR), with applicable state licensure or eligibility to obtain required licensure.

• Certification and Licensing as required by the state of Pennsylvania and Florida.

• Board Certified Specialist in Sports Dietetics preferred.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and counseling skills.

• 5+ years of experience as a Sports Nutritionist within a professional or collegiate program.

• At least 3 years managing dietitians in a team sports setting with proven experience creating an environment focused on staff development

• Knowledge of eating disorders, including early signs and symptoms.

• Knowledge and application of medical nutrition therapy, ergogenic aids, nutritional supplements, herbal supplements.

• Excellent time management, organizational, and record keeping skills.

• Knowledge of food service quality and safety practices.

• ServSafe certified preferred.

• Knowledge of resting metabolic rate and energy expenditure as it relates to baseball.

• Self-motivated, with the ability to work independently as well as within a group.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

This position will require regular travel to Minor League affiliates throughout the season but does not require full-time travel with the Major League club. The Director, Performance Nutrition will have flexibility to determine the frequency of Major League travel and will work collaboratively with the Director, Performance to establish a travel schedule that best supports the needs of the Nutrition Department and the organization.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, disability, gender identity, marital or veteran status, or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Clinical Recruiter (Contract-to-Hire)
jobs.description:
About Lifeforce
We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.
Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.
Overview
Lifeforce is hiring a Clinical Recruiter to run full-cycle hiring across three tracks: on-site Registered Nurses for Ultimate Longevity Centers (ULC), our in-person locations; remote longevity clinicians (NPs, PAs, MDs, and DOs) for our telehealth practice; and remote corporate roles across the company, in partnership with our HR Manager. You'll own a high-volume req load across markets nationwide and be the first hire on a recruiting team that is just getting built.
We're expanding fast. Our clinician network is growing across more states, and through ULC, our franchise network, we're opening physical locations that bring proactive, in-person care to communities across the country. Every one of those centers needs on-site nurses, and our telehealth practice needs remote NPs, PAs, MDs, and DOs licensed across many states. As the company grows, our corporate teams are growing too. This role hires for all three.
You'll report to the Head of Talent, who owns the clinical recruiting strategy. You'll own the desk: sourcing, screening, managing hiring stakeholders, and closing candidates. You'll also help shape the scorecards, interview structure, and funnel benchmarks that let us scale hiring without dropping quality.
About the Engagement
This is a full-time, temp-to-hire role. The temp period starts January 1, 2027, and runs through mid-May 2027. We can start a week or two earlier if that works better for you. The role may then convert to a permanent, full-time position. That decision depends on how the temp period goes and on the team's hiring needs at the time.

jobs.title: Automotive Mechanic Supervisor
jobs.description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:

The Automotive Mechanic Supervisor role is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets. This role is not visa eligible.

What you’ll be doing:

EarnIn's marketplace business unit is focused on helping members earn rewards, save on everyday spending, and build credit through products like Rent Reporting. It is one of our fastest-growing revenue lines, and its platform for partner integrations, rewards, and ranking is reused across the company. You'll lead a full-stack team including staff-level tech leads that pioneered AI-native, spec-driven development at EarnIn. You’ll bring a product-minded approach, using member and partner data to shape what the team builds, while helping partners launch faster and keeping high-traffic, critical-path services reliable. The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $266,793-$326,081, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer I

• Lead the end-to-end design of product enhancements within the repayments space for the platform across app and web that allows users to make purchases, split them into installments and manage their repayments.

Our purpose is unlocking financial potential, together. Our mission is to bring exceptional experiences, innovation, and partnership to every financial journey. We put the financial well-being of our customers and merchant partners at the heart of everything we do.

• Notices overlap or dependencies across initiatives and escalates alignment conversations

• Implements change, not just suggests it

• Redesign the design workflows using approved AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, ideation, and validation

• Create repeatable AI-assisted frameworks for rapid prototyping and experimentation

• Contribute to and apply best practices for AI-supported discovery, including insight generation and hypothesis development

• Improve how we measure design impact by leveraging AI for pattern detection and signal extraction

• Embed AI into cross-squad collaboration, enabling faster scoping and clearer trade-offs

• Explore multiple design directions quickly using AI-assisted tools, then articulate trade-offs clearly

• Address post-launch issues by leveraging AI to analyze feedback and surface improvement opportunities

• Help other designers and writers grow through skill shares and feedback on AI-assisted craft

What you’ll bring to the team

• A portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and measurable impact, not just polished screens

• 5+ years of experience designing at scale in product, UX, or interaction design

• Experience working on complex, multi-product ecosystems with cross-functional dependencies

• Demonstrated ability to frame work within long-term product strategy while independently owning execution

• Strong ability to interpret metrics and make data-informed decisions

• Experience leading lean experiments and validating hypotheses quickly

• Comfort exploring a breadth of options and articulating trade-offs clearly

• Experience documenting complex systems and onboarding others effectively

• Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with clear and concise written communication

• A clear, predictable design process that partners can rely on

• Ability to manage bandwidth and surface risks early

• An open mindset toward change, actively seeking opportunities to expand your skills

• Experience incorporating AI-powered tools thoughtfully into research, prototyping, documentation, or design operations

• A pragmatic understanding of how your work contributes to business outcomes and customer financial well-being

• Our values in your DNA: Customer First, Own It, Stronger Together, and Change the Game

What you’ll get in return

Zip is a place where you’ll get out what you put in. The newness of our sector means we need to move at pace and embrace change, and our promise to you when you join the team is that you’ll feel empowered and trusted to make big things happen quickly.

We want you to feel welcome and as though you have the support to be yourself, and care for yourself at work. Because it’s important to us that you make the most of the opportunities you’ll get to grow your skills and your career, and be surrounded by smart, friendly people and leaders that have your back.

• Flexible working culture

• Incentive programs

• Unlimited PTO

• Generous paid parental leave

• Leading family support policies

• Company-sponsored 401k match

• Learning and wellness subscription stipend

The annual base Pay Range for this position is $134,000 - $150,000. This range reflects our US national compensation band (USN). Additional premium percentages may apply based on our tiered premium strategy.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or commission awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

If hired, employees will be in an 'at-will position' and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Be a part of a team that reflects the diversity of our customers

We pride ourselves on being a workplace that provides equal opportunities to people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities, veteran status, and everything else that makes you unique.

Equally, we’re committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive. Please let us know If there are any adjustments that need to be made to ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

jobs.description:
New to North Carolina. Known for pursuing breakthroughs in medicine.

Ready to join our team?

At AbbVie, we bring together talented people and innovative science to develop medicines that help patients. Now, we’re bringing that commitment to Durham, North Carolina, with a new manufacturing campus that will expand our ability to produce medicines and create opportunities in the Research Triangle.

The campus will integrate advanced manufacturing, laboratory technologies and AI to support the production of immunology, oncology and neuroscience medicines. The first phase will include manufacturing facilities, next-generation laboratories, a warehouse, administrative offices and employee wellness facilities.

To learn more about this investment, please visit https://www.abbvie.com/abbvie-north-carolina-manufacturing.html

We are now recruiting our Senior Manager, Electrical as part of the core start up leadership team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The job leads technical workstreams and contributes to program outcomes by developing actionable methods and analyses, collaborating with cross‑functional partners to integrate technical solutions throughout the lifecycle, and advising on complex technical decisions and risks.

Designs site-level processes and improvements by defining operating ranges, critical parameters, and acceptance criteria that support efficient, high-quality production.

Leads process improvement and optimization workstreams, defining the technical approach, coordinating trial execution with production, and documenting results.

Conducts process validation and troubleshooting for manufacturing processes manufacturing processes by analyzing performance data, investigating deviations, and drafting corrective actions and supporting documentation for review and approval

Establishes technical standards for process documentation and change execution, ensuring methods, assumptions, and evidence are complete.

Guides engineers through technical decisions by running working sessions, documenting decision logic, and tracking actions to closure.

Delivers high‑quality technical outputs for complex projects and programs; defines and validates methods, documents results and key assumptions, ensures adherence to applicable standards and controls, and communicates technical progress, impacts and recommended mitigations to project leads and stakeholders.

1. Electrical Design Basis & Power Distribution Strategy

• Own the electrical Basis of Design and overall power distribution philosophy for the SVP program.
• Establish and maintain electrical load lists, connected/demand load assessments, single-line diagrams, voltage levels and distribution architecture.
• Coordinate the utility interface, site substation, medium-voltage distribution, building substations and low-voltage distribution.
• Ensure the design incorporates appropriate capacity and flexibility for future campus expansion.

The current concept identifies a new utility substation supplying 12.47 kV distribution to the CUB, with underground feeders serving unit substations in the major buildings.

2. Reliability, Redundancy & Critical Power

• Lead development of the program's normal, standby, emergency and UPS power philosophy.
• Define critical electrical loads with Process, Manufacturing, Automation, HVAC, Utilities, Quality and equipment SMEs.
• Establish appropriate redundancy and backup-power requirements based on operational and GMP impact.
• Ensure critical systems such as controls, isolators, monitoring and data systems receive appropriate backup power.

The current Durham scope identifies UPS, emergency generation, power redundancy and critical-load philosophy as areas still requiring definition. The current project scope also identifies normal, standby and emergency generation plus UPS for critical controls, isolators, monitoring and data systems.

3. Process Equipment, Utilities & Building Systems Integration

• Own electrical interfaces with filling equipment, formulation/compounding systems, HVAC, clean utilities, black utilities, warehouse systems, laboratories and automation.
• Coordinate equipment electrical requirements with vendors and engineering disciplines, including loads, voltage, feeders, disconnects, controls interfaces and backup-power classification.
• Ensure vendor electrical requirements are incorporated into the facility design and electrical load model.
• Drive resolution of electrical interfaces between the CUB, filling buildings, admin/lab, warehouse and campus infrastructure.

These interfaces are significant because the program includes three filling buildings plus warehouse, laboratory/administration, central utilities and supporting campus loads.

4. Electrical Safety, Standards & Design Governance

• Provide technical governance for electrical design and ensure applicable corporate engineering requirements, codes and project criteria are incorporated.
• Lead reviews of single-line diagrams, equipment specifications, electrical room layouts, grounding, lightning protection, arc-flash considerations and electrical safety requirements.
• Drive closure of electrical technical decisions, design risks, assumptions and deviations.
• Coordinate hazardous-area assessments with Process and EHS where applicable.

The current engineering proposal specifically calls for an Electrical Basis of Design, load assessments, single-line diagrams, emergency power, generator and UPS strategies, arc-flash study basis and lightning-protection strategy.

5. Procurement, Construction, Commissioning & Startup

• Provide electrical technical leadership from design through procurement, construction, testing, commissioning and startup.
• Establish specifications and technical requirements for major electrical equipment and support technical bid evaluations/vendor reviews.
• Identify long-lead electrical equipment early and ensure design information supports timely procurement.
• Support installation inspections, energization planning, testing, turnover, commissioning and resolution of field issues.
• Coordinate electrical system readiness with CQV, Automation, Facilities and Manufacturing to support overall SVP startup.

• You will have in-depth knowledge typically obtained through advanced education and experience; with a Bachelors degree in Engineering or similiar related discipline and 8 + years relevant industry experience.

jobs.title: Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
The Compliance Manager provides strong leadership and strategic direction to help ensure the organization operates in accordance with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies. The role translates compliance risks and business priorities into practical, risk-based actions, supports implementation of the company’s Compliance program, and leads assessments, internal investigations, and training. As a trusted advisor to management and a role model for ethical behavior, the Compliance Manager promotes integrity, accountability, and a culture in which employees feel empowered to raise concerns without fear of retaliation.

Main Responsibilities

• Lead, coordinate, and monitor day-to-day compliance activities, setting clear priorities, aligning stakeholders, and driving accountability for timely execution.
• Identify and assess current and emerging Compliance risks, anticipate their business implications, and develop risk-based strategies and controls that support sustainable business objectives without compromising ethical standards.
• Provide practical, audience-appropriate training and guidance on compliance requirements, ethical decision-making, and best practices, reinforcing leaders’ responsibility to model ethical behavior.
• Manage misconduct concerns raised through the Hotline and other reporting channels, ensuring timely, impartial handling and promoting trust, accessibility, and protection against retaliation throughout the organization.
• Ensure investigations are efficient, effective, thorough, and objective, applying consistent standards and maintaining independence of judgment, including under pressure.
• Prepare clear, decision-ready reports on compliance activities and communicate findings, risk implications, and actionable recommendations to relevant stakeholders, including senior management; constructively challenge decisions that may compromise compliance or integrity.
• Maintain strict confidentiality throughout the investigation process, exercise discretion in handling sensitive information, and consistently demonstrate integrity, fairness, and respect.
• Build cross-functional commitment to Compliance priorities, coach colleagues and project teams, and influence stakeholders across organizational levels to embed ethical conduct into everyday business decisions.

Experience and Education

• Bachelor's degree in law, business administration, or a similar discipline.
• Strong knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and trends.
• 7+ years of experience in compliance management and risk mitigation strategies, with demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives and translate strategic priorities into measurable actions.
• Proven capacity to manage multiple investigations, prioritize according to risk, coordinate resources, and maintain quality and timely delivery.
• Uncompromising ethical standards, integrity, and commitment to the company’s values, demonstrated through consistent behavior, impartial judgment, accountability, and the courage to raise concerns and challenge inappropriate practices.
• Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect emerging risks, business context, and long-term objectives and turn complex information into practical, risk-based decisions.
• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with a track record of building collaborative, productive relationships, setting clear expectations, coaching others, and influencing stakeholders with and without formal authority.
• Clear, persuasive communication and sound judgment, with the ability to advise senior management, navigate ambiguity, and balance competing priorities while maintaining independence and ethical standards.
• Ability to travel up to 30% domestically and internationally, including travel on short notice as needed to support investigations and business requirements

Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

• 3+ years of experience in conducting audits and risk assessments.
• Familiarity with compliance-related software and tools.
• Spanish-language proficiency to support effective communication and collaboration with Spanish-speaking stakeholders.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US



At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.






ABOUT THE TEAM

The LangSmith team owns and builds LangChain's core platform for observability, evaluation, and production reliability of AI systems. From tracing and annotation to run rules, evaluations, and beyond, this team owns LangSmith end-to-end. If you want to define what great AI observability looks like at production scale, this is where that work gets done.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

 

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join us. In this role you will be building the backend systems that power LangChain’s observability and evals platform. You will work on the core services that allow developers to monitor and evaluate their AI applications at scale. While the focus is on backend feature development, familiarity with fullstack or frontend engineering, performance tuning, and debugging production issues would be extremely valuable.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work closely with full-stack engineers, product managers, and product designers on rolling out new features.
   
    


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of professional experience in backend engineering working on highly complex products

 - Proficiency in one or more backend languages/frameworks, ideally Python or Go

 - Strong understanding of API design and building reliable data services.

 - Experience with high-throughput or mission-critical systems.

 - Demonstrated ability to optimize backend services for performance and reliability.

 - Experience with database systems (Postgres, Redis, Clickhouse), and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally

 - Customer centricity and ownership mentality
   
    

Compensation 

Annual salary range: $180,000- $240,000

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. 

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.




BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer, TVC
jobs.description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.

Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

Ursa Major’s solid rocket motor (SRM) team is hiring multiple Senior Design Engineers to support the design, development, and qualification of solid rocket motor thrust vector control (TVC) structures and mechanisms. This role has substantial technical responsibility and autonomy, with support from subject matter experts where needed.

You will be a key contributor for SRM TVC design at Ursa Major, developing TVC architectures, leading mechanism and actuation system design, owning key interfaces, and executing TVC test campaigns. You’ll help refine the design methods, standards, and processes that enable scalable, high‑rate production of reliable SRM TVC systems.

This isn’t purely a desk job. You’ll be expected to be on the build floor working with technicians, integrating hardware, and resolving build issues in real time. Our engineers work across a variety of programs and roles, so you’ll have the opportunity to contribute beyond your title and take on new challenges as they arise.

What You’ll Do

• Own the design of SRM TVC systems and related components (e.g., flexible joints, gimbal/actuator mechanisms, jet tabs/vanes, liquid/hot‑gas injection hardware, mounts, and structural interfaces).

• Translate customer requirements and mission needs into robust, manufacturable TVC designs that meet performance, reliability, cost, and schedule targets.

• Execute design trades across TVC architectures, actuator types, materials, and manufacturing processes.

• Help define and allocate TVC design and performance requirements and ensure designs meet flight‑control and structural needs.

• Plan and support test campaigns from component-level through full‑scale joint actuation tests and integrated static‑fire TVC demonstrations to de‑risk new concepts and qualify systems.

• Review test data and post‑test hardware to verify performance against predictions, identify anomalies, and drive design or process changes.

• Provide hands‑on support for prototype assembly and test, including troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and integration issues on the build floor.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration with analysis, manufacturing, test, systems, and supply chain teams to ensure nozzle designs meet all stakeholder needs.

• Maintain aggressive but realistic project schedules, identifying key risks early and working with technical leads to implement mitigation plans.

• Generate and review CAD models and engineering drawings in accordance with internal standards and ASME Y14.5‑2009/2018.

• Maintain clear, organized technical documentation, including requirements, design reviews, test plans and reports, and verification/validation evidence.

• Provide day‑to‑day technical guidance to junior engineers, contributing to the team’s growth in nozzle design, materials, and manufacturing.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience with thrust vector control systems, precision electromechanical mechanisms, rocket propulsion hardware, or closely related flight‑control actuation systems.

• Experience with SRM TVC design, analysis, and integration into solid rocket motor architectures.

• Ability to execute TVC mechanism and actuation system designs, including first‑order sizing and kinematics/dynamics analyses (actuation torque, stiffness, backlash, friction, inertia, and response).

• Proficiency with CAD and engineering analysis tools (e.g., structural/FEA, kinematics/dynamics, basic thermal analysis; exposure to control/servo analysis and aero/jet flow analysis is a plus).

• Strong engineering fundamentals, including in‑depth knowledge of structural mechanics, dynamics, and actuators.

• Familiarity with thermodynamics and fluid dynamics as they relate to SRM performance, nozzle flow, and side‑force generation.

• Clear, effective written and verbal communication skills for cross‑functional collaboration, design reviews, customer discussions, and documentation.

• Eligibility for a U.S. DoD Secret Clearance is required and maintaining that eligibility is a condition of employment.

Desired Experience

• Master’s degree or PhD in mechanical, aerospace, electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Experience architecting and designing TVC actuation and mechanism systems, including motor/gearbox selection, load path definition, stiffness/backlash management, and fault‑tolerant configurations.

• Experience applying formal design criteria and recommended practices for SRM TVC from sources like NASA SP‑8114 or similar.

• Understanding of design for additive manufacturing, including material behavior and design constraints for metal additive processes used in TVC components (e.g., actuator housings, brackets, manifolds).

• Hands‑on involvement in rapid product development environments (prototype‑heavy, fast‑iteration programs).

• Experience designing hardware for high‑rate, automated production, including DFM/DFA and process automation.

• Experience with Siemens NX (CAD) and Ansys (FEA/structural, motion, or thermal) software packages.

• DoD Secret security clearance or higher.

Colorado law requires us to tell you the base compensation range of this role, which is $105,840 - $132,300, determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

Classification: Full-time Exempt

Benefits Include: (Please note, Interns are not eligible for benefits)

• Unlimited PTO - Vacation, Sick, Personal, and Bereavement

• Paid Parental and Adoptive Leave

• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance

• Tax Advantage Accounts (HSA/FSA)

• Employer Paid Short and Long Term Disability, Basic Life, AD&D

• Additional Benefit Options Including Voluntary Life and Emergency Medical Transport

• EAP Program

• Retirement Savings Plan - 401k with Company Match

How To Apply:
Interested candidates are encouraged to apply by filling out the application below and clicking "Submit Application". This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will remain open until filled or adjusted based on the volume of applicants.

NOTE: Research suggests that women and BIPOC individuals may self-select out of opportunities if they don't meet 100% of the job requirements. We encourage anyone who believes they have the skills and the drive necessary to succeed here to apply for this role.

Must be a U.S. Person (this includes U.S. Citizens and Permanent Residents).

Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Security Clearance.

Identify key brand pillars across our products and mission and develop innovative strategies to build on and reinforce them.

jobs.title: Finance AI & Transformation Analyst
jobs.description:
• Lead Finance transformation initiatives at Zip, embedding AI and automation into core finance workflows and delivering measurable business impact.

• Bring 5-8 years driving process improvement or transformation initiatives, with hands-on AI fluency and the ability to turn business problems into scalable solutions.

• Hybrid opportunity for US-based employees with an expectation of 3 days per week in our Union Square Manhattan office.

Start your adventure with Zip

We're looking for a Finance AI & Transformation Analyst to help build the next generation of how Finance operates at Zip.

Sitting within Finance Change & Transformation, you'll bring strong transformation instincts and hands-on experience with both AI-enabled and process-driven solutions, and apply them to modernize Finance processes and workflows. You'll identify high-friction processes, diagnose root causes, and design scalable solutions that improve efficiency and deliver measurable business impact.

You'll identify where AI can create meaningful value, build foundational workflows yourself, and translate complex opportunities into clear business and technical requirements.

This is a hands-on role for a systems thinker with a builder mindset. You'll structure the plan, align on the outcome, then coordinate stakeholders and resolve issues to get there.

Interesting problems you'll get to solve

Evolve and Scale an AI-Enabled Finance

• Identify workflows where AI, automation, or agentic solutions can create meaningful business value.

• Prototype, test, and build agentic workflows and automations, using LLM-based tools and no-code/low-code platforms, that solve real Finance problems.

• Translate Finance use cases into clear requirements across workflows, data, controls, exceptions, human oversight, and success metrics.

• Partner within internal Finance pillars (Accounting, Treasury, FP&A, Tax) as well as cross functional teams (Data, Engineering, and Agentic Platform teams) to design, test, deploy, govern, and continuously improve solutions.

Finance Transformation Program Delivery

• Lead transformation workstreams with stakeholder alignment at key decision points, from diagnosing problems and gathering requirements through solution design, implementation, testing, change management, and impact measurement

• Diagnose process, system, and control gaps and recommend scalable, standardized future-state solutions that reduce complexity.

• Own project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, stakeholder communications, and day-to-day delivery.

• Measure success through efficiency, accuracy, control effectiveness, adoption, and improved decision quality.

Drive Cross-Functional Change

• Build alignment across Finance, Data, Technology, Compliance, and other teams, surfacing risks and keeping work moving.

• Develop recommendations and drive adoption through strong business cases, executive communication, documentation, training, and stakeholder feedback.

• Develop executive-ready updates and presentations for senior stakeholders, including CFO and CEO.

What you'll bring to the team

Required

• 5-8 years of professional experience driving transformation or technology-enabled process improvement, with hands-on experience building or shipping AI-enabled tools, workflows, or automations.

• Demonstrated ownership of cross-functional transformation initiatives from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

• Proven project management skills across requirements, gap analysis, roadmaps, timelines, stakeholder management, risk, and change adoption.

• Hands-on experience using generative AI, automation, or agentic tools to design, prototype, and ship real workflows or products, not just experimenting with them.

• Strong product and systems mindset, with the ability to identify where AI and automation create value and translate business problems into clear requirements for technical teams.

• Working understanding of AI capabilities, limitations, and responsible use, including data quality, validation, privacy, controls, and human oversight.

• Strong communication and influence, with the ability to engage senior leaders and drive cross-functional progress without direct authority.

• Strong critical thinking, organization, attention to detail, and judgment in ambiguous environments.

Preferred

• Strong grounding in core financial concepts and processes, with a background in accounting, treasury, FP&A, or similar.

• Hands-on experience in finance transformation initiatives, with an understanding of end-to-end finance data flows.

• Experience working within a complex, high-growth, fintech, financial services, or regulated environment.

• Proven experience in finance process optimization or system implementation.

• Familiarity with NetSuite or similar ERP systems, along with other core Finance systems.

How you'll operate

• Accountable: You own the problem through the outcome, including delivery, adoption, controls, and results.

• Curious: You experiment responsibly with emerging technology and continuously look for better ways to work.

• Collaborative: You build credibility across Finance and technical teams and influence without formal authority.

• Action oriented: You create structure from ambiguity, make informed decisions, and move work forward.

What you’ll get in return

Zip is a place where you’ll get out what you put in. The newness of our sector means we need to move at pace and embrace change, and our promise to you when you join the team is that you’ll feel empowered and trusted to make big things happen quickly.

We want you to feel welcome and as though you have the support to be yourself, and care for yourself at work. Because it’s important to us that you make the most of the opportunities you’ll get to grow your skills and your career, and be surrounded by smart, friendly people and leaders that have your back.

We think these are just some of the best things about being a Zipster. We will also offer you:

• Flexible working culture

• Incentive programs

• Unlimited PTO

• Generous paid parental leave

• Leading family support policies

• Company-sponsored 401k match

• Learning and wellness subscription stipend

• Beautiful Union Square office with a casual dress code

• Industry-leading, employer-sponsored insurance for you and your dependents, with several 100% Zip-covered choices available

Zip is committed to a straightforward and transparent pay structure. The actual base salary will be determined by various individualized factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, location, internal equity, as well as other objective business considerations.

The annual base Pay Range for this position is $128,000 - $140,000 USD. This range reflects our *Premium Location band (US2). Different bands may apply based on our tiered premium strategy if residence is outside of the Greater Manhattan area.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

If hired, employees will be in an 'at-will position' and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

Be a part of a team that reflects the diversity of our customers

We pride ourselves on being a workplace that provides equal opportunities to people of all ages, cultural backgrounds, sexual orientations, gender identities, abilities, veteran status, and everything else that makes you unique.

Equally, we’re committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are accessible and inclusive. Please let us know If there are any adjustments that need to be made to ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

And finally…get to know us

Zip Co Limited (ASX: ZIP) is a digital financial services company, offering innovative, people-centered products.

Operating in two core markets - Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) and the US, Zip offers access to point-of-sale credit and digital payment services, connecting millions of customers with its global network of tens of thousands of merchants.

jobs.title: Senior Executive Protection Driver
jobs.description:
Are you interested in joining an organization with a global reach? In a world of shifting threats, Concentric is your trusted ally. Powered by elite professionals from military, government, and intelligence backgrounds. If you are passionate about intelligence, risk analysis, threat management, executive protection, security operations, or business resiliency, Concentric may be the organization you’ve been searching for!

Concentric is a risk consultancy specializing in delivering strategic security and intelligence services. We provide holistic, intelligent security solutions for private clients and corporations globally. Concentric offers strategic advisory services, risk assessments, physical protection, threat intelligence, open-source monitoring, program audits, secure embedded staffing, and training for security teams and intelligence analysts.

Our ultimate goal is to be recognized as the most innovative, capable, and trusted Risk Management partner in the world, and we do this by following these core values:

Integrity – Collaboration - Relationships – Excellence – Creativity - Results

Join Us,

Concentric - "Your World Secured"

We are currently looking to hire a Senior Armed EP Driver to join our team embedded with our client in Washington, D.C.!

This is a full-time position alternating between travel deployments and local assignments. Local assignments follow a standard 40-hour week, which may include training, unless assigned to a Principal, while deployment hours vary based on operational needs. Shifts may include early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays. The Senior Armed EP Driver may be asked to deploy on short notice based on the Principal's schedule or operational needs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Senior Armed EP Driver provides safe, discreet, and highly coordinated vehicle transport for the client and their guests within the Washington, D.C. Area, the surrounding East Coast states, and other major U.S. cities, while functioning as an integrated member of the client's personal security detail. This is an armed role that combines the full scope of the Security Driver function with executive protection responsibilities, advance-work ownership, and team leadership. The Senior Armed EP Driver is expected to operate with a high degree of independent judgment, lead route and movement planning for complex or high-threat scenarios, mentor and evaluate Security Drivers, and serve as a primary logistics point of contact between the client's personal security detail and the broader account team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Provide “white-glove” driving service as the personal driver for the client and guests, including companion animals

• Serve as an armed extension of the client's personal security detail, maintaining situational awareness and readiness to respond to threats or potential threats during transit and at the point of pickup/drop-off

• Carry a concealed firearm as legally authorized in Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia in direct support of the client's protective coverage

• Independently develop and lead advance work, route planning, and contingency/alternate-route development for standard, complex, and high-threat movements, coordinating with the client's personal security detail as needed

• Take the lead or follow role in multi-vehicle movements and motorcade-style operations when required, depending on the support type (Main Principal or Supplemental Team support)

• Identify threats and intervene proactively along the route, coordinating and working directly with the client's personal security detail to avoid or eliminate threats in transport and en route

• Coordinate logistics and plan all details relating to the client's or guest's physical location, including movements in, out, and around the site while preparing for emergencies and other contingencies

• Mentor, train, and evaluate Security Drivers on route planning, defensive driving, security protocols, and client-service standards; serve as a first-line escalation point for driver-related issues before elevating to the Account Manager

• Operate vehicle in a safe and comfortable manner and conduct vehicle checks for cleanliness, functionality, and fuel level

• Identify, track, log, and coordinate vehicle fleet maintenance requirements

• Render aid in the event of illness, accident, or other safety hazards

• Work with home office staff and security teams to ensure a coordinated pick-up/drop-off routine

• Develop and implement internal processes and procedures, including standard operating procedures for the driving team

• Maintain excellent rapport and open lines of communication regarding client needs, requests for support, service issues, and deliverables, while maintaining the highest level of discretion and confidentiality regarding the principal's privacy, schedule, movements, and personal information.

• Proactively communicate with the client and/or client's personal security detail regarding identified delays or other route issues

• Understand, conform with, and abide by all Local, State, and Federal laws/regulations, policies, work procedures, and instructions

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of equivalent or relevant industry experience, including prior experience in an armed driving, executive protection, or personal security role

• Currently possess and/or ability to obtain First Aid/CPR/AED certification; TCCC/TECC or similar advanced medical training a plus.

• Currently possess and/or ability to obtain and maintain: a Washington, D.C. Armed Special Police Officer (SPO) certification; a Maryland Handgun Wear & Carry Permit (CCW) and Maryland Armed Guard Card; and a Virginia Armed Guard Card.

• Demonstrated experience driving high-profile executives or high-net-worth passengers in an armed capacity

• Valid Driver's License with a flawless driving record

• Prior experience mentoring, training, or providing lead direction to other drivers or protective personnel

• Thorough understanding of local and federal laws and regulations related to personal driver and armed protective services

• Well-versed in driving in and around the Greater Washington D.C. Area

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

• Operational experience with residential security teams, executive protection details, and/or high-profile corporate security teams

• Emotional intelligence and a customer-focused approach

• A successful track record operating within a high-touch, customer service environment

• Ability to adapt well to fast-paced environments with changing circumstances, direction, and strategy

• Ability to remain calm under stressful and/or high-threat driving conditions

• High ethical standards with proven ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information, excellent judgment, discretion, and diplomacy

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort working with senior leadership

• Demonstrated computer skills, including Google Suite and MS Office applications

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior law enforcement, military, or federal protective service background

• Formal Executive Protection certification and/or advanced tactical training

• Proven experience operating an armored vehicle (hard car) in urban, highway, and motorcade environments, including knowledge of its handling characteristics and emergency procedures such as evacuation and evasive maneuvers.

• Defensive Driving and/or EVOC certification

• Experience planning or leading motorcade/multi-vehicle movements

• Experience providing executive driving service for individuals with mobility issues

• Working knowledge and comfort with the use of communication apps (i.e., Signal, WhatsApp)

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

• Medical plan options: Concentric offers two medical plans: a high deductible health plan (HDHP) and a copay plan.

• Health Savings Account (HSA): Employees enrolled in the HDHP receive an employer contribution to their HSA, which can be used for eligible medical expenses and carries over year to year.

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA): Employees can set aside pre-tax dollars in a medical FSA to cover eligible healthcare expenses.

• 11 paid holidays

• Annual Health & Wellness Benefit

• Paid leave (vacation, sick, parental)

• Employer-paid insurance: life, STD, LTD, and AD&D

• 401 (k) including employer match

• Pet Insurance

• National discount employee program

• Employee Assistance Program for personal needs

• Credentity Protection - Eclipse Digital Protection by Concentric

• Free access to our Risk Intelligence Dashboard and GEAR App. Providing 24/7 access to trusted risk intelligence and remote support, helping you stay informed, prepared, and protected wherever you operate.

• Dedicated Security and Intelligence Training Programs for Professional Development

• Coaching and Mentoring Opportunities

Washington, DC Pay Range

$75—$75 USD

Concentric and SPS Global acknowledge the systemic barriers in the security industry and recognize that removing those barriers will require a collaborative and conscious effort. Concentric and SPS Global are committed to programs and initiatives that promote diversity, equity, and inclusion, enhancing our organization and the broader community. We are creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Concentric Advisors and SPS Global are committed to protecting the privacy and security of all applicants who submit personal information to us. You can access our GDPR and CCPA policy by clicking the GDPR button at the bottom of our career page.
