jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

Location: New York, NY (Hybrid or Remote)

Reports To: Sales Director by Vertical

About the Team:

The extraordinary AlphaSense Sales team is split into two parts: Financial Services and Corporates. The Financial Services Sales Team focuses on sales to hedge funds, asset management, investment banking, and private equity. The Corporate Sales team is verticalized with a focus on the Fortune 1000 in the following sectors: Life Sciences, Technology, Media, and Telecom, Energy and Industrials, Consulting, and Consumer Packaged Goods. Both the Financial Services and Corporate sales teams have Enterprise and Mid-Market sales professionals, and there is an additional corporate team of sales professionals focused exclusively on Investor Relations.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial, driven and accomplished new business sales professional to join our growing Corporate Sales team. With a track record of sales success, you’ll  focus on selling to top Fortune 1000 companies, specifically the largest and most matrixed organizations. This role offers a high level of ownership within your book of business, driving  the overall account strategy in partnership with SDR’s and sales leadership. This is an opportunity to join a high growth company and sell an award winning product that is experiencing rapid adoption across all industry verticals. The person in this role will make a major contribution in the company’s growth and future success.

Who You Are:

• An experienced seller! You have previous experience owning a book of new business, ideally selling into enterprise clients. You have a strong track record of success in a SaaS sales environment and can clearly communicate a drive to understand our customers and sales cycle.

• You understand Sales is both art and science, and clearly can articulate your version of the “science of sales”.

• Hard-working and possess a ‘never give up’ attitude: We have a highly motivated team and a winning culture. We look for people who possess a natural tenacity and desire to succeed.

• A Strong Communicator: You have the skills necessary to explain complex financial data and concepts to a non-financial audience. You’re a storyteller with the ability to communicate present and future value to folks at all levels within an organization.

• A Hunter: You are constantly working to drive pipeline through your own efforts, in addition to the support of our SDR and Marketing teams.

• Intellectually Curious: You know the right questions to ask and how to uncover business challenges at all levels of an organization.

• Coachable: You will have the opportunity to advance your career through robust training and development programs at AlphaSense. An openness to feedback and desire for constant improvement is key to success here.

• Tenacious: You thrive in environments where you can be creative to get things done!

What You’ll Do:

• Take responsibility for the end-end sales processes in your territory, targeting folks in Corporate Strategy, Competitive Intelligence, Business Development, Investor Relations, and M&A.

• Research opportunities, prospect, initiate discussions, build relationships, conduct demos, manage product trials, and most importantly: close deals! This is an end-to-end new business sales role and no task is too small or too large.

• Partner with our SDR team to create prospecting plans and drive pipeline.

• Forecast accurately and develop the necessary pipeline to meet/exceed quota.

• Work closely with our Product Specialist team during trials to ensure client engagement and ultimate purchase.

• Work closely with Account Management to ensure customer health throughout the contract term, as well as closing down sourced upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

• Gather and distribute product feedback from clients and prospects to the sales and product teams to help us continually enhance our product offerings.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

We offer a competitive benefits program, a generous commission plan with uncapped earning potential as well as equity.

Base Compensation Range

$105,000—$140,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

jobs.title: Manufacturing & Sourcing Program Manager
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

Infinite Machine is hiring a Manufacturing & Sourcing Program Manager to oversee production execution, sourcing, and quality at our contract manufacturer and suppliers in China. You’ll be responsible for keeping builds on schedule, resolving manufacturing and supplier issues, and ensuring our vehicles meet quality standards as we scale production.

This is a hands-on role based primarily at our contract manufacturer in Lufeng, with regular travel to suppliers across China. You’ll work closely with our production, engineering, and vehicle operations teams in New York.

We’re looking for someone who has managed builds from the factory floor, knows what great manufacturing looks like, and takes ownership of problems through resolution. You proactively identify risks, hold manufacturing partners accountable, and help factory teams continuously improve.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own China-side execution against production plans, coordinating our contract manufacturer and suppliers from purchase order through shipment.

 - Track production schedules, identify bottlenecks and delivery risks, and drive improvements in throughput, line balancing, and material flow.

 - Drive production readiness, including SOPs, line setup, tooling, fixtures, material availability, and operator training.

 - Source, qualify, and manage suppliers, ensuring delivery, quality, and cost targets are met.

 - Lead supplier commercial discussions, including quotes, pricing, lead times, and contract terms, in coordination with the New York team.

 - Oversee manufacturing and supplier quality, including process audits, IQC, IPQC, OQC, and adherence to approved specifications.

 - Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions using factory and field data, tracking issues through verified resolution.

 - Coordinate engineering changes, ensuring updated parts, documentation, processes, and validation are implemented correctly.

 - Report production, supplier, quality, and schedule risks to the New York team, escalating issues early.

 - Establish scalable manufacturing and quality processes and support new product introductions.




QUALIFICATIONS — REQUIRED

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing, sourcing, supplier quality, or program management at hardware factories in China.

 - Experience managing mass production at contract manufacturers, including production schedules and coordination across multiple suppliers.

 - Experience sourcing, qualifying, and managing suppliers, including delivery schedules, pricing, and quality requirements.

 - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, SOPs, quality inspection, factory audits, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.

 - Fluent in Mandarin, with strong written and spoken English.

 - Confident working with factory operators, engineers, suppliers, and management, including holding partners accountable.

 - Self-directed, proactive, and comfortable independently representing Infinite Machine at the factory.

 - Practical, hands-on approach to manufacturing and quality improvement.

 - Ability to work primarily on-site at our contract manufacturer in Lufeng, with travel to suppliers across China and morning/evening calls with New York.




QUALIFICATIONS — PREFERRED

 - Experience with e-bikes, motorcycles, electric vehicles, batteries, or other electromechanical products.

 - Experience at a small or overseas-headquartered company working with a large contract manufacturer.

 - Experience with cosmetic finishing on anodized aluminum and plastic components.

 - Working knowledge of PFMEA, DOE, MSA, and 8D.

 - Experience training operators and developing factory teams.




ABOUT INFINITE MACHINE

Our mission at Infinite Machine https://www.infinitemachine.com/?lp_location=wf is to build the best non-cars on earth. We design and manufacture premium electric vehicles that blend design with breakthrough hardware and software.

With P1 https://www.infinitemachine.com/p1?lp_location=wf and Olto https://www.infinitemachine.com/olto?lp_location=wf, we are reimagining how people move through cities and laying the foundation for a broader ecosystem of vehicles, software, and services. We are hiring world-class engineers, designers, and operators to build a generational company shaping the future of urban mobility.

jobs.description:
WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

WHY BOX NEEDS YOU

Box Consulting is a fast growing team helping customers rapidly deploy, maximize value, and deeply integrate Box into their enterprises. Your proven ability to work creatively and analytically on complex, multi phase engagements with the most strategic of customers will help you build, manage, and scale your team in highly engaged environment.  Excellent communication, leadership, and management skills enable you to grow the team's professional development while staying highly engaged with customers - an opportunity for your team to learn the depth of your delivery expertise on the job.

Box is growing fast. Real fast. Every business in the world is looking to modernize the way they work. As the leader in intelligent content management, Box is the only company that can help enterprises transform how people work together.  Your years of experience with project management and business process design, combined with expert knowledge of internal processes and related systems, empower you to be an influential leader within Box Consulting and more broadly across all of Box.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Manager, you will be scaling a world-class team, working closely with our customers as a thought leader, shape & evolve consulting delivery offerings, and drive new business with your sales partners.  You will bring the energy and expertise to inspire our customers and influence Box Consulting's strategic direction, building a strong feedback loop between customer work and how we evolve our delivery methods.  You will lead teams of varying levels of experience, thrive in dynamic & cross-functional environments, and enjoy achieving results thru engaging directly with our customers. Ultimately, you’re comfortable in a player-coach role, helping up-level your team to improve how we work through stronger discovery, faster iteration, and sharing approaches that work across the Box Consulting organization.

WHO YOU ARE

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

• 6+ years service delivery experience in technology

• Regularly interacts with and influences senior management, other functional areas such as Customer Success, Support, Sales and/or external parties

• Focuses on maximizing customer delight and outcomes in all conversations across Box; consistent advocacy of customer experience cross functionally with all levels of leadership

PREFERRED SKILLS

• 2+ years of consulting sales experience

• Experienced working with SI and Reseller partners to co-sell services

New to North Carolina. Known for pursuing breakthroughs in medicine.

Ready to join our team?

At AbbVie, we bring together talented people and innovative science to develop medicines that help patients. Now, we’re bringing that commitment to Durham, North Carolina, with a new manufacturing campus that will expand our ability to produce medicines and create opportunities in the Research Triangle.

The campus will integrate advanced manufacturing, laboratory technologies and AI to support the production of immunology, oncology and neuroscience medicines. The first phase will include manufacturing facilities, next-generation laboratories, a warehouse, administrative offices and employee wellness facilities.

To learn more about this investment, please visit https://www.abbvie.com/abbvie-north-carolina-manufacturing.html

We are now recruiting our Sr. Manager, Packaging, Aseptic as part of the core start up leadership team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The job leads technical workstreams and contributes to program outcomes by developing actionable methods and analyses, collaborating with cross‑functional partners to integrate technical solutions throughout the lifecycle, and advising on complex technical decisions and risks.

Designs site-level processes and improvements by defining operating ranges, critical parameters, and acceptance criteria that support efficient, high-quality production.

Leads process improvement and optimization workstreams, defining the technical approach, coordinating trial execution with production, and documenting results.

Conducts process validation and troubleshooting for manufacturing processes manufacturing processes by analyzing performance data, investigating deviations, and drafting corrective actions and supporting documentation for review and approval

Establishes technical standards for process documentation and change execution, ensuring methods, assumptions, and evidence are complete.

Guides engineers through technical decisions by running working sessions, documenting decision logic, and tracking actions to closure.

Delivers high‑quality technical outputs for complex projects and programs; defines and validates methods, documents results and key assumptions, ensures adherence to applicable standards and controls, and communicates technical progress, impacts and recommended mitigations to project leads and stakeholders.

1. Filling Line & Aseptic Equipment Technical Leadership

Serve as the technical lead and SME for the SVP filling line, providing engineering leadership for the filling process and associated equipment. Establish technical requirements, design criteria, operating ranges, critical parameters, and acceptance criteria to support safe, reliable, and high-quality aseptic manufacturing. This aligns directly with the generic profile's accountability for defining operating ranges, critical parameters, and acceptance criteria.

2. Equipment Design, Vendor & System Integration

Lead technical evaluation and integration of the filling-line equipment package with upstream/downstream processes, facility systems, utilities, automation, and supporting equipment. Drive technical decisions with the A/E, equipment suppliers, automation teams, operations, quality, and other engineering disciplines, ensuring interfaces and assumptions are identified and resolved.

3. Aseptic Design, GMP & Contamination-Control Readiness

Provide filling-line expertise to ensure the design supports aseptic processing, GMP operation, cleaning/decontamination, material and personnel interfaces, maintainability, and contamination-control objectives. Lead technical reviews and challenge design decisions that could affect product quality, equipment performance, or reliable operation.

4. Testing, Qualification, Startup & Process Validation

Provide technical leadership through equipment testing and the transition from design into execution and startup. Support resolution of equipment and process issues and ensure technical acceptance criteria, system performance expectations, and supporting documentation are clearly established. The generic role explicitly includes process validation, troubleshooting, performance-data analysis, investigation of deviations, and documentation of corrective actions.

5. Technical Governance, Risk Management & Decision Making

Own key filling-line technical decisions and maintain disciplined documentation of requirements, assumptions, risks, decisions, and actions through closure. Facilitate technical working sessions, evaluate complex issues, recommend mitigation strategies, and communicate impacts to project leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. This closely reflects the T7 expectations to guide engineers through technical decisions, document decision logic, track actions, and advise on complex technical risks.

• You will have in-depth knowledge typically obtained through advanced education and experience; with a Bachelors degree in Engineering or similiar related discipline and 8 + years relevant industry experience.
• Experience in drug substance, drug product, biologics and/or aseptic sterile fill finish is required
• You will have demonstrated your ability to partner cross functionally with successful teams in a GMP manufacturing environment and prior experience in a start up facility is preferred

jobs.description:
About Magic Hat Consulting

Magic Hat Consulting (MHC) is a boutique Life Sciences consulting firm that helps companies maximize product launch success, helps successfully navigate and implement transformational initiatives, and helps companies increase execution capabilities by delivering Life Sciences Subject Matter Expertise as needed to cost effectively bridge resource gaps.

About You

You have built a successful career in life sciences consulting and are ready to make an even greater impact. You know what it takes to earn client trust, deliver meaningful results, develop talented teams, and turn new opportunities into business growth. You also recognize that the best consulting firms are built by people who take ownership, challenge the status quo, and are willing to put ideas into action.

At Magic Hat Consulting, you will have the opportunity to help shape the direction of a growing firm, influence how we serve our clients, and play a meaningful role in building our future. We are looking for leaders who enjoy working at both the strategic and tactical levels, bringing energy and initiative to new challenges, and taking pride in seeing ideas through to execution.

If you are excited by the opportunity to build something, make a lasting impact, and help grow a firm alongside a talented team, we would love to hear from you.

Launch Excellence (LEx) Practice Leadership Opportunity

Magic Hat Consulting is looking for a LEx Director or Principal to help shape the future of our Launch Excellence Practice and play a key role in the continued growth of our firm. This is an opportunity to put your consulting experience and commercial acumen to work in a growing business, building trusted client partnerships, leading high-impact launch engagements, and turning new opportunities into lasting relationships.

Beyond leading client engagements, you will help define the direction of the practice, develop service offerings, expand our market presence, and build teams that deliver exceptional results. Working closely with firm leadership, you will have a meaningful voice in how MHC grows and competes, with the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and see the impact of your contributions firsthand.  This opportunity is ideal for a driven professional who is entrepreneurial minded; this role provides a pathway to equity.

What You'll Do

• Shape practice strategy, develop service offerings and go-to-market approaches to position MHC as a leading LEx consulting partner.

• Serve as a strategic advisor to clients, effectively develop engagement approaches that align client objectives with business priorities across the product life cycle.

• Be viewed by our clients as a SME who provides valued, thought-partner perspectives.

• Lead complex engagements spanning areas including commercialization strategy, launch planning, operating model design and transformation initiatives, at the individual and team level.

• Serve as a management-level contact to lead discussions, oversee all presentations, ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction.

• Drive business development, expand existing client relationships, acquire new clients, lead proposals and sales pursuits, and contribute to overall revenue growth.

• Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams, create a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration.

• Meet performance goals, individually, and practice.

• Ensure consistency in quality of client presentations and deliverables, including proposals, strategic recommendations and stakeholder communications.

• Accountable for developing and maintaining practice standards including frameworks, tools, IP, engagement kick-off/completion procedures, etc.

• Build MHC’s market presence through thought leadership, industry insights, participation in relevant forums and development of industry partnerships.

• Support recruiting efforts by engaging with and attracting top talent to the firm.

• Embrace an “owner mindset”, proactively seek opportunities to improve all aspects of running our business and demonstrate a genuine commitment to the firm’s overall success.

• Embrace and bring to life our cultural values “ACES” (Accountable, Collaborative, Entrepreneurial and keeping it Simple).

Qualifications

• 12+ years of professional experience, including a demonstrated track record in life sciences consulting.

• Proven success leading complex consulting engagements in product launch strategy, planning, readiness, or commercialization.

• Demonstrated ability to generate business, grow existing client relationships, and establish new clients.

• Experience developing consulting teams, service offerings, and go-to-market strategies.

• Strong commercial acumen, excellent communication, and presentation skills.

• Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and advise senior client stakeholders

• Demonstrated ability to lead teams, develop talent and drive high performance.

• Entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, take ownership, and balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution.

• Proficiency in PowerPoint and experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.

• Be a leader that people want to work with, for and follow.

Benefits

Magic Hat Consulting believes that happy employees make for productive team members. That's why we're proud to offer flexible working arrangements to support our team members' well-being and work-life balance.

• Competitive salary: Based on experience. Director: $220K - $250K Principal: $250K+

• Performance Bonuses: Utilization and business development bonuses.

• 401(k) Retirement Plan: Up to 4% employer match.

• Professional Development: $2,500 annual allowance.

• Health Benefits: 100% paid employee medical, dental, and vision insurance.

• Unlimited time off.

If you're ready to help grow a life sciences consulting practice and make a meaningful impact on a growing firm, we'd love to connect!

jobs.title: Staff Yield Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Staff Foundry Yield Engineer to join our Foundry Yield Engineering team. The position is responsible for driving yield improvement, supporting new product introduction and manufacturing transfers, performing yield and defect data analysis, and providing technical support for foundry manufacturing issues.

The engineer will work closely with external foundry partners and cross-functional internal teams to ensure robust manufacturing performance, successful product ramp, effective excursion resolution, and continuous improvement in yield, quality, cost, and engineering efficiency.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related technical field.

• Solid understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes, device fundamentals, and manufacturing/yield engineering.

• Relevant experience in semiconductor yield engineering, process engineering, process integration, product engineering, or foundry engineering.

• Strong experience with manufacturing and yield data analysis, including inline, electrical test, wafer sort, defect, and wafer-level data.

• Strong statistical problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.

• Experience with statistical/data-analysis tools such as JMP, Spotfire, Exensio/PDF, or equivalent.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional engineering teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with semiconductor foundries or outsourced wafer manufacturing.

• Experience with NPI, manufacturing transfer, qualification, safe launch, and production ramp.

• Knowledge of SPC, Cp/Cpk, D0/defect-density analysis, wafer-map analysis, correlation analysis, and statistical data mining.

• Experience resolving complex manufacturing yield excursions and driving corrective actions.

• Experience developing automated data-analysis or reporting workflows.

• Exposure to AI/ML-assisted semiconductor data analytics is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Foundry Yield Improvement

• Monitor and analyze manufacturing yield, defect, inline, electrical test, wafer sort, and related production data.

• Identify yield-loss mechanisms and improvement opportunities through statistical analysis, wafer-level analysis, correlation, and data mining.

• Partner with foundries and internal engineering teams to develop and implement yield-improvement actions.

• Benchmark foundry performance and identify opportunities to improve yield entitlement and manufacturing cost.

NPI, Manufacturing Transfer & Safe Launch

• Support new product introduction, manufacturing transfer, qualification, safe launch, and production ramp activities.

• Develop data-analysis and monitoring plans to assess manufacturing readiness and identify potential risks.

• Track yield and manufacturing performance during product introduction and ramp and drive issues to closure.

• Support qualification and transfer schedules through effective collaboration with foundry and internal stakeholders.

Yield Excursion & Quality Support

• Perform timely analysis of low-yield events, manufacturing excursions, abnormal defect patterns, and other quality-related issues.

• Correlate manufacturing, electrical, and test data to support root-cause identification.

• Work with foundry, Product Engineering, Quality, Test Engineering, and other technical teams on containment, corrective actions, and continuous improvement.

• Provide data-driven technical recommendations for manufacturing disposition and risk assessment.

Data Analytics & Yield Engineering Tools

• Apply statistical and visualization tools such as JMP, Spotfire, Exensio/PDF, or equivalent platforms for yield analysis and data mining.

• Develop and improve reusable analysis methods, dashboards, and reports to increase engineering efficiency.

• Support evaluation, user acceptance testing, and deployment of new yield-analysis capabilities and engineering tools.

• Explore automation and AI/ML-assisted approaches to improve yield analytics and engineering productivity.

Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Serve as a technical interface between external foundries and internal engineering organizations.

• Lead or participate in regular technical interlock meetings covering yield, manufacturing capacity, excursions, NPI, and manufacturing transfers.

• Communicate technical findings, risks, recommendations, and improvement plans clearly to engineering teams and management.

• Develop and maintain engineering documentation, analysis methodologies, and best practices.

jobs.title: Principal Data Architect
jobs.description:
Babel Street is the trusted technology partner for the world’s most advanced identity intelligence and risk operations. We deliver advanced AI and data analytics solutions providing unmatched, analysis-ready data regardless of language, proactive risk identification, 360-degree insights, high-speed automation, and seamless integration into existing systems. Babel Street empowers government and commercial organizations to transform high-stakes identity and risk operations into a strategic advantage.  The actionable insights we deliver safeguard lives and protect critical assets around the world.  Babel Street is headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with regional offices in Boston, MA and Cleveland, OH, and international offices in Australia, Canada, Israel, Japan, and the U.K. For more information, visit www.babelstreet.com.

Role summary

Principal Data Architect, Data Platform and Pipelines

We are hiring a hands-on architect to redesign and rebuild Babel Street's data infrastructure and pipelines. You will set the target architecture, write the critical code yourself, and lead engineers through a multi-year move of a petabyte-scale platform onto Google Cloud.

Babel Street collects, enriches and resolves open-source and commercial data across hundreds of sources and dozens of languages. Today that data flows through pipelines and stores that grew up separately: a mix of warehouse, search and object storage, plus legacy delivery systems that are hard to change and expensive to run. Your job is to replace that with one coherent platform that is cheaper, more reliable, and built for AI and agentic workloads.

This is a principal engineering role, not a people-management role. You will be judged on the systems you design and ship, the quality of your technical decisions, and how much you raise the bar for the engineers around you. You will report to the SVP of Engineering and work alongside our Head of Architecture, AI, Graph and Product teams.

What you will do in your first year

• In your first 90 days, map the current estate end to end: every source, pipeline, store, consumer and delivery path, with its volume, cost, owner and failure history. Publish a target-state data architecture and a sequenced migration plan that engineering and product leadership sign off.

• Design and build the new ingestion and processing backbone. Replace bespoke pipelines with a standard pattern for streaming and batch ingestion, enrichment, and delivery, running at millions of documents per day with clear SLOs.

• Lead the data platform workstream of our GCP migration. Turn "lift and shift" into real modernization: decide what moves as is, what gets rebuilt, and what gets retired, and own the technical design of each wave.

• Rationalize storage and search. Define when we use the warehouse (BigQuery), search and index (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), object storage, vector and graph stores, then consolidate toward that pattern and cut the cost of our most expensive workloads.

• Build the data foundation for AI. Deliver agent-callable data services, hybrid retrieval (keyword, analytical, vector, graph), and provenance and lineage on every record so our AI products can cite their evidence.

• Build the governance and compliance platform. Centralize and serve governed and compliant data (e.g. privacy laws) as part of AI-readiness, setting parameters, exclusions, and retention for optimal performance of AI.

• Make the platform operable. Put in place data contracts, quality checks, observability and cost attribution so every pipeline has an owner, an SLO and a known unit cost.

What you will own

Pipelines and ingestion. Architecture and reference implementations for collection, ingestion, parsing, enrichment (translation, NER, entity resolution) and delivery. Event-driven and queue-based processing, idempotency, backfills and replay, schema evolution, and exactly-once or effectively-once guarantees where they matter.

Storage, compute and search. The physical data platform across warehouse, lakehouse, search and object storage. Partitioning, indexing, tiering and retention strategies at petabyte scale. Query and aggregation performance, and the hardware and cost trade-offs behind them.

Cloud migration and environments. Technical design for moving data workloads from AWS to GCP with minimal disruption to customers. Patterns that also work in FedRAMP, disconnected and air-gapped deployments, where managed cloud services may not be available.

Retrieval and AI enablement. APIs and query layers that serve both analysts and agents. Hybrid retrieval across structured, unstructured, vector and graph data, built with our AI and Graph teams to support RAG and agentic workflows.

Data quality, lineage and economics. Data contracts, automated quality checks, lineage and provenance, observability and SLOs. Unit economics for the platform: cost per source, per pipeline, per query and per customer.

Technical leadership. Architecture decision records, design reviews and coding standards for data engineering. Mentoring senior engineers, partnering with our offshore engineering teams, and being the escalation point for the hardest data incidents.

Required qualifications

• 12+ years building data systems, with at least 5 as the lead architect or principal engineer on a large-scale data platform.

• You still write production code. Strong in Python plus at least one of Java, Scala or Go, and fluent in SQL.

• You have personally led a major re-architecture or cloud migration of a data platform and can walk us through the design, the sequencing, what broke and what you would change.

• Deep hands-on experience with distributed processing and streaming, for example Spark, Beam/Dataflow, Flink, Kafka, Pub/Sub or Pulsar.

• Production experience with GCP data services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, GCS and Spanner. AWS experience is also expected, since you will be migrating from it.

• Expert-level operation of search and index systems (Elasticsearch or OpenSearch) at scale, including cluster sizing, mappings, aggregation performance and cost tuning.

• Experience with lakehouse table formats (Iceberg, Delta or Hudi) and orchestration (Airflow/Composer, Dagster or similar).

• A track record of cutting platform cost materially without hurting performance, and the numbers to show for it.

• Clear written communication. You can write a design doc that a CEO and a senior engineer both understand.

• Ability to obtain a US security clearance

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with vector search, embeddings pipelines and retrieval architectures for LLM and agentic applications.

• Experience with entity resolution, knowledge graphs or graph databases, ideally across multilingual or messy real-world data.

• Background in OSINT, national security or law enforcement, risk intelligence, and financial data

• Experience building for FedRAMP, IL5 or air-gapped environments, including running data platforms without managed cloud services.

• Experience with data observability, lineage and governance tooling (for example OpenLineage, Great Expectations, Monte Carlo, Dataplex).

• Experience combining large volumes of scraped multimedia and structured third-party data.

Education and location

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience. A Master's or PhD is a plus but not required.

Benefits at Babel Street (just to name a few...)

• Health Benefits: Babel Street covers 85-100% monthly premium costs for Medical, Dental, Vision, Life & Disability insurances – for you and your family!

• Retirement Plans: Babel Street offers both a Traditional and Roth 401(K) with a very competitive match.

• Unlimited Flexible Leave: We trust our employees to manage their own time and balance their personal and work lives.

• Holidays: Babel Street provides employees with 12 paid Federal Holidays

• Tuition Reimbursement: We are committed to investing in our employees. One way we do that is with our Tuition Reimbursement Program for continuing education.

Babel Street is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Further, Babel Street will not discriminate against applicants for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co‐worker, Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination. In addition, Babel Street's policy is to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances where a particular employee works. Upon request, we will provide you with more information about such accommodations.

Range for this position based on qualifications and experience

$220,000—$250,000 USD

jobs.title: Executive Oncology Account Manager (Orlando)
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Location: Orlando, FL  (Field Based)

Overview of Role:

The Executive Oncology Account Manager (OAM) will be responsible for driving the successful launch and commercialization of ivonescimab within an assigned U.S. territory. Reporting to a Regional Business Director (RBD), this individual contributor role is accountable for developing and executing territory-level business plans, building strong customer relationships, and achieving sales objectives in alignment with national and regional commercial strategies.

The Executive Oncology Account Manager will engage oncology customers across community practices, academic centers, integrated delivery networks, and other key accounts to support appropriate product education and access. This role will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, and regional leadership, to deliver a best-in-class customer experience and support business performance.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute territory business plans to achieve sales objectives, market share goals, and product launch priorities within the assigned geography.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with oncology healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, practice administrators, and other relevant stakeholders.

• Effectively communicate product information, clinical value, and approved promotional messaging in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.

• Analyze territory performance, customer needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics to identify opportunities and adjust business plans accordingly.

• Partner with the Regional Business Director to align territory priorities with regional strategies, performance expectations, and launch execution plans.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial Operations, and other cross-functional partners to support customer engagement and business objectives.

• Provide customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market feedback to regional leadership and internal stakeholders.

jobs.title: Program Manager, RF & Radar Systems

jobs.title: GTM Process & Automation Manager
jobs.description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will...

• Grow with an Ownership Mindset: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place.

• Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike: At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.

• Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose: We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward.

Location: Remote in these states: AL, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, KS, KY, IA, ID, IL, IN, LA, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, VT, WA, WI

Role Description:

ShipBob is looking for a GTM Process & Automation Manager to improve the design of our North American sales processes and optimize the systems that support them. You'll decide what those processes should be, shape how Salesforce, Gong, and every other system in the sales workflow are set up and used to support them, and drive consistent adoption across the team. The goal is better sales outcomes: stronger pipeline, higher conversion, and more time spent selling. You'll spend your time with BDRs, AEs, managers, and leaders to find where processes break down, where systems add friction, and where manual work can be automated. Then you'll own the full cycle: discover the problem, scope it, recommend a fix, align stakeholders, build the solution, drive adoption, and iterate. You'll build with Salesforce, Gong, Clay, Claude, and n8n, and partner with Enablement so every change lands with training and accountability. You'll own adoption and consistency reporting to leadership and bring data and a point of view to every recommendation. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations.

What you'll do:

• Discover. Spend time with BDRs, AEs, managers, and sales leaders across Mid-Market and SMB to see how work gets done in Salesforce, Gong, and the other systems in the sales workflow. Find where the process itself is flawed, where the field has worked around it, and where systems add friction instead of removing it. Map the path an AE takes from first meeting to closed-won, noting every system they touch, and inventory the manual tasks BDRs and AEs repeat today.

• Scope. Turn what you hear into defined problems, each with a baseline, a success metric, and an estimate of impact. Prioritize by time saved, systems removed, and reps affected.

• Recommend. Bring insights from field conversations, system data, and call recordings. Present options, trade-offs, and a clear recommendation to the Director and GTM leaders.

• Align. Get Sales leadership, Enablement, GTM Systems, and other stakeholders on the same page before you build. Agree on owners, timelines, and what success looks like.

• Build. Improve the process design, then build the solution yourself: workflow automations in n8n, AI agents and skills in Claude, signal-based prospecting plays in Clay, and configuration in Salesforce and Gong. Optimize how each system supports the process, remove manual steps, and bring work into the systems reps already use, so fewer tools stand between a rep and a closed deal. Partner with GTM Systems, who own the tech stack, on integration and consolidation decisions.

• Drive adoption. Own adoption of every process and system change you ship, from launch until it sticks. Build adoption into the workflow itself through automation, in-system guardrails, and prompts, and give managers simple inspection routines to reinforce it.

• Drive consistency. Set clear standards for how each stage of the funnel should run. Then reduce variance across reps, teams, and segments, so the process looks the same whether a deal sits with an SMB AE or a Mid-Market AE.

• Measure and hold accountable. Define adoption, consistency, and outcome metrics for everything you ship, and own that reporting across the North American sales org. Review results with sales leaders and RevOps leadership on a regular cadence, flag gaps, make clear asks of managers and leaders, and escalate up the leadership chain when adoption stalls.

• Iterate. Run a standing feedback loop with reps, managers, and leaders. Use it, plus the adoption data, to refine or retire what isn't working.

• Partner with Enablement. Make sure every change ships with documentation, training, and clear expectations so adoption starts on day one, not just a Teams announcement.

In your first 12 months, you'll:

• Improve the design of core sales processes to drive better outcomes, including pipeline generation, stage conversion, and win rates.

• Raise adoption of core sales processes and systems across North American Mid-Market and SMB, and close consistency gaps between reps, teams, and segments.

• Increase adoption of signal-based prospecting.

• Cut the time BDRs and AEs spend on research, follow-ups, and other manual work by automating the highest-volume tasks.

• Reduce the time reps spend on non-sales activities.

• Reduce the number of systems an AE must touch to take a deal from first meeting to closed-won.

• Create consistent next-best-action prioritization at each stage of the funnel.

• Ship automations and tools that stay in active use, each with measured impact.

• Stand up adoption and consistency reporting and a regular leadership review.

• Other duties/responsibilities as necessary.

What you'll bring to the table:

• 8+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Enablement operations, or GTM engineering, ideally supporting a B2B sales team.

• A track record of improving a process's design after talking to the people who run it, then driving adoption until it stuck, with the data to prove it.

• Experience mapping end-to-end workflows across multiple tools and removing steps, whether through automation, integration, or consolidation.

• An eye for manual work worth automating. You can size what it costs in time and decide what's worth building.

• Proof you've built and shipped something people use: automations, AI agents, or internal tools. We care about what you built, not which tool you used.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce and Gong. Experience with Clay, n8n, or similar workflow tools, and hands-on building with LLMs such as Claude, is a strong plus.

• The ability to turn field feedback and system data into a clear point of view, and to defend it with VPs and with reps.

• Comfort reporting adoption and consistency data to leaders and holding people accountable, constructively and without ego.

• You own problems end to end and keep iterating until the fix works.

• Excellent communication. You can run a working session with a rep in the morning and present a recommendation to a VP in the afternoon.

Perks & Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, Vision & Basic Life Insurance

• Paid Maternity/Parental Leave Program

• Paid Holidays & Flexible Time Off Program

• Paid Sick Leave

• Wellness Days (1 day/quarter)

• 401K Match

• Comprehensive Benefits Package >>> https://www.shipbob.com/careers/

• See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob)

ShipBob believes in transparency while providing a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance approach.  The full base pay range for this position in our compensation architecture is $101,629 - $169,381. In addition to base salary, this role includes the opportunity to be eligible for participation in the Company's discretionary bonus plan based on Company's plans and in accordance with Company’s policies.

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

About You:

Building the world’s leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob’s environment isn’t the right fit for everyone, and that’s okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you.

Learn more about our core values and how we perform at a high level in our day-to-day work on our Culture page (https://www.shipbob.com/careers/culture/).

About Us:

ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob’s proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob’s dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. ShipBob is backed by leading investors like Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and is one of the fastest-growing tech companies headquartered in Chicago.

At ShipBob, every full-time employee gets access to our best-in-class AI and productivity tools from Day 1 at no cost. This isn't a pilot or a perk for select teams. It's standard for everyone. We believe innovation isn't owned by one department. Whether you're in Talent, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or Customer Success, we expect you to ask: how can this be done better, faster, or smarter? These tools are our investment in your ability to find those answers.

Use of AI-Assisted Tools During Recruitment

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to support administrative functions such as transcribing interviews, generating summaries or notes, organizing interview feedback, facilitating candidate communications, and helping recruiters identify candidates whose qualifications may align with job requirements. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and are not used to make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by trained human reviewers who consider the candidate's application, interview performance, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. AI-assisted tools do not independently determine whether a candidate advances in the hiring process or receives an offer of employment. Where required by applicable law, candidates will be provided with notice regarding our use of AI-assisted technologies and, where available, information about any applicable rights relating to such processing, including the ability to request additional information or opt out of certain AI-assisted processing activities. Candidates who exercise available opt-out rights may be reviewed through alternative processes consistent with applicable law.

ShipBob provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

There is no deadline to apply for this position, as ShipBob accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Growth Event Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

Clipboard is looking to revolutionize the staffing industry. The MTO (Market Takeover) team is at the forefront of this mission, running high-energy, in-person events across the country to boost sales and build Clipboard into a household name. A big part of that is showing up at industry conferences and trade shows across the country, in long-term care and increasingly in hospitals and home health.

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-obsessed Growth Event Coordinator to join the MTO team. In this role, you will own everything that has to happen for Clipboard to show up well at a conference – from registering and booking the booth, to getting the attendee list into reps' hands, to making sure every conversation gets captured in Salesforce afterward. You will be the central point of coordination between conference organizers, our sales team, Sales Ops and finance. This is a position perfect for someone who loves running a tight process, gets satisfaction from things going off without a hitch, and wants a front-row seat to how events turn into revenue.

What you'll do

 - Own end-to-end logistics for our conference program, from registration and booth setup to travel, shipping and event materials.

 - Serve as the central point of coordination between conference organizers, the sales team and internal partners.

 - Make sure reps walk into every event prepared, with clear agendas, briefings and insight on who will be there.

 - Partner with Sales Ops to manage attendee data and keep event activity accurately captured in our systems.

 - Track event outcomes and costs, and turn learnings into a repeatable playbook that scales as the program grows.

What we're looking for

 - Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail – you juggle a dozen conferences at different stages and nothing slips.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills – we write a LOT here at Clipboard, and this role is constantly coordinating with organizers, vendors and reps.

 - Comfort with systems and data. Experience with Salesforce, spreadsheets or similar tools is a plus, and you're excited to use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job.

 - A proactive and collaborative team player who is eager to learn and take on new challenges.

 - A passion for our mission to lift people up the socioeconomic ladder.

 - Speed and bias for action. We move quickly, which means that flexibility and adaptability are key to succeeding here.

 - Willingness and ownership – if there is something that needs to get done, you do it instead of waiting for someone else to do it.

 - Prior experience in event operations, sales operations, project coordination or a related field is a plus, but not required.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You:

 - Have 1-3+ years of professional experience in operations, event planning, sales ops or a similar coordination-heavy role. A history in the software and healthcare industries is a plus, but not required.

 - Are the person friends and coworkers hand the trip planning to, and you actually enjoy it.

 - Like building processes and SOPs, and get annoyed when the same thing is done three different ways.

 - Are comfortable traveling occasionally to support conferences on the ground.

 - Thrive in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment and adapt quickly when the playbook changes.

 - Are naturally curious, a creative problem-solver, and see challenges as opportunities.

 - Communicate clearly, follow through on commitments, and take full ownership of your work.

You'll Love This Role If You:

 - Want to grow your career in operations, marketing or sales strategy, and are eager to see the direct impact of your work on pipeline and revenue.

 - Are excited by autonomy – you'll own the operational side of our conference program and be trusted to make every event run smoothly.

What We Offer

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - All travel, lodging, and meal expenses are covered for event-related travel.

 - Remote-friendly structure.

 - Smart teammates, real responsibility, and opportunities to grow fast into more senior roles in operations, marketing, sales or strategy.

Quick Note on Scammers: 

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here https://forms.gle/SyGaxHFbon7Hg9fW6.

jobs.title: Fan Insights Communications Intern
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about sandals, boots, and everything in between? Do you live and breathe sustainability? Do you have a creative eye, a hunger to learn, and a KEEN interest in the outdoor industry? If you said yes to any of the above, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

Position: Fan Insights Communications Intern
Location: KEEN’s Global Headquarters in Portland, Oregon (on-site)
Duration: 10 weeks
Compensation: $22/hour
Program Duration: Monday, June 14th – Friday, August 20th

What You'll Do

As an Intern at KEEN (KEENtern), you’ll dive into the exciting world of footwear, innovation, and community! You’ll get hands-on experience working alongside industry experts and contribute to shaping the future of KEEN.

We’re looking for someone to join the Fan Insights team and level up how we communicate and educate teams across KEEN about who our Fans are and what makes them special. The Fan Insights team is the hub for KEEN Fan knowledge, running surveys, tests, interviews, and studies that help bring the voice of the Fan into our work.

As the Fan Insights KEENtern, you’ll be our internal storyteller and PR lead—turning research into engaging, shareable content that teams can understand and use. We’re seeking a strong writer and creative communicator who can spot a compelling story, translate insights into clear and approachable messages, and bring fresh ideas to life across written, visual, and video formats. You’re organized, proactive, comfortable collaborating across teams, and excited to learn more about consumer insights and the KEEN Fan.

Essential Responsibilities

• Create engaging internal content—including short videos, one-pagers, posters, and Campfire posts—that brings Fan stories and research findings to life.

• Build and maintain a searchable Fan Library of video clips, quotes, study highlights, and other resources, organized so teams can easily find and use them.

• Develop and manage a consistent cadence of internal Fan Insights communications, including Fan spotlights, study recaps, and “What Fans Told Us This Month” updates.

• Partner with the Fan Insights team to identify the strongest stories from each study and recommend creative ways to share them across KEEN.

• Support consumer research activities, including helping field surveys and studies using Quantilope, dScout, and Qualtrics.

• Update PowerPoint presentations and Excel spreadsheets using established templates, including organizing information, creating basic charts, and preparing materials for internal teams.

• Provide day-to-day project support to the Fan Insights team, including organizing research materials, documenting key information, and completing assigned tasks with guidance and feedback.

Minimum Qualifications

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field .

• Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university at the Junior, Senior, or Graduate level. You will also be considered if you have recently graduated from an accredited college or university.

• Must be able to work 40 hours/week during the internship program during normal working hours (Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM) and be available to work in the office 5 days/week.

What We’re Looking For:

We’re seeking someone who embodies our passion for creativity, sustainability, and the great outdoors. Our ideal KEENtern is:

• Passionate: Whether you’re an outdoor enthusiast, committed to sustainability, or fascinated by footwear trends and innovation, you’re excited to engage with the world around you.

• Creatively Minded: You’re detail-oriented, love bringing fresh ideas to life, and have a knack for solving problems.

• A Strong Communicator: Whether it’s collaborating with a team or presenting ideas, you know how to express yourself clearly and effectively.

• Proactive & Eager to Learn: You’re curious, ready to ask questions, take initiative, and dive into new challenges with enthusiasm.

Why Intern with Us?

Being a KEENtern means you’re not just an intern—you’re a valued part of our KEEN community. Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Meaningful Work: Tackle real-world projects that make an impact, gaining valuable hands-on experience at a globally recognized brand.

• Collaborative Environment: Partner with talented teammates and work on a group project with other KEENterns.

• Networking Opportunities: Build connections with industry experts and mentors who can help shape your career.

• Perks & Benefits: Enjoy product discounts, a subsidized cafeteria, and an inspiring workspace.

• Outdoor Adventures: Immerse yourself in Portland – a vibrant city nestled between the mountains and the coast – a hub for all things outdoors, such as hiking, biking, rafting, camping, and climbing.

Program Requirements:

To qualify for this internship, you must:

• Be a Junior, Senior, or Graduate student working toward a degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

• Be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

• Commit to a 10-week program from mid-June through mid-August.

• Dedicate 40 hours per week during standard M-F work week.

• This is an onsite role located at our beautiful headquarters office in Portland, OR.

• Plan no more than four total days of vacation during the internship.

• Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, including Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint.

• Able to learn and adapt quickly to new software and tools.

• Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills, strong attention to detail in preparation of presentations, reports, and materials.

• Demonstrate strong organization skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.

• Proven ability to work independently as well as collaborate with a team.

• Able to perform the essential functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation, including using a computer for extended periods.

Travel: Occasional travel in and around the larger Portland area to support activations.

Ready to Take the Next Step?
If you’re ready to take your passions to the next level and be part of a world-class team, please apply.

Other Requirements

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without cause.

Fuerst Group, KEEN and Chrome are equal opportunity employers.  We value an inclusive and diverse community. Qualified candidates of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?

General qualifications and requirements

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Executive Oncology Account Manager (Durham)
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Location: Durham, NC (Field Based)

Overview of Role:

The Executive Oncology Account Manager (OAM) will be responsible for driving the successful launch and commercialization of ivonescimab within an assigned U.S. territory. Reporting to a Regional Business Director (RBD), this individual contributor role is accountable for developing and executing territory-level business plans, building strong customer relationships, and achieving sales objectives in alignment with national and regional commercial strategies.

The Executive Oncology Account Manager will engage oncology customers across community practices, academic centers, integrated delivery networks, and other key accounts to support appropriate product education and access. This role will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, and regional leadership, to deliver a best-in-class customer experience and support business performance.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute territory business plans to achieve sales objectives, market share goals, and product launch priorities within the assigned geography.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with oncology healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, practice administrators, and other relevant stakeholders.

• Effectively communicate product information, clinical value, and approved promotional messaging in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.

• Analyze territory performance, customer needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics to identify opportunities and adjust business plans accordingly.

• Partner with the Regional Business Director to align territory priorities with regional strategies, performance expectations, and launch execution plans.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial Operations, and other cross-functional partners to support customer engagement and business objectives.

• Provide customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market feedback to regional leadership and internal stakeholders.

• Plan and conduct compliant customer interactions, including in-person and virtual engagements, speaker programs, business reviews, and other approved promotional activities.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions, territory plans, expenses, and required administrative activities.

• Ensure all commercial activities are conducted in compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and applicable legal requirements.

• Manage territory travel, expenses, and resources responsibly.

• All other duties as assigned.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in business, life sciences, or related field required; advanced degree preferred.

• Minimum of 6+ years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial experience with at least 3+ years of oncology experience preferred, with demonstrated clinical acumen, strong commercial performance, and experience influencing treatment decisions in competitive markets; or relevant combination of commercial, education and life experience.

• Recent experience supporting oncology product launches preferred; NSCLC experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding sales goals within a defined territory.

jobs.title: Field Technician

Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. With a global team of over 3,000 professionals, we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to grow. Our mission is to securely connect people, places, and information with end-to-end technology solutions at scale.

At New Era, you'll join a team-oriented culture that prioritizes your personal and professional development. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.

· Medical

· Dental

· Vision

· 401K match

· 28 PTO Days including company holidays

SUMMARY:  The Field Technician role includes a combination of local field service and regional/national installation, supervision, and QA support.  The Field Technician provides support for New Era Technology project teams by completing work in the field at customer sites and acting as installers and supervisors to sub-contractors.  The role is responsible for assuring all facets of field operations are executed safely and in the prescribed amount of time in accordance with the scope of work. • Improve customer satisfaction/NPS scores.

• The majority of work is performed at customer locations.

• Installation of cabling infrastructure includes but not limited to: Single/Multi mode fiber 50/62.5 Copper Category 3, 5e, 6, shielded in both horizontal and backbone applications. 18/2 twisted pair cabling. Floor mount/wall mount racks/cabinets Proper grounding applications

• Installation, troubleshooting, and servicing of the following areas: POS, CCTV, video monitoring, security systems, computer, and low voltage cabling equipment.

• Installation of high-speed circuits, routers, switches, and modems.

• Experience working with subcontractors.
