Floor mount/wall mount racks/cabinets Proper grounding applications

• Experience installing, programming and servicing a variety of telephone, PBX and key systems.

• Experience installing, troubleshooting and servicing 2 or more of the following areas: POS, CCTV, video monitoring, security systems, computer and low voltage cabling equipment.

• Knowledge of high-speed circuits, routers, switches and modems

• Knowledge of Cisco and Adtran high speed circuits, routers and switches

• Some combination of the following experience: Ability to login to network equipment via a GUI or command line using PuTTY or similar terminal emulator. Knowledge of IP subnetting Knowledge of wireless networking, specifically Ekahau, AirMagnet or similar tools Some experience with desktop/laptop support

• Valid driver’s license

Related/Relevant Certifications (Not Mandatory):

•     Licensed Electrician Journeyman level
•    Relevant Certifications – Cisco, Aruba, Ruckus, Avaya, CommScope, etc.
•    OSHA Construction Safety and Health (10 or 30 hour) certification
•    BICSI Installer 1/2 or Technician

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

• Demonstrated ability to properly use basic hand tools, power tools, and testing tools for the installation and testing of voice and network equipment to include but not limited to: Firewalls, routers, switches Wireless LAN controllers On-premises voice/key systems Physical security controllers and door strikes Video security cameras, DVRs, and NVRs VoIP handsets

• Knowledge and experience with the utilization of time tracking software

• Intermediate MS Office computer skills, including Word, Excel and Outlook

• Ability to give and receive clear direction from multiple sources.

• Ability to effectively communicate, present information, and respond to managers, employees, customers, and vendors in an intelligent, clear, concise, professional and grammatically correct manner.

• Ability to establish and retain customer confidence.

Working Conditions and Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

• Work on remote job sites in various stages of construction.

• Required to use hands and arms to finger, type, handle, feel or reach, pull and squeeze.

• Sitting and driving may be required for up to 100% of the workday.

• Frequently required to stand, walk, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and perform work overhead.

• Required to use a 6, 8, 10 and 12ft ladder and Scissor/Boom lifts.

• Vision requirements include the ability to adjust focus and view a computer screen, also to focus on components in their original casings to detect problems and troubleshoot issues.

• The employee is required to hear, and talk in a clear, audible voice.

• May be exposed to wet and/or humid conditions, extreme cold, extreme heat, moving mechanical parts, high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and outside weather conditions.

• All Personal Protective Equipment is supplied by the Company where required.

EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: Monday – Friday 8am – 5pm. May vary due to project assignment.

TRAVEL: Overnight travel could be to 80% depending upon project requirements.

jobs.description:
Purpose

Oversees the direction, planning, execution, and interpretation of clinical trials or research activities of one or more clinical development programs. Participates in cross-functional teams to generate, deliver, and interpret high-quality clinical data supporting overall product scientific and business strategy.

Responsibilities

• Manages the design and implementation of one or more clinical development programs in support of an overall Product Development Plan, based on strong medical and scientific principles, knowledge of compliance and regulatory requirements, AbbVie’s customers, markets, business operations, and emerging issues. Oversees project-related education of investigators, study site personnel, and AbbVie study staff.
• Has overall responsibility for oversight of clinical studies, monitoring overall study integrity, and review, interpretation, and communication of accumulating data pertaining to safety and efficacy of the molecule. Along with Clinical Operations, is responsible for oversight of study enrollment and overall timelines for key deliverables. Responsible for assessment and reporting of serious adverse events per corporate policy and regulations for those protocols on which assigned.
• Responsible for design, analysis, interpretation, and reporting of scientific content of protocols, Investigator Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, regulatory submissions and responses, and other program documents.
• May oversee the work of Medical Directors and/or Scientific Directors, and of Clinical Scientists working on the same or related programs.
• Provides in-house clinical expertise for the molecule and disease, coordinating appropriate scientific and medical activities with internal stakeholders as they relate to ongoing clinical projects. May participate in due diligence or other business development activity. As required by program needs, contributes in partnership with Discovery colleagues to design and implementation of translational strategies.
• May serve on or chair an Integrated Evidence Strategy Team (IEST), with responsibility for development of a rigorous, cross-functionally-aligned, vetted Clinical Development Plan with full consideration of contingencies and alternative approaches. In the role of IEST Chair, responsibilities may include supervision of matrix team members and serving as Clinical Research representative to lend clinical development and medical expertise to an Asset Strategy Team (AST)
• Acts as a clinical interface and actively solicits opinion leader interactions related to the molecule and disease area; partners with Medical Affairs, Commercial and other functions in these activities as required, consistent with corporate policies, to ensure that broad cross-functional perspectives are incorporated into Clinical Development Plans and protocols as appropriate.
• Stays abreast of professional information and technology through conferences, medical literature, and other available training, to augment expertise in the therapeutic area.
• Responsible for understanding the regulatory requirements related to the clinical studies and global drug development and accountable for complying with those requirements. Serves as a clinical representative for key regulatory discussions.
• Ensures adherence to Good Clinical Practices, pharmacovigilance standards, standard operating procedures and to all other quality standards in conducting research.

• Medical Doctor (M.D.), Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) or non-US equivalent of M.D. degree with relevant therapeutic specialty in an academic or hospital environment. Completion of a residency program strongly preferred. Completion of a subspecialty fellowship is desirable.
• At least 2 years of clinical trial experience in the pharmaceutical industry, academia, or equivalent.
• Experience with psychedelic drug development highly preferred
• Ability to run a clinical research program of moderate complexity with minimal supervision.
• Ability to perform and bring out the best in others on a cross-functional global team.
• Ability to interact externally and internally to support a global scientific and business strategy.
• Knowledge of clinical trial methodology, regulatory and compliance requirements governing clinical trials and experience in development of clinical strategy and the design of study protocols.
• Must possess excellent oral and written English communication skills.

jobs.title: Principal Manager, Procurement Enablement & Contingent Workforce
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Manager, Procurement Enablement & Contingent Workforce

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Lead a team of 4 Procurement Enablement and Contingent Workforce (ITV) program managers who will work on Procurement and Contingent Workforce process governance, support, enablement, process improvement, and redesign.

• Manage all Procurement related systems and enhancements including Oracle P2P, Ironclad CLM, Pursuit RFP, Airtable Savings Tracker, and AI tools.

• Deliver on Procurement intake transformation including Agentic Intake Orchestration by designing and deploying next-generation, AI-driven conversational and autonomous agentic intake systems that replaces static forms.

• Drive Agentic in-take process to be fully comprehensive through multiple system integrations with ability to provide a guided buying experience, provide real time status updates, and provide renewal notifications and actions to both sourcing and business owners.

• Redesign the end to end Contingent Workforce process to provide hiring managers a simpler and faster hiring journey for Contingent Workers that reduces hand offs between the Procurement and Contingent Workforce program team.

• Oversee the Contingent Workforce program and governance including managing the VMS and its global expansion.

• Develop the global Contingent Workforce supply chain through identifying and driving a cohesive supply chain strategy and enabling hiring managers to find Contingent Workforce talent globally.

• Lead other S2P process enhancements and be the glue that drives cross functional collaboration between AP, Accounting, Security, Privacy, Audit, IT, and other functions.

• Responsible for driving Procurement Policy simplifications and enhancements.

• Lead cross functional training and enablement for hiring managers globally and also for all Procurement stakeholders.

• Track and manage preferred supplier list; identify then partner with sourcing on areas to increase preferred supplier usage.

• Lead development of an external supplier landing page that highlights supplier FAQ, how to navigate supplier portal, an invoice lookup tool, Twilio code of conduct, Sustainability expectations etc.

• Partner with Twilio sustainability team to lead on reporting of supplier GHG emissions.

• Drive simplification of our POC and NDA processes into a centralized agentic workflow.

• Partner with Procurement Legal to ensure contracting requirements and proper positioning of paper are built into any new or redesigned process — including agentic intake, guided buying, and POC/NDA workflows — so process speed doesn’t come at the cost of downstream legal or compliance rework.

• Partner with the Procurement Operations and Compliance team to implement an automated KYS screening for both vendors and carriers globally.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

• 12+ years of experience of managing procurement systems, S2P processes, and ITV/contingent workforce programs.

• Familiarity or participation in an ERP redesign with advance knowledge of Oracle Cloud Procurement.

• Strong understanding or experience in implementing Procurement agentic solutions that result in simpler and leaner processes.

• Familiarity or participation in an Contingent Workforce redesign with knowledge of Beeline or other VMS systems.

• Track record of successful cross-functional leadership, collaboration, and relationship building.

• Knowledgeable in requirements gathering, analysis, design and implementation methodologies

• Pragmatic and collaborative, able to work independently to ensure execution and on time delivery of programs to achieve objectives in procurement efficiency taking into consideration upstream/downstream partner processes, systems, security standards and compliance requirements.

• Solid understanding of contracting fundamentals and how contracting fits within the S2P process, with the ability to design or redesign intake, policy, and workflow changes that preserve proper contracting positioning rather than treating it as an afterthought.

• Tech savvy change agent who understands procurement and finance vendor landscape, tool capabilities/gaps and possible solutions. Knowledge of Netsuite, Coupa, or Oracle Cloud is strongly advantageous.

• Strong ability to manage multiple projects concurrently with sound business acumen.

• Excellent communication skills, able to communicate clearly and succinctly in writing, presentations and verbally to multiple levels within the organization.

• Strong project management skills (certifications a plus), the ability to track and manage complex processes, and a desire to lead teams and projects

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

Desired:

• Experience in the Technology industry and operating within hyper-growth environments, with a proven ability to build scalable sourcing processes and systems from the ground up.

• Proven track record of cultivating collaborative, high-trust partnerships across matrixed internal business units and external vendor ecosystems to drive shared strategic outcomes.

• Demonstrated experience scaling, structuring, and developing a ITV/Contingent Workforce and procurement Process, and developing process change with Agentic workflows.

• Lean Six Sigma or similar process improvement experience.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately <10%> travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

• Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $141,520.00-$176,900.00

• Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $149,840.00-$187,300.00

• Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $166,400.00-$208,000.00.

• This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 11/20/26, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Producer - Central Technology, Infrastructure Platform
jobs.description:
As Technical Producers at Riot, we lead passionate technical teams to create products and experiences that achieve maximum developer, operator, and player value. We guide development, clear blockers, and push projects across the finish line while ensuring our teams are sustainable and foster a collaborative environment.

As a Senior Technical Producer on the Infrastructure Platform team, you'll drive direction and delivery across the platforms the rest of Riot ships on: live game services in every region, internal tools Rioters build to do their jobs, and a fast-growing set of workloads. Much of the work ahead is extending those platforms to support emergent or underserved use cases, and you'll help decide what that should look like. You'll partner closely with engineering leads across Infrastructure and the teams across Riot who depend on what we deliver.

Responsibilities:

• Partner with engineering managers and technical leads to develop the technical product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your area

• Own product requirements for your area, defining what to build, what success looks like, and how it will be measured.

• Partner with engineering to evaluate designs against user needs, assess trade-offs, and pressure-test implementations

• Manage delivery plans, risks, blockers, dependencies, tradeoffs; maintain clear stakeholder communication

• Lead the breakdown and execution of multi-month work efforts spanning multiple teams within an initiative

• Partner with teams to improve work systems, practices, delivery rituals, and goal setting; strengthen product feedback loops to clarify decisions, strengthen delivery predictability, and create a more consistent customer experience

• Coordinate or facilitate day-to-day team rituals where needed within assigned scope

• Assess team health, composition, and capacity to ensure the team is set up for success

• Drive difficult technical tradeoffs with technical leaders, and articulate and advocate those tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders

• Serve as a key point of contact for customers in your assigned scope; engage them to understand needs and coordinate new-work intake

• Prioritize customer requests in partnership with relevant engineering and technical leads for your assigned scope

• Own an integrated view of delivery status across your assigned scope, tracking progress against goals and milestones, and contribute to consolidated reporting for relevant stakeholders, adapting updates to the audience and reporting needs

• Use customer feedback, product signals, test results, and operational data to validate problems and drive priorities

• Monitor product and service health, including user experience, cost, usage, performance, and operational effort, and help turn signals into improvements

• Mentor other producers and contribute ideas beyond your immediate ownership across teams

Required Qualifications:

• 6+ years of experience as a Technical Producer, Technical Product Manager, Development Manager, or a relevant role on medium to large technical teams

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience

• Experience applying Agile and Lean development processes at scale, and contextually adapting a broad set of development processes

• Experience independently leading complex technical programs/projects with multiple teams, diverse stakeholders, or dependencies

• Broad understanding of technical systems across multiple related areas, with the ability to identify and articulate multiple solutions and their tradeoffs

• Experience defining product strategy, success metrics, and roadmap priorities for technical platforms, internal tools, or operational capabilities

• Ability to understand technical requirements and how technical choices affect reliability, operations, and developer and player experience

• Strong understanding of product management and the ability to find balanced solutions across technical, developer, and delivery constraints

• Ability to set product and technical requirements within a defined space and evaluate designs or architecture against those requirements

• Experience owning a roadmap, product plan, or execution plan through more than one stage of the product lifecycle, including launch and post-launch improvement

• Ability to communicate complex topics clearly to audiences with little or no context

• Proficiency with Jira

Desired Qualifications:

• Familiarity with Atlassian tools, including Jira Product Discovery and Jira Plans

• Experience building business cases and funding asks for technical investment

• Experience with infrastructure, cloud, developer tooling, or live-service products

• Experience improving developer productivity, operational quality, or self-service for a central platform

• Experience applying data, experimentation, automation, or AI-enabled workflows to deliver customer value or improve efficiency

• Experience working across infrastructure and game teams in a globally distributed, high-scale, or live-service environment

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!

Our Perks:

Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:

• Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data

• Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors

• Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks

• Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters

These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

jobs.title: Channel Account Manager, North Central (NorAm)
jobs.description:
Description

Keeper is hiring a driven, Regional (North Central) Channel Account Manager to join the Keeper Channel Sales team. This is a 100% remote position available in select locations. Qualified candidates must reside in or near Chicago, IL, which is preferred, or elsewhere within the North Central United States.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of users and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for building pipeline and channel revenue with high performance partners.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

The Channel Account Manager will report to our Director of Global Channel Account Management carrying a primary focus on building pipeline and channel revenue with existing channel partners. There will also be a heavy focus sourcing strategic new channel relationships. This position requires the candidate to be extremely motivated, results-driven and have a good network within the channel ecosystem.

Responsibilities

• Responsible for the day-to-day recruitment and relationship management of channel partners to include value added resellers, distributors, systems integrators and strategic software partners (primarily in the North Central United States)

• Act as a liaison between Keeper and assigned channel partners

• Build, maintain, and manage relationships with current and prospective channel partners

• Establish productive, professional relationships with key sales and channel personnel in assigned partner accounts

• Coordinate the involvement of Keeper personnel, including support, service, and management resources, in order to meet partner performance objectives and partners’ expectations

• Sell through partner organisations to end users in coordination with partner sales resources

• Meet assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned partner accounts

• Manage direct/channel conflict by fostering excellent communication between the channel and direct sales teams

• Ensure partner compliance with Channel Partner programs and agreements

• Participate in a partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship

• Identify partner GTM &/or services offerings; working with partner sales resources, marketing, etc. develop & launch offerings to point of incremental joint revenue achievement

• Build relationships with technology vendors to identify mutual greenfield opportunities with shared partners

• Maintain channel opportunity registrations in Salesforce.com and assist the direct sales team in closing channel generated leads

• Plan and execute on Channel Marketing activities and events to support brand awareness and demand generation with the Strategic Partner group

• Ability to travel to and from customer meetings (locally and nationally) & rent and/or operate a vehicle on behalf of the company

• Willingness to travel up to 50%

Requirements

• 3+ years of security SaaS channel sales experience

• Proven success driving revenue growth via channel partners

• Good understanding of Partner Incentive programs and PRM tools

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to excel in a team oriented atmosphere

• Strong written/verbal communications skills

• Very motivated and goal-oriented

• Must want a career-oriented environment that is both fun and professional

• You share our values, and work in accordance with those values

Benefits

• Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance

• 401K (Roth/Traditional)

• A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

jobs.title: Executive Oncology Account Manager (Columbia)
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Location: Columbia, SC  (Field Based)

Overview of Role:

The Executive Oncology Account Manager (OAM) will be responsible for driving the successful launch and commercialization of ivonescimab within an assigned U.S. territory. Reporting to a Regional Business Director (RBD), this individual contributor role is accountable for developing and executing territory-level business plans, building strong customer relationships, and achieving sales objectives in alignment with national and regional commercial strategies.

The Executive Oncology Account Manager will engage oncology customers across community practices, academic centers, integrated delivery networks, and other key accounts to support appropriate product education and access. This role will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, and regional leadership, to deliver a best-in-class customer experience and support business performance.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute territory business plans to achieve sales objectives, market share goals, and product launch priorities within the assigned geography.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with oncology healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, practice administrators, and other relevant stakeholders.

• Effectively communicate product information, clinical value, and approved promotional messaging in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.

• Analyze territory performance, customer needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics to identify opportunities and adjust business plans accordingly.

• Partner with the Regional Business Director to align territory priorities with regional strategies, performance expectations, and launch execution plans.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial Operations, and other cross-functional partners to support customer engagement and business objectives.

• Provide customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market feedback to regional leadership and internal stakeholders.

• Plan and conduct compliant customer interactions, including in-person and virtual engagements, speaker programs, business reviews, and other approved promotional activities.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions, territory plans, expenses, and required administrative activities.

• Ensure all commercial activities are conducted in compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and applicable legal requirements.

• Manage territory travel, expenses, and resources responsibly.

• All other duties as assigned.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in business, life sciences, or related field required; advanced degree preferred.

• Minimum of 6+ years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial experience with at least 3+ years of oncology experience preferred, with demonstrated clinical acumen, strong commercial performance, and experience influencing treatment decisions in competitive markets; or relevant combination of commercial, education and life experience.

• Recent experience supporting oncology product launches preferred; NSCLC experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding sales goals within a defined territory.

• Strong understanding of the oncology marketplace, treatment landscape, customer environment, and account-based selling.

• Proven ability to analyze sales data, market trends, and customer insights to inform territory planning and execution.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with regional leadership and cross-functional partners, with demonstrated accountability, adaptability, and proactive problem solving.

• Strong business acumen, organizational skills, strategic territory planning, data-driven decision making, and ability to prioritize within a dynamic launch environment.

• Strong understanding of FDA, OIG, and industry compliance requirements governing the promotion of prescription drugs, with a track record of operating with the highest ethical standards.

• Proficiency with CRM platforms and data analytics tools (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce) to track activity, segment accounts, and measure performance.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and virtual meeting and presentation tools.

• Valid driver's license and a clean driving record; ability to travel within the assigned geography.

• Willingness and ability to travel as required by territory design and business needs, including overnight travel and weekend exhibits and conventions.

Preferred Experience:

• Experience with immuno-oncology, targeted therapy, or novel biologic agents (e.g., PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors, bispecific antibodies) preferred.

• Working knowledge of biomarker and molecular testing pathways, including EGFR and other actionable alterations in NSCLC, and how they inform treatment selection.

• Demonstrated ability to build and sustain relationships with key opinion leaders, thoracic oncologists, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary tumor board participants across academic and community settings.

• Experience navigating complex oncology accounts, including academic medical centers, health systems, and integrated delivery networks, with an understanding of formulary, reimbursement, and buy-and-bill dynamics.

• Knowledge of the oncology access and reimbursement landscape, including payer policies, prior authorization, specialty pharmacy, and patient support services.

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$210,000—$220,000 USD

This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The job leads technical workstreams and contributes to program outcomes by developing actionable methods and analyses, collaborating with cross‑functional partners to integrate technical solutions throughout the lifecycle, and advising on complex technical decisions and risks.

Designs site-level processes and improvements by defining operating ranges, critical parameters, and acceptance criteria that support efficient, high-quality production.

Lead HVAC start-up, commissioning, and qualification activities, including equipment start-up, testing and balancing, controls verification, commissioning, cleanroom certification, environmental performance testing, qualification protocol execution, deviation resolution, punch-list management, and turnover of systems from the project organization to site operations.

Establish and manage the HVAC operating and maintenance program following system turnover, including standard operating procedures, preventive and predictive maintenance, HEPA filter management, calibration requirements, alarm management, critical spare parts, operator/technician training, system monitoring, and ongoing cleanroom certification and requalification activities.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Services
jobs.description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

The Platform Services team builds self-service platform products that simplify how development teams interact with infrastructure. Its goal is to let teams focus on delivering business value rather than on platform integrations and infrastructure complexity. Examples include:

Access Management – Work towards a single source of truth for who can do what at DRW. Simplify engineering's approach to Identity and Access Management (IAM) by providing a platform that can be used to manage access across DRW's proprietary and third-party systems.

Limit Monitoring – Create a platform for defining and monitoring firmwide trading limits across domains like Risk, Treasury, and Compliance.

Data Tables – Provide a best-of-breed service for managing lightweight datasets, with built-in support for temporal (point-in-time) data, access controls, APIs, and front end.

Usage – Normalize the collection, storage, and presentation of usage data to provide insight into how services and data are being used and why.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will define, develop, and own services that form the foundation of DRW's Unified Platform.

Key Responsibilities:

• Architect and deliver complex features end-to-end with minimal oversight.

• Turn high-level requirements into solutions, drawing on a deep understanding of the business.

• Maintain a constant focus on testing, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

• Design systems, model data, and write code across a variety of languages and technologies.

• Evolve legacy code alongside greenfield development.

• Learn and promote new technologies with a focus on best practices.

• Engage in on-call and production support activities.

• Contribute to system and architecture design discussions.

• Challenge ideas and participate in defining the path forward.

Required Qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience in server-side development using major programming languages such as Java, Ruby, Python, Clojure, or C#.

• Strong understanding of system and architecture design principles, especially in the context of distributed systems.

• Ability to own projects, define requirements, and lead their development.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, with the capacity to work on both software development and support tasks.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Desirable Qualifications:

• Experience with Platform as a Service (PaaS) and the transformation of services into products.

• Experience with IAM concepts such as RBAC/ABAC, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, or SCIM.

• Experience with temporal data modeling and designing APIs consumed by other teams.

• Experience building real-time or event-driven systems.

The annual base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $275,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer, BizTech
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention.  We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.

Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.

Collaboration Products

The Collaboration Products team owns the enterprise systems that Airbnb's workforce relies on to plan, build, and deliver — including our Atlassian ecosystem, AI-powered tooling integrations, and custom-built engineering platforms. Our mission goes beyond keeping the lights on. We are moving fast to modernize our stack, retire technical debt, and integrate AI capabilities that directly multiply the productivity and quality of the teams we serve. We build with urgency, operate with rigor, and treat every system we touch as an opportunity to raise the bar on what BizTech delivers to Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Senior Systems Engineer is a hands-on technical leader who moves fast, builds to last, and uses AI as a force multiplier — not a future initiative. In this role, you will own the configuration, migration, and continuous improvement of Airbnb's Atlassian platforms, including leading the active deprecation of Jira Data Center and full transition to Jira Cloud. But your impact goes beyond administration. You will identify where AI and automation can compress delivery cycles, reduce toil, and improve the quality and reliability of the systems our workforce depends on — and then build those improvements, quickly. You bring the platform depth to architect scalable solutions and the judgment to know when to move fast and when to be deliberate. You are the kind of engineer who raises the velocity and quality of everyone around you.

A Typical Day:

• Serve as the primary SME and hands-on administrator for JiraCloud Software, JiraCloud Service Management (JSM), and associated Atlassian tooling; own configuration standards, governance, and technical debt reduction across the environment

• Architect and implement scalable Jira configurations including custom workflows, issue type hierarchies, permission schemes, notification schemes, screens, and field configurations aligned with Atlassian best practices

• Lead and execute Jira migrations - including Data Center to Cloud - coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver seamless cutover experiences

• Design and configure Jira Service Management projects including SLAs, custom queues, JSM Forms, approval workflows, and security schemes to support internal service delivery teams

• Build and maintain advanced analytics, dashboards, and reporting solutions using native tooling for Jira Cloud as a first line of options; Airbnb has elected to avoid Atlassian Marketplace products for information security, privacy & legal prerogatives. Airbnb is building custom Forge applications that will require your ongoing maintenance and partnership with supporting systems engineering teams.

• Configure and administer Atlassian access management, user lifecycle management, license tier optimization, and security posture improvements

• Evaluate if Atlassian Marketplace plugins architecture evolves to a point where Airbnb could consider adopting plugins where business needs dictate, and where security, legal, and privacy requirements are satisfied.

• Act as a strategic partner to business stakeholders by leading requirements-gathering sessions, translating business needs into technical designs, and proactively identifying opportunities for automation and process improvement

• Configure and expand Atlassian Rovo AI agents and automation rules; evaluate emerging AI/ML capabilities within the Atlassian ecosystem and champion responsible, contextually appropriate AI adoption aligned with Airbnb's mission

• Write and maintain custom automation rules using Jira's native Automation engine and JavaScript; leverage Jira REST API for integrations, data imports, and custom reporting

• Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) efforts for platform changes and migrations; develop and maintain test plans, test scripts, and defect tracking documentation

• Facilitate Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, standups) as needed; operate as Scrum Master or Product Owner for platform-focused workstreams

• Document system configurations, runbooks, and knowledge base articles to support operational continuity and enable self-service across the organization

• Participate in on-call rotation and provide escalation support for critical Atlassian platform issues

Your Expertise:

• 7+ years of hands-on Atlassian administration experience, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (across JiraCloud & JiraDC) in enterprise environments with large user populations

• Deep expertise in Jira workflow design, including post functions, validators, conditions, and custom properties; strong command of JQL for filters, subscriptions, dashboards, and board configuration

• Proven experience leading Jira migrations (Data Center to Cloud), including project configuration migration, macro compatibility, and data integrity validation

• Experience configuring and administering Jira Cloud native tooling for capacity planning and portfolio reporting

• Proficiency with Atlassian Marketplace plugins including JavaScripting

• Hands-on experience with Jira REST API using tools like Postman (GET/PUT/POST) for data extraction, integration, and custom reporting workflows

• Experience integrating Atlassian tools with identity providers via LDAP & Okta; familiarity with user lifecycle management, license governance, and security hardening practices

• Working knowledge of Atlassian Rovo and AI/ML capabilities within the Atlassian ecosystem; ability to configure Rovo agents with careful consideration for AI ethics, value alignment, and contextual appropriateness

• Experience configuring Jira Automation rules (native and scripting-based); working knowledge of JavaScripting and JSON for custom automation

• Strong background in Jira Service Management including SLA configuration, JSM Forms, custom queues, and approval workflows

• Experience leading UAT for complex migrations and platform changes; proficiency in developing and executing test plans, test scripts, and defect documentation

• Familiarity with SAFe Agile (SAFe Agilist and/or SAFe Scrum Master certification a plus); experience as Scrum Master or Product Owner for technical workstreams

• Strong analytical and communication skills with a demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience working in a remote-first, high-growth environment; ability to independently manage multiple priorities and keep stakeholders informed

• Familiarity with complementary enterprise tools such as Slack, Asana, Figma, Airtable, and Miro is an advantage

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$164,000—$193,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

jobs.title: Vice President of Partnership Sales
jobs.description:
The Denver Broncos are one of the most popular franchises in all of sports. Whether judged by the measure of wins and championships, attendance, national television exposure or by the Broncos' reputation locally and throughout the NFL, there are few parallels in the world of professional sports. We are dedicated to being the best team to cheer for, play for, and work for across all of sports. We are looking for employees who are passionate about what they do, have fun doing it, and proud to represent the Denver Broncos Football Club and Empower Field at Mile High.

Job Summary

The Denver Broncos Football Club is seeking a Vice President of Partnership Sales to lead the Partnership Sales team and turn the Club’s new-business strategy into results. This is a distinctive opportunity to leverage the NFL platform, the strength of the Broncos brand, and the dynamic Denver market while helping shape partnership opportunities tied to a potential new stadium and mixed-use development as plans evolve.

Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, this hands-on sales leader and accomplished dealmaker will develop talent, establish disciplined sales practices, and maintain an active personal pipeline—directly originating, advancing, negotiating, and closing complex, high-value, multi-year partnerships. The role also includes serving as senior deal strategist for priority team opportunities, driving pipeline health and forecasting accuracy, and collaborating across the organization to create commercially sound partnerships aligned with the Broncos’ brand and values. Success requires strong sales leadership, executive communication, sound judgment, and the ability to balance personal dealmaking with coaching and team development while fostering a collaborative, inclusive, high-accountability culture.

VALUES & LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS

• Stakeholder Driven: Build trust, create clarity, develop talent, and align stakeholders around shared outcomes in an inclusive, high-accountability environment.

• Growth and Innovation Mindset: Lead with humility and curiosity, challenge assumptions, and continually improve sales strategy, process, and performance.

• Grit and Resiliency: Navigate ambiguity, competitive pressure, and changing priorities with composure, adaptability, and resolve.

• Strive for Excellence / Do the Right Thing: Model preparation, sound judgment, financial discipline, transparency, and decisions grounded in the organization’s best interests.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Sales Leadership and Execution

• Translate annual new-business goals into a focused sales plan and clear team priorities.

• Maintain an active personal pipeline and directly originate, advance, negotiate, and close complex, high-value, multi-year partnerships.

• Serve as senior deal strategist for priority team opportunities, strengthening discovery, positioning, negotiation, and executive engagement.

• Drive Partnership Sales pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, deal quality, risk assessment, velocity, and reporting.

• Develop recommendations on category priorities, packaging, valuation, and commercially sound deal terms through established approval processes.

• Use market intelligence, audience insights, competitive trends, and emerging categories to sharpen prospecting strategies, sales narratives, proposals, and presentations.

• Build and maintain senior-level relationships with brands, agencies, and industry stakeholders.

Team Leadership and Culture

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Partnership Sales team, including direct oversight of sellers and sales leaders.

• Create a culture of trust, accountability, collaboration, preparation, inclusion, and results, supported by candid communication and shared ownership.

• Set clear expectations, provide timely feedback, recognize contributions, and address performance or behavior gaps promptly and fairly.

• Support hiring and onboarding and identify practical development opportunities for the Partnership Sales team.

• Coach sellers and sales leaders to strengthen sales execution, build trusted relationships, and collaborate effectively across the organization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Partnership Marketing to align inventory, valuation, activation feasibility, portfolio considerations, and the partner experience.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Stadium Operations, Ticketing, Legal, Finance, Strategy, and other stakeholders to build integrated solutions and navigate competing priorities.

• Provide senior leadership with concise, transparent updates on pipeline performance, bookings, priority opportunities, emerging risks, and resource needs.

• Represent the Partnership Sales function at games, events, relevant league meetings, industry forums, and partner engagements.

Future Stadium and Development Opportunities

• Bring partnership sales expertise to potential future stadium and mixed-use development opportunities as plans evolve.

• Translate emerging venue concepts, inventory, and experiences into market-informed opportunities, including potential naming rights, founding partnerships, and other integrated platforms.

• Support prospect prioritization and go-to-market planning while considering implications for the current portfolio.

• Provide partnership sales input to ownership, internal leaders, advisors, and project stakeholders, adapting recommendations as scope, approvals, sequencing, and timing change.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Typically 10+ years of progressive consultative, enterprise-level sales or business development experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience, including meaningful sales leadership experience.

• Demonstrated success leading high-performing sales teams and originating, negotiating, and closing complex, seven-figure or larger, multi-year partnerships.

• Experience managing pipelines, forecasts, sales analytics, and executive-level reporting.

• Ability to attend Broncos home games and other business events, including nights and weekends, with reasonable accommodations, as applicable.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND ABILITIES

• Clear executive communication, sound judgment, consistency, self-awareness, humility, and a demonstrated ability to build trust and lead through change.

• Strong coaching capability and a record of recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent.

• Deep understanding of sponsorship sales, valuation, category strategy, integrated partnerships, and portfolio management.

• Experience with naming rights, founding partnerships, major venue projects, or mixed-use development is helpful but not required.

• Strong command of CRM platforms, forecasting tools, sales analytics, and disciplined operating processes.

• High business acumen, creativity, financial judgment, organization, and adaptability in a fast-paced environment.

Compensation

In accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, the expected salary range for this position is $225,000- $275,000.

Benefits

The Denver Broncos Football Club offers a competitive benefits package to eligible employees. Benefit offerings may include medical, dental, and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts; company-paid life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid parental leave; tickets to Broncos home games; NFL apparel discounts; and other employee perks.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Utilities
jobs.description:
New to North Carolina. Known for pursuing breakthroughs in medicine.

Ready to join our team?

At AbbVie, we bring together talented people and innovative science to develop medicines that help patients. Now, we’re bringing that commitment to Durham, North Carolina, with a new manufacturing campus that will expand our ability to produce medicines and create opportunities in the Research Triangle.

The campus will integrate advanced manufacturing, laboratory technologies and AI to support the production of immunology, oncology and neuroscience medicines. The first phase will include manufacturing facilities, next-generation laboratories, a warehouse, administrative offices and employee wellness facilities.

To learn more about this investment, please visit https://www.abbvie.com/abbvie-north-carolina-manufacturing.html

We are now recruiting our Sr. Manager Utilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The job leads technical workstreams and contributes to program outcomes by developing actionable methods and analyses, collaborating with cross‑functional partners to integrate technical solutions throughout the lifecycle, and advising on complex technical decisions and risks.

Designs site-level processes and improvements by defining operating ranges, critical parameters, and acceptance criteria that support efficient, high-quality production.

Leads process improvement and optimization workstreams, defining the technical approach, coordinating trial execution with production, and documenting results.

Conducts process validation and troubleshooting for manufacturing processes manufacturing processes by analyzing performance data, investigating deviations, and drafting corrective actions and supporting documentation for review and approval

Establishes technical standards for process documentation and change execution, ensuring methods, assumptions, and evidence are complete.

Guides engineers through technical decisions by running working sessions, documenting decision logic, and tracking actions to closure.

Delivers high‑quality technical outputs for complex projects and programs; defines and validates methods, documents results and key assumptions, ensures adherence to applicable standards and controls, and communicates technical progress, impacts and recommended mitigations to project leads and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Executive Oncology Account Manager (Columbus)
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Location: Columbus, OH  (Field Based)

Overview of Role:

The Executive Oncology Account Manager (OAM) will be responsible for driving the successful launch and commercialization of ivonescimab within an assigned U.S. territory. Reporting to a Regional Business Director (RBD), this individual contributor role is accountable for developing and executing territory-level business plans, building strong customer relationships, and achieving sales objectives in alignment with national and regional commercial strategies.

The Executive Oncology Account Manager will engage oncology customers across community practices, academic centers, integrated delivery networks, and other key accounts to support appropriate product education and access. This role will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, and regional leadership, to deliver a best-in-class customer experience and support business performance.

• Plan and conduct compliant customer interactions, including in-person and virtual engagements, speaker programs, business reviews, and other approved promotional activities.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Minimum of 6+ years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial experience with at least 3+ years of oncology experience preferred, with demonstrated clinical acumen, strong commercial performance, and experience influencing treatment decisions in competitive markets; or relevant combination of commercial, education and life experience.

• Recent experience supporting oncology product launches preferred; NSCLC experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding sales goals within a defined territory.

• Proven ability to analyze sales data, market trends, and customer insights to inform territory planning and execution.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with regional leadership and cross-functional partners, with demonstrated accountability, adaptability, and proactive problem solving.

• Strong business acumen, organizational skills, strategic territory planning, data-driven decision making, and ability to prioritize within a dynamic launch environment.

Preferred Experience:

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Pioneer Desktop
jobs.description:
About SewerAI Corporation

SewerAI is transforming underground infrastructure management through AI-powered inspection and risk analysis. Our platform helps contractors, engineering firms, and utilities unlock valuable insights from sewer inspection data—turning hours of manual video review into actionable intelligence in minutes. After doubling our customer base over the past year, we’re now entering an exciting phase of accelerated growth.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to develop Pioneer Desktop alongside the Truck team lead. It's an Electron app: our React web app, Pioneer, runs inside a desktop shell that talks to the truck's hardware. The operator drives the camera, records video, reads distance and incline from the crawler controller, codes defects to NASSCO standards, and syncs the inspection to the cloud once the truck has signal.

Trucks are a hard place to run software. They run on hardware we don't choose, from many manufacturers, often with no internet connection. The operator isn't a software person and has a crew waiting. If a recording fails, someone drives back to the manhole.

Working with the Truck team lead, you'll contribute across the desktop runtime: hardware integrations, video recording, offline storage, sync, crash diagnostics, and the release pipeline that gets software updates onto trucks safely.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Working alongside the Truck team lead, you'll:

 - Connect Pioneer Desktop to inspection cameras, truck equipment and sensors

 - Make video recording reliable and inspection data safe, even without internet access

 - Improve cloud sync, app stability and software updates for trucks in the field

 - Work with Product, Design and the web team to make operators' workflows simpler

 - Help resolve customer issues and visit trucks and hardware vendors to understand how the software is used


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 5+ years building production software, including real time on desktop or hardware-connected applications.

 - You've shipped a desktop app (Electron, Tauri, Qt, WPF or native Windows) to users you can't SSH into. Auto-update, code signing and crash reporting are familiar ground.

 - Your TypeScript is strong, and you understand the Electron process model: main, renderer, preload and utility processes, and what belongs in each.

 - You've talked to hardware: serial protocols, byte framing, checksums, flaky USB and drivers that behave differently on every machine.

 - You can debug on Windows. You know your way around file locks, path and locale quirks, Event Viewer, Process Monitor and PowerShell.

 - You design for failure. You assume the disk fills up, the network drops, and Windows kills the process halfway through a write.

 - You can take a log from a customer you'll never meet and work out what happened.

 - You have strong product fundamentals: you understand user needs, weigh tradeoffs, and focus on solving the right problem for operators.

 - You explain technical problems in plain language to operators and field supervisors, and you listen when they describe a bug in their own words.

 - You follow through. When a truck in another state can't record, you work with the Truck team lead and your teammates to investigate the issue and see the fix through.

 - You use AI coding tools every day to optimize your workflow.


TECHNICAL SKILLS

 - TypeScript

 - Node.js

 - Electron

 - React

 - Browser media APIs

 - ffmpeg

 - Understanding of serial communication

 - Database fundamentals

 - Windows internals and PowerShell

 - Desktop app testing (Playwright for Electron, Vitest)

 - AWS

 - CI/CD (GitHub Actions)


NICE TO HAVE

 - C#/.NET, DirectShow or Media Foundation

 - Rust and WebAssembly

 - Crash analysis: minidumps, Crashpad or Breakpad, symbol servers

 - Windows installers and fleet management: WiX/MSI, Squirrel, Intune, SCCM

 - Code signing: Authenticode, EV certificates, cloud KMS

 - Video capture and encoding: H.264, capture cards, RTSP

 - GPS, NMEA and geospatial data

 - NASSCO standards (PACP/MACP/LACP) and sewer inspection data

 - CCTV inspection trucks, crawler controllers or other industrial hardware

 - Municipal utility, contractor or infrastructure customers


WHAT YOU'LL GAIN

 - The chance to help build a product that crews depend on every working day, working alongside the Truck team lead

 - Work that spans bytes on a serial wire, video pipelines, Windows installers and React UI

 - A short path from code to impact: you'll hear from the operators who use your release

 - Growth in a fast-moving company where you'll write processes as well as code


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Base salary: $150,000–$205,000, plus equity

 - Medical, dental, vision, basic life and 401(k)

 - Unlimited PTO

This role requires about 5-10% travel for truck visits, customer go-lives and team offsites.


WHY JOIN SEWERAI?



JOIN THE FASTEST-GROWING TEAM IN WASTEWATER TECH AND HELP MODERNIZE CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE WITH AI. YOU’LL OWN HIGH-VISIBILITY PROJECTS, INFLUENCE HOW OUR BRAND MEETS THE MARKET, AND SEE YOUR WORK DRIVE MEASURABLE IMPACT FOR CUSTOMERS AND COMMUNITIES.
