jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Media Intelligence
jobs.description:
Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.

Our AI-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action.

Founder-controlled and growing  profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives.

We're growing quickly and looking for a confident, driven Enterprise Account Executive with experience selling media intelligence, media monitoring, social listening, communications technology, or other complex enterprise SaaS solutions. In this role, you'll be responsible for winning new enterprise customers, generating pipeline, and driving revenue growth across a territory of strategic accounts.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll partner with communications, PR, corporate affairs, and marketing leaders to help them modernize how they monitor, measure, and understand their media impact. We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at navigating complex enterprise sales cycles, and has a proven track record of building executive relationships, managing multiple stakeholders, and closing high-value SaaS opportunities. If you enjoy uncovering business challenges, delivering consultative solutions, and competing to win new business, you'll be a great fit for this role. You'll join a tenured team of enterprise sellers who share what works, coach each other, and expect every new teammate to raise the bar.

What you'll do:

• Serve as the primary point of contact and fully manage an Enterprise territory account list

• Achieve sales goals and maintain the activity needed to build a healthy pipeline

• Prospect for self-generated opportunities within your book of business to build highly qualified and credible pipeline, and respond to inbound demo requests

• Lead tailored Muck Rack product demonstrations at meetings, on calls, and at events, connecting platform capabilities to customer challenges and business outcomes

• Navigate complex enterprise sales cycles, engaging multiple stakeholders and executive decision-makers throughout the buying process

• Negotiate contracts and close new enterprise business

• Forecast your pipeline accurately and own your number in weekly reviews

• Partner with Onboarding, Success, and the CAE team for a clean handoff after close

• Share what's working with the team and learn from what's working for others

How success will be measured in this role:

• Individual revenue goal and new enterprise customer acquisition

• Pipeline generation and prospecting activity

• Metrics such as ACV, qualified win rate, and cross-sell attachment

• Forecast accuracy

If the details below describe you, you could be a great fit for this role:

• 5+ years of quota-carrying Account Executive experience in SaaS, with at least 2–3 years closing new enterprise logos. Experience selling media intelligence, media monitoring, social listening, communications technology, reputation management, or related insights platforms is a strong plus

• Demonstrated success selling either comparable media intelligence/communications technology platforms or complex enterprise SaaS solutions involving multiple stakeholders, longer sales cycles, and executive-level decision-makers

• Experience in a full-cycle sales role, including prospecting, pipeline generation, territory management, opportunity management, and closing new business

• Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a SaaS sales environment, with demonstrated success closing new business and managing high-value opportunities

• Self-motivated, competitive, and driven by results

• Invested in continuous professional development and growth as a sales professional and industry expert

• Natural relationship builder who is personable, patient, dependable, and skilled at establishing trust with prospective customers

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong executive presence and the ability to lead confident, consultative conversations and presentations

• Dedicated to understanding customer challenges and aligning solutions to measurable business outcomes

• Proven ability to build pipeline from scratch and win new logos against established competitors

• Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including executive discovery, tailored product demonstrations, competitive evaluations, procurement, negotiation, and close

• Accurate forecaster who can explain why a deal is real and what will move it forward

• Ability to coordinate internal resources, including subject matter experts, product specialists, and sales support personnel throughout the sales process

• Experience successfully selling subscription-based software platforms and associated services

• Ability to quickly learn new industries, understand different buyer personas, and translate complex technology into compelling business value

• Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, CPQ systems, Slack, and Google Workspace, with a willingness to quickly learn new technologies

• Proactively incorporate AI tools into day-to-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery

• Coachable, curious, and generous with teammates. You make the people around you better

Interview Overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

• 30 min interview with a member of our Talent Team

• A 1 hour zoom interview with the hiring manager

• Peer interviews with several team members

• 30-minute executive interview

• 30-minute Bar Raiser

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary

In the US, the base salary for this role ranges from $99,000 and $110,000+ with on target earnings of $200,000+. Note that we typically build 1-3 quarters of ramp time with lower goals and thus lower earnings from commissions. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location. For all other countries, we have competitive pay bands based on market standards.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Why Muck Rack?

Remote Work, Forever

• Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup

• Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership

• Virtual and in-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions)

Transparent & Fair Compensation

• Competitive geo-neutral pay in the U.S.

• Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment

• Standardized bonus or commission structure

• 401(k) with employer contributions

• Equity opportunities

Health & Wellness

• Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents

• 100% premium coverage for individuals on high-deductible plans

• 24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program

• Employer-funded HSA contributions and other pre-tax benefits

• Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription

Time Off & Family Benefits

• 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days

• 13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days

• Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

Learning and Development

• Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion

• Bi-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training

• Unlimited access to Coursera and O’Reilly

• 2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

• Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives

• Agile, founder-led company focused on collaboration and innovation

• Trusted by 3,000+ companies worldwide

Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.

While we are a fully distributed team, we do have limitations on where we can hire and maintain a list of acceptable working locations based on job function. If we are unable to hire in your current location for the role for which you applied, you will be notified via email. While we enjoy many benefits as a permanently distributed and remote company, we cannot always support relocation or extended travel and have guidelines in place to ensure compliant work away from your designated permanent residence.

#LI-Remote

Please note: For detailed information regarding our GDPR and/or CCPA compliance policies, including how we handle personal data and privacy rights, kindly refer to the email correspondence accompanying this application.

Muck Rack does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or any other third parties. Any unsolicited resume sent to Muck Rack will be considered Muck Rack property, and Muck Rack will not pay a fee should it hire the subject of any unsolicited resume.

Muck Rack considers applicants for all positions on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs, and without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, alienage or citizenship status, ancestry, marital status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, familial status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Note to applicants/job seekers: We have recently been made aware of scams impersonating Muck Rack’s HR team. Please be cautious of these attempts to elicit banking or other financial or sensitive information. Muck Rack will never request financial information during the interview process, and follow ups for interviews or next steps will always come from an ‘@muckrack.com’ email address. If you are contacted by anyone from a different domain who claims to be from Muck Rack, please forward the communication to legal@muckrack.com.

jobs.title: Global AML Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT


You'll strengthen Airwallex's global AML/CTF framework so the business can grow safely across markets, products, and payment flows. You'll develop and maintain risk-based policies, processes, controls, and guidance covering customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, beneficial ownership, transaction monitoring, sanctions-related financial crime controls, and higher-risk customer management. You'll translate regulatory developments and financial crime risks into practical requirements, partnering with Product, Risk, Data, Engineering, Operations, Compliance Technology, and regional compliance teams to improve onboarding, screening, monitoring, payment, and case-management workflows. You'll support escalated customer, account, and transaction reviews, regulatory examinations, partner bank inquiries, audits, governance reporting, training, remediation, and continuous improvement across the global programme. 

This is a remote role based in Dallas, Texas.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Essentials

 - 7+ years of experience in AML/CTF, financial crime compliance, or a related risk or regulatory function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or a similarly complex regulated environment.

 - Demonstrated understanding of AML/CTF laws, regulations, enforcement trends, and industry practices across multiple jurisdictions.

 - Experience supporting or managing AML programme components such as customer risk assessment, customer due diligence, enhanced due diligence, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity investigations, or sanctions-related financial crime controls.

 - Experience working with customer onboarding, transaction monitoring, screening, case-management, or other compliance technology, including alert review, case disposition, or control enhancement processes.

 - Ability to assess complex customer profiles, commercial transactions, products, and cross-border payment flows and identify practical, risk-based recommendations.

 - Strong written communication, analytical, project management, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across a global programme.
   
   

Preferred

 - CAMS or an equivalent globally recognised AML or financial crime compliance credential.

 - Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, correspondent banks, financial institution partners, or other external stakeholders on AML/CTF matters.

 - Experience in fintech and payments, including cross-border payments, virtual accounts, multi-currency wallets, or multi-entity regulated groups.

 - Experience partnering with Product, Data, Engineering, or Operations teams to embed AML/CTF requirements into automated workflows, dashboards, or other technology-enabled compliance tools.
   
   


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You've operated in a compliance-heavy environment and know how to move fast without cutting the corners that matter.

 - You're comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

 - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

 - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

 - You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.
   
   


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.




APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Director, Business Development - Land Warfare & Air Defense
jobs.location: Arlington, Virginia, United States; Fort Worth, Texas; San Luis Obispo, California, United States; United States
jobs.description:
At Zone 5 Technologies, we're redefining what's possible in precision weapons and unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). Our team of engineers and innovators are developing cutting-edge autonomous solutions to deliver affordable and scalable precision weapons, interceptors, and UAS.

We're building the next generation of munitions and unmanned systems for the United States and its allies. If you're driven by hard problems, energized by rapid innovation, and ready to make an impact on defense technology, you belong here.

Zone 5 Technologies is seeking a technically grounded Director of Business Development to lead the company's land warfare and air defense business for ground forces: counter-UAS, short-range air defense (SHORAD), close air support (CAS), and precision ground attack, anchored by the WHITE SPIKE counter-UAS interceptor and ground and surface-attack missile, the PEACEMAKER counter-UAS and multi-mission UAS, and the ECLIPSE counter-UAS and multi-mission UAS. This role is built for a U.S. Army or U.S. Marine Corps (USMC) ground-combat or attack aviation professional: an Air Defense Artillery (ADA), field artillery, or maneuver officer; a Joint Terminal Attack Controller (JTAC), Forward Air Controller (FAC), or Fire Support Officer (FSO); an AH-64 Apache or AH-1Z Viper attack pilot or Gray Eagle operator who has employed AGM-114 Hellfire and Joint Air-to-Ground Missile (JAGM) in support of ground forces; a Marine Aviation Weapons and Tactics Squadron One (MAWTS-1) Weapons and Tactics Instructor (WTI); or a counter-UAS and air-to-ground weapons acquisition and test leader who can speak fluently to layered base and maneuver-force defense, kinetic and non-kinetic effectors, command and control (C2) and sensor integration, and program-of-record pathways because they have fielded, tested, or operated these systems, not simply sold around them. Operational experience employing counter-UAS systems or air-to-ground missiles in combat or in large-force exercises is strongly desired in addition to the technical and acquisition background described below.

The Director will own the domestic land warfare and air defense pursuit portfolio, engaging directly with U.S. Army and USMC requirements owners, program offices, joint counter-UAS organizations, operational and test organizations, and government-funded research and development (R&D) organizations, and will serve as the senior technical sales authority and point of contact as relationships mature into substantive capability and integration discussions. This individual's operational and engineering credibility will be leveraged to strengthen capture strategy and proposal development, ensuring technical narratives are accurate, defensible, and compelling. The role requires close, sustained cross-functional integration to keep messaging, positioning, and pursuit strategy aligned across the company.

The Director is the accountable owner of the land warfare and air defense pipeline: the Director sets probability of win (Pwin) and probability of go (Pgo) assessments, makes bid/no-bid recommendations directly to executive leadership, serves as capture lead with direction over the proposal and technical staff assigned to each pursuit, and is the company's accountable voice to U.S. Army and USMC customers for this portfolio. Within 24 months, the Director is expected to have advanced at least one WHITE SPIKE, PEACEMAKER, or ECLIPSE pursuit to a funded program-of-record transition or production contract with the U.S. Army or USMC and to have secured Zone 5 Technologies participation in at least one Joint Interagency Task Force 401 (JIATF-401), Army, or USMC counter-UAS, air defense, or attack aviation experimentation or live-fire campaign.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Business Development and Capture Leadership

• Own the land warfare and air defense opportunity pipeline, Pwin assessments, and Pgo assessments from identification through award; set pursuit priorities, capture strategy, and bid/no-bid recommendations for executive leadership.

• Serve as the subject matter expert on counter-UAS, SHORAD, CAS, and precision ground attack for ground forces, translating WHITE SPIKE, PEACEMAKER, and ECLIPSE into terms relevant to U.S. Army and USMC requirements, concepts of operations (CONOPS), tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTP), force-protection and maneuver-force air defense architectures, attack aviation and UAS weapons integration, and program-of-record maturation paths.

• Engage directly with U.S. Army requirements, acquisition, and test stakeholders, including JIATF-401, the Army Rapid Capabilities and Critical Technologies Office (RCCTO), Program Executive Office (PEO) Missiles and Space and its counter-UAS, Indirect Fire Protection Capability (IFPC), and Joint Attack Munition Systems (JAMS) project offices (AGM-114 Hellfire and JAGM), PEO Aviation (Apache and Gray Eagle weapons integration), Army Transformation and Training Command (T2COM), the Fires Center of Excellence (FCoE) and ADA School at Fort Sill, the Maneuver Center of Excellence (MCoE) at Fort Benning, the Aviation Center of Excellence at Fort Rucker, Army Applications Laboratory (AAL), U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command (DEVCOM) Aviation and Missile Center (AvMC), Redstone Test Center (RTC), and the Yuma Proving Ground (YPG) counter-UAS experimentation enterprise.

• Engage directly with USMC requirements, acquisition, and test stakeholders, including Marine Corps Warfighting Laboratory (MCWL), Combat Development and Integration (CD&I) and the Capabilities Development Directorate, Marine Corps Systems Command (MARCORSYSCOM), PEO Land Systems and the Ground Based Air Defense (GBAD) program, including Marine Air Defense Integrated System (MADIS) and Light-MADIS (L-MADIS), MAWTS-1 at Yuma, Marine Corps Tactics and Operations Group (MCTOG), the Low Altitude Air Defense (LAAD) battalions, I Marine Expeditionary Force (MEF) and III MEF, Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center (MCAGCC) Twentynine Palms, and Camp Pendleton.

• Engage joint and special operations stakeholders, including U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) Special Operations Forces Acquisition, Technology, and Logistics (SOF AT&L) and the SOF Counter-Unmanned Systems (SOF CUxS) enterprise, joint program offices, Defense Innovation Unit (DIU), and government-funded R&D organizations, including service laboratories, Federally Funded Research and Development Centers (FFRDCs), and University Affiliated Research Centers (UARCs), to identify emerging requirements and shape early opportunity development.

• Build and sustain relationships with operational, technical, and program stakeholders that position Zone 5 Technologies as a credible, informed partner rather than a transactional vendor.

• Track and interpret evolving adversary threats, including Group 1 through 3 UAS and one-way attack (OWA) munition employment, doctrine, force design, and acquisition strategy relevant to land-force counter-UAS, SHORAD, attack aviation, and precision ground attack.

International Sales Support

• Provide senior technical sales expertise to the international business development team, supporting partner-nation army, land-force, and army aviation engagements as they progress beyond introductory conversations into substantive Letter of Request (LOR), request for proposal (RFP), and integration discussions, especially those involving unique CONOPS or integration with non-U.S. C2, radar, vehicle, or rotary-wing platforms.

• Partner with international sales to tailor technical positioning of WHITE SPIKE, PEACEMAKER, and ECLIPSE to partner-nation land-force requirements, threat environments, and export considerations.

Proposal and Capture Execution

• Leverage operational and engineering background to lead technical volume development, win themes, and discriminator articulation on proposals across domestic and international pursuits.

• Serve as capture lead, directing proposal writers and technical contributors to ensure technical accuracy, credibility, and consistency across proposal, white paper, and request for information (RFI) and RFP responses.

• Lead development of technical exchange meetings (TEMs), capability briefings, and government stakeholder demonstrations, including live-fire, operational assessment, and joint counter-UAS experimentation events.

Cross-Functional Integration

• Maintain close, ongoing coordination with portfolio and engineering leadership to ensure business development activity reflects current product maturity, roadmap, and technical constraints.

• Partner with marketing on the development of technically accurate capability collateral, briefing materials, and messaging for land warfare, air defense, and attack aviation audiences.

• Coordinate with international sales leadership to align technical engagement strategy with country-level pursuit plans and export posture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior U.S. Army or USMC service (uniformed or civilian) in a land warfare or attack aviation role with direct counter-UAS, SHORAD, CAS, or air-to-ground missile exposure: ADA, field artillery, or maneuver; FSO, JTAC, or FAC; AH-64, AH-1Z, or Gray Eagle weapons employment; MAWTS-1 WTI; or a counter-UAS or air-to-ground weapons program office, test and evaluation, systems engineering, or operational fielding role. Operational employment experience in combat or large-force exercises is strongly desired.

• Deep technical understanding of the missions of interest to U.S. Army and USMC audiences: counter-UAS detect, track, identify, and defeat chains; SHORAD and maneuver-force air defense; CAS and joint fires; precision ground attack with AGM-114 Hellfire and JAGM-class weapons; kinetic, electronic warfare (EW), high-power microwave (HPM), and directed energy (DE) effectors; and integration with Forward Area Air Defense (FAAD) C2, Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS), and Team Awareness Kit (TAK), derived from a genuine operational and engineering background, not solely a sales career.

• Working knowledge of weapons integration and certification standards for ground-launched and rotary-wing and UAS-launched effectors: MIL-STD-1760 aircraft and store electrical interconnection, MIL-STD-1553 data bus, MIL-STD-3014 Universal Armament Interface (UAI), MIL-STD-1316 fuze safety, MIL-STD-2105 insensitive munitions and hazard assessment, MIL-STD-882 system safety, MIL-STD-810 environmental and MIL-STD-461 electromagnetic compatibility testing, MIL-STD-6016 Link 16 and Cursor-on-Target (CoT) messaging, and the airworthiness release process for Army and USMC rotary-wing and UAS platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to communicate credibly with engineers, program managers, and operators on system performance, integration, and employment considerations, and to brief at the general officer and Senior Executive Service (SES) level.

• Exceptional writing skills: demonstrated ability to produce clear, precise, and persuasive technical prose, including proposal volumes, white papers, capability statements, and correspondence for general officer, flag officer, and SES audiences, with minimal editing. Writing samples will be requested.

• Experience leading or writing technical content for proposals, capture efforts, or government-facing technical documentation; familiarity with Other Transaction Authority (OTA), Middle Tier of Acquisition (MTA), and traditional Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) and Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) pathways.

• Ability to travel 25 to 50 percent, domestically and internationally, to support client engagement, demonstrations, and industry events.

• Active U.S. Secret clearance required.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) clearance.

• Direct engineering, test, or operational experience with fielded land-force counter-UAS, SHORAD, and air-to-ground systems: the Mobile-Low, Slow, Small Unmanned Aircraft Integrated Defeat System (M-LIDS), MADIS and L-MADIS, Coyote, FAAD C2, IFPC, Maneuver-SHORAD (M-SHORAD), Stinger-based systems, AGM-114 Hellfire, JAGM, or Gray Eagle and Apache weapons integration; or with loitering munition and OWA systems.

• Operational deployment experience defending ground forces or fixed sites against Group 1 through 3 UAS and OWA threats, or delivering CAS and precision ground attack in support of maneuver forces.

• Graduate of the MAWTS-1 WTI course, the Army Aviation Tactics Instructor course, the Joint Firepower Course, or the ADA Captains Career Course; or graduate of the U.S. Army Experimental Test Pilot program or U.S. Navy (USN) Test Pilot School (TPS).

• Prior experience engaging government-funded R&D organizations, service laboratories, FFRDCs, or UARCs on emerging weapons system requirements.

• Experience supporting international or Foreign Military Sales (FMS) engagements alongside a business development team.

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering, systems, or physical science discipline; advanced degree a plus.

• Previous employment with DIU focused on counter-UAS or UAS systems.

• Previous employment within U.S. Army operational units (ADA, field artillery, maneuver, or attack aviation), operational test, developmental test, or rapid acquisition organizations: JIATF-401, RCCTO, PEO Missiles and Space counter-UAS, IFPC, and JAMS project offices, PEO Aviation, FCoE and ADA School, AAL, DEVCOM AvMC, RTC, or the YPG counter-UAS experimentation enterprise.

• Previous employment within USMC operational units (LAAD battalions, artillery regiments, infantry battalions, or attack helicopter squadrons), MCWL, CD&I, MARCORSYSCOM, PEO Land Systems GBAD, MAWTS-1, MCTOG, or the MADIS integration enterprise.

• USSOCOM SOF CUxS enterprise or Army Special Operations ground-force protection experience.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• Technical credibility: speaks the language of engineers and operators, not just program managers and contracting officers.

• Relationship building: establishes trust quickly with operational, technical, and program stakeholders across the services, R&D organizations, and partner nations.

• Cross-functional leadership: operates fluidly across portfolio, engineering, marketing, and international sales without losing message discipline, and sets direction for supporting business development and capture staff.

• Exceptional writing: produces clear, precise, decision-quality prose for proposals, white papers, and executive correspondence with minimal editing.

• Verbal communication: briefs general and flag officers, SES leaders, and partner-nation delegations with precision and brevity.

This role is eligible for performance bonuses in addition to the base salary.

Pay range for this role (base salary)

$138,000 — $178,000 USD

Pay range with eligible performance bonuses

$241,500 – $311,500 USDUSD with eligible performance bonuses. Bonus components are variable and not guaranteed.

Pay range for this role

$138,000—$178,000 USD

What's in it for you:

Benefits:

• Competitive total compensation package

• Comprehensive benefit package options include medical, dental, vision, life, and more.

• 401k with company-match

• 3 weeks of paid time off each year

• 40 hours of sick time

• 12 annual company holidays

Why Join Zone 5 Technologies?

• Innovative Environment: Work on cutting-edge technology that is shaping the future of defense and aerospace.

• Collaborative Culture: Join a team of passionate professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Career Growth: Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

If you are passionate about unmanned aircraft technology and want to be a part of a dynamic and growing company, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and join the Zone 5 Technologies team!

About the Team

The Strategic Finance team is responsible for shaping the company’s financial strategy and plays a critical role in capital allocation decisions to align financial goals with broader business and mission objectives.

The Strategic Finance Data Science function has four core priorities: (1) accurately and credibly forecast our key business and financial metrics; (2) ensure attainment of key targets; (3) support complex modeling and analyses for business decision-making; and (4) scale recurring work and analysis through automation and dashboarding.

About the Role

The Head of Data Science, Strategic Finance will partner closely with the rest of the Strategic Finance team as well as the Product and GTM Data Science organizations to execute on core business priorities. You will report to the VP of Strategic Finance and work closely with finance leadership to drive data driven decision-making, improve data fluency of those around you, and move the needle on financial outcomes. This is a managerial role. 

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop accurate forecasts for product usage and revenue, compute consumption and their underlying drivers, allowing for real-time tracking of key metrics performance and trajectory.

 - Become an expert in OAI’s data and systems, through partnership with Data Engineering, Finance, and other Data Science teams.

 - Design and deliver dashboards for key metrics that impact financial performance.

 - Lead metrics reviews with Strategic Finance and finance leadership to interpret trends from aforementioned dashboards and surface actionable insights.

 - Drive automation of standardized reporting, analysis, and processes across our various revenue segments and compute spend.

 - Build and mentor a high-performing team.

 - Support critical business decisions with ad hoc analysis as needed.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A MS/PhD in a quantitative discipline (Math, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Engineering, or CS).

 - 12+ years of experience in a Data Science role at a dynamic and outcome-driven organization.

 - Proficiency in critical analytical tools including SQL.

 - Extensive experience building production-ready models for time series applications.

 - Built adjustable and explainable forecast models for multiple planning cycles.

 - Experience conducting open-ended research projects on new forecasting methodologies.

 - Exemplary ability to distill complex financial information into actionable insights for leadership.

 - Excellent communication skills and “storytelling” ability when presenting data insights.

 - The ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. That means being flexible and willing to jump in and do whatever it takes to be successful.

 - Knowledge of Python.

 - Prior management experience.

jobs.title: Executive Oncology Account Manager (Ann Arbor)
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Location: Ann Arbor, MI  (Field Based)

Overview of Role:

The Executive Oncology Account Manager (OAM) will be responsible for driving the successful launch and commercialization of ivonescimab within an assigned U.S. territory. Reporting to a Regional Business Director (RBD), this individual contributor role is accountable for developing and executing territory-level business plans, building strong customer relationships, and achieving sales objectives in alignment with national and regional commercial strategies.

The Executive Oncology Account Manager will engage oncology customers across community practices, academic centers, integrated delivery networks, and other key accounts to support appropriate product education and access. This role will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, and regional leadership, to deliver a best-in-class customer experience and support business performance.

Role and Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute territory business plans to achieve sales objectives, market share goals, and product launch priorities within the assigned geography.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with oncology healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, practice administrators, and other relevant stakeholders.

• Effectively communicate product information, clinical value, and approved promotional messaging in accordance with company policies and compliance standards.

• Analyze territory performance, customer needs, market trends, and competitive dynamics to identify opportunities and adjust business plans accordingly.

• Partner with the Regional Business Director to align territory priorities with regional strategies, performance expectations, and launch execution plans.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial Operations, and other cross-functional partners to support customer engagement and business objectives.

• Provide customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market feedback to regional leadership and internal stakeholders.

• Plan and conduct compliant customer interactions, including in-person and virtual engagements, speaker programs, business reviews, and other approved promotional activities.

• Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer interactions, territory plans, expenses, and required administrative activities.

• Ensure all commercial activities are conducted in compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and applicable legal requirements.

• Manage territory travel, expenses, and resources responsibly.

• All other duties as assigned.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in business, life sciences, or related field required; advanced degree preferred.

• Minimum of 6+ years of pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial experience with at least 3+ years of oncology experience preferred, with demonstrated clinical acumen, strong commercial performance, and experience influencing treatment decisions in competitive markets; or relevant combination of commercial, education and life experience.

• Recent experience supporting oncology product launches preferred; NSCLC experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding sales goals within a defined territory.

• Strong understanding of the oncology marketplace, treatment landscape, customer environment, and account-based selling.

• Proven ability to analyze sales data, market trends, and customer insights to inform territory planning and execution.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with regional leadership and cross-functional partners, with demonstrated accountability, adaptability, and proactive problem solving.

• Strong business acumen, organizational skills, strategic territory planning, data-driven decision making, and ability to prioritize within a dynamic launch environment.

• Strong understanding of FDA, OIG, and industry compliance requirements governing the promotion of prescription drugs, with a track record of operating with the highest ethical standards.

• Proficiency with CRM platforms and data analytics tools (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce) to track activity, segment accounts, and measure performance.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and virtual meeting and presentation tools.

• Valid driver's license and a clean driving record; ability to travel within the assigned geography.

• Willingness and ability to travel as required by territory design and business needs, including overnight travel and weekend exhibits and conventions.

Preferred Experience:

• Experience with immuno-oncology, targeted therapy, or novel biologic agents (e.g., PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors, bispecific antibodies) preferred.

• Working knowledge of biomarker and molecular testing pathways, including EGFR and other actionable alterations in NSCLC, and how they inform treatment selection.

• Demonstrated ability to build and sustain relationships with key opinion leaders, thoracic oncologists, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary tumor board participants across academic and community settings.

• Experience navigating complex oncology accounts, including academic medical centers, health systems, and integrated delivery networks, with an understanding of formulary, reimbursement, and buy-and-bill dynamics.

• Knowledge of the oncology access and reimbursement landscape, including payer policies, prior authorization, specialty pharmacy, and patient support services.

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$210,000—$220,000 USD

jobs.title: Account Executive, Flexport Capital
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Account Executive, Flexport Capital

Flexport helps more than 10,000 clients and suppliers lead all aspects of their supply chain operations. Each of these customers faces significant working capital burdens that hamper their ability to grow their businesses. Since inception, Flexport Capital has provided over $2 billion in loans to Flexport customers to address these needs. Our non-dilutive capital products empower businesses to grow and bridge their working capital needs while maintaining ownership and control. As a start-up within a start-up, we’re developing unique fintech products that leverage the resources and data of Flexport’s platform for global trade. We are seeking an entrepreneurial and financially savvy individual to join our tight-knit team.

The Opportunity: Flexport Capital is Flexport’s financing arm, offering inventory and logistics financing, asset-based lending, term loans, and working capital products to Flexport clients. As an Account Executive, you will own the full end-to-end sales cycle for Flexport Capital, from sourcing, prospecting, negotiation, underwriting coordination, and close. You will build and manage your own growing book of business. You will serve as the primary commercial voice for your customers, acting as a financial consultant and strategic advisor to founders, CFOs, and finance teams seeking working capital solutions. You will work directly with Credit, Product, and Legal as a peer partner, shaping product development and go-to-market strategy based on real market feedback. You’ll play a critical role in scaling Flexport Capital’s market presence and establishing it as the go-to financing partner for growth stage businesses. You’ll own building the sales playbook that drives this growth, with full autonomy over your territory and clear upside as you scale.

You Will:

• Own the full end-to-end sales cycle for your territory, from sourcing and prospecting through deal structuring, underwriting coordination, closing, and early relationship management.

• Build and own a growing book of business with direct revenue accountability. You'll win new customers, expand relationships as they scale, and identify cross-sell opportunities within your territory.

• Serve as the commercial relationship owner for your clients. You'll negotiate terms, structure deals, and coordinate with Credit through underwriting to close.

• Use Flexport's supply chain data as a commercial advantage. By analyzing shipment patterns, volume spikes, transit times, and invoice data, you can identify when customers need capital and turn those signals into targeted actions to drive sustainable growth.

• Drive strategic initiatives related to growth strategy, sales motions, and capital markets partnerships that expand Flexport Capital's market position.

• Leverage Flexport's freight and omni capabilities to create working capital solutions that deepen customer relationships, increase wallet share, and win deals competitors can't.

You Should Have:

• Experience - 6+ years of experience in sales/sales development for a financial services and/or a technology company. Previous startup experience is a plus.

• Financial & Credit Acumen - Fluency in working capital structures, financial statement analysis, and lending mechanics. You can read and interpret P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flow statements to assess customer needs. You'll be expected to recommend appropriate lending structures and create tailored working capital solutions for each prospect based on their business model and financing needs.

• Full-cycle sales execution - You’ve owned deals from prospect through close. You understand pipeline management, deal structuring, and how to navigate complex sales cycles. You’ve hit and exceeded quota consistently.

• Communication & Presence - Excellent communication and executive presence. You can build trusted relationships with Founders, CEOs, CFOs, and Finance Directors. You navigate senior-level conversations with ease and represent your company credibly with C-suite buyers.

• Commercial drive and ownership - You’re motivated by building and growing a business. You think like an owner, take accountability for outcomes, and proactively solve problems to move deals forward.

• Strategic business sense - You see beyond individual deals. You understand market trends, competitive threats, and identify customer needs that create product/GTM opportunities.

• Data & Tools - Proficiency in Salesforce, Excel, Claude, and other data tools. Ability to design dashboards and reporting frameworks to track pipeline growth and buying signals.

jobs.title: Line Lead for Cosmetic Paint Repair - Chesterfield, VA
jobs.description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

Hours: 6am-3pm Monday - Friday - overtime may be required some Saturdays

Pay rate: $20-$27/hr.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for paint repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Mid-Market
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the full commercial relationship and customer’s success across a book of 50 to 100 mid-market accounts - the builders, founders, and product teams at companies between 250 and 2,000 employees who are defining what AI-native experiences look, feel, and sound like. Your job is to make sure every one of them is getting real value, expanding into new products, and renewing with conviction.

This is a high-agency, high-impact role. You won't succeed by managing accounts one at a time - you'll build the systems, playbooks, and motions that let you drive meaningful outcomes across a diverse book while going deep with the accounts that have the most room to grow. If you love the challenge of being a true partner to your customers without losing commercial sharpness, this role was built for you.

On the ground, you'll be in the product with customers - advising on agent design, voice customization, conversation flows, integrations, and using data and logs to spot friction before customers do. You're the person who connects what's working technically to what's growing commercially and partnering closely with high growth accounts to help them achieve value.

Success of the customer and commercial ownership go hand in hand and are at the core of this role. You own NRR across your managed book of business, you drive cross-sell into ElevenLabs' expanding product suite, and you lead renewals end to end. The best AMs at ElevenLabs don't just retain customers, they grow with them.




COMPENSATION

This role offers a competitive on target earnings (OTE) structure with a split of 70% base and 30% variable. Variable compensation is weighted 70% net revenue retention (NRR) and 30% product cross sell. Cross-sell performance counts toward NRR, so strong expansion compounds across both components. Quota is set on managed ARR, giving you clear ownership over a defined book of business. The plan includes accelerators for above target NRR performance and is designed to reward account managers who grow with their customers, not just retain them. Variable compensation is paid on a quarterly basis.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 3 to 5 years of Account Management or Customer Success experience in B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products - you know what great looks like and you've delivered it in a complex, fast-moving environment

 - A proven track record of owning revenue outcomes end to end - quota, renewals, and expansion - without defaulting to a handoff to a sales team

 - You approach your book with commercial intent: you segment by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers

 - You can hold a technical conversation with a developer or engineering team and earn their trust - familiarity with AI concepts, API integrations, and SDKs is a must

 - You use product data to stay ahead of your accounts - spotting health signals, identifying expansion opportunities, and getting in front of risk before it becomes churn

 - You know how to read a room - whether you're with a founder, a technical lead, or a procurement team, you show up with the right message and leave with the relationship stronger

Preferred

 - Experience in the voice AI, audio AI, or conversational AI space

 - Experience selling or expanding into multiple products within a platform




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in ET, CT, MT, or PT timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York City or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our offices in these cities. 

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: TPS Technician II, First Shift
jobs.description:

Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Manufacturing team owns all process development, fabrication strategy, and production equipment for Terran R, our next generation reusable rocket. This team has a wide variety of responsibilities—from factory floor layout to developing complex tooling for novel processes and partnering with our vehicle engineering team to influence the design of the rocket. We leverage our deep expertise to translate engineering requirements into highly optimized production lines while working cross-functionally to continuously improve the vehicle program.

This is a 2nd shift position with a standard schedule of 3:00 PM – 1:30 AM PT, Monday through Friday. The role includes a 10% shift differential added to the base pay. Please note that this position is structured around a baseline expectation of a 50-hour workweek, which may include occasional overtime as needed to meet operational goals.

About the Role:

• Manufacture Thermal Protection System (TPS) components and subassemblies for the Terran R vehicle while meeting quality, safety, and production requirements

• Perform adhesive bonding operations including surface preparation, adhesive mixing, application, vacuum bagging, and other TPS manufacturing processes

• Follow engineering drawings, work instructions, specifications, and manufacturing procedures while completing assigned work with minimal supervision

• Safely operate hand tools, pneumatic tools, calibrated equipment, and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software to document production activities

• Collaborate with engineers, quality inspectors, and fellow technicians to troubleshoot routine production issues and continuously improve manufacturing processes

• Support downstream operations as needed while maintaining Relativity Space's high standards for safety, quality, and shop organization

About You:

• High school diploma or GED. 0–1 years of experience in aerospace manufacturing, automotive manufacturing, composites, fabrication, assembly, or another related hands-on field

• Basic experience using hand tools, power tools, or production equipment in a manufacturing or shop environment

• Ability to follow written work instructions, drawings, specifications, and established manufacturing processes

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to safety, quality, and proper documentation

• Ability to communicate effectively with technicians, supervisors, engineers, and quality personnel

• Willingness and ability to learn adhesive bonding, surface preparation, adhesive mixing and application, vacuum bagging, and flight-hardware assembly processes

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We at Peloton are looking for a scrappy, creative and fast-moving AI Engineer.

You’ll take raw ideas and rapidly transform them into production-grade applications that empower our global organization. You will architect the Intelligence & Integration Layers that connect autonomous agents directly into Peloton’s enterprise infrastructure.

We don't care about your specific stack or what programming language you grew up with. We care about systems thinking, engineering fundamentals, product sense, and your ability to ship fast. Work at the bleeding edge of the AI ecosystem with top-tier tools and compute resources. What you build goes directly into the hands of real users in days, not months.

YOUR DAILY IMPACT AT PELOTON

• Take ambiguous problems and turn them into functional, high-performing AI features and standalone tools

• Solve the "State Problem" for AI by building memory architectures and vector stores (Pinecone, Pgvector) that maintain context while strictly adhering to data retention and deletion policies

• Build pipelines and entity-resolution logic that connect data across CRM, ERP, CPQ, and marketing systems (e.g. Salesforce, SAP, BigQuery) into a single, reliable source of truth agents can act on

• Embed with Peloton business units to understand their workflows, identify high-value opportunities, and select the right initial use cases to prove value

• Embed closely with stakeholder teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

• Share field feedback that helps other teams understand where the models succeed and where they can improve

• Deploy continuous evaluation pipelines to test models for hallucinations, prompt injections, data leakage, and performance regressions before code hits production

• Implement Semantic Caching and smart routing logic (directing routine queries to smaller, cheaper models) to maintain low latency and efficient inference costs

YOU BRING TO PELOTON

• 5–7+ Years of General Software Engineering. Strong foundational software engineering skills (distributed systems, async patterns, API design, microservices, and databases)

• Comfortable pivoting to whatever language or framework gets the job done fastest

• Hands-on experience deploying RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and Agentic Workflows into production using LLM APIs, vector databases, and orchestration frameworks

• Proven track record building and maintaining pipelines across fragmented enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, CPQ, marketing platforms) with attention to entity resolution, schema design, and data quality — not just consuming clean data once it exists

• Cutting-Edge Stack: Work at the bleeding edge of the AI ecosystem with top-tier tools and compute resources.

• Direct Impact: What you build goes directly into the hands of real users in days, not months.

#LI-DD1
#LI-HYBRID

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position based at our New York City headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors including, without limitation, experience and business objectives and if the location for the job changes. Our base salary is just one component of Peloton’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits.

As an organization, one of our top priorities is to maintain the health and wellbeing for our employees and their family. To achieve this goal, we offer robust and comprehensive benefits including:

• Medical, dental and vision insurance

• Short-term and long-term disability

• Access to mental health services

$160,600—$224,950 USD

ABOUT PELOTON:

Peloton (NASDAQ: PTON) provides Members with expert instruction, and world class content to create impactful and entertaining workout experiences for anyone, anywhere and at any stage in their fitness journey. At home, outdoors, traveling, or at the gym, Peloton brings together innovative hardware, distinctive software, and exclusive content.  - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the full commercial relationship and customer success across a book of 25 to 50 enterprise accounts - the builders, innovators, and product teams at companies between 2,000 and 10,000 employees who are defining what AI-native experiences look, feel, and sound like. Your job is to make sure every one of them is getting real value, expanding into new products, and renewing with conviction.

This is a high-impact, high-depth role. You'll manage a focused book while building the executive relationships, success plans, and expansion motions that drive meaningful outcomes at scale. If you love the challenge of going deep with complex organizations while keeping commercial momentum, this role was built for you.

On the ground, you'll be in the product with customers - advising on agent design, voice customization, conversation flows, integrations, and using data and logs to spot friction before customers do. You're the person who connects what's working technically to what's growing commercially and partnering closely with high growth accounts to help them achieve value.

Success of the customer and commercial ownership go hand in hand and are at the core of this role. You own NRR across your managed book of business, you drive cross-sell into ElevenLabs' expanding product suite, and you lead renewals end to end. The best AMs at ElevenLabs don't just retain customers, they grow with them.




COMPENSATION

This role offers a competitive on target earnings (OTE) structure with a split of 70% base and 30% variable. Variable compensation is weighted 70% net revenue retention (NRR) and 30% product cross sell. Cross-sell performance counts toward NRR, so strong expansion compounds across both components. Quota is set on managed ARR, giving you clear ownership over a defined book of business. The plan includes accelerators for above target NRR performance and is designed to reward account managers who grow with their customers, not just retain them. Variable compensation is paid on a quarterly basis.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5 to 7 years of Account Management or Customer Success experience in B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products - you have specific, quantified wins at the enterprise level and you can speak to them clearly

 - You own revenue outcomes end to end at the enterprise level - quota, retention, and expansion - and you run the full expansion motion yourself without a sales handoff

 - You've been in deals where the champion and the economic buyer aren't on the same page, and you know how to navigate that without losing the relationship or the deal

 - You can hold a technical conversation with a developer or engineering team and earn their trust - familiarity with AI concepts, API integrations, and SDKs is a must

 - You use product data to stay ahead of your accounts - spotting health signals, identifying expansion opportunities, and getting in front of risk before it becomes churn

 - You can present to a C-suite, troubleshoot with an engineering team, and close with a procurement lead - sometimes in the same week - and you make each conversation count

Preferred

 - Experience in the voice AI, audio AI, or conversational AI space

 - Experience selling or expanding into multiple products within a platform




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in ET, CT, MT, or PT timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York City or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our offices in these cities. 

#LI-remote

jobs.title: Client Services Lead, Healthcare
jobs.description:
ABOUT MERCOR



Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

About the Role
As a Client Services Lead, you will own Mercor's relationships with healthcare and life sciences clients — providers, payers, pharma, and health-tech companies — from first contact through long-term account growth. You'll sit at the intersection of client management, data strategy, contracting, and stakeholder alignment, ensuring healthcare clients get maximum value from Mercor's expert network and data products, while navigating the sector's unique regulatory and clinical requirements.

This role is highly autonomous and intentionally scrappy: you'll be trusted to build the healthcare client function largely from scratch.

What You'll Do

Build the Healthcare Client Function (0 → 1)

 - Identify, engage, and onboard healthcare and life sciences clients and partners

 - Test and iterate on service models tailored to healthcare-sector needs (clinical accuracy, regulatory constraints, data sensitivity)

 - Create early playbooks for how Mercor serves healthcare clients

Account Ownership & Growth

 - Lead client conversations end-to-end, from scoping through renewal and expansion

 - Qualify client needs, define mutual value, and drive engagements to close

 - Structure commercial terms suited to healthcare organizations' procurement and compliance norms

Contracting & Negotiation

 - Own negotiations on pricing, scope, timelines, and obligations with healthcare clients

 - Work closely with Legal and Finance to move quickly without sacrificing rigor

 - Navigate data rights, privacy, and compliance requirements specific to healthcare (e.g., HIPAA)

Stakeholder Management

 - Act as the primary point of contact for healthcare-sector clients and senior stakeholders

 - Manage complex, multi-party relationships (clinical, compliance, technical teams) with clarity and credibility

 - Align internal teams (Product, Research, Ops, Legal) around healthcare client priorities

Operate Scrappily, Then Systematize

 - Start hands-on: build client lists, run outreach, draft docs, close deals yourself

 - Identify patterns and convert them into repeatable processes as the healthcare book of business scales

What We're Looking For

Experience

 - 5+ years in Client Service, Account Management, or Commercial roles, serving healthcare or life sciences clients

 - Proven experience negotiating and closing contracts

 - Track record managing high-stakes external stakeholders, including clinical and compliance functions

 - Direct experience working with data products

Mindset & Skills

 - Builder mentality: excited by ambiguity and 0→1 problems

 - Scrappy, resourceful, comfortable with unglamorous work early on

 - Strong commercial instincts and negotiation skills

 - Clear, concise communicator with executive presence

 - Able to operate independently while partnering closely with internal teams

Nice to Have

 - Experience in healthcare, life sciences, health-tech, or payer/provider organizations

 - Exposure to data-driven products, AI, or technical/clinical stakeholders

 - Background working cross-functionally with legal and finance teams

 - Familiarity with healthcare compliance and data rights (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST)

Benefits

 - Bi-annual performance bonus structure

 - Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

 - Up to $15k relocation bonus

 - $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

 - $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

 - Free Equinox membership

 - $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

 - $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

 - Health, Dental, Vision insurance
