Ability to lift 50 lbs, sit on floors and/or child-sized furniture, and quickly move from a seated position to running stance.

For more information about FirstSteps for Kids, we encourage you to visit our website at www.firststepsforkids.com.

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer - Solutions Management
jobs.description:
What you'll do

The Customer Support Engineer is a pivotal technical role that bridges client support, custom development, and platform implementation. You will work as a technical subject matter expert on enterprise platforms, delivering hands-on support and custom solutions that drive client success. This role combines hands-on client support (working alongside practitioners during launches and implementations) with custom development capabilities (API integrations, Claude AI tooling, web-based solutions). You'll manage the full lifecycle of technical issues and custom requests, from initial diagnosis through root cause analysis, custom workarounds, and permanent fixes — working closely with product, engineering, and implementation teams. This is a high-impact, technically challenging role suited for engineers who thrive in problem-solving, client engagement, rapid learning, and delivering measurable business value. Success in this role directly impacts customer adoption, retention, and platform revenue.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Implementation & Client Support

• Serve as a technical subject matter expert on enterprise platforms, providing hands-on implementation guidance and troubleshooting during client launches and deployments.

• Work alongside clients during training and go-live, executing implementation steps and problem-solving real-time adoption blockers.

• Develop and deliver technical training, best practice documentation, and configuration guides tailored to client use cases.

• Track and communicate on adoption metrics: instances launched, users onboarded, time-to-value achieved.

Custom Development & Configuration

• Implement custom configurations, scripting, and lightweight development to meet client-specific requirements (e.g., dashboards, API integrations, data transformations, Claude AI agent configurations, web-based applications).

• Write and maintain full-stack code for client customizations and internal automation tools; architect and build web-based solutions tailored to client needs.

• Coordinate with development teams on client-specific integrations, API customizations, and feature requests.

• Develop workarounds for platform limitations and advocate for product enhancements based on recurring client needs.

Technical Support & Issue Resolution (L2/L3)

• Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex technical issues across enterprise platforms and client environments.

• Perform in-depth root cause analysis using SQL queries, log review, and systematic troubleshooting; implement short-term workarounds and long-term fixes.

• Manage incidents end-to-end: reproduce issues, assess impact/priority, coordinate cross-functional resolution, validate fixes, and communicate outcomes clearly to stakeholders.

• Escalate appropriately to engineering and product teams while maintaining ownership of customer communication and resolution tracking.

• Support production incidents and urgent deployments following secure deployment processes.

Documentation, Knowledge Management & Automation

• Create and maintain knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and best-practice documentation; ensure content is current with releases.

• Identify patterns in support tickets and recommend product/process improvements backed by data and evidence.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support tasks using scripting and workflow automation to improve efficiency and reduce cycle time.

• Contribute to QA efforts, including test automation, regression testing, and UAT coordination for platform updates.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Implementation teams to drive issue resolution and product improvements.

• Participate in customer success reviews and post-implementation check-ins to identify adoption opportunities and technical risks.

• Mentor junior support team members and contribute to team knowledge sharing.

What you'll need

Required Experience & Technical Skills

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in technical support, customer success engineering, or SaaS operations.

• Full-stack proficiency to build web-based applications; comfortable working across front-end and back-end technologies.

• Strong expertise in API design and integration; demonstrable experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and webhooks.

• Advanced knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and experience implementing MCP-based integrations or tools.

• 5+ years of SQL experience; comfortable writing queries, analyzing data, and troubleshooting data issues.

• Experience with AI tools and Claude API for building AI-powered client solutions.

Core Competencies

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical issues methodically and independently; strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to tailor technical explanations to different audiences (developers, business users, executives).

• Customer-first mindset with ownership mentality; committed to driving client success and adoption.

• Ability to learn new platforms and systems quickly; hands-on orientation.

• Strong organizational skills; able to manage multiple concurrent issues while meeting response-time expectations.

• Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; adaptable and proactive.

Nice-to-Have

• Proficiency in Python or other modern programming languages for backend development and scripting.

• Front-end framework experience (e.g., React, Vue) for building user-facing applications.

• Experience with ServiceNow, ticketing systems, or support management platforms.

• Exposure to supply chain, procurement, or logistics domains.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Fleetio is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Developer Enablement team. The Developer Enablement team owns Fleetio’s public API, webhooks, Developer Portal, and the tools that let customers and partners build on Fleetio. You will be a key player in making our API reliable, well-documented, and easy to build on, so that customers and integration partners can connect, extend, and automate Fleetio on their own.

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are hiring a Tier 1 Technical Support Specialist to join our North American support team. You will help customers use and troubleshoot home energy management products, mobile applications, connected hardware, and supported smart home devices.

Customers will contact you by phone, email, and in-app chat. Some will need help getting started; others will have a device that will not connect or information that is missing from their app. Your job is to understand the problem, work through the appropriate steps, and explain what happens next.

You will report to the Unified Tier 1 Manager and work with technical specialists and utility partner contacts when an issue requires additional help.

Schedule

Our support hours are 8 AM to 8 PM ET, Monday through Friday, and 9 AM to 6 PM ET on Saturday. This role’s regular schedule includes a required Saturday shift, helping ensure our customers receive reliable technical support throughout the week. You’ll have a weekday off to balance your schedule. Weekday shifts are staggered within support hours to maintain coverage.

What You Will Do

 - Respond to customer questions through phone, email, and in-app chat.

 - Guide customers through account access, app setup, hardware installation steps, and everyday product use.

 - Troubleshoot device pairing, account-to-device binding, connectivity, and missing or delayed data.

 - Help customers connect and use supported smart home devices within documented support boundaries.

 - Use Zendesk and internal support tools to review account, device, and utility program information.

 - Document the reported problem, relevant errors, troubleshooting completed, results, and next steps.

 - Resolve issues using approved procedures and knowledge articles. Recognize when further investigation or utility partner action is required.

 - Prepare escalations with customer impact, timing, device and app details, and supporting evidence.

 - Keep customers informed, follow through on commitments, and maintain clear ownership of assigned cases.

 - Flag recurring problems and gaps in support documentation.

 - Meet established expectations for response times, case quality, customer satisfaction, and follow-up.

 - Complete product training and contribute useful troubleshooting findings to the team’s knowledge base.

Required Qualifications

 - At least one year of customer-facing technical support experience, or equivalent practical experience troubleshooting technology with customers.

 - Experience helping customers troubleshoot mobile apps, connected devices, or consumer hardware.

 - A working understanding of home Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, device pairing, and common connectivity problems.

 - Clear spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical steps in everyday language.

 - A methodical approach to troubleshooting: ask relevant questions, verify details, test possible causes, and record the results.

 - Experience using a ticketing system and maintaining accurate case notes.

 - The ability to manage several open cases, prioritize work, and follow up without repeated reminders.

 - Patience when working with end users or people who are unfamiliar with technology.

 - Sound judgment about when to continue troubleshooting and when to ask for help.

 - Careful handling of customer information and adherence to access and privacy procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with Zendesk, particularly in an environment supporting multiple brands or customer programs.

 - Experience supporting smart home devices, energy monitoring equipment, thermostats, or other connected home products.

 - Familiarity with both iOS and Android troubleshooting.

 - Experience supporting utility customers or working with utility program requirements.

 - Familiarity with Jira or another system used to track technical escalations and product defects.

 - Experience using device status information, logs, or internal portals during troubleshooting.

 - Experience working with colleagues across regions and handing off cases between teams.

What Success Looks Like

You can guide customers through common issues, document your work clearly, and recognize when a problem needs additional expertise. Customers understand their next steps and are satisfied with the effort provided, and colleagues receiving an escalation have enough information to continue the investigation.

US-BASED ROLES ONLY - BENEFITS

 - Fully covered Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for employees
   
   - Cost share for dependents

 - 401(K) plan with company match

 - Fully covered STD/LTD

 - Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

Our Unified Platform (UP) organization builds and offers managed data services, shared infrastructure, and metadata management systems that underpin our common query layer and power batch and streaming pipelines that power teams across DRW.

As a Staff Engineer focused on the Data Platform, you will bring experience scaling data platforms to shape and uphold DRW’s long-term data platform vision, translating data strategy into engineering products and managed services used by Traders, Quantitative Researchers, and Back-Office personnel. You will work across tooling, producer, and consumer teams to connect business priorities with technical direction and hands-on delivery. This is an individual contributor role combining strategic thinking, architectural leadership, software development, and mentorship, with responsibility for technical initiatives that span teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to and uphold the overall vision for DRW’s Data Platform, guiding its architecture and evolution to advance the firm’s data strategy.

• Work with engineering leads, product managers, and stakeholders to understand business priorities and translate data strategy into engineering products, platform capabilities, and contribute to the sequenced technical roadmap.

• Design, guide, and build managed platform services for data storage, distributed query execution, batch and streaming processing, and workload orchestration, owning their lifecycle from provisioning and upgrades through production support, refining the managed offers from direct user feedback.

• Lead delivery across team boundaries, turning ambiguous requirements into practical designs and measurable outcomes while balancing immediate business needs with long-term platform goals.

• Drive architecture reviews and technology decisions, documenting trade-offs and building consensus around patterns that uphold the platform vision across the data ecosystem.

• Own the strategy for large-scale data governance and build platform capabilities for metadata management, discovery, lineage, schema evolution, and data quality. Partner with security and data stakeholders on access controls and usage tracking.

• Troubleshoot distributed systems, contribute to production support and incident response, and drive lasting improvements through root-cause analysis, automation, and operational documentation.

• Mentor engineers across teams through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on collaboration, strengthening engineering practices and helping others take ownership of complex systems.

Required Qualifications

• Extensive experience designing, building, and operating large-scale, data-intensive distributed systems, including technical leadership of initiatives spanning multiple teams.

• Experience coordinating with engineering leadership to accelerate team- and organization-wide delivery within existing processes and practices.

• A track record of translating data or business strategy into engineering products and technical roadmaps, with the judgment to align near-term delivery with a long-term platform vision.

• A track record of building and offering managed platform services to other teams, owning provisioning, upgrades, reliability, and ongoing support throughout the service lifecycle, working directly with users to incorporate their requirements and feedback into product and roadmap decisions.

• Experience scaling metadata management systems, such as data catalogs or lineage tracking systems, that span multiple storage and compute technologies.

• Expertise in Java and/or Python, with a proven ability to deliver high-quality, maintainable production software, and strong familiarity with SQL and Linux environments.

• Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs, including consistency, fault tolerance, concurrency, partitioning, and recovery from partial failures.

• Production experience building both batch and stream processing systems at scale, demonstrating practical knowledge of state management, replay, backpressure, and delivery guarantees.

• Experience deploying data processing and query technologies such as Flink, Spark, and ClickHouse, and the ability to guide platform users on the performance and operational trade-offs among them.

• Experience with multiple storage technologies, including object storage, relational or NoSQL databases, and event streaming systems such as Kafka. In-depth knowledge of the internals of open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


INFORMATION SYSTEMS SECURITY ENGINEER (PRINCIPAL)


ABOUT THE ROLE

Snowflake's national security deployments are authorized to operate inside classified environments, and each authorization stands or falls on the security documentation behind it. This role owns that documentation. You assess the system against its security control baseline, assemble the evidence the authorizing official reviews, and you are accountable for the package getting to authorization on schedule.

Arc Reactor, a classified deployment for a US government customer, is the immediate assignment. The same work will apply to the deployments that follow it.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Lead the security control assessment for an assigned deployment, from control selection and tailoring through the body of evidence to authorization.

 - Produce the assessment plan, the evidence collection schedule and the residual risk that goes to the authorizing official, and keep them current.

 - Direct the engineers and security staff producing control artifacts. Tell them which evidence to collect, review what they produce, and catch gaps in the requirements before they surface during assessment.

 - Be the person who can explain a Snowflake control implementation to a government security reviewer, and explain a reviewer's finding back to the engineering team in terms they can act on.

 - Track authorization status and blockers, and report them weekly to the engineering lead and the program.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - You have taken at least one system through authorization to operate under a government security control framework (NIST 800-53 / RMF, FedRAMP, or the DoD RMF and its Impact Levels), and you can point to the package you were responsible for.

 - You can read an engineering implementation and decide which control it satisfies and what evidence it produces.

 - You have worked with government authorizing officials or security control assessors, and you know what they reject and why.

 - You write the plan down. Assessment scope, control status, evidence gaps and residual risk live in a document the team can run without you, not in your head.

 - You are eligible for TS/SCI with a full-scope polygraph, or already hold it.


HOW THIS TEAM WORKS

The ISSE does not work alone and does not do all the collection. Engineers and supporting security staff produce the artifacts; you decide what is needed, review it, and own the result. The role reports into national security engineering and sits in the deployment's weekly engineering and security cadence. The work is done from the Washington, DC area, with regular time on site.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

jobs.title: Director, Advanced Analytics
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The Role:

As a Director, Advanced Analytics, you will lead CookUnity’s Advanced Analytics function, helping the business understand performance, identify opportunities, and make better decisions across product performance, retention, and growth.

You will partner closely with Product, Finance, Operations and senior leadership to turn complex business questions into rigorous analyses and actionable recommendations. Your work will help explain what is driving performance, measure the impact of initiatives, and guide product priorities and business investments.

This is a hands-on, player-coach leadership role. You will tackle complex analytical problems while developing the team, providing technical direction, and raising the quality and impact of its work. You will also help shape the team’s structure, priorities, and ways of working as the business evolves.

Your focus will be advanced analytics, experimentation, and measurement, working in partnership with the separate Data Science/ML and Engineering teams responsible for deploying models into products and systems.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Direction & Business Partnership

• Set the direction for Advanced Analytics. Build a proactive analytical agenda aligned with CookUnity’s priorities. Establish clear ownership, prioritize high-impact questions, and balance immediate business needs with longer-term capability building.

• Turn insights into business impact. Bring an independent analytical perspective to leadership discussions, communicate recommendations clearly, and evaluate how the resulting decisions affect business outcomes. Be the person driving key business and product decisions based on advanced analytics insights.

Advanced Analytics & Experimentation

• Measure the impact of product, operational, and pricing decisions. Use experimentation and causal inference to determine how changes to the customer experience, operational processes, pricing, and loyalty programs affect conversion, ordering, retention, and profitability. Apply quasi-experimental methods when randomized tests aren’t feasible, and clearly communicate assumptions and uncertainty.

• Lead growth experimentation. Partner with Growth and Product to design, prioritize and evaluate tests across acquisition, activation, offers and lifecycle engagement. Connect short-term conversion gains to longer-term retention and customer value.

• Lead hands-on analytical work. Dive into complex problems, challenge assumptions, and guide methodological choices. Provide technical direction from problem framing through analysis, interpretation, and communication.

Business Performance & Product Impact

• Explain churn and retention drivers. Investigate how customer mix, pricing, promotions, meal quality, menu availability and the delivery experience influence weekly ordering, skips, pauses and cancellations. Turn those findings into prioritized opportunities to improve retention and lifetime value, and drive better business strategy and product feature outcomes.

• Influence product priorities. Translate customer behavior and product performance insights into recommendations that inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and opportunities to improve the customer experience. Be core partner to Head of Product to drive product priorities.

• Strengthen marketing measurement. Bring a practical understanding of marketing mix modeling (MMM), multi-touch attribution (MTA) and incrementality testing. Help Marketing interpret conflicting signals and make better decisions about channel mix, budgets and customer acquisition.

Team Leadership & Development

• Develop and strengthen the team. Coach Data Analysts, provide actionable feedback, and set clear expectations for analytical rigor, business understanding, and delivery quality. Identify capability gaps and elevate team performance.

Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in advanced analytics and advanced statistical analysis, with at least 5 years in leadership roles.

• Strong applied experience in product and growth experimentation, causal inference and customer retention analysis, alongside a practical understanding of marketing measurement approaches such as MMM, MTA and incrementality testing.

• Strong hands-on analytical capabilities, with experience independently investigating complex business problems and guiding others through them.

• Proven experience partnering with Product teams and translating analytical insights into product decisions and measurable business outcomes.

• People leadership experience, including developing talent, providing technical guidance, and improving team performance.

• Strong strategic judgment and business understanding, with the ability to identify the right questions and prioritize work based on potential impact.

• Ability to communicate complex findings, methodological limitations, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders.

• A player-coach approach that combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and people leadership.

• High autonomy, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive approach to solving problems in an evolving environment.

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience in consumer-facing businesses, ideally with exposure to retention and growth analytics.

• Experience scaling Analytics teams and strengthening their capabilities, structure, or ways of working.

If you are passionate about combining analytical rigor with business impact and developing a team that helps shape better decisions, we’d love to hear from you!

What Success Looks Like

• 6 months: Established clear ownership and priorities for Advanced Analytics across the organization; assessed team capabilities and recommended an optimal team structure; strengthened standards for analytical quality, experimentation, and measurement.

• 12 months: Demonstrated sustained improvements in analytical rigor, team capabilities, and business impact; elevated the Analytics talent bar through coaching, development, and clear performance expectations; delivered insights that inform product decisions and drive measurable outcomes in retention and growth.

Learn More About CookUnity

We believe great leadership starts with alignment on vision, values, and ways of working. To give you deeper insight into who we are and what we’re looking for, we invite you to explore: CookUnity's Leadership Principles – The values and behaviors that guide how we operate, collaborate, and scale.

We hope this provides valuable insight into our culture and product vision. If this excites you, we’d love to connect!

Benefits

🩺  Health insurance coverage.

🌅 401k Plan.

📈 We grow, you grow: Stock Options Plan granted on Day 1.

🌟 Eligible for a bi-annual performance bonus.

⛱ Unlimited PTO.

🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity, you get a 4-week paid sabbatical.

🐣 Paid family leave.

🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises.

🥘 A generous amount of CookUnity credits to enjoy our amazing meals, added to your account, monthly.

🧘🏽‍♀️ Wellness perks: access to fitness subsidies to build a healthy lifestyle.

🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster.

👩🏾‍🏫 Personalized Spanish coach.

🚀 Awesome opportunity to join a company that is looking to change how we eat and how chefs work!

Compensation

All final pay rates will be determined by candidates experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

Pay Range for this position

$240,000—$270,000 USD

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, People Experience Programs
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

Anduril is building the technology that will transform defense and national security. Our People team ensures the organization scales as fast as the problems we're solving — and People Experience is at the center of how employees actually feel that scale.

People Experience is a global function responsible for the moments that shape an employee's relationship with Anduril — from their first day through alumni status. We own the global onboarding program, the regional engagement strategy, company-wide engagement survey, the alumni program, and other engagement related programming. This role sits within that umbrella but is focused on the regional engagement strategy, employee listening, and the alumni program.

The People Experience function is being built, not maintained — we are actively defining the operating model and programming portfolio. This role will be instrumental in shaping and informing that build alongside the Head of People Experience. If you want to inherit a playbook, this isn't the role. If you want to write one, keep reading.

About The Job

We are looking for a Senior Manager, People Experience Programs to serve as the strategic and operational backbone of Anduril's People Experience function. You will be the connective tissue across a portfolio that includes a global regionalized engagement strategy, the company-wide engagement survey, an alumni program, and the ongoing definition of what People Experience means at a defense technology company that is rapidly expanding.

This role is equal parts strategist and program manager. You will partner directly with the Head of People Experience to shape the function's direction — and then you'll be the one who makes it real. You need to be comfortable presenting to senior leadership, managing complex cross-functional programs across multiple geographies, and adapting your approach for different site populations and contexts.

What You'll Do

• Lead the program management and rollout of Anduril's global engagement strategy — a regionalized model designed to understand and address site-level engagement challenges through targeted programming across seven sites and regions worldwide.

• Own the end-to-end program management of the company-wide engagement survey, including launch planning, results analysis, communication strategy, and driving accountability for action planning across business units.

• Help launch and operationalize the Anduril Alumni Program, managing the program's day-to-day execution and implementation effort along various stakeholder groups.

• Partner with the Head of People Experience to shape and inform the function itself — identifying gaps in the employee experience, proposing new programming, building the case for investment in areas the function hasn't yet reached, and designing the frameworks and systems that will define how People Experience operates at scale.

• Serve as the primary program operator across the People Experience portfolio: building project plans, managing timelines, running stakeholder communications, and keeping complex multi-workstream initiatives on track.

• Build and manage strategic stakeholder relationships across the People organization — including People Business Partners, People Leadership and Development, Onboarding Regional Leads, and the People Experience Operations Manager — navigating competing priorities, building buy-in, and maintaining trust across a complex partner network.

• Work closely with our People Experience Operations Manager to leverage site health data, engagement metrics, and quality-of-hire insights — translating data into strategic recommendations and program adjustments.

• Present program strategy, progress, and outcomes to senior leadership with clarity, confidence, and full executive presence — translating operational detail into a strategic narrative that shapes organizational direction.

• Drive systems-level change: identify where processes, structures, or ways of working need to shift to support the engagement strategy, and build the coalitions to make those changes stick. You will lead change initiatives that span multiple teams and geographies, anticipating ripple effects and designing for interdependencies.

• Create new frameworks and systems where none exist — this function is being built, and you will be expected to design program architecture, evaluation methodology, and feedback loops rather than adapting existing ones.

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years of experience in people programs, employee experience, engagement, organizational development, or program management within a People/HR function.

• Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and evaluating employee experience or engagement programs end-to-end — not just executing someone else's playbook, but owning the full lifecycle from strategy through execution.

• You are motivated by our mission. We are working to solve the biggest problems in defense.

• Strong program management skills: you build structure in ambiguous environments, manage multiple concurrent workstreams, and drive complex cross-functional work to completion without waiting to be told what to do.

• Executive presence and communication skills that allow you to present confidently to senior leaders at the VP and C-suite level.

• Experience managing enterprise-wide stakeholder relationships (VP+ level) across multiple functions — you build strategic alliances, navigate competing priorities, and influence organizational direction through those relationships.

• Strategic thinking with global scope: you connect individual site-level programs to a coherent enterprise strategy, define the frameworks others execute against, and think about how decisions scale before you make them.

• Comfort with data: you can interpret engagement data, design evaluation methodology, build a case for investment, and adjust your approach based on what the numbers say. You think in systems — connecting employee experience outcomes to broader business strategy.

• You are both high ownership and low ego, approaching everything with strong outcome orientation and high humility.

• You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and get energy from building something from the ground up rather than maintaining the status quo.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience at high-growth technology or defense companies that have navigated rapid organizational scaling.

• Background in managing global or multi-region programs across different employee personas, cultural contexts, and timezones.

• Experience managing engagement survey programs end-to-end, including, launch, analysis, and action planning accountability.

• Experience building a people experience, employee engagement, or similar function from scratch — defining scope, making the case, and standing it up.

• Experience driving organizational or systems-level change management — not just launching programs, but shifting how an organization operates. You've anticipated systemic risks and designed mitigation strategies that protect the broader business.

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. jobs.title: AX Business Liaison (Senior ADX Manager)
jobs.description:
Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations.  Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions.  Our management philosophy, "Jeong-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer-Value Creation' and 'People-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment.  Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology.  At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone.

Position Overview
We are seeking a strategic and highly collaborative AX Business Liaison to serve as a primary change agent within the organization.
The primary role of the AX Business Liaison is to spearhead Business Innovation and Change Management. You will work directly with our domain experts to reimagine legacy processes and transform the way people work to accommodate new, AI-influenced workflows.
Sitting at the core of our execution layer within a dedicated AX POD, you will serve as the crucial bridge between business stakeholders and our technical execution teams. You will ensure that the AI solutions we build are not only technically sound but also operationally practical, responsibly implemented, and paired with the operational changes necessary to drive true business value and seamless user adoption.

Key Responsibilities
1. Business Innovation & Workflow Transformation (Primary Focus)
● Analyze current business operations to identify bottlenecks, manual steps, and improvement opportunities before applying AI.
● Document current-state and future-state workflows, redesigning processes to natively integrate AI tools, automation, and new decision-support models.
● Challenge the status quo by guiding business leaders away from “how we've always done it” toward AI-augmented operating models, rather than layering new tools onto outdated processes.

2. Change Management & AI Adoption
● Develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies to ensure business units successfully transition to new AI-driven workflows.
● Proactively identify and manage organizational resistance to change, acting as a coach and advocate for AI adoption by helping leaders and users understand how AI will change work.
● Identify, train, and coach business champions in each assigned domain as partners in Business Innovation engagements.
● Equip champions to act as on-the-ground change leads who co-own adoption within their teams, while ADX continues to lead the Business Innovation methodology.

3. Business-to-Technical Translation & Intake
● Partner with business leaders to identify, scope, and define opportunities where AX (AI/Data) solutions can improve operational performance.
● Recommend when a business challenge calls for process redesign or simplification rather than an AI solution.
● Translate redesigned processes into clear technical requirements, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria for AX Engineering and Data teams.
● Align pod intake with the guidelines set by the AX PMO's Intake & Metrics team.

4. Responsible AI & Governance
● Work with technical teams to identify and address business-side risks related to bias, data quality, transparency, and operational misuse.
● Embed human-in-the-loop principles into workflow design, ensuring AI workflows are introduced with appropriate business controls and oversight mechanisms.

5. Business Innovation Methodology & Playbook
● Contribute to ADX's Business Innovation playbook by standardizing artifacts and capturing lessons from each engagement.
● Help assigned domains progress through the Business Innovation capability stages on the AX roadmap.

Qualifications
● Experience: 5+ years in Change Management, Business Innovation, Process Improvement, Business Transformation, or Product Management.
● Transformation Expertise: Proven track record driving Digital Transformation (DX) initiatives and managing the human side of organizational change. Familiarity with change management frameworks is highly preferred.
● Business Innovation Craft: Hands-on experience with process mapping, workflow analysis, and workshop facilitation.
● Domain Knowledge: Foundational understanding of AI, Machine Learning, and software development lifecycles, with the ability to envision how these technologies change workflows, decision rights, and risk controls. Familiarity with responsible AI concepts.
● Communication & Empathy: Exceptional communication skills and high emotional intelligence. Able to guide non-technical teams through disruptive change while articulating clear workflows to engineering teams.
● Collaboration: Proven experience in a matrixed or pod-based organization, influencing without direct authority across business, project management, and engineering teams.
● Preferred Experience: Internal consulting or transformation office experience, building credibility with business units as a partner from outside the team, is a strong plus.

What Success Looks Like in Year One
● Led Business Innovation engagements end to end, with documented future-state workflows in place before build begins on assigned pod initiatives.
● Trained and activated business champions in each assigned domain.
● Achieved strong user adoption, fewer manual workarounds, and positive sentiment for newly deployed AX tools, measured at defined intervals after launch.
● Delivered measurable improvements in cycle time and productivity on deployed initiatives.
● Contributed reusable artifacts and lessons to ADX's Business Innovation playbook.
● Established yourself as a trusted advisor to business leaders on the cultural, operational, and workflow shifts that AI transformation requires.

#LI-DR1

Recruiting Range

$145,000—$185,000 USD

Benefits Offered Full-Time Employees:

• No-cost employee premiums for you and your eligible dependents for competitive medical, dental, vision and prescription benefits.

• Auto enrollment with immediate vesting of competitive company matching contributions in a 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with several investment options.

• Generous Paid Time Off program that includes company holidays and a combined bank of paid sick and vacation time.

• Performance based Short-Term Incentives (varies by role).

• Group Rate Life and Disability Insurance.

Benefits Offered Temporary/Contractors:

Applicants who need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process may contact our team by phone at: 973-477-7090 or support@lg4me.freshdesk.com. This email and phone number will only reply to accommodation requests and is not intended for general employment inquiries.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: International Brand Media Manager
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We’re looking for an International Brand Media Manager to help build awareness and consideration for Rippling across international markets.

In this role, you’ll own digital brand media planning and campaign delivery across CTV, YouTube, Meta, LinkedIn, programmatic, display, and audio. You’ll translate audience insights and business priorities into focused media plans, adapt our approach to local markets, and manage agency partners from briefing through performance evaluation.

You’ll work closely with Growth, Brand, Creative, regional Marketing, and Analytics to deliver campaigns that reach the right audiences with compelling creative. You’ll also help establish how we measure success—using brand lift studies, incrementally testing, and marketing mix modeling to understand effectiveness and inform investment decisions.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who combines strong execution with analytical judgment. You should be comfortable setting clear direction, challenging agency recommendations, and taking ownership of the work.

What you will do

• Own international digital media plans. Recommend audiences, channel mix, budgets, and flighting based on market maturity, local media behavior, and campaign objectives.
• Lead agency partnerships. Write clear briefs, evaluate media recommendations, oversee activation, and hold partners accountable for delivery, quality, and actionable insights.
• Manage budgets and campaign execution. Own pacing and optimization recommendations, with clear oversight of timelines, asset readiness, and tracking accuracy.
• Partner across Growth and Brand. Coordinate audience strategies, campaign timing, retargeting, and exclusions to create a connected experience across the funnel.
• Shape creative needs for each market. Partner with Brand and Creative to translate media plans into actionable briefs, prioritize localized assets, and use campaign learnings to improve creative.
• Build practical measurement plans. Work with Analytics and measurement partners to define objectives, baselines, KPIs, and testing approaches appropriate to each market’s budget and data availability.
• Turn evidence into decisions. Interpret MMM, brand lift, incrementality tests, and campaign reporting to recommend where to invest, what to change, and what to learn next.
• Communicate clearly. Deliver concise performance readouts that explain results, limitations, and recommendations, distinguishing near-term campaign signals from longer-term brand impact.

What you will need

• 4+ years of experience in paid media planning, strategy, or activation, either in-house or at a media agency.
• Experience managing digital campaigns across multiple channels, with an understanding of how audience behavior, creative, and channel opportunities influence media decisions.
• Strong knowledge of digital brand channels, including CTV, YouTube, Meta, LinkedIn, programmatic/display, and audio, with deeper execution experience in several.
• Experience managing media agencies or leading agency client engagements, including briefing, reviewing plans, overseeing budgets, and driving accountability.
• Applied experience with media measurement frameworks, including MMM, brand lift studies, and incrementality testing. You can explain their strengths and limitations and use findings to make investment recommendations.
• Experience partnering with Growth, Brand, Creative, and Analytics teams to deliver campaigns and resolve competing priorities.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, including managing concurrent campaigns, budgets, and deadlines.
• The ability to work independently, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and identify when to involve partners or escalate an issue.
• Willingness to occasionally adjust working hours to collaborate with international teams and agency partners across time zones.

Nice to have

• Experience planning or managing media campaigns across international markets.
• Experience in B2B SaaS or launching campaigns in markets with low brand awareness.
• Familiarity with GA4, CM360, and major advertising platforms.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture.  For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

jobs.title: Campus Executive Director
jobs.description:
Training Tomorrow's Technicians to Become Skilled, Employable and Essential.

About Us  - Big Changes, Better Benefits - Join us today!

The Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM), established in 1969, is a premier institution dedicated to advancing the field of aviation maintenance through exceptional education and training. With 15 campuses nationwide, AIM is a cornerstone in the aviation industry, accounting for 20% of all students attending FAA-certified Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) schools across the country. Each year, AIM proudly contributes to the graduation of nearly one in four certified aircraft technicians in America.

At AIM, you'll become part of a dynamic team of educators and leaders, all united by a shared commitment to delivering top-notch training and ensuring student success. We are passionate about equipping the next generation of aircraft technicians with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in the aviation industry. If you are eager to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of aviation maintenance, AIM offers a rewarding environment where your contributions will truly matter.

Position Purpose

The Campus Executive Director plays a crucial role in ensuring the successful operation of the college campus. This position encompasses a broad range of responsibilities aimed at fostering a positive educational environment, enhancing student engagement, and achieving institutional goals. The Executive Director will lead efforts in student recruitment and retention, manage financial resources, and oversee staff performance, all while ensuring compliance with state regulations and accreditation standards.

Key Competencies:

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and implement long-term strategies to drive campus growth, ensuring alignment with the institution's broader vision and goals.

• High-Level Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain relationships with key industry partners, accrediting bodies, and community organizations to foster collaboration and support campus initiatives.

• Broader Accountability: Lead the financial strategy for the campus, ensuring sustainable growth and efficient resource allocation to support long-term goals.

• Decision-Making & Influence: Lead campus hiring decisions, shaping the organizational structure to meet strategic objectives, and ensuring staff performance aligns with campus goals.

• Enhance Outcome Focus: Drive measurable improvements in student outcomes and operational efficiency, with accountability for key performance indicators such as graduation rates, job placement success, and campus financial performance.

Job Responsibilities

• Ensure compliance with accreditation, state requirements, and other regulatory standards, working closely with Corporate Compliance.

• Drive student retention and enrollment efforts to increase active student count.

• Prepare and manage the operational budget in collaboration with the Regional Director, ensuring compliance with budgetary constraints, including payroll and facility costs.

• Oversee the management of physical facilities, monitoring associated expenses such as utilities and rent, and assessing needs for potential expansion.

• Staff all departments by collaborating with Corporate Department Directors and the Regional Director, structuring roles according to established policies and published job descriptions.

• Prepare for initial or ongoing accreditation, coordinate Program Advisory Committee (PAC) meetings, and manage Advisory Board meetings by assigning appropriate staff.

• Assign educational duties to the Director of Education, focusing on the alignment of educational programs with student needs.

• Address employee grievances promptly and communicate relevant issues to the Regional Director or Director of Human Resources for further action.

• Stay informed on Human Resource topics and ensure compliance with policies regarding employee medical conditions that may affect leave eligibility.

• Conduct monthly school meetings to ensure clear communication of policies, goals, and progress toward benchmarks.

• Maintain a positive working relationship with both school and corporate staff, upholding the institution's reputation and supporting its mission.

• Perform any other duties as assigned by the Regional Director, President, or Vice President of Operations.

• Supervise the entire school staff, including the Director of Education, Director of Compliance & Administration, Registrar, Student Service Coordinator, Financial Aid Officer, Bursar, Career Services Coordinator, and any other positions designated to report directly to them.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree

• Must have at least five (5) years of management experience within a post-secondary educational institution, preferably within a private sector.

• Positive business and sales aptitude and background.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, performance-driven, compliance-oriented educational environment.

• Detail-oriented, analytical, highly organized, and have the ability to multi-task and work well under pressure.

• Demonstrate a high level of integrity, strong work ethic, and professionalism.

• Persuasive and effective verbal and written communication skills, with a strong focus on customer service in an educational setting.

• Highly motivated and goal-oriented, with strong problem-solving skills.

• Must be able to work independently and as collaborative team member and have exceptional interpersonal skills.

• Excellent computer skills are required with proficiency in MS Office applications including, but not limited to, Word, Excel, Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams.

• Ability and willingness to work outside of regular work shifts, including evenings and/or weekends as necessary or as requested by Supervisor.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s Degree

• Experience in Admissions

• CampusNexus experience

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary range up to $150,000 we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• 401(k) and Matching: Secure your future with our competitive retirement savings plan.

• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Enjoy Health, Dental, and Vision insurance to keep you and your family healthy.

• Life Insurance: Peace of mind with life insurance options.

• Parental Leave: Support for new parents during important life transitions.

• Paid Time Off: Recharge with paid time off to promote work-life balance.

• Retirement Plan: Additional options to help you save for retirement.

• Employee Assistance Program: Access to resources for personal and professional support.

• Tuition Reimbursement: Invest in your future with financial support for further education.

We are committed to providing a rewarding compensation package that supports both your professional growth and personal well-being.

AIM is a proud equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes to the success of our company and are dedicated to fostering a culture of respect, equity, and inclusion.

jobs.title: Managing Director - AIE & Amazon Commerce Connections Lead
jobs.location: Chicago, Illinois, United States; Kansas City, Missouri, United States; New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

AIE & Amazon Commerce Connections Capability Lead

Managing Director, Commerce Connections

The Role

We are looking for a senior Commerce leader to build and lead a new AIE & Amazon Commerce capability within WPP Commerce Connections.
This role sits at the intersection of Amazon commerce, data, AI, technology and business transformation. The immediate mandate is to lead the business and solution vision for a significant AI-enabled Amazon Commerce engagement, working alongside AWS and a cross-functional WPP team to turn complex retail, media, operational and financial data into actionable commercial intelligence.

The ambition extends well beyond the initial project you will lead. This leader will help turn the solution, learnings and underlying capabilities into a repeatable WPP offering that can scale across clients and future AWS opportunities.

What You'll Own

• Lead the business and solution vision for AIE, ensuring technology and AI are grounded in meaningful Amazon business problems, decisions and measurable outcomes.

• Serve as the senior Amazon Commerce subject matter leader, connecting retail operations, profitability, inventory, digital shelf, search, media, measurement and customer experience.

• Translate client business priorities into high-value use cases, requirements and product capabilities, working closely with strategy, analytics, experience design and technology teams.

• Partner with AWS and WPP technical leadership to shape solutions that combine Amazon data, cloud infrastructure, analytics and AI into scalable commercial applications.

• Provide senior client leadership, helping executives and operating teams understand what the intelligence means, what decisions it enables and how to act on it.

• Work alongside Program Delivery leadership to ensure the business vision, product roadmap and technical execution remain connected throughout delivery.

• Build the broader AIE & Amazon Commerce Connections capability, identifying reusable IP, methodologies, technology and operating models that can be deployed across additional clients.

• Help shape the WPP + AWS Commerce partnership, identifying new opportunities and turning successful client solutions into repeatable offerings.

• Develop and mentor a multidisciplinary team spanning Amazon Commerce, retail operations, analytics, strategy, product, experience and technology.

• Support growth and commercialization, including client development, solution design, scoping and executive-level pitches.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who has operated at the intersection of Amazon, technology and commercial decision-making, rather than someone whose experience is limited to managing an Amazon account or individual discipline.

The strongest candidate will bring:

• Deep Amazon ecosystem expertise, ideally including experience inside Amazon and/or leading sophisticated Amazon solutions for major brands.

• Significant experience with data, analytics, technology and AI-enabled solutions and the ability to translate technical capabilities into commercial value.

• Strong understanding of the signals that drive an Amazon business, including sales, profitability, inventory, operations, search, digital shelf, media and measurement.

• Experience building products, solutions or capabilities from ambiguity rather than simply operating established programs.

• Ability to move comfortably between executive conversations, Amazon business strategy, product definition and technical teams.

• Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional teams across strategy, analytics, engineering, product and delivery.

• Strong client leadership and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex problems and create alignment across multiple stakeholders.

• An entrepreneurial mindset and interest in building a capability, not simply filling a role on one account.

jobs.title: Director, Global Corporate Learning Management Systems
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

Revolution Medicines is scaling rapidly, with an established U.S. presence and 10 recently established entities outside the United States, with further expansion ahead. This growth brings increasing complexity in learning requirements, employee populations, regional needs, and the systems and partnerships needed to support them.

We are seeking a Director, Corporate Learning Management Systems to lead the strategy, governance, and operations of our enterprise learning technology ecosystem. Reporting to the Senior Director, Corporate Learning and Development, this leader will own the business strategy, governance, and operational standards for Workday Learning as RevMed's core enterprise non-GxP learning management system and provide strategic oversight for Sana Learning, LinkedIn Learning, and other connected learning platforms. Deep, hands-on Workday Learning expertise and close collaboration with Corporate L&D, People Operations & Technology, IT, and functional and regional training partners will help make required training and developmental learning easier to assign, complete, track, and improve.

The role combines strategic direction with accountability for reliable daily operations and requires sound judgment, resilience, and flexibility as business needs and organizational structures evolve. Working across a learning ecosystem means creating an effective learner experience between Workday Learning for non-GxP learning, Veeva Vault for GxP learning, connected content providers such as LinkedIn Learning, Emtrain, and ComplianceWire, and specialized learning or documentation platforms such as ACTO, Veeva PromoMats, HoxHunt, and Vanta.

The Director will improve the learner experience, streamline systems where feasible, and establish clear assignment practices while respecting functional ownership and regulated requirements. This role will initially lead one team member and will be accountable for ensuring the function's priorities and operational responsibilities are delivered effectively, adapting team capabilities and resourcing as needs evolve.

Core Responsibilities:

Enterprise Learning Strategy and Governance

• Create a multi-year, cross-functional and cross-regional learning systems strategy and prioritized roadmap that connects learning needs, regulatory obligations, learner experience, integrations, and operational capacity. Translate business needs into phased improvements and measurable outcomes while accommodating local and regulated requirements.

• Partner with the Talent Platforms lead on shared Workday dependencies and roadmap decisions across skills, Career Profile, mentoring, Career Hub, reporting and data, releases, and connected employee experiences, as prioritized by HRLT.

• With the Sr. Director of Corporate L&D, co-lead the evolution of the monthly cross-functional Learning Committee established in 2025. Define its charter, membership, decision rights, and escalation paths; establish focused sub-committee working groups for system operations, assignment strategy, aligned learning plans, and learning experience practices; bring recommendations to the strategic committee for decisions and alignment.

• Partner with the Director of Culture and Engagement and functional training owners to coordinate cross-functional onboarding and other learning plans, reducing duplicate assignments, conflicting timelines, and avoidable learner overload. Establish a shared approach to reviewing planned training volume and sequencing required learning by role, location, and timing.

• Lead a cross-functional solution for assigning, tracking, and reporting contractor training across functions, addressing worker identity, system access, duplicate assignments, and completion gaps. Clarify roles and accountabilities while respecting each function’s ownership and regulated processes.

Platform Leadership and Operational Excellence

• Own the business strategy, platform roadmap, governance, administration standards, release priorities, and continuous improvement of Workday Learning and connected learning platforms. Align priorities with People Tech, which is responsible for Workday configuration, security, integrations, and technical deployment.

• Ensure effective delivery of learning platform administration, user support, Functional Learning Partner enablement, business testing, and release readiness. Establish clear responsibilities, service standards, quality controls, capacity plans, and escalation paths across the team and partner functions; address complex decisions and enterprise-level risks in partnership with People Tech and other stakeholders.

• Define the learning operating model, standards, decision rights, and coverage expectations for Functional Learning Partners in collaboration with functional leaders.

• Work with internal content owners and external vendors to structure, migrate, publish, and maintain learning assets and paths in the appropriate platform. Establish practical standards for metadata, versioning, archiving, testing, and learner communications.

• Partner with People Operations & Technology, IT, compliance, and other system owners on integrations, data flows, audience rules, content delivery, and completion records across learning systems. Assess interoperability and automation, including reductions in manual data loads and reconciliation work.

• Lead learning vendor and platform investment strategy, including licensing, contract performance, budget and capacity requirements, and sourcing recommendations, in partnership with relevant business and procurement stakeholders.

• Establish and oversee the learning support and knowledge management model, including service expectations, ServiceNow case management, escalation paths, controls, and performance measures. Ensure guides, SOPs, demos, and RevNet content enable learner and administrator self-service; coordinate technical escalations with People Tech.

• Develop dashboards and reporting with People Operations & Technology, HR Business Partners, and functional training owners. Monitor assignment accuracy, completion, adoption, training load, service performance, and operational efficiency; use the findings to prioritize improvements and inform committee decisions.

Leadership and Partnerships

• Manage, coach, and develop the team; align responsibilities with evolving priorities; and build sustainable expertise and coverage. Assess capacity and capability needs, recommend appropriate staffing or contractor support, and lead hiring and onboarding as approved.

• Build trusted partnerships across functions and regions, listen to competing needs, and facilitate decisions among senior stakeholders and system owners without formal authority. Document dependencies, risks, and timelines; communicate changes clearly to administrators, leaders, and learners.

• Navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities with resilience and flexibility, adjusting plans and responsibilities while maintaining reliable service and clear communication.

• Plan for growth in geographic reach, organizational complexity, and training demand with regional and functional partners, balancing enterprise consistency with local and regulated requirements.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

• Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of relevant experience in enterprise learning technology, learning systems, or related operations, including experience leading strategy and cross-functional initiatives. Prior work experience with Workday Learning is required.

• Deep hands-on and strategic experience with Workday Learning business ownership, administration standards, requirements, assignments, reporting, releases, and integrations in partnership with a dedicated configuration team.

• Experience working in a regulated industry, with an understanding of how regulatory obligations shape learning governance, training records, documentation, and operational controls.

• Experience supporting contractor training and integrations or APIs involving HR, identity, service, content, and training platforms.

• Demonstrated success designing scalable learning systems roadmaps and cross-functional operating models, and improving assignment logic, onboarding plans, worker population management, completion tracking, data quality, and learner experience across systems.

• Strong consulting, facilitation, project leadership, and change management skills. Ability to build trusted partnerships, define decision rights, resolve competing priorities, gain agreement without direct authority, and communicate effectively with technical, functional, and executive audiences.

• Ability to balance strategic planning with operational oversight and use data to assess outcomes and make decisions. Demonstrated resilience and flexibility through ambiguity, rapid growth, and organizational change, adapting priorities while maintaining operational quality and follow-through.

• Applied experience using analytics, enterprise data, or AI-enabled tools to improve learning assignments, reporting, support, or the learner experience.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience in biotechnology or pharmaceuticals.

• Direct people management experience strongly preferred, including building team capabilities and performance management.

• Prior experience integrating LinkedIn Learning with an LMS and managing the integrated learner and administrator experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience scaling learning systems and operations across multiple countries or legal entities.

• Familiarity with GxP learning environments and platforms such as Veeva Vault or ComplianceWire, including coordination across GxP and non-GxP systems, systems of record, Sales or Medical Affairs training, good documentation practices, and read-and-acknowledge workflows.
