jobs.title: Creative, Experiments
jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

Experiments make expression, introspective, optimistic, thoughtful, and impactful things with frontier models. Continuing to experiment while pushing the spectrum of what the voice and stories we tell. We bring creative and technical collaborators together to explore what these models make possible through prototypes, interactive experiences, physical objects, and stories that invite people to participate, reflect, and imagine.

About the Opportunity

We’re looking for a Creative, Experiments to help develop and make original work for the Experiments program. You’ll contribute to a distinctive body of work with frontier models, finding ideas that connect new capabilities with human curiosity, humor, and everyday life.

You’re a creative thinker and a hands-on maker who moves comfortably between storytelling, design, and technology. You can turn an open-ended question into a compelling concept, build a working prototype with creative and technical partners, and carry an idea through iteration and delivery.

You’ll contribute ideas to the program’s creative agenda, identify opportunities worth exploring, and work with creative and technical partners to make them real. Working closely with the Experiments Team, you’ll help explore new possibilities for Research Design. The work may take the form of digital experiences, physical installations, playful objects, films, or formats we have yet to discover. Each experiment should have a clear idea, thoughtful execution, and a reason to matter to its audience.

This role is based in the US and partners closely with OpenAI’s Creative, Research, Product, Engineering, and Communications teams, alongside external makers and production partners.

In this role, you will:

 - Contribute to the Experiments program’s slate of ideas, owning individual projects from initial exploration through public release in partnership with creative leads

 - Develop original concepts that use frontier models to make work with humor, emotional depth, optimism, and meaningful impact

 - Prototype early and often, working hands-on and with creative technologists to test interactions, explore model behavior, and refine the idea

 - Collaborate across design, storytelling, engineering, and production to create digital and physical experiences with strong craft and a clear point of view

 - Build relationships with internal teams and external makers, coordinate project needs, and use audience response and project learnings to inform the next experiment

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have 8+ years of relevant experience

 - Bring a portfolio of original experiments, experiences, or creative projects that shows your role in developing ideas, collaborating across disciplines, and making the work

 - Combine conceptual thinking, experience design, and storytelling with curiosity about technology and a strong sense of humor, culture, and human behavior

 - Are a resourceful maker who explores frontier models and emerging tools through practical experimentation and can partner effectively with technical specialists

 - Can take ownership of open-ended projects, use feedback to refine what to pursue, and balance ambitious ideas with practical scope, timelines, and delivery

 - Work with curiosity and generosity, build trust across disciplines, and contribute to an environment where collaborators take creative risks and learn together

 - Support your teammates, adapt when experiments don’t go as planned, and iterate and ship quickly



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Creative Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT PRIMER

Primer is a growing network of K–8 schools restoring the timeless foundations of American education. Inspired by the original teaching primers that shaped a nation of readers, thinkers, and builders, our schools begin with what has always worked, and build for what lies ahead. Close-knit learning environments. Skilled educators. A culture that takes kids seriously as learners and leaders.

Primers shaped the first 200 years of American children. Primer will ready them for the next.

We hear from parents, educators, legislators, and community leaders every day about the lives we’re changing — from families who felt stuck in the traditional system and now see their child thriving at Primer, to parents who “feel like they have their child back” after a few months at Primer.

Your job is to bring Primer’s story to life for families across every state, campus, and event. You’ll own the standards that keep our creative consistent and build the production engine that makes high-quality, locally relevant assets available fast. You’ll work within Primer’s established brand, making one brand feel personal in dozens of communities, soon hundreds.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll design, review, and ship work yourself while building the templates, workflows, and AI-powered tools that help us scale. Teams will count on you as a creative partner with a sharp eye for detail, clear judgment on what’s ready to ship, and the resourcefulness to deliver as demand grows.

Key Responsibilities

 - Own and uphold Primer’s established brand guidelines, ensuring every asset meets our standards while reflecting state, campus, and event-specific needs.

 - Build and run a creative production program that delivers high volumes of customized, high-quality assets with fast, predictable turnaround times.

 - Develop reusable templates, event kits, and asset libraries that make localized production efficient and maintain brand consistency.

 - Partner with Growth, Admissions, and campus teams to translate business needs into clear creative briefs, priorities, and deliverables.

 - Own the workflow from intake through delivery, establishing clear SLAs, approval processes, and quality checks.

 - Serve as the final creative reviewer, ensuring assets are accurate, polished, on-brand, and ready to publish or print.

 - Personally design and produce assets while directing contractors or external creative partners as needed.

 - Track turnaround times, revision volume, and output quality to improve production as Primer expands.

What You Bring:

 - A strong design portfolio demonstrating brand consistency across digital, print, and localized marketing materials.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and the creative judgment to recognize what is ready to ship and what needs refinement.

 - Experience building creative workflows that support high-volume production across multiple locations, audiences, or event types.

 - A scrappy, hands-on approach with the ability to lead a program and execute the work yourself.

 - Strong prioritization and stakeholder management skills, balancing speed, quality, and competing deadlines.

 - Fluency in design tools and experience using templates, automation, and AI-assisted workflows to scale production without compromising quality.

 - Uses AI tools and automation to accelerate creative production, scale state and campus customization, and shorten turnaround times while maintaining brand consistency and quality.

Experience:

 - 6+ years of experience in graphic design, brand design, or creative production, creating high-quality digital and print assets.

 - 3+ years of experience adapting an established brand across multiple locations, audiences, and event types, with a portfolio demonstrating strong design judgment and locally relevant creative.

 - 2+ years of experience building creative production systems, including templates, asset libraries, intake processes, and clear turnaround expectations.

 - Hands-on proficiency with design tools and a track record of personally taking assets from brief to final delivery.

 - Experience using AI and automation to accelerate production and customization while maintaining quality and brand consistency.

 - Demonstrated attention to detail, including reviewing creative for accuracy, consistency, and readiness to publish or print.

 - Experience partnering with growth and local operations teams to prioritize requests and deliver against competing deadlines.

Primer is a mission-first company. We believe our mission is the highest-leverage way we can create positive change. In service of that, we keep work centered on mission execution and avoid social or political activism at work that’s unrelated to the mission. If that energizes you, we’d love to see you apply.

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years

jobs.title: HR Business Partner – Engineering
jobs.description:
Forward was founded in 2013 by four Stanford Ph.D.s, building the industry's first network digital twin: a mathematically accurate model of the production network. It's the foundation for autonomous networking, giving engineers and AI agents the ability to know the impact of every change before it touches production. That founding instinct still defines how we work. We're accurate and evidence-driven, relentless about clarity, and we'd rather be certain than comfortable, building a groundbreaking platform that transforms how teams run and secure networks across every major cloud and vendor environment.

Global leaders like Goldman Sachs, PayPal, S&P Global, IBM, and Dell trust Forward, alongside fast-growing enterprises and government agencies, realizing an average of $14.2 million in annual benefits, according to IDC. Backed by top-tier investors, including A. Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Goldman Sachs, MSD Partners, Omega Venture Partners, Section 32, and Threshold Ventures, and headquartered in Santa Clara, we're most proud of our team: curious people who'd rather build what doesn't exist than accept how things have always been done.

About the Role

Forward is looking for a HR Business Partner (HRBP) to serve as a strategic partner to our Sales organization. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy and people strategy, working directly with senior sales leaders (CRO, VPs of Sales, and Regional/Sales Directors) to build high-performing revenue teams, shape organizational design, and drive talent, culture, and change initiatives that scale with an evolving go-to-market motion. This role requires deep credibility with commercial leaders and fluency in the unique dynamics of a quota-carrying, commission-driven workforce.

What You'll Do

• Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales senior leadership, providing coaching and counsel on organizational design, territory/quota structure, workforce planning, and leadership effectiveness.

• Partner with sales leaders to translate revenue targets and go-to-market strategy into people strategies, including org design, span of control, and role architecture as the sales org scales or restructures.

• Lead full-cycle talent management for the client group: performance management, calibration, succession planning, promotion processes, and career pathing tailored to sales career ladders (RSD/AE, SDR/BDR, sales management, and sales enablement tracks).

• Use data and analytics (attrition, ramp time, quota attainment, rep productivity, pipeline health as it relates to headcount, promotion equity) to diagnose organizational health and recommend proactive interventions.

• Partner closely with Talent Acquisition on sales-specific hiring strategy, headcount planning, and workforce composition, including seasonal/quarterly hiring cycles tied to sales capacity planning.

• Lead or co-lead org design and change management efforts tied to territory realignments, reorganizations, M&A integration, or new market/segment launches.

• Coach sales managers and directors on leadership skills, performance conversations, managing underperformance in a quota-driven environment, and team motivation.

• Partner with Compensation on commission plan design, quota setting implications, and annual compensation planning cycles (merit, equity, promotions) to ensure competitiveness and pay-for-performance alignment.

• Own employee relations matters within the client group, including performance improvement plans and terminations tied to quota non-attainment, ensuring fair, consistent, and legally sound resolution.

• Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives specific to the challenges of building diverse sales teams.

• Partner cross-functionally (Talent Acquisition, Legal, Sales Enablement) to design and deliver programs that meet the unique needs of a revenue organization.

• Act as a culture carrier, helping sales leaders build and reinforce an environment of high performance, accountability, and inclusion.

What We're Looking For

• 7–10+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, with a significant portion spent directly supporting Sales, Revenue, or other quota-carrying/commission-based client groups.

• Proven experience operating at a senior level, partnering directly with CRO, VP, and Director-level sales leaders.

• Deep understanding of sales organizational structures, compensation plan design (base/commission/OTE), quota methodology, and the specific talent dynamics of hiring and retaining sales talent.

• Strong track record leading org design, workforce planning, and change management in a fast-paced, target-driven, high-growth environment.

• Excellent coaching skills with the credibility and presence to influence senior commercial leaders.

• Data-driven approach to HR — comfortable building and interpreting people analytics dashboards (attrition, ramp, productivity) to inform decisions.

• Sound judgment and experience navigating complex employee relations issues, including performance-based terminations; working knowledge of employment law.

• Experience partnering on incentive compensation design and annual compensation planning cycles.

• Exceptional communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills across all levels of the organization.

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, HR, Organizational Psychology) or SHRM-SCP/SPHR certification a plus.

The base pay range for this role is between $210,000 and $265,000. Base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location

jobs.title: Pediatrician (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

About the Role

Galileo is looking for a culturally sensitive Pediatrician to join our primary care medical group. As a part of our collaborative clinical care team, you will leverage data, technology, and operational rigor to optimize great patient outcomes while offering highly personalized care and shared decision making with patients.

This is an in office role, supporting our clinic in Starbase, TX. Our clinic is open Monday through Friday from 8am-4pm CST, with future plans to be open until 8pm CST. We're open to both part-time and full-time employment.

Here’s what you’ll do:

• Act as a key PCP for our patient population, delivering care in the clinic and digitally

• Provide primary care across the full scope of preventive health, chronic disease management, and urgent care for pediatric patients

• Collaborate and partner across care team members including behavioral health, virtual urgent care and triage, and clinical subspecialists

• Educate patients on their health conditions and develop individualized care and treatment plans

• Solve patient problems in an efficient, nimble manner by drawing on resourcefulness, collaborating with team members to leverage their expertise, and a “can-do” approach

About You

You are a Pediatrician with extensive clinical experience. You are comfortable with complex clinical and social needs and eager to care for patients in a modern, technology-enabled practice. You are driven to create systems that enable personalized, empathetic care for individuals and families in the community, and you are eager to find a practice that supports approaching patient care in ways that make a meaningful, real impact on their lives.

We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:

• 3+ years of clinical experience in chronic care and primary care for ages 0-17

• Comfort with basic procedural skills

• Active board certification in Pediatrics

• Active licensure in Texas or ability to obtain license by start date with Galileo

• Strong communication skills, especially the ability to translate complex ideas into simple language

• Bi-lingual in English and Spanish is a plus

Physical Requirements: The employee must be able to meet the following requirements with or without reasonable accommodation(s):

• This position requires the ability to stand, sit, and walk for extended periods of time

• Ability to lift and carry objects weighing up to 20 pounds

• The job involves frequent bending, reaching, and kneeling to perform various tasks

Compensation: This is a salaried position with annualized salary of $300,000-$325,000 (1.0 FTE) commensurate to experience. For those looking to work part-time, the compensation will be prorated based on weekly hours.

Benefits Offered:

• Medical / Dental / Vision insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account + match

• Company paid STD/LTD, AD&D, and Life insurance

• Paid Family Leave

• 401K + match

• Paid Time Off

How We Hire

Galileo Health is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

We have recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. We will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments or access to any financial accounts; and/or conduct text-only interviews. If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

jobs.title: Customer Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
Step into the innovative world of LG Electronics. As a global leader in technology, LG Electronics is dedicated to creating innovative solutions for a better life. Our brand promise, 'Life's Good', embodies our commitment to ensuring a happier life for all. We have a rich history spanning over six decades and a global presence in over 290 locations.  Our diverse portfolio includes Home Appliance Solutions, Media Entertainment Solutions, Vehicle Solutions, and Eco Solutions.  Our management philosophy, "Jeong-do Management," embodies our commitment to high ethical standards and transparent operations. Grounded in the principles of 'Customer-Value Creation' and 'People-Oriented Management', these values shape our corporate culture, fostering creativity, diversity, and integrity. At LG, we believe in the power of collective wisdom through an inclusive work environment.  Join us and become a part of a company that is shaping the future of technology.  At LG, we strive to make Life Good for Everyone.

Position Summary

The Customer Solutions Specialist delivers timely, accurate, and professional support across customer inquiries, cases, orders, parts, warranty, returns, and related service needs. The role owns issues through resolution, maintains complete case documentation, and collaborates across teams to provide a consistent customer experience.

The specialist also develops and maintains accurate, customer-focused CSG processes, procedures, and FAQs that promote self-service, improve information accessibility, and reduce avoidable contacts. Approved AI tools may be used to support content development, standardization, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Documentation, Accuracy, and Self-Service

• Develop and maintain accurate, customer-focused CSG processes, procedures, standard work, knowledge articles, and FAQs.

• Convert complex internal information into clear, consistent, and professional customer-facing content.

• Validate documentation with process owners and subject matter experts before publication or distribution.

• Organize content so customers and employees can quickly locate answers and complete common tasks through self-service.

• Review content routinely for accuracy, usability, duplication, and opportunities to reduce repeat contacts.

• Use approved AI tools to assist with drafting, editing, formatting, and content standardization while ensuring human review and final accuracy.

Customer Support and Case Ownership

• Respond to customer and partner inquiries through assigned channels with professionalism, accuracy, and urgency.

• Create, update, and manage cases from initial contact through resolution, including clear notes, actions, ownership, and next steps.

• Research order, parts, warranty, return, shipment, account, and process-related questions using approved systems and resources.

• Communicate realistic status updates and coordinate escalations when issues require cross-functional support.

• Identify customer impact, remove barriers where possible, and confirm resolution before closing the case.

Operational Excellence and Collaboration

• Follow established policies, procedures, service standards, and data handling requirements.

• Partner with Sales, Operations, Parts, Warranty, Logistics, Technical Support, and other teams to resolve issues and improve processes.

• Identify recurring contact drivers, documentation gaps, and process breakdowns; recommend practical corrective actions.

• Participate in training, calibration, team meetings, and continuous improvement activities.

• Support team service-level, quality, productivity, case-aging, and customer-experience objectives.

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent; associate or bachelor's degree preferred.

• Experience in customer service, customer solutions, call center, order management, technical support, or related environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain information clearly to internal and external audiences.

• Demonstrated attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.

• Ability to prioritize multiple cases, meet deadlines, and work effectively across functions.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and experience using CRM, case-management, knowledge-management, ERP, or similar business systems.

• Ability to learn about products, policies, processes, and systems quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience creating standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, FAQs, training materials, or customer-facing documentation.

• Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM and case-management platform.

• Experience supporting parts, warranty, orders, logistics, returns, distributors, contractors, or business-to-business customers.

• Familiarity with approved generative AI tools for business writing, knowledge development, or process improvement.

jobs.title: Senior User Experience Designer (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas or take over sponsorship at this time.

About the role:

Enova’s UX team designs the experiences behind our financial products for business owners and consumers. As a Senior UX Designer, you’ll combine strong research and design skills with strategic thinking to solve complex problems and deliver experiences that drive measurable results. You’ll partner with Product, Engineering and Marketing to uncover opportunities, shape solutions and balance customer needs, business objectives and technical constraints. You'll also embrace AI to advance how we research, design and deliver work.

About you:

You believe great design starts long before the first wireframe. It starts with asking better questions, challenging assumptions and using data and insights to uncover opportunities others might overlook. Solving the problem in front of you isn't enough. You want to understand whether it's the
right problem to solve. Curiosity, conviction and craft drive your work. You perform and dig deep into research, find meaning in complexity and turn insights into experiences that feel remarkably simple. Confident enough to challenge conventional thinking and humble enough to recognize a better idea, you know how to bring others along. You're excited by how AI and emerging technologies are changing what's possible, but recognize that technology is only as valuable as the problems it solves. Above all, you love the craft of design as much as the strategy behind it, and you're driven to turn ambitious ideas into experiences that make a measurable difference.

Responsibilities:

• Lead research end to end: Independently frame research questions, select appropriate methods, conduct studies and synthesize qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable insights that inform design decisions and uncover opportunities across the customer journey.

• Turn insights into experiences: Translate complex customer needs, research findings and business requirements into elegant experiences, from initial concepts and wireframes through high-fidelity Figma prototypes. Apply strong information architecture, interaction and visual design skills.

• Apply AI across the UX process: Integrate AI into research, synthesis, ideation, prototyping and design to improve quality and efficiency. Proactively experiment with emerging tools, evaluate their impact and help evolve how the team works.

• Influence and collaborate: Build trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Marketing and other teams. Communicate design decisions with confidence, use research and data to influence outcomes, and exercise sound judgment about when to advocate, adapt or compromise.

• Design within established systems and constraints: Apply and evolve the design system with sound judgment while meeting legal, compliance and accessibility requirements. Balance customer needs, business objectives and technical considerations to deliver effective, scalable and competitive solutions.

• Identify opportunities and measure impact: Look beyond immediate project requests to proactively identify customer and business opportunities. Partner with UX leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to help inform product priorities, define success metrics and use performance data to evaluate and continuously improve experiences.

• Drive work forward: Take ownership of complex UX challenges, navigate ambiguity and changing priorities, and partner with UX Writing, Product, Engineering and fellow designers to move solutions from problem definition through launch and iteration

Requirements:

• 6+ years of UX design experience, including work in financial services or another highly regulated industry, with a portfolio demonstrating strong research, design execution and measurable product impact.

• Advanced qualitative and quantitative research skills, with demonstrated experience independently planning and conducting studies, synthesizing findings and translating insights into actionable design decisions.

• Strong UX design craft, including information architecture, interaction design, prototyping and visual design, with advanced Figma proficiency and experience working within design systems.

• Demonstrated experience applying generative AI across UX research and design workflows to improve quality, accelerate execution or develop new approaches.

• Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders, constructively challenge assumptions and balance competing business, technical and user needs.

• Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with experience proactively identifying product opportunities and connecting customer insights to measurable business outcomes.

• Adaptability, sound judgment and demonstrated ability to independently navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems and deliver results.

• Experience with UX research and behavioral analytics tools such as Dscout, FullStory or similar platforms.

• Strong understanding of digital product development, technical constraints and agile workflows, with experience partnering closely with Engineering to bring designs to life.

• Familiarity with design-to-develop tools and workflows, including Storybook, Chromatic or similar technologies.

About our Enova Studios team:

Enova Studios is the in-house creative agency for Enova’s small business and consumer lending brands: OnDeck, CashNetUSA, NetCredit, Simplic and more. We bring Creative, Content, Code and UX capabilities together under one roof. Leveraging deep brand knowledge, cross-functional
relationships and strategic context, we turn customer insights into work that drives real results.

Compensation:

The budgeted annual salary range for this position is $75,000 to $110,000. Actual annual salary will be determined based on qualifications, skills, experience, and level assessed during the hiring process and may fall outside of the range shown. Additional compensation for this role may include a bonus. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in Company benefits, described in more detail here.

#LI-Hybrid #BI-Hybird #LI-FB1

Benefits & Perks:

• Our hybrid roles require in-office work Tuesday through Thursday, with remote flexibility on Mondays and Fridays. This schedule fosters collaboration, team connection, and strategic planning, enhancing communication and effectiveness to drive results.

• Health, dental, and vision insurance including mental health benefits

• 401(k) matching plus a roth option (U.S. Based employees only)

• PTO & paid holidays off

• Sabbatical program (for eligible roles)

• Summer hours (for eligible roles)

• Paid parental leave

• DEI groups (B.L.A.C.K. @ Enova, HOLA @ Enova, Women @ Enova, Pride @ Enova, South Asians @ Enova, APEX @ Enova, and Parents @ Enova)

• Employee recognition and rewards program

• Charitable matching and a paid volunteer day…Plus so much more!

About Enova

Enova International is a leading financial technology company that provides online financial services through our AI and machine learning-powered Colossus™platform. We serve non-prime consumers and businesses alike, while offering world-class technology and services to traditional banks—in order to create accessible credit for millions.

Being a values-driven organization is at the core of Enova’s success. We live our values by listening to our customers, challenging assumptions, thinking big, setting high expectations, and hiring and developing the best. jobs.title: Development Test Specialist
jobs.description:
About Northwood:

Northwood is a modern space infrastructure company bringing the benefits of space to the masses through advanced communications technology. We are building a global network of phased array ground stations that enable real-time, reliable communication for satellite missions such as national security, global connectivity, and disaster response. With a vertically integrated approach, Northwood designs, builds, and rapidly deploys scalable systems that power the next generation of space missions. If you like solving complex challenges and seeing your work deployed around the world with real impact, Northwood is the place to do it.



Role: 

Northwood is seeking a Development Test Specialist to build and operate the hands-on test infrastructure that enables rapid hardware iteration from prototype through integration and qualification. In this role, you’ll assemble and troubleshoot test racks and setups, perform benchtop and integrated testing, and support environmental and system-level test campaigns with high-quality documentation and traceability. You’ll work closely with test engineers and hardware teams to debug anomalies, execute rework, fabricate harnessing and RF assemblies, and maintain a well-run lab environment. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who thrives in fast-paced development environments and enjoys turning scrappy prototypes into repeatable test setups that accelerate learning and reliability.



Responsibilities:

 - Build, wire, and troubleshoot test racks, fixtures, and mechanical/electrical test setups

 - Perform benchtop and integrated testing independently or with engineers, following procedures and requirements

 - Execute SMT + through-hole solder rework and fabricate harnesses/coax assemblies

 - Support integration and environmental test (repeatable configs, calibration/traceability, documentation)

 - Summarize and share test data and preliminary results, and support anomaly investigations to resolution

 - Maintain lab readiness (calibrated instrumentation, equipment health, tooling, consumables, organization)

 - Drive 5S and process improvements to improve throughput and reliability

 - Help develop safe work practices for high voltage / high power RF systems

 - Partner with test engineers to improve rack maintainability, documentation, and throughput



Basic Qualifications:

 - High school diploma or equivalency certificate

 - 6+ years of experience as an electronics technician, test technician, or specialist supporting complex hardware

 - Knowledge of Ohm's Law, DC power supplies, and multimeters

 - Ability in soldering/rework for SMT and through-hole components, including fine-pitch work

 - Knowledge/experience operating basic machine shop equipment, including: sanders, grinders, saws, and hand tools



Preferred Qualifications: 

 - Associate or bachelor's degree with a focus in physics, mathematics, or engineering

 - Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and mechanical drawings

 - Familiarity with the Linux command line

 - Ability to fabricate and repair electrical systems, including: soldering, crimping, and assembling connectors/harnesses

 - Ability to fabricate mechanical components and assemblies, including: milling, drilling, tapping and torquing

 - Knowledge/experience with RF test - including spectrum analyzer and network analyzer measurements - and dB units



Additional Information:

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.



To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.



Northwood Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Northwood Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.description:
As a part-time Assistant Teacher (Float) at Bezos Academy (internally titled Assistant Teacher I), you share our passion for early childhood education and commitment to creating nurturing, high-quality learning environments for all children. While exact responsibilities will vary from school to school, you may assist in classrooms, serve and supervise mealtimes, and support the overall operations of the school. Drawing on your organizational skills, professionalism, and commitment to children, you will support a multi-state network of schools in under-resourced communities, offering quality Montessori-inspired preschool at no cost to families.

LOCATION

We are actively hiring for a part-time Assistant Teacher (Float) to support our preschool in Mesa - Greenfield Estates (4840 E Adobe Street, Mesa, AZ 85205).

SCHEDULES, BENEFITS, AND COMPENSATION

• This is a part-time, non-exempt/hourly position requiring a minimum of 20 hours per week, with occasional opportunities to work additional hours based on school needs.

• You will work a four-hour shift, Monday through Friday, totaling 20 hours per week. Specific school schedules are determined by school leaders when considering all staff, classroom, and community needs, but are currently expected to be 11:00am-3:00pm.

• The full compensation range for this position is $19-$22 per hour. The starting pay for all new employees is $19 per hour.

• Benefits include paid sick (care) time, accrued based on hours worked, and a 401(k) plan with a 4% employer contribution match.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Age 18 with high school diploma or GED

• Six or more months of prior work experience in childcare, education, or a related setting

• Ability to pass background checks, clear tuberculosis screenings, and (upon hire) successfully complete trainings required by the state of Arizona to supervise children independently

• Ability to independently supervise, communicate effectively with, and care for young children safely, including ability to lift a minimum of 40 lbs

• Access to reliable transportation to and from work and ability to consistently attend work as scheduled to ensure proper staff-to-child classroom ratios and support smooth school operations

• Must have a valid Food Handler’s Permit or be willing to obtain one upon hire

• Ability to complete 20 hours of onboarding by your seventh day of employment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Demonstrated reliability and flexibility in supporting school operations, including meal service, playground supervision, assisting with classroom coverage as needed, and lead after-school activities

• Prior experience supporting or teaching children ages 3–5 in a Montessori or early childhood classroom setting

• Experience working effectively across lines of difference and fostering an inclusive, welcoming environment for all children and families

• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage daily operational tasks such as classroom setup, safety checks, and basic clerical responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

*NOTE: The combination of responsibilities may vary based on the needs of the school site, students, and prior experiences of the Assistant Teacher (Float).

Instructional

• Serve as a floating assistant teacher, providing support wherever and however the school most needs it each day

• As needed, independently supervise children throughout the day in classrooms and a variety of other situations, including but not limited to arrival/departure, transitions, outside time, rest/nap time, and (if offered) extended hours

• Assist in maintaining accurate child and family records

• Complete Montessori basics training and credentialing/licensing requirements within seven days of hire

Operational

• Support Bezos Academy classrooms by following regulations and guidelines in the day-to-day operation of the classroom and school (e.g. cleaning/preparing materials, meal prep and cleanup, nap time transitions, laundry, bathroom supervision, etc.)

• Support school leadership and teachers to foster a nurturing, safe, and stimulating, non-competitive school environment

• Support children’s increasing independence with daily living skills (i.e., washing hands, using the bathroom, eating meals and snacks, cleaning up, etc.)

• Maintain licensing and credentialing requirements and complete required ongoing professional development trainings in a timely manner

• Attend staff meetings and family events as schedule allows

• Assume postures at low levels (e.g., kneeling, stooping, bending, and sitting on the floor) as needed to communicate effectively with children

Other

• Attend staff meetings and family events as schedule allows

• Provide support to nearby Bezos Academy schools, as needed, at the direction of your Head of School or District School Leader

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Marketing Manager - Enterprise Password Manager
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



With over 180,000 business customers, Enterprise Password Manager is 1Password's core product. It is rapidly evolving into a complete credentials security platform for humans, machines, and AI agents.

This is a Senior Staff PMM role. Individual contributor with broad organizational visibility. You’ll report to the Director of Product Marketing and own EPM end-to-end: messaging, positioning, competitive strategy, and launch execution.

You will shape how the market understands credentials security as 1Password grows.



How we’re using AI today
On the Marketing team, we’re growing our AI capability together and redesigning how work gets done. We’ve built agents to improve workflows focused on competitive intelligence, content creation, and campaign planning, helping us stay sharp, reduce context-switching, and surface the right information at the right time. AI helps us coordinate, execute, and uncover insights faster so we can spend more time on what’s most important: performance, judgement, and driving the future of 1Password.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

Experience and Domain Expertise

 - 7+ years of B2B SaaS product marketing, with direct experience in password management, enterprise vaulting, credentials security, or identity security.

 - Working knowledge of broad cybersecurity concepts.

 - You've repositioned a mature enterprise product. You know the difference between a messaging refresh and actually shifting how the market thinks about something.

 - You can market to enterprise IT and security buyers: the admin managing rollout, the CISO approving the spend, and the security engineer evaluating the technical depth.

 - A track record of winning in competitive markets by displacing incumbents, not just differentiating in an open field.

Technical Depth

 - You understand how credentials work beyond passwords: API keys, certificates, machine secrets, passkeys, and what it takes to issue credentials to AI agents.

 - Working knowledge of enterprise IT: MDM, SSO, directory services, and where password management fits in the IAM stack.

AI-Forward, Not AI-Dependent

 - You use AI to go faster, not to think less. You know what to hand off and what to own, and you can tell good output from output that still needs work.

 - You want AI to free up time for the work only a good product marketer can do: strategy, judgment, and narrative.

 - You own the ideas you bring. Walk into a room with a recommendation and you can defend it. Candidates who produce content but can’t explain the thinking behind it won’t fit here.

Strategic Storytelling and Senior-Level Communication

 - You write for multiple audiences without diluting the message. An IT admin and a CISO aren't reading the same document for the same reason. You know how to serve both.

 - Strong narrative instincts: open with the problem, build to the solution, and land in a way that makes the reader feel the product was built for their situation.

 - You’ve shaped category narratives, not just contributed to them.



Bonus points for:

 - Security certifications (CISSP, Security+, or similar).

 - Experience developing thought leadership in a fast-moving category. 1Password has a team that produces content. This role provides the point of view.

 - You've repositioned an established product category. There's a real difference between entering a space and redefining it.



What you can expect:

Own EPM Product Marketing

 - Own messaging, positioning, and launch strategy for the Enterprise Password Manager.

 - Define how 1Password talks about credentials security for employees, service accounts, and AI agents.

 - Tell the story clearly to analysts, IT buyers, security leaders, and sellers. The narrative has to work for practitioners and executives.

 - Connect EPM’s story to the Unified Access platform narrative.

Build Competitive Intelligence and Category Positioning

 - Own positioning and market leadership claims for EPM.

 - Partner with Solutions Marketing on competitive differentiation. Know the competitive set cold: where they’re strong, where they’re not, and how to win against each.

 - Track where the credentials security market is moving and keep 1Password’s messaging ahead of it.

Enable the Field with Tools That Actually Get Used

 - Produce discovery decks, battlecards, objection-handling guides, and technical briefs that sellers and SEs reach for because they work.

 - Take complex concepts like passkeys, machine credential lifecycle, AI agent authentication, and zero-knowledge architecture and make them usable in a customer conversation.

 - Surface win/loss signals from the field and turn them into repeatable GTM motions, not one-off documents.

Influence EPM Product Strategy

 - Bring the market's perspective to Product: customer evidence, analyst intelligence, competitive signals, field feedback.

 - Make the market case early, before decisions are locked.
   
   

Why join us:

 - The credentials security market is being reshaped by machine identities and AI agents. You'll own how 1Password tells that story.

 - You'll work across product strategy, competitive positioning, and field execution. The work is visible at the executive level.

 - 1Password is remote-first and has been since day one. We hire for judgment, not proximity.

 - The company is growing and there's room to shape how PMM works here, not just execute what's already been defined.

How we work with AI

Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

Our approach to remote work

While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer

jobs.title: Airworthiness Engineer, Magnum
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is seeking a Senior Airworthiness Engineer to join the Group 4 & 5 Maneuver Dominance team at our Costa Mesa HQ. The mission is to revolutionize the DoD capabilities at a pace never seen before. You will work on the Airworthiness aspects of new aircraft development effort in a lean, high-ownership culture where you directly shape the product and operate at a velocity to fly new designs within months, not years.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• You will work as an Airworthiness Engineer to develop and author Airworthiness certification and conformance plans for Group 4 & 5 developmental and production aircraft, to fly both CONUS and OCONUS.

• Bring a pragmatic and right-sized approach to Airworthiness (and Systems Safety) to enable capability realization at the speed of relevance.

• Engage with customers, end-users and local regulatory authorities to identify and negotiate appropriate Airworthiness frameworks and recognized standards to develop the overall Airworthiness strategy as a foundation for design efforts.

• Develop Airworthiness plans and documentation in support of regional regulatory processes and submissions.

• Support System Design Reviews (SDR) and engineering governance structures such as Preliminary Design Reviews (PDR), Critical Design Reviews (CDR), Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), Safety Review Boards (SRB) representing and Airworthiness.

• Ensure the logical and systematic realization of customer airworthiness certification objectives, to include the tailoring of traditional Airworthiness processes, and continuously evaluate and update Airworthiness plans throughout the product lifecycle.

• You will develop, author and maintain all Airworthiness activities in a digital environment which is interconnected with system requirements, program schedules, flight test point matrix, and also risk assessments, providing input to the flight test program execution schedule.

• Faced with technical and execution challenges, you will be expected to develop creative solutions to unique problems. You will be biased for action — you are empowered to engage your team to solve and fix any problem you encounter.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A bachelor degree in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or aviation related engineering degree.

• 8+ years airworthiness engineering experience.

• Experience with safety-critical hardware and software systems in the Defense or Aerospace industries, specifically crewed aircraft, rotorcraft, UAS (Group 3 or larger) or weapon systems.

• Extensive knowledge of AC 23-1309-1E, MIL-STD-882E, MIL-STD 516C airworthiness, AC-17-01, and other relevant safety standards.

• Experience establishing and maintaining relationships with civil and military Airworthiness authorities (DoD, FAA and/or EASA).

• Proven experience working civil and military Airworthiness processes, including MIL-HDBK-516 series documents, throughout the life cycle of a developmental aircraft to achieve successful program completion.

• Familiarity with technical software packages such as Relyence, Teamcenter, JIRA, JAMA, Cameo, and/or Ansys.

• Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal and communication skills.

• A sincere commitment to a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture.

• Eligible to obtain and maintain a security clearance in United States, United Kingdom, or Australia.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Masters in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering or aviation related technical discipline.

• 15+ years airworthiness engineering experience.

• Systems engineering and Airworthiness experience with large UAS airworthiness authorizations.

• Experience authoring and submitting FAA Certificates of Waiver or Authorization (COA).

• Previously held a position as Airworthiness Engineering Lead or Airworthiness Engineer.

• Airworthiness experience on a team that executed first flight on a manned or large UAS developmental aircraft.

• Experience working US Army framework for air worthiness

US Salary Range

$167,000—$222,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Director of Customer Support
jobs.description:
About Tekmetric

Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.

Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.

Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

Where We Work: At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

About the Role

We are looking for a Director of Customer Support to own the quality, efficiency, and people strategy of our customer support organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for customer satisfaction and quality assurance across every support channel and every tier (Tier 1–3), while building the team, processes, and metrics that allow support to scale with a growing SaaS business.

Our customers depend on our platform to run their businesses every day, and support is often where they decide whether they trust us. You will lead the full support organization across phone, chat, email, and AI-assisted channels, setting one consistent standard of quality and building/maintaining the programs to measure, coach, and sustain it. You will lead managers and team leads, shape the structure and career paths of the team, and be accountable for the experience customers have every time they reach out.

You will set the standard for what great support looks like, hold the organization accountable to it, and develop the leaders and agents who deliver it. Support Operations owns the systems, data, forecasting models, and process infrastructure behind that work. You will partner closely, bringing Ops prioritized improvement ideas and the data to back them, and Ops will turn them into roadmap delivery. This role is built for someone who is equally comfortable coaching a frontline agent, presenting KPIs to executives, and partnering with Product and Engineering to fix root causes.

In your first year, you will:

• Establish a unified QA and customer satisfaction framework that applies consistently across all channels and tiers

• Improve CSAT and resolution quality while holding or improving efficiency metrics such as FCR, TTR, and SLA adherence

• Define clear career paths, training programs, and coaching practices that strengthen retention and internal promotion

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to turn support insights into fixes that reduce contact volume

• Work with Operations to refine the forecasting, staffing, and reporting rhythm that lets leadership see support performance clearly and plan with confidence

You will report to executive leadership and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, remote-first environment where support is treated as a strategic driver of retention and growth, not a cost center.

Key Responsibilities

Quality & Customer Satisfaction

• Own customer satisfaction outcomes (CSAT, NPS) across all support channels, including phone, chat, email, and AI-assisted interactions

• Design, run, and continuously improve the QA program for Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3, with consistent scorecards, calibration sessions, and sampling methodology

• Ensure quality standards are applied consistently across channels and tiers, and that QA findings drive coaching, training, and process changes

• Review customer feedback, low-CSAT interactions, and escalations to identify trends and drive corrective action

• Establish quality benchmarks and hold managers and team leads accountable for results

• Evaluate and improve the quality of AI and automation-handled interactions alongside human-handled contacts

Efficiency & Operations

• Own operational efficiency metrics including FCR, AHT, TTR, SLA adherence, backlog, and cost per contact

• Partner with Support Operations on forecasting, staffing, scheduling, and capacity planning to meet service levels

• Identify and lead initiatives that reduce handle time, increase deflection and self-service, and improve resolution rates without sacrificing quality

• Define and maintain escalation paths, tier definitions, and handoff processes between Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3

• Evaluate and provide feedback on gaps in the support tech stack, including ticketing, telephony, QA, knowledge base, and AI tools

People Development & Career Pathing

• Hire, onboard, and retain a high-performing support organization, including Managers, Team Leads, and frontline agents

• Build clear career paths and role definitions from Tier 1 through leadership, including promotion criteria, skill matrices, and development plans

• Lead coaching and performance management practices, equipping managers to give consistent, data-driven feedback

• Own the training strategy, including new-hire onboarding, product and tool training, soft-skills development, and ongoing upskilling

• Foster a culture of accountability, engagement, and recognition; monitor team health, attrition, and morale

Strategy, Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

• Develop and execute the customer support strategy and multi-year roadmap in alignment with company goals

• Own headcount planning and organizational design around forecasted needs

• Serve as the voice of the customer, translating support trends and root-cause insights into actionable recommendations for Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales

• Partner with Engineering on Tier 3 escalations, bug triage, and incident communication

• Deliver regular performance reporting and data-driven recommendations to executive leadership

• Inform where there are gaps in the knowledge base and support documentation, and champion self-service resources

• Lead the team through change, including product launches, customer incidents, and periods of rapid growth

Qualifications

Required

• 8+ years of experience in customer support or contact center operations, with 5+ years leading managers or a multi-tier support organization

• Proven track record improving CSAT and quality through a structured QA program

• Experience managing support across multiple channels (phone, chat, email) and tiers (Tier 1–3)

• Demonstrated success building career paths, training programs, and coaching frameworks that improve retention and performance

• Strong analytical skills with experience using KPIs and dashboards to drive decisions

• Experience managing a department including headcount plan, and forecasting

• Hands-on experience with support platforms such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar

• Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to translate operational data into leadership-ready insights

• Background in SaaS or technology-sector support organizations

Preferred

• Experience implementing or optimizing AI and automation in support (chatbots, deflection, AI-assisted QA)

• Experience with QA and conversation intelligence tools such as Gong

• Experience scaling a support team through rapid growth

• Familiarity with automotive or other vertical SaaS industries

Why You'll Love Working With Us

Health & Wellness That Have You Covered:

• Enjoy the flexibility of remote work

• Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.

• Flexible PTO — No set number of days, just the trust to take the time you need. We genuinely encourage our team to disconnect and recharge.

• Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones.

• Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families.

• Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp.

Investing in Your Future (and Present):

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you.

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further.

• Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind.

• Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best.

• After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you.

• Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development.

Most importantly, we have a stellar team, a whole lot of fun, and work that actually matters to the shops and families we serve!

Tekmetric is an equal opportunity employer. We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Tekmetric will never ask for your personal financial or banking information or require any financial commitment as part of our candidate search or application process. No job offers will be made without a formal interview process. All legitimate Tekmetric job postings are listed at tekmetric.com/careers. jobs.title: Care Manager, LPN Springfield, MO / Field-Based)
jobs.description:
FreedomCare is a healthcare company that has been dedicated to revolutionizing the home care industry since 2016. We support our patients by ensuring they have the power to choose a caregiver who will care for them in the comfort of their own homes. Our mission spans coast to coast, supporting patients across the U.S.

We pride ourselves on our values which drive the level of care that we deliver to our patients:

• Here For You (An attitude of service, empathy, and availability)

• Own It (Drive and ownership)

• Do the Right Thing (High integrity)

• Be Positive (Great attitude and a can-do positive approach to challenges

Join our team and make a positive impact on the lives of others! We are looking for an LPN for our team in Missouri.

This is a field-based position that requires frequent travel to patient's homes across our Springfield, MO market.

Department & Position Overview:

FreedomCare’s Missouri operations support In-Home Services (IHS), a Medicaid home and community-based services model that allows eligible participants to receive in-home assistance to help them live independently.

The Care Manager, LPN is responsible for conducting initial in-home assessments, annual home visits, and providing ongoing care management and support. This role combines clinical assessment, care coordination, patient and caregiver education, and quality assurance to ensure safe, effective, and person-centered care.

The Care Manager, LPN collaborates closely with patients, caregivers, and interdisciplinary care teams to assess needs, identify potential changes to the individualized plans of care, and facilitate the seamless initiation and delivery of services. Through regularly scheduled home visits, the LPN evaluates patient and caregiver well-being, monitors the quality and effectiveness of care, and identifies opportunities to enhance health outcomes, safety, and regulatory compliance. The Care Manager, LPN proactively communicates clinical concerns, changes in condition, and potential barriers to care with the appropriate team members to ensure timely intervention, effective care coordination, and optimal patient outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct initial in-person clinical assessments and coordinate timely service activation, ensuring all required documentation, approvals, and standard procedures are completed.

• Identify potential changes to the individualized plans of care, making and documenting revisions as the patient’s needs or condition change.

• Educate patients, caregivers, and internal teams regarding care needs, safety considerations, service requirements, caregiver responsibilities, and next steps.

• Coordinate patient care through timely communication and documentation with physicians, clinical disciplines, internal partners, and appropriate community resources.

• Provide ongoing education and coaching to support effective use of established best practices, promote caregiver competency, and connect patients and families with appropriate resources.

• Review participant service records regularly and respond appropriately to identified changes in the patient’s condition, environment, or service needs.

• Identify changes in condition, safety concerns, service gaps, incidents, or other urgent issues and escalate them in accordance with established clinical protocols.

• Complete and document assessments, visits, clinical observations, care-plan updates, incidents, communications, and follow-up actions accurately, thoroughly, and within required timeframes.

• Support authorization, renewal, start-of-care, and continued-service processes, as applicable.

• Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, professional standards, and company policies and procedures.

• Perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Credentials:

• Diploma from an accredited nursing program.

• Valid Licensed Practical Nurse license and in good standing by Missouri Board of Nursing

• Minimum of (1) year of experience with the care of the elderly, or individuals with disabilities or medically complex conditions.

• Valid driver’s license and car insurance required, with means of reliable transportation.

Qualifications:

• Demonstrated commitment to providing a high level of customer service, with the ability to communicate with empathy, patience, professionalism, and respect.

• Ability to follow established scripts, workflows, policies, procedures, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Strong active listening skills, with the ability to understand patient needs, clarify concerns, and provide the necessary support and escalation when appropriate.

• Effective verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly summarize interactions, document case activity, and communicate case status and next steps.

• Strong typing and computer proficiency, with the ability to efficiently navigate contact center technology, customer relationship management systems, telephone platforms, and other necessary software applications while accurately documenting interactions.
