jobs.description:
ABOUT JUNIPER SQUARE

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first https://blog.junipersquare.com/juniper-square-ponders-future-of-office-with-digital-first-hybrid-workplace-strategy/ operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.




ABOUT YOUR ROLE

Juniper Square is seeking a high-impact sales leader to build and lead our Venture Capital sales team. This is a full-time people leadership role. You will lead a team of four quota-carrying Account Executives, drive new logo acquisition through your team, establish a repeatable GTM motion, and serve as one of Juniper Square’s most credible voices in the venture capital ecosystem.

You will own team performance, pipeline health, territory strategy, and forecasting accuracy. There will be a heightened focus on building Juniper Square’s technology motion into Venture Capital while continuing to grow our Fund Administration market share.

Key measurables include team ARR and logo quota attainment, people development, and iterating on the GTM playbook so we play defense against disruptors and offense against the incumbents.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Team Leadership & Performance Management

 - Lead, coach, and develop a team of quota-carrying Account Executives focused on the venture capital segment

 - Drive consistent quota attainment through structured pipeline reviews, deal coaching, and performance accountability

 - Instill a culture of urgency, rigor, and disciplined new logo execution

 - Identify performance gaps early and implement coaching plans to close them

 - Hire, onboard, and ramp high-performing Account Executives aligned to our ideal candidate profile

New Logo Acquisition & Pipeline Creation

 - Own new logo acquisition targets for the VC segment and hold your AEs accountable to sourcing and pipeline creation goals

 - Establish outbound discipline, sourcing cadences, and top-of-funnel accountability across the team

 - Define territory strategy and account prioritization to maximize coverage of the VC market

 - Ensure strong CRM hygiene, segmentation, and pipeline visibility across all active accounts

 - Set clear performance metrics for activity levels, conversion rates, and deal velocity

Deal Strategy & Sales Excellence

 - Coach reps on structured discovery, objection handling, competitive positioning, and deal strategy throughout the sales cycle

 - Inspect deals from prospecting through close, raising each team member’s sales acumen and execution quality

 - Train your team on the nuances of venture capital managers and how to build credibility with GP finance executives

 - Serve as executive sponsor on strategic and late-stage deals where your involvement can accelerate or secure a win

 - Ensure the team can confidently navigate pricing discussions, switching costs, and multi-stakeholder deal dynamics

VC Ecosystem & Market Coverage

 - Build and leverage relationships across VC firms, accelerators, and portfolio company networks to open doors for your team

 - Drive team presence at industry events and conferences to extend our network and generate pipeline

 - Provide competitive intelligence and VC market insights to product and executive leadership

 - Help define and evolve the VC coverage model as Juniper Square’s presence in the segment grows

Cross-Functional Partnership

 - Partner with Marketing on demand generation strategy, VC-specific positioning, and sales collateral

 - Collaborate with Partnerships to leverage ecosystem relationships for pipeline creation and referral channels

 - Work with Sales Operations to improve forecasting accuracy, CRM performance, and sales reporting

 - Contribute to overall VC GTM strategy in close partnership with Sales and executive leadership




QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
THE MISSION 💪

Our mission is to ensure that no one in the world has to suffer from a treatable skin disease because of an access issue ever again.




ABOUT HONEYDEW 👋

Honeydew is building a platform for hundreds of millions of people globally to access expertise and science-backed skin treatments, from prescription to retail. Our tech-forward dermatology experience helps people with chronic skin conditions access licensed specialists, FDA-approved treatment, and ongoing support in record time. Honeydew is the future of skin health — digitally native, scientifically rooted, integrated end-to-end, and powered by AI.




THE OPPORTUNITY 📈

Honeydew's Operations Experience engineering team has more to build than it can ship today, because the person leading it is also doing the work. As Engineering Manager, you'll take ownership of the team's plans, delivery, and people — a tech lead, engineers, and contractors — so the team can ship more, predictably, against our 2027 objectives. You'll also shape what the team becomes: its structure, its headcount, and its hiring plan.




WHAT YOU'LL BUILD (YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS) 🛠

 - Team ownership: 1:1s with every team member by day 15, ownership of the team's planning and delivery by day 60, and a written growth plan for each engineer by day 90

 - Better delivery: baseline cycle time, throughput, and deployment frequency by day 60, then improve at least two of them by 20% or more by day 180, while hitting roadmap commitments each quarter

 - A vision for the team through 2027: by day 120, an inventory of planned operations projects and the capacity they need; by day 180, a written vision covering team structure, headcount, and hiring plan


HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

Lead the team. You'll manage the Operations Experience engineering team, including contractors, running regular 1:1s, giving direct feedback, and growing each person.

Own delivery. You'll own the team's plans, efforts, and outputs, take part in all agile ceremonies and the planning and design sessions for operations feature work, and keep the team shipping predictably, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early.

Partner across the company. You'll work with other Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Product and Engineering leadership on feature plans and execution.

Shape what's next. You'll plan how the team grows through 2027, from structure to hiring.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The Non-Negotiables:

 - People management and hard conversations — a proven track record of giving direct feedback, managing performance (including underperformance), and growing engineers, across seniority levels and employment models, from a tech lead to contractors, with clear communication up and down

 - Delivery ownership — you turn priorities into a plan, keep the team shipping predictably, and surface risks and tradeoffs early, so the team is never the bottleneck

 - Cross functional collaboration — you can work across multiple teams and verticals to drive results

 - Technical depth — enough to understand our systems, judge the tradeoffs in technical plans, hold the quality bar, and earn the respect of senior engineers; you don't need to be the best coder on the team

The Nice-to-Haves:

 - 3+ years of experience managing an engineering team

 - Experience with our tech stack. React, Node, AWS, SQL

 - Player coach mentality, willing to roll up sleeves and code


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF…

 - You give direct feedback, and you receive it well

 - You keep a team shipping without becoming its bottleneck

 - You can say no to work the team doesn't have the capacity to take on

 - You grow people deliberately, with a plan, not by accident

 - You partner easily with Product and leadership, and know when to push back, rather than working in a silo


WHY HONEYDEW?

Real Ownership:

You'll own a team's plans, delivery, and people — this isn't a role where accountability disappears into a committee.

Mission-Critical Work:

The faster your team ships, the sooner the tools our operations teams rely on get better, and the sooner patients get care.

Total Rewards:

Competitive pay, equity, health benefits, and a fully remote role, plus employee perks and recognition programs.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.




THE ROLE

Our Product Managers operate like owners of their surface. The APM role is how we develop the next ones.

You join a senior PM's team and own a defined part of a banking product. You ship to real customers in your first quarter. You get real scope, a direct mentor, and honest feedback every week. The goal: in 18 months, you own a surface as a full PM.

In banking, every interaction carries trust. Money moves, cards get declined, payments settle or fail. You learn how a regulated financial product works from the inside, and you learn to build products that customers trust with their money.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own a feature area end to end. Your mentor gives you a defined part of the product. You own it from the problem to the result. Frame the problem, write the spec, ship it, and measure what changed. When the data shows a better direction, bring a recommendation, not only the data.

Build with Design and Engineering every day. Sit with your designer and engineers from the first sketch to the launch. Write specs that engineers want to read. Give clear feedback on flows and edge cases, because in banking an edge case is a customer's money. Unblock the team fast, and run launches end to end. In a regulated product, this also means that you bring Compliance and Operations in early, so they do not block the launch late.

Get close to customers. Talk to founders and finance teams every week. Read support tickets. Learn how early-stage companies think about cash, spend, and risk, and bring that knowledge back to the team.

Decide with data. Define success before you build. Pull your own data. Report clearly what worked and what did not.

Build with AI. Use frontier models to test ideas, build prototypes, analyze customer feedback, and draft specs. We expect AI to make you faster, and we expect you to find new ways to use it for our customers.


WHAT YOU GET

 - A named senior PM as your mentor, and a defined scope from your first week.

 - Weekly 1:1s and structured reviews at 6 and 12 months.

 - Direct exposure to product reviews with leadership.

 - A clear path to Product Manager.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have 1 – 3 years of experience in product, engineering, data, consulting, banking, at a startup, or in a customer facing role. Or you started something of your own.

 - You are analytical. You are comfortable with SQL, spreadsheets, and numbers, and you check your own work.

 - You are curious about how money moves. Knowledge of ACH, card networks, KYC/KYB, or reconciliation is a plus. We teach the rest.

 - You use AI every day, and you can show us something you built with it.

 - You write clearly. You can explain a complex problem in one page.

 - You take feedback well and act on it fast.

 - You take ownership. When something is broken, you fix it or you find the person who can.

Nice to have: a technical background or coding experience, work at a bank or fintech, or startup experience.

Our people are our most valuable asset. Our target compensation range for this role is $133K - $160K. Compensation will be determined by leveling and performance throughout the interview process. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

ABOUT ZELLO

Zello is a voice-first communication platform, powered by our industry-leading push-to-talk technology, to improve collaboration and productivity for desk-less workers. With over 175+ million users, we’re the #1 rated push-to-talk app in the world, delivering 9 billion (yes, with a B) messages a month. 

At Zello, our company values are at the heart of what we do everyday. We’re proud to serve the frontline, we’re privileged to connect people in times of crisis across the globe, and we’re honored to support first responders.

And this is where you come in.

At Zello, we keep frontline workers connected through instant, voice-first communication. Behind that mission is a People team focused on creating an exceptional employee experience and helping our organization grow.

We're a four-person People team supporting approximately 85 Zellonauts, and we're building an AI-enabled People function that scales with our business.

We're looking for a Senior People Operations Generalist who loves making things work better. Someone who takes pride in operational excellence, enjoys solving complex problems, and gets excited about building smarter systems and processes.

You'll own the operational foundation of our People function, including payroll, benefits, HRIS, compliance, and the employee lifecycle. You'll also have the autonomy to challenge how things work today, introduce new technology, and create solutions that make work easier for employees and the People team.

You'll work directly with our VP of People, have meaningful ownership over how we operate, and see the impact of your work across Zello.

If you love bringing order to complexity, take pride in getting the details right, and find yourself thinking, "There has to be a better way to do this," we'd love to meet you.



AFTER A SUCCESSFUL FIRST YEAR, YOU WILL HAVE

 - Owned reliable People operations: Independently managed payroll, benefits, HRIS, and employee lifecycle processes with strong accuracy, compliance, and controls, allowing the VP of People to step out of day-to-day operations.

 - Built smarter, scalable processes: Automated or AI-enabled at least five recurring processes, reducing manual work by 10+ hours monthly with appropriate quality checks.

 - Improved the employee experience: Elevated onboarding to help new hires ramp more effectively and improved employee access to People information through simpler workflows and self-service resources.

 - Advanced our People technology: Delivered a recommendation on our HRIS/payroll transition and, if approved, led operational implementation toward our target go-live.

 - Strengthened our operational foundation: Documented at least 90% of recurring People Operations processes, improved audit readiness, and reduced dependency on individual knowledge.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run reliable People operations: Own semi-monthly multi-state payroll, benefits and 401(k) administration, leaves of absence, HRIS administration, and employee lifecycle processes with strong accuracy and controls.

 - Build smarter systems: Own HRIS workflows, configuration, reporting, and data integrity. Use AI and automation to streamline processes while maintaining appropriate checks for accuracy and confidentiality.

 - Manage compliance and operational risk: Coordinate state employment registrations, filings, I-9/E-Verify, immigration cases with outside counsel, and international employment administration. Anticipate issues, maintain accurate records, and resolve problems at the root cause.

 - Drive our HRIS evolution: Help evaluate, select, and implement our next HRIS/payroll platform, building project plans, managing milestones, and coordinating with Finance, IT, and external partners.

 - Elevate the employee experience: Partner with Recruiting, IT, and managers to improve onboarding, simplify employee-facing processes, and make People information easier to find and use.

 - Support People programs: Manage the operational execution of performance reviews, compensation cycles, and other recurring People initiatives.

 - Own outcomes, not just tasks: Independently establish priorities, anticipate risks, bring recommendations, and drive initiatives through completion without waiting for direction.


WHO YOU ARE

 - An experienced operational owner. You bring meaningful hands-on People Operations experience, including independently managing multi-state U.S. payroll, benefits, and HR systems.

 - Analytical and detail-oriented. You are comfortable with spreadsheets, reconciliations, and complex data. You establish controls that catch errors before they impact employees and take accountability for resolving issues.

 - Naturally proactive. You don't wait for someone to establish every next step. You build plans, anticipate challenges, and bring thoughtful solutions and recommendations.

 - Systems-minded and AI-forward. You've improved or automated recurring processes and are excited to use technology to make work more effective. You know when to trust automation and when to validate the output.

 - Pragmatic and adaptable. You understand the importance of compliance but can navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment.

 - Energized by growth. You genuinely enjoy hands-on People Operations and thrive in an environment where you can improve existing processes and build what comes next.


THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - An HR business partner role. Manager coaching and employee relations sit with the VP of People, though there's room to grow into that work.

 - A people management role. This is an individual contributor seat.

 - A remote role. We work together in our Austin office four days a week.

 - A keep-the-lights-on role. You'll be expected to rebuild processes, not just run them.


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience leading an HRIS or payroll implementation.

 - Experience coordinating immigration, international employment, or complex leaves.

 - Experience building AI-enabled workflows or employee self-service tools.

 - Experience improving onboarding or employee programs.

 - Experience in a startup or scale-up environment.


WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

 - Real ownership: You'll have the autonomy to improve how our People function operates, not simply maintain existing processes.

 - Meaningful impact: You'll work directly with our VP of People and influence systems and experiences that touch every employee at Zello.

 - Room to build: We're investing in AI, automation, and better technology, giving you the opportunity to shape how People Operations evolves as we grow.

 - A career in operations: You can deepen your expertise and expand your impact without needing to move into strategic HR business partnering or people management.

 - A collaborative environment: We're based in Austin and work together in our office four days a week.



We hire for potential, passion for our mission, and a knack for solving difficult problems over checking every qualification box. We have competitive pay, equity with significant upside, and intentionally design our benefits to encourage healthy and well-balanced employees, flexible schedules and time off. We even offer a sabbatical after every five years of service so you’re able to pursue and enjoy what matters most to you. And of course, we wouldn’t be a technology company without a ping-pong table and free snacks in our break room. Join us!

Zello provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

All Zello personnel are required to comply with defined security, privacy, and compliance requirements applicable to their role along with requirements that are applicable to all Zello personnel.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Continuity
jobs.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

What We’re Looking For

We're seeking an Engineering Manager to lead Platform Continuity, a newly formed team within Cloud Platform Engineering that serves as the operational backbone of our multi-cloud infrastructure organization. This is a build-from-the-ground-up leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of operational discipline and engineering rigor.

Platform Continuity exists to execute the engineering work that keeps systems healthy and unblocked  work that requires privileged access and platform judgment, but does not belong to a single product vertical and is not net-new design. Your team handles IaC drift remediation, VDI operations, monitoring and alerting hygiene, cloud cost management, and SRE-tier application support across Datavant's AWS and Azure environments.

The ideal candidate understands the difference between operational work and infrastructure engineering  and holds the line between them. You build teams that work from playbooks, not ad hoc, and you're relentlessly focused on eliminating the work your team does by hand. You measure success not by ticket volume, but by how much repeatable work has been handed off to automation or back to accountable teams with runbooks that actually work.

You bring strong technical credibility with Staff-level SREs, a clear framework for operational intake and acceptance, and the management experience to lead a distributed team across US, Ireland, and Spain time zones. You communicate clearly across organizational boundaries, influence without authority, and know how to define scope precisely enough that nothing falls through the cracks  and nothing that shouldn't be yours ends up yours.

What You Will Do

• Lead, develop, and retain a team of senior and staff-level SREs distributed across the US, Ireland, and Spain providing both people leadership and technical direction.

• Own the Operational Intake & Acceptance process: no system is handed to Platform Continuity without a runbook, architecture context, validated access, and a live knowledge transfer walkthrough.

• Drive the shift-left mandate every repeatable pattern your team closes is a candidate for automation. Partner with the Cloud Platform Tools team to route identified patterns for elimination, and hold the team accountable to not becoming a permanent owner of solvable problems.

• Manage operational work across five categories: IaC/Terraform workspace hygiene, VDI/end-user compute, monitoring and alerting upkeep, cloud cost management and rightsizing, and SRE-tier client and application support.

• Establish and track the team's north star metric: org-wide KTLO (Keep The Lights On) percentage reduction from an 86% baseline, with per-team breakdowns tracked quarterly.

• Build and maintain a playbook library that makes your team's operational work reproducible, auditable, and eventually automatable.

• Define and enforce intake criteria work that can be closed by pointing someone to a doc is ITSD scope, not Platform Continuity scope. Protect the team from misrouted tickets and return them to the right owner.

• Partner with Cloud Platform Infrastructure, Services, eSRE, and Tools leadership to maintain clean ownership boundaries and coordinate on cross-cutting work.

• Serve as the operational escalation point for platform-layer issues that engineering teams cannot self-diagnose, including production access, SSL certificate management, and system-state remediation.

What You Need to Succeed

• 5+ years of engineering management experience, including managing distributed or international teams across multiple time zones.

• Strong technical foundation in cloud infrastructure operations sufficient to establish credibility with Staff-level SREs and make sound judgment calls on scope and escalation.

• Knowledge of Terraform/IaC; hands-on experience managing infrastructure state, module versioning, and workspace hygiene at scale.

• Solid Kubernetes operational knowledge (EKS and/or AKS) cluster health, workload troubleshooting, and node management.

• Experience with AWS (required) and Azure (strong plus) in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.

• Hands-on experience with observability platforms Datadog preferred including monitor management, alerting configuration, and dashboard governance.

• Demonstrated ability to build operational discipline: runbooks, SLAs, intake processes, escalation paths, and shift-left frameworks.

• Clear communication skills for defining scope boundaries, managing cross-team expectations, and explaining operational tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Comfort with ambiguity this is a new team with a deliberately bounded scope, and you'll be defining the operating model in parallel with executing it.

What Helps You Stand Out

• Experience with Datadog in FedRAMP or GovCloud environments.

• Background managing operational or platform teams with an explicit automation-first or toil-reduction mandate.

• Familiarity with PagerDuty, Incident.io, and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD).

• Experience in healthcare technology, life sciences, or other regulated data environments.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Division Marketing Coordinator at The Fischer Group supports division sales by coordinating marketing initiatives that help drive traffic, appointments, and sales. This role helps ensure collateral, community touchpoints, events, communications, and administrative processes are delivered accurately, on time, and in alignment with standards. Working with division teams and outside vendors, the coordinator helps keep projects moving and marketing materials ready across assigned divisions. From event logistics to digital listings and marketing materials, the work brings variety across division marketing touchpoints.

This position is 100% onsite in Erlanger, KY, starting day 1.
Compensation: $20-24/hr

You Will Thrive in This Role If You…

• Enjoy organizing multiple assignments and keeping details, deadlines, and follow-through on track.

• Communicate professionally and responsively with sales teams, division partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.

• Bring a customer-service mindset to interactions with internal and external partners.

• Adapt to changing tasks, responsibilities, people, and work environments.

• Plan and organize work toward clear goals, using information to identify problems and next steps.

• Look for practical ways to improve recurring processes while maintaining accuracy and brand consistency.

These skills will be used to:

• Coordinate division marketing initiatives that support traffic, appointments, and sales.

• Coordinate the ordering, production, and distribution of collateral, signage, model home items, promotional items, and related market materials.

• Review marketing materials, website content, and division-facing information for accuracy, completeness, and brand consistency.

• Support event planning and execution, including scheduling, materials, communication, logistics, and follow-up.

• Help maintain community, model, and market-home marketing readiness, and support updates to digital listings, location information, and related marketing touchpoints.

• Process invoices, secure approvals, track vendor paperwork, and help ensure timely, accurate payment for marketing-related expenses.

• Gather and organize marketing information, performance updates, and meeting materials for division and sales meetings.

• Coordinate with internal partners and outside vendors to keep projects moving on schedule and aligned with expectations.

• Provide responsive, professional support to Sales, division teams, and other stakeholders.

• Identify ways to improve recurring marketing processes, pursue ongoing self-improvement, participate in required training programs, and perform additional duties as requested.

Required Qualifications:

• Four-year degree in Marketing, Sales, Communications, Business, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

• One or more years of experience in marketing, communications, administrative, or customer-facing work.

• Experience supporting events, promotions, digital content updates, or vendor coordination.

• Experience in homebuilding, real estate, retail, hospitality, or another fast-paced, customer-driven environment.

• Familiarity with Canva, CRM systems, website content updates, or task management platforms.

Physical demands and work environment:

• Must have the capability to effectively use and operate various items of office related equipment such as but not limited to the computer, calculator, copier, and fax machine

• Must be able to sit for long periods of time with low periods of reaching and standing

• Travel to communities and divisions on an as-needed basis via car or plane

• Minimal overnight travel may be required

Fischer Homes is one of the largest and most reputable home builders in the Midwestern and Southeastern states. Founded in 1980, the company has grown to build over 40,000 homes and employs over 700 Associates. Fischer Homes' solid reputation has been built largely by the talent of our Associates as we have been recognized as the 32nd largest builder in the United States.

We value diversity within the Fischer Homes organization and see each Associate as a team member and valuable asset. The rewards for their efforts are:

• Tuition Reimbursement

Fischer Homes holds the highest ethical standards of business. We are honest and straightforward and will stand by our word. Our actions demonstrate respect, courtesy, and above all, fairness.

Schedule:

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

About Carvana

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

jobs.title: Auto Mechanic
jobs.description:
About Us
ADESA, a Carvana owned company, currently operating over 50 locations throughout the US. Our Auto Auctions, some up to 200 acres, provide a wide array of vehicle services including repair & reconditioning, auction remarketing, and many of our sites serve as market hub distribution centers. Our inventory comprises hundreds of thousands of vehicles across North America from retail to commercial, OEM & more.
We work in a service industry and embrace a “we” versus “I” culture – help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive – and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.
We’re excited about the future! As an industry leader, ADESA is poised for a multi-year expansion including huge investments in facilities, massive sales growth, and an ever-increasing inventory of vehicles! We are looking for great people who want to take this journey with us! Get a sneak peek into life at ADESA!

Role and Team

• Reporting to the Mechanical Services Manager or designated manager, the Auto Mechanic performs proper diagnosis, repairs and maintenance to vehicles as assigned. Maintain consistently high standards on quality, efficiency and safety.

Some Responsibilities

• A/C & Heater - Operate the system and recognize if the system is cooling or not, Perform basic system checks such as power to compressor, Visually inspect condenser, belt tension, etc., Identify Freon and oil leaks

• Brakes - Identify components of brake system, Visually inspect brakes, Identify irregular noises and leaks, Perform simple system tests, Measure lining, drums, rotors, cams, Road test for proper operation, Check fluid level, Adjust service and park brakes and perform repair

• Electrical Charging Systems - Visually inspect batteries, Clean connections, Check condition of belts, Test batteries, Check alternator mounting and pulley, Replace and adjust belts, Perform basic charging system check

• Clutch - Lubricate bearing, linkage, shafts and cables, Identify proper clutch operation

• Cooling Systems - Check and adjust coolant levels, antifreezes (and requirements), Visually inspect system for leaks, Make minor repairs such as hose replacements, fan shrouds, fittings, Pressure test, Flush and refill systems

• Electrical Cranking System – Inspect/ test batteries, cables and motor, Clean battery cables, connections and starter, Check, charge and replace batteries, Repair/replace defective cables, Read wiring schematics

• Lighting System and Electrical Accessories - Repair minor wiring problems, Replace bulbs, lenses and simple light assembles, Adjust/replace sealed beams, Install/replace accessories (heated mirrors, fans, spotlights, etc.)

• Drive Axles - Inspect housings for leaks, Change oil and filter and clean breathers

• Driveline - Lubricate drive line, Inspect components for wear or damage

• Gas Engines - Check and adjust oil levels, Identify unusual noises and oil leaks

• Fuel Systems - Replace and prime fuel filter, Check gas and diesel fuel system components such as fuel lines, pickup tubes, return lines, etc. for proper integrity and condition

• Preventive Maintenance - Proper lube techniques, Minimal tire inspection, Brake check/applied stroke, Battery check, Under vehicle check/lose components, Initial Fault code identification

• Tire and Wheel Maintenance - Perform air pressure checks, Check tread depth, Identify tires that need to be changed or repaired, Perform tire Checks, Replace tire and wheel assembles, Mount/dismount and rotate tires

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• Must be at least eighteen (18) years of age.

• Must be qualified to operate a motor vehicle and possess a valid driver’s license.

• Must have a demonstrated ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.

• Must have the ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools.

ADESA Benefits and Perks
Competitive Pay | Quality Benefits | Holiday and Paid Time Off | Education and Equipment Reimbursement Programs | Matching 401(k) | Career Path Opportunities | And More!

Other Requirements
To be able to do your job at ADESA, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you. Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

• The physical activity requirements of the position range from Light to Medium Physical Work. Frequent – standing, watching, touching, listening, walking, talking Potential – running, jumping, yelling or other rapid or forceful movement in emergency situations

• Visual acuity requirements include color, depth perception and field of vision comparable to definitions for Clerical, Administrative, Machine Operators (including inspection) positions.

jobs.title: International Indirect Tax Compliance Specialist (VAT/GST)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SPHERE

Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.

Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.

 - Backed by a16z and YC. $21M Series A, 30%+ month-over-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.

 - Small team, global surface area. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office.

 - The problem keeps compounding. Expanding into input tax, withholding, e-invoicing, tariffs — each multiplies the complexity. Tens of millions of transactions today, billions ahead.




THE ROLE

We're looking for an International Indirect Tax Compliance Specialist to help execute and scale our international tax compliance operations. Working closely with the Compliance Lead and Tax leadership, you'll own the day-to-day filing process for a portfolio of countries and customers, ensuring returns are prepared, reviewed, and submitted accurately and on time. 

That covers a wide range of obligations, and the list keeps growing:

 - Domestic VAT and GST returns, including annual returns where required (for example Germany, Italy and Spain)

 - Non-resident and simplified regimes: EU OSS and IOSS, UK, Switzerland, Norway VOEC, India OIDAR, Japan JCT, Singapore, Australia and New Zealand

 - EC Sales Lists

 - SAF-T and similar data filings (for example Poland JPK, Portugal and Romania D406)

This role focuses on VAT, GST and similar taxes outside the US. US sales tax is handled by a separate team.

Beyond executing filings, you'll play a key role in improving how we operate and expand globally. You'll partner with Engineering to automate manual workflows, identify opportunities to streamline processes, and help build a more scalable, technology-driven tax compliance function. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining operational excellence with process improvement and is excited to help modernize tax operations.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Within days

Work directly with our compliance lead and tax leadership on the below:

 - Prepare, review, and file VAT/GST returns accurately and on schedule across multiple countries and filing frequencies

 - Monitor filing status and operational metrics, proactively identifying risks and driving issues to resolution

 - Perform reconciliations between tax returns, payments, and remittance records, investigating and resolving discrepancies

 - Manage filing calendars, deadlines, and dependencies to consistently meet compliance obligations

Within months

 - Own a portfolio of countries end to end, and build a filing playbook for each one

 - Work with fiscal representatives, local agents and external reviewers, and manage tax portal access and digital certificates (for example Elster, AEAT and HMRC MTD)

 - Execute process and automation improvements in collaboration with the broader Tax team and Engineering

 - Flag process gaps, errors, and risk areas

 - Take on a growing share of filing volume as the business scales

 - Work with the Customer Success team to build a knowledge base and trainings to address customer questions




REQUIREMENTS

 - 3+ years of experience preparing, reviewing, and filing high volumes of VAT/GST returns across multiple countries, ideally at a Big 4 firm or an outsourced VAT compliance provider covering 10+ countries

 - Working knowledge of VAT rules for cross-border trade: place of supply for digital and electronically supplied services, B2B vs B2C treatment, reverse charge, OSS mechanics and VAT number validation

 - Solid understanding of return filing processes, reconciliations, and controls

 - Hands-on experience with tax authority portals and country-specific filing formats

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience collaborating across Finance, Operations, and Engineering teams -  we work at an extremely fast pace and so clear, concise communication is essential

 - High attention to detail - one of our key values is ‘Sweating the details’ and it is essential in our business

 - Multitasking capabilities - a lot will be thrown at you and you’ll need to manage your time wisely

 - Eagerness to lean in and learn new countries, regimes and processes quickly. Our coverage grows every month, and you'll often be the first person at Sphere to file in a new country or work through a new obligation

NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience working with tax automation or compliance platforms

 - Familiarity with AI, web automation, and data analytics tools

 - Comfortable partnering with software engineering or product teams to automate operational workflows

 - Language skills, in addition to English




WHO YOU ARE

You'll thrive here if:

 - You're a Dog. You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: good, that means the opportunity is ours. Hunger beats pedigree.

 - Early stage is in your bones. You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.

 - You own it end to end. Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.

 - You believe speed and accuracy are both possible. We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.

This won't be a fit if:

 - You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating

 - You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)

 - You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
ABOUT F. SCHUMACHER & Co.

F. Schumacher & Co. is an innovative interior design company that is disrupting the $150 billion-dollar global interior design industry. We are a technological leader on the design frontier, constantly pushing boundaries and striving for excellence. With over 500+ employees and growing, we are driven by a shared belief that design transforms life. We are dedicated to the mission of helping our customers“celebrate the feeling of home”.Schumacher designs and produces some of the most beautiful fabrics, wallcoverings, trims, furniture, and accessories in the world. Our portfolio of products is broad, but they are united by a passion for design, a thirst for what is next, an appreciation for what’s come before, a drive to make our products with enormous care and attention for detail. Schumacher is a globally recognized company with a myriad of showrooms both domestically and internationally.

Our competitive advantage in the industry is the people. We believe that our employees are our most important assets. F. Schumacher & Co is deeply anchored in our company core values which are as follows:

• Preserve Our Entrepreneurial Spirit

• Take Ownership & Accountability

• Be Solutions-Oriented

• Demonstrate Courage

• Practice Adaptability

• Embrace Collaboration

We empower our employees to live these values daily because we understand how it will positively impact the customer's journey. F. Schumacher & Co., also known as FSCO, is the parent company to many brands within our portfolio.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Account Executive in Las Vegas serves as a brand ambassador for the FSCO portfolio across Nevada and New Mexico, cultivating lasting relationships with leading interior designers, architects, and developers while driving growth across fabric, wallcovering, rugs, and trim. This is a highly field-focused, relationship-driven role requiring approximately 50% travel to meet with clients in person, understand their needs, present thoughtfully curated product solutions, and identify opportunities across Schumacher, Patterson Flynn, Tillett Textiles, and Backdrop.

Working collaboratively with our inside sales team to own and grow a shared portfolio of accounts, the Account Executive acts as a trusted advisor to the design community—bringing strong sales instincts, an appreciation for great design, and the ability to translate relationships into meaningful business growth.

Account Executive Responsibilities

Territory Ownership

• Develop and grow sales across Schumacher, Patterson Flynn, Tillett Textiles, and Backdrop, spanning fabric, wallcovering, trim, and rugs within your geographic territory.

• Cultivate a strategic view of your territory, including leading firms, rising design studios, dormant accounts ready for reactivation, new business opportunities, and the trade events that shape the market.

• Know your client. Develop a strong understanding of each firm’s aesthetic, project mix, and business needs, and use that knowledge to thoughtfully curate each meeting—knowing which brands, categories, and products to lead with to make every client interaction relevant and impactful.

• Consistently meet monthly, quarterly, and annual sales plans across all brands and categories, taking shared ownership with your sales partners for the strategy and execution required to achieve them.

• Main areas of travel (with additional cities possible as territory grows):

• Nevada: Las Vegas, Reno/Tahoe and surrounding cities

• New Mexico: Santa Fe and Albuquerque and surrounding cities

Relationship Building

• Be present in the field, including designer offices, project sites, industry events, designer dinners, and other relevant events and gatherings.

• Develop trusted advisor relationships with principal designers, junior staff, purchasing teams, and other key contacts across your accounts.

• Become an extension of your clients’ firms—a trusted resource they regularly turn to for project needs, product expertise, and new opportunities to support and grow their business.

• Serve as a brand ambassador within the local design community, representing FSCO and its portfolio with professionalism, warmth, strong product knowledge, and a genuine passion for design.

Lead Generation & Cross-Sell

• Generate qualified opportunities across every brand and category, partnering with your inside colleagues to bring each opportunity through to close.

• Provide clear briefs, relevant designer and project context, and timely follow-through so the inside team can execute effectively.

• Identify natural cross-sell opportunities across the portfolio. Every Schumacher account is a potential Patterson Flynn rug opportunity, every Tillett project may present a custom rug specification, and every wallcovering installation may create a trim opportunity. Bring the full portfolio into client conversations thoughtfully and strategically.

Curation & Product Storytelling

• Curate the sample story for each account with thoughtful consideration of the firm’s aesthetic, current projects, and clients.

• Lead project shops, line shows, and in-person presentations with clarity, taste, and confidence.

• Act as a knowledgeable brand ambassador, staying deeply current on product launches, collaborations, brand stories, and trends across the portfolio.

Pipeline & Partnership

• Use FSCO’s CRM, sample tools, and reporting platforms with discipline, maintaining clean, accurate, and current account records.

• Partner closely with your inside team as equal collaborators, recognizing the distinct expertise each person brings to the account. Clear communication, mutual respect, and shared ownership are essential to the work.

• Communicate progress, blockers, opportunities, and pipeline status to your Managing Director and inside partners on a regular cadence.

REQUIREMENTS

Experience & Skills

• 3–5+ years of outside sales experience, ideally within luxury, interior design, home furnishings, or the trade.

• Proven ability to build and grow a territory through relationship development, strategic prospecting, and consistent follow-through.

• Demonstrated success setting and achieving sales goals, influencing purchasing decisions, and identifying opportunities to grow business within existing and prospective accounts.

• Multi-line or multi-category sales experience, or a clear track record of quickly mastering complex product assortments.

• Strong territory and time-management skills, with the ability to strategically plan client visits, travel, prospecting, and follow-up across a large geographic region.

• Ability to work independently in the field while collaborating closely with inside sales partners to deliver an exceptional client experience.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a polished, professional, and warm presence across all levels of a client organization.

• Comfort using digital tools to manage relationships and drive business, including CRM systems (Odoo or comparable), Microsoft Office, Instagram, and email marketing platforms.

• Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% of the time, including regular overnight travel throughout the territory.

• Dependable transportation, a clean driving record, and a willingness to travel throughout your territory, including comfort driving in winter weather conditions.

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant experience and a strong track record of success may be considered in place of formal credentials.

Who You Are

• A salesperson with great taste. You have a genuine eye for design and an appreciation for color, scale, texture, and materials.

• A natural connector. You are energized by being in the field, meeting people, cultivating new relationships, and deepening existing ones.

• Polished, warm, and professional. You can confidently engage with principal designers and firm leadership while remaining approachable and collaborative with junior designers, purchasing teams, and support staff.

• A proactive business developer. You are always looking for the next opportunity—whether that means opening a new account, expanding an existing relationship, or introducing a client to a category they have yet to explore.

• Collaborative and team-oriented. You thrive as an equal partner within a shared account team, working closely with your SSR and Account Manager toward common goals. You value the expertise and contributions of your teammates, communicate openly, and understand that each person plays a distinct and equally important role in growing the business and delivering an exceptional client experience.

• Driven and positive. You bring energy, curiosity, resilience, and grace to every interaction.

• Self-directed, organized, and dependable. You take ownership of your calendar, territory, pipeline, and follow-through without needing constant direction.

• Adaptable and comfortable with change. You can manage competing priorities, pivot quickly, and thrive in an environment where no two days look exactly the same.

• Genuinely passionate about design. You light up when you walk into a beautifully designed room and enjoy helping designers discover products that make their work even better.

• Invested in long-term growth. You want to build relationships, develop a market, and grow a territory—not simply hit a quota.

Benefits Package

Your well-being is our top priority. Our benefits and total compensation are designed for the whole person, caring for both you and your family.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Foundations
jobs.description:
SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, DATA & FOUNDATIONS

Location: Remote. (Eastern & Central time zones only. Some travel required.)




ABOUT US

Clasp is a mission-driven, venture-backed startup transforming access to education and career pathways. A college education was always meant to lead to economic mobility. But with rising costs and shrinking loan availability, many working-class and first-generation students don’t have the money they need to finish school. That’s where Clasp comes in. We’re the market leader in institutionally funded gap loan programs. We partner with schools to design, launch and manage lending programs that keep students enrolled, graduating and thriving.

Fresh off our Series B, Clasp is entering its next phase of growth. Recent recognition includes:

 - TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026 (Loan-Linked Hiring)

 - Forbes Fintech 50

 - Business Insider: Top 14 Healthcare Startups to Watch in 2026 and 43 Startups to Bet Your Career On in 2025

Our work spans two business lines:

Clasp Talent helps healthcare employers attract and retain critical talent by connecting them with diverse candidates and using student loan repayment as a powerful recruiting and retention tool. We meaningfully connect employers, educational institutions, and learners to drive mutual benefit.

Clasp Finance equips colleges and universities with lending technology to launch and operate their own private student loan programs, enabling schools to step in and support their students directly with financial aid. Recent federal financial aid changes are reshaping how institutions think about supporting their students, and Clasp Finance is poised to meet this moment.

Underneath both is the work that connects everything: partner data flowing in reliably, users hearing from us at the right moment and in the right way, teammates with tools that let them do their best work, and data that tells one true story. We need someone to own that work.




WHO WE NEED

Clasp is hiring a Product Manager for Data & Foundations. We want a product manager who gets energy from making everyone around them more effective, and who is just as comfortable digging into an integration spec with engineers as they are rethinking how we talk to our users or helping a teammate get the answer they need from our data. You also need to be excited, not intimidated, by deciding what AI-native tooling and communication should look like at a growing company.

You'll lead two pods: our existing Data team and our new Foundations & Integrations team. Your customers are a mix of internal teams, customers, and end users. You'll keep two engineering teams on track, shape the roadmap with the Director of Product, and work alongside three other PMs across Clasp Talent and Clasp Finance. We're hiring at the PM or Senior PM level, depending on the candidate.




WHAT YOU'LL DO




ROADMAP & DELIVERY

 - Run roadmap and sprint planning for the Data and Foundations & Integrations pods, working with two engineering leads.

 - Keep both teams focused, unblocked, and shipping. Break large efforts into clear milestones and communicate progress and risk honestly.

 - Prioritize. Demand will always outrun capacity, and you'll make trade-offs openly instead of letting the loudest request win.


DATA INGESTION & INTEGRATIONS

 - Own how we keep our customers' data in sync with ours, from SFTP file ingestion to full API integrations.

 - Make bringing on a new partner faster, more repeatable, and less dependent on engineering heroics.

 - Design for what happens when things fail, including validation, monitoring, and clear recovery paths, so problems surface before a partner notices.

 - Lead enterprise-readiness work like SCIM provisioning that removes friction for larger partners.


NOTIFICATIONS & USER COMMUNICATIONS

 - Own how Clasp communicates with end users across email, in-product, and emerging channels like AI chat.

 - Give teams visibility into what goes out, to whom, and why.


INTERNAL TOOLS & AI

 - Own the tools our teams use to support partners and users, including staff tools, user impersonation, and internal workflows.

 - Push for better UAT environments and engineering foundations so every product team can ship faster and more safely.


DATA & REPORTING

 - Partner with our data team to bring data from across the business together into a single source of truth.

 - Set the vision for customer-facing reporting and the internal reporting teammates rely on, and make sure both are trusted and acted on.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience. We weight the work heavily over the credential.

 - 5+ years in product management, ideally on data, integrations, communications, internal tools, or B2B SaaS products. A background in data, solutions engineering, or engineering before product is a plus.

 - Technical depth: you're comfortable in SQL, can read a data model, and understand APIs, webhooks, file-based integrations, and auth and provisioning patterns well enough to hold your own in system design discussions.

 - Hands-on experience owning or shipping customer or partner integrations (SFTP, APIs, SSO/SCIM, or similar), and a clear view of what makes them scale or break.

 - Experience running roadmaps and sprint planning for engineering teams, ideally across more than one team at a time.

 - A real partnership with data teams. You understand the modern data stack (warehouses, pipelines, BI) well enough to contribute to migrations, data quality, and reporting.

 - Hands-on experimentation with LLMs, MCP, or agents, with a grounded view of where they help in user communications and internal operations, and where they don't.

 - Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a migration plan to an executive and a partner-facing impact to an engineer.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Fintech, lending, HR tech, or healthcare experience.

 - Experience in a regulated industry where consumer data, consent, and access controls carry real rules.

 - Notification or messaging experience (email, in-app, SMS, or conversational AI).

 - Building or replacing an internal tools stack at a growing company.
   
   

What We Give in Return

 - Competitive cash and equity compensation.

 - Health benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Student loan repayment benefits.

 - 401(k) + Match.

 - Flexible PTO.

 - Opportunities to grow with a fast-moving, mission-driven team.




SALARY

The salary range for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and industry knowledge, ranging between $125,000 to $160,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, we offer an attractive equity component as part of our compensation package, providing an opportunity for eligible employees to share in the success and growth of our company. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent.

Work authorization
This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer.

How we use AI in hiring
Clasp uses AI-assisted tools in parts of our hiring process, such as AI notetakers transcribing or summarizing interviews, scheduling, and supporting evaluation in technical assessments. Humans review applications and make every hiring decision. AI tools don't make final decisions about any candidate. You're welcome to use AI to research Clasp and prepare, but during live interviews and assessments we want to hear your own thinking, so please don't use AI tools that generate or feed you responses in real time. If you'd like to be evaluated without AI tools, need an accommodation, or have questions about how we use these tools, email recruiting@clasp.com and we'll arrange another process where we can.

Equal opportunity
Clasp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status (except as required by law), or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in line with applicable fair chance laws. jobs.title: Global Supply Manager, ODM/CM Management (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER, ODM/CM MANAGEMENT (STARLINK)

We are seeking a world-class Global Supply Manager to own end-to-end strategic management of Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs) and Contract Manufacturers (CMs) for all SpaceX compute and network hardware builds at L10 (subassembly/module) and L11 (system-level/FATP) stages. In this role, you will partner deeply with responsible engineers to define build strategies, craft and optimize Statements of Work (SOW), aggressively challenge unnecessary specifications and costs, and drive manufacturing execution at extreme velocity and scale. You will elevate ODM/CM relationships into true strategic partnerships that deliver unprecedented on-time delivery, quality, cost efficiency, and flexibility while powering SpaceX's record-breaking cluster deployment cadence. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in server and network manufacturing processes, thrives in high-ambiguity/high-velocity environments, and turns ODM/CM operations into a core competitive advantage and force multiplier for SpaceX's AI infrastructure leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Partner deeply with responsible engineers, hardware teams, and manufacturing experts to co-define build strategies, L10/L11 manufacturing roadmaps, and Statements of Work (SOW) for ODMs and CMs across compute servers, network hardware, and related assemblies

• Own global ODM/CM management end-to-end, including selection, qualification, onboarding, performance governance, and relationship management to achieve on-time delivery and continuous lead-time compression while supporting SpaceX's aggressive cluster build cadence

• Define and negotiate transformative SOWs and commercial agreements that rigorously challenge unnecessary specifications, drive value engineering, secure aggressive pricing, capacity commitments, and flexibility without compromising the highest quality and reliability standards required for SpaceX training clusters

• Drive continuous cost leadership through should-cost modeling, design-for-manufacturability reviews, specification optimization, and long-term pricing agreements that meaningfully reduce total cost of ownership while accelerating time-to-scale

• Standardize and automate NPI-to-mass-production processes, implement advanced inventory and WIP optimization models (including consignment and just-in-time tailored to SpaceX's build velocity), and establish clear KPIs for cost, quality, speed, yield, and resilience that are reviewed weekly with leadership

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 10+ years of experience working in one or more of the following: Business Manufacturing Supply Chain Engineering

• 5+ years of experience in global supply chain, ODM/CM management, or electronics manufacturing, with a focus on compute servers and networking hardware

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Deep technical understanding of L10/L11 manufacturing flows, FATP, value engineering, design-for-manufacturability, and the global ODM/CM ecosystem for hyperscale datacenter hardware

• Proven track record managing ODMs and CMs at L10 and L11 levels in hyperscale or high-growth technology environments

• Hands-on familiarity with server/network build processes and FATP concepts

• Previous experience at hyperscalers, leading ODMs, Tier-1 CMs, or AI infrastructure companies with aggressive scaling demands

• Demonstrated success negotiating complex SOWs, challenging specifications and costs, and delivering results in ambiguous, high-velocity environments with extreme timelines and massive scale

• Strong negotiation, analytical, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills

• Familiarity with commodity management, roadmap planning, and approved vendor list processes in a manufacturing context

• Passion for SpaceX's mission and excitement about enabling the fastest AI infrastructure builds on Earth

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed to support ODM/CM factory sites, audits, and critical projects

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment with rapidly evolving priorities and world-class execution speed

• This position is based in Austin, TX and requires being onsite

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
GSM: $145,000.00 - $215,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

Learn more about the ITAR here.
