jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, Clasp Talent
jobs.description:
Associate Product Manager, Clasp Talent

Remote (ET and CT time zones)

About Us

Clasp is a mission-driven, venture-backed startup transforming access to education and career pathways. A college education was always meant to lead to economic mobility. But with rising costs and shrinking loan availability, many working-class and first-generation students don’t have the money they need to finish school. That’s where Clasp comes in. We’re the market leader in institutionally funded gap loan programs. We partner with schools to design, launch and manage lending programs that keep students enrolled, graduating and thriving.

Fresh off our Series B, Clasp is entering its next phase of growth. Recent recognition includes:

 - TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026 (Loan-Linked Hiring)

 - Forbes Fintech 50

 - Business Insider: Top 14 Healthcare Startups to Watch in 2026 and 43 Startups to Bet Your Career On in 2025

Our work spans two business lines:

Clasp Talent helps healthcare employers attract and retain critical talent by connecting them with diverse candidates and using student loan repayment as a powerful recruiting and retention tool. We meaningfully connect employers, educational institutions, and learners to drive mutual benefit.

Clasp Finance equips colleges and universities with lending technology to launch and operate their own private student loan programs, enabling schools to step in and support their students directly with financial aid. Recent federal financial aid changes are reshaping how institutions think about supporting their students, and Clasp Finance is poised to meet this moment.

Who We Need

Clasp is hiring its first Associate Product Manager. You'll work alongside our Product Managers across Clasp Talent to understand our users, turn what we learn into clear specs, help keep our system and partner data in sync, and measure whether what we ship is working.

This is a broad, hands-on role. You'll support discovery with students and employers, write the stories and follow-up tickets that keep engineering moving, and own the loop from launch to impact: telling the company what's shipping, building the dashboards that track it, and reporting back on what changed. You'll also be a product partner to Partner Success and Operations on complex partner setups and data quality. For example, when a participant's eligibility changes and they qualify for a lower benefit amount, you'll help work out when the new amount should take effect, what happens to payments already scheduled, and what else in our system needs to update to stay in sync.

You'll report to our Senior Product Manager, with coaching from our Director of Product, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Partner Success, and Operations. There is a clear path to Product Manager, which we're targeting in about 12 months depending on your growth and the team's needs.

What You’ll Do


Discovery and user feedback

 - Interview students and employer users, run surveys, and synthesize what you hear into insights PMs can act on.

 - Gather feedback from support tickets, Partner Success, sales calls, and usage data, and spot the patterns across them.

 - Run short research projects, such as competitive reviews or vendor evaluations, that feed roadmap decisions.

Specs and delivery

 - Draft user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria with PMs and engineers.

 - After a release, track how features land, write follow-up tickets and fast-follows, and file clear, reproducible bug tickets.

Systems and data integrity

 - Advise Partner Success and Implementation on complex or unusual partner setups, helping them work out what the partner is really asking for and how our system should handle it.

 - Help keep our system in sync with partner data from HRIS and payroll integrations. Learn which data drives which rules, notice when they drift apart, and turn recurring issues into product fixes.

 - Partner with Operations on data backfills and cleanup. Spot recurring data quality issues, define the scope of the fix, check the results, and tell the affected teams what changed.

 - Think through how product and rule changes affect participants, payments, and reporting, and explain the impact clearly to internal teams and partners.

Launch and impact

 - Before launch, work with PMs to define what success looks like and confirm we can measure it.

 - Write release notes so Partner Success, Sales, and leadership know what's shipping, why it matters, and what it should change.

 - Create demos, walkthrough videos, and launch materials that build excitement for new features with internal teams and partners, showing the real problem each one solves and the value it brings.

 - Build and maintain dashboards that show whether features are being adopted and moving the metrics we expected.

 - Share 30- and 60-day impact readouts on what we expected versus what happened, and turn the gaps into follow-up work.

What You’ll Need

 - 1 to 3 years of experience in product, analytics, product operations, implementation, consulting, or a similar role.

 - Data skills: you've built dashboards people use, you use SQL to answer questions and to check data quality and validate results, and you're comfortable with a product analytics tool such as PostHog, Amplitude, or Mixpanel.

 - Measurement instinct: you can define what success looks like for a feature and tell a real result from noise.

 - Systems thinking: you trace how data and rules interact, spot edge cases and conflicts, and ask "and then what happens?" before anything goes live.

 - User curiosity: you've talked to users directly and can separate what they ask for from what they need.

 - Clear writing: your specs and tickets are easy for engineers to act on, and you can explain technical logic to non-technical partners.

 - Technical comfort: you understand how software gets built and work well with engineers.

 - Ownership: you follow through on all your work even the details, including the behind-the-scenes work, and flag problems early.

What We Give In Return

 - Competitive cash and equity compensation

 - Health benefits (health, dental, & vision)

 - 401k + match

 - Flexible PTO policy

 - Opportunities to grow and perform in a fast-paced environment alongside a stellar team.


Salary

The salary range for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and industry knowledge, ranging between $85,000 to $100,00 annually. In addition to the base salary, we offer an attractive equity component as part of our compensation package, providing an opportunity for eligible employees to share in the success and growth of our company. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent.

Work authorization
This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer.

How we use AI in hiring
Clasp uses AI-assisted tools in parts of our hiring process, such as AI notetakers transcribing or summarizing interviews, scheduling, and supporting evaluation in technical assessments. Humans review applications and make every hiring decision. AI tools don't make final decisions about any candidate. You're welcome to use AI to research Clasp and prepare, but during live interviews and assessments we want to hear your own thinking, so please don't use AI tools that generate or feed you responses in real time. If you'd like to be evaluated without AI tools, need an accommodation, or have questions about how we use these tools, email recruiting@clasp.com and we'll arrange another process where we can.

Equal opportunity
Clasp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status (except as required by law), or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in line with applicable fair chance laws. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, email recruiting@clasp.com.

jobs.title: Senior / Principal Scientist, Ingredient Development
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Kingdom is the world’s first AI-native ingredients company.  We create Superculture® ingredients from natural microbes to improve the health of pets and people. Brands use our ingredients because they deliver industry-leading efficacy and health benefits that consumers notice in just days.

AI powers how we develop, clinically validate, and manufacture our ingredients, enabling us to bring them to market faster and at lower cost.  Developing a new ingredient has traditionally taken more than five years and tens of millions of dollars.  Our small team is launching one clinically validated ingredient a year, at a small fraction of that cost.

Kingdom has clear product-market fit, with accelerating customer demand:

 - After just a year in market, our ingredients are already in dozens of products from household pet brands.  And 95% of our first-time customers are launching additional products with us.

 - Each ingredient improves our discovery platform, clinical engine, and manufacturing expertise, so we can develop the next one faster and at lower cost.

 - We’ve raised nearly $40M from leading investors to bring our ingredients to more brands and markets around the world.

Our number one priority is turning proven ingredient performance and early commercial traction into repeatable growth across customers and markets. We’re looking for highly resourceful, high-throughput individuals who solve problems from first principles, make sound decisions, communicate clearly, and move quickly.

More than $1.2 trillion is spent every year on pet and human health products.  Our ambition is to make clinical efficacy the standard across that entire market.

All full-time roles are in person at our Brooklyn Navy Yard headquarters and lab.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Kingdom’s next stage of growth depends on bringing more Superculture® ingredients into customers’ products. That requires rigorous evidence of how our ingredients work, perform in formulations, and withstand manufacturing and storage. We’re building a dedicated scientific function to lead that work and help customers evaluate and adopt our ingredients.

As Senior or Principal Scientist, Ingredient Development, you will lead our in vitro validation function, combining scientific direction with hands-on execution. You’ll determine which questions matter most, choose the experiments that answer them, and use the results to guide development. Your work will connect scientific judgment with practical decisions about how ingredients are developed and used.

You’ll work closely with bioprocess, clinical development, regulatory, and commercial colleagues to connect laboratory findings with customer needs. This means helping colleagues and customers understand what the evidence establishes, where uncertainty remains, and what further work would support adoption. Scientific leadership and collaboration will be central to your impact.

This is an opportunity to shape how Kingdom develops ingredients across a growing portfolio. Success means rigorous, timely validation and clear evidence that supports customer evaluation. You’ll expand your leadership through scientific direction and mentoring, while remaining involved in the experimental work that moves ingredients forward.




IF YOU JOIN, YOU WILL:

 - Lead in vitro validation across projects
   
   - Own the in vitro validation strategy across ingredient programs, identify evidence gaps, and design and execute studies of efficacy, safety, mechanisms of action, stability, shelf-life, and analytical characterization, including comparisons with other ingredients.
   
   - Plan and coordinate external testing with contract research organizations (CROs), defining study designs, deliverables, and timelines. Assess data quality and interpret findings to guide ingredient development.
   
   - Lead formulation development, working with the bioprocess team to account for manufacturing processes and requirements as production scales.

 - Connect technical development to customer needs
   
   - Maintain a shared database of ingredient evidence, contributions across teams, and remaining gaps. Translate findings into technical materials, formulation guidance, and safety and stability documentation, coordinating scientific, safety, and regulatory review.
   
   - Help the commercial team explain ingredient efficacy, safety, and mechanisms of action to customers, engaging independently as experience allows. Together, turn customer feedback into development priorities, distinguishing immediate adoption barriers from longer-term needs.
   
   - Own responses to in vitro and formulation questions, setting realistic timelines and following through. Coordinate clinical and in vivo questions with the clinical team through its established process, agreeing on scientific input and response timing.




WE’RE LOOKING FOR YOU IF YOU HAVE:

 - A PhD in a relevant life-sciences field plus 3–4 years of work experience; more experienced candidates are encouraged to apply

 - Rigorous experimental design, quantitative analysis, and interpretation of efficacy and mechanisms-of-action studies

 - Hands-on experience developing, validating, and troubleshooting cell-based models and assays, with reproducible, transferable protocols

 - The ability to synthesize evidence clearly into reports and datasets, including limitations and needs for further testing or specialist review

 - Scientific leadership: the ability to set direction, make decisions, and build a function while remaining accountable for its work

 - Structured planning and prioritization across projects: identifying evidence gaps and dependencies, allocating effort, and resolving blockers with relevant stakeholders

 - Scientific judgment under ambiguity: choosing informative experiments, balancing depth of investigation with urgency, and recognizing when specialist input is needed

 - Clear communication and collaboration: explaining evidence, translating requests into scientific questions, and agreeing on realistic commitments

 - Practical experience using AI to support scientific work, with independent verification of outputs

 - Experience working with CROs: defining study objectives and deliverables, assessing proposed methods, and critically reviewing results

 - Intellectual curiosity and enjoyment of learning unfamiliar biology




WORKING WITH US

Kingdom is based in the Brooklyn Navy Yard, with our full team working out of a 9,000 sq-ft headquarters and lab space.  We operate in a high-trust, high-autonomy environment, which requires that everyone uphold our core values:

 - Solve from first principles. We have a deep-seated curiosity about the most important problems facing the business. Our nature is to dig deeply into their details, question assumptions, understand the smallest details, and drive towards the best possible solution using these insights. This makes us very effective in crafting new solutions and operating in ambiguous circumstances.

 - Collaborate with kindness. We are very low ego, and treat each other with respect, compassion, and humility. We hold one another to high standards, but do so while being deeply committed to each other's wellbeing. We invest in each other's growth, and are willing to engage in difficult conversations and deliver direct, constructive feedback when necessary.

 - Be resourceful and resilient. We figure out how to make things work, and how to accomplish our goals regardless of what stands in the way. We're keen to confront challenges together through proactive planning and scrappy methods. When things go wrong, we learn quickly from our missteps, adapt our approach, and push forward.



We provide competitive compensation with generous equity.  Everyone who joins Kingdom will be a major contributor to our success, which we reflect in our approach to ownership and compensation.  The cash salary range for this role is $132.5–205K for Senior or Principal Scientist, with the final starting salary being determined by qualifications, experience, skill set, and internal equity.  Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of a total compensation package that also includes benefits (more below) and equity (to be discussed more during the interview process).



We also provide a rich benefits package to support our team:

 - Fully covered, best-in-class medical, vision, and dental insurance

 - Free memberships to One Medical, Teladoc, and Talkspace

 - Flexible PTO, in addition to 13 paid company holidays (including a weeklong winter closure from Christmas Eve through New Year's Day)

 - 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, with the option to extend up to 24 weeks total

 - 401(k) plan, FSA option, and commuter benefit of your choice

 - Fully stocked kitchen with fruits, snacks, coffee, and tea, plus weekly team lunches



Kingdom is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

jobs.description:

The role is responsible for driving process optimization, cross-functional collaboration, data-driven decision-making, and the implementation of scalable technology solutions.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager (Starship Electronics)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER (STARSHIP ELECTRONICS)

The SpaceX Supply Chain department plays a pivotal role in advancing Starship's ambitious mission. Leveraging the company's groundbreaking technological and market-transforming successes, our team will help build and manage an agile, resilient supply chain that delivers a powerful competitive advantage. Core functions include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, logistics, and inventory management. By excelling in these areas, Supply Chain will be instrumental in achieving SpaceX's aggressive growth targets and accelerating our journey to make humanity a multi-planetary species.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop sourcing strategies for assigned categories to minimize risk and achieve key purchasing targets, including optimized payment terms, cash flow objectives, and significant cost savings

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders to design strategic sourcing models that maximize value from products and services while supporting business unit needs and driving continuous cost reduction across controllable spend

• Communicate, implement, and enforce compliance with established sourcing strategies

• Identify, plan, and execute cost reduction initiatives, including stakeholder coordination, timeline management, and regular progress reporting

• Conduct advanced quantitative and process analyses to evaluate financial impacts, identify cost improvement opportunities, and assess performance for assigned categories

• Partner with stakeholders to establish supplier SLAs and KPIs, then track performance against key metrics such as business results delivery, cost reduction, quality, and on-time performance

• Perform market research, benchmarking, and competitive analysis for assigned categories

• Collaborate with Legal to draft and finalize contract documentation

• Actively manage contracts to ensure suppliers meet all obligations and performance standards

• Analyze complex contract terms and interrelationships, applying creative yet sound business judgment to align them with operational needs

• Drive maximum value and cost savings while mitigating risk through skilled strategic negotiations

• Lead year-over-year cost optimization by identifying and eliminating waste and reducing unnecessary usage across operations

• Establish and maintain a roster of preferred suppliers for assigned categories

• Design and implement supplier management programs to develop, continuously improve, and monitor performance and KPIs across the supply base

• Issue purchase orders and resolve blocked invoices for assigned categories

• Lead initiatives to streamline processes and significantly reduce transaction volume for assigned categories

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Advanced degree and 4+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience working in one or more of the following; or 10+ years of experience working in one or more of the following: Engineering Purchasing Contract negotiation Material or production planning Operations or supply chain management Material cost control Master production scheduling

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Familiarity or experience working with machined metallic components for aerospace, medical, energy, or automotive applications

• Strong ability to read drawings and specifications with an understanding of manufacturing complexity

• Experience with technical procurement, manufacturing, or designing production components

• APICS certification

• Lean Six Sigma certification

• Ability to prove a strong track record of leadership and team building

• Remarkable problem solving skills with a bias for speed and positive impact

• Ability to learn quickly and prioritize appropriately to meet customer and company needs

• Exceptional analytical and organizational skills

• Excellent customer service skills, produce exceptional work at all times, highly self-motivated

• Effective written, verbal and presentation communication skills

• Strong technical knowledge and skills in current technologies and applications (e.g. MS Office Suite, SQL, Power BI, etc.)

• Detail-oriented, and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment

• Holds self to highest ethical standards, and conducts all activities with the highest of integrity

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be able to travel domestically and internationally for business needs - up to 50%

• Must be able to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed

• This position is based in Hawthorne, CA and requires being onsite - remote work not considered

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
$135,000.00 - $200,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.location: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
jobs.description:

• A field based scientific expert that strategically supports the research and business objectives of a designated therapeutic area across the product life cycle for a specific geography/territory
• The primary communicator of AbbVie science within a specific geography with healthcare professionals.
• Develops and maintains professional relationships with internal and external customers to provide comprehensive medical and scientific support to AbbVie initiatives in assigned therapeutic areas.
• Viewed as a peer scientific expert in a designated therapeutic area/product.

Combined with strong strategic vision, market therapeutic area awareness, as well as clinical expertise, the MSL/Senior MSL serve as a conduit of information, education, and research activities for physicians and ancillary healthcare professionals regarding current and future therapies in development or commercialized by AbbVie.

The MSL/Senior MSL works closely with other AbbVie personnel to ensure information, education, and research needs of healthcare professionals are met and to ensure scientific and technical training needs of commercial organizations are identified and met.

Responsibilities:

• Identify, develop, and maintain professional relationships with thought leaders, academic centers, and researchers in assigned areas of therapeutic interest to ensure access to current medical and scientific information on the designated therapeutic/product area
• Present scientific information and education relative to disease state, therapeutic landscape, and AbbVie products across the product lifecycle to healthcare professionals including physicians, academic institutions, researchers, and other health care professionals.
• Support research initiatives as requested by AbbVie R&D, Clinical Operations, and Medical Affairs Departments and physician-initiated projects including, but not limited to, site evaluation and identification, recruitment, investigator meetings, external expert identification, and external collaboration management.

• Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and Procedure, including accurate and timely documentation as it relates to HCP (Healthcare Professionals) interactions. Responsible for maintaining annual expenses within assigned budget parameters.

• Advanced degree required (i.e., Pharm D, MD/DO, PhD, APP (i.e.: Physician Associate or Nurse Practitioner) in a relevant scientific discipline. Doctorate strongly preferred in a health science or clinical discipline.

• Ability to engage the audience and help them understand and retain information

jobs.title: Outbound Team Supervisor
jobs.description:
Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

We're hiring an Outbound Team Supervisor to lead a team of Outbound Patient Enrollment Specialists responsible for enrolling patients referred to Cadence by partner physicians. You will own day-to-day coaching, quality, and performance for the team, ensuring every patient conversation reflects Cadence's standards for clarity, trust, and compliance. This is a high-volume, phone-based environment where consistency and speed both matter.

What You'll Do

• Lead a team of Outbound Patient Enrollment Specialists, providing daily coaching on call quality, script adherence, and patient communication.

• Monitor call volume, enrollment conversion, and productivity metrics, and adjust team focus to meet targets.

• Conduct call audits and quality assurance reviews, giving specialists direct feedback tied to Cadence's enrollment standards.

• Resolve escalated patient concerns and complex enrollment cases that specialists cannot close independently.

• Manage day-to-day scheduling and pipeline coverage to keep enrollment volume on pace with partner physician referrals.

• Onboard and train new Outbound Patient Enrollment Specialists on scripts, CRM workflows, and HIPAA-compliant patient handling.

• Report team performance and enrollment trends to the enrollment operations lead on a regular cadence.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What You Need

• 5+ years of experience in outbound sales or patient enrollment, including prior high-volume, phone-based work.

• Prior experience conducting high-volume outbound calls in a fast paced environment.

• Working knowledge of CRM and dialer platforms, with the ability to manage pipeline coverage across a team.

• Ability to maintain strict patient confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and Cadence standards.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience handling escalated or sensitive patient conversations.

• Experience as a team lead or manager.

• Experience with AI tools (such as Claude or Gemini).

Compensation

The anticipated compensation range for this role is $65,000-$80,000, which is based on role scope, level, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for incentive compensation as part of the overall total rewards package with an OTE of $115,000-$135,000. This position is remote and based in the United States. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, internal equity, and applicable law.

Benefits & Perks

• Competitive pay & equity*

• Fully remote

• Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental & vision

• Paid time off

• 401k plan + matching

• Paid parental leave

• Home office stipend

*benefit offerings may vary depending on job profile, job level and worker type

jobs.title: People Operations Admin (Seasonal)
jobs.description:
About CookUnity:

Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul.

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

The Role

We’re looking for a seasonal People Operations Administrator to help create a welcoming, organized, and supportive employee experience. This position will run through March 26, 2027. In this role, you’ll support team members throughout their journey at CookUnity, from onboarding and training to feedback and career development.

You’ll partner with teams across the organization to coordinate workflows, maintain accurate employee information, and support People initiatives. Strong time management, communication, and organizational skills will help you succeed in this fast-paced role.

Responsibilities

Employee Onboarding & Engagement

• Welcome new employees and guide their integration into CookUnity, ensuring they feel supported, informed, and valued from day one.

• Facilitate orientation meetings and partner with managers to complete onboarding checklists and paperwork accurately.

• Own new-hire data entry in Rippling, ensuring employee profiles are set up correctly for payroll and benefits.

• Partner with the People Experience team to coordinate on-site culture events, team-building activities, and employee engagement initiatives.

Administrative & Operational Support

• Maintain and audit digital employee files to support compliance with applicable labor laws and internal company policies.

• Partner with the Office Manager and People Experience team to ensure administrative consistency across company-wide initiatives.

• Manage the company merchandise process, including ordering, inventory management, and distribution for new hires and employee milestones.

Qualifications

• 2+ years of administrative or project management experience in a startup environment.

• Fluency in both Spanish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages.

• Strong time management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

• A proactive, self-starting approach, with the ability to work independently and anticipate team needs.

• Proven ability to collaborate effectively with teammates across the organization.

• Proficiency with computer systems and digital tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience supporting remote onboarding and working in a remote company environment.

• Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a dynamic work environment.

• Experience using Notion, Google Workspace, Monday.com, and Rippling.

Benefits

🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach

🌅 Sick time

🧘🏽‍♀️ Wellness perks, including access to fitness subsidies to support a healthy lifestyle

🚀 An exciting opportunity to join a company changing how we eat and how chefs work!

Compensation

All final pay rates will be determined by candidates experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

Pay Range for this position

$23—$24 USD

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability.

A quick note for all candidates
We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us:

• Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: careers.cookunity.com

• Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page.

• We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS.

• We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away.

If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

General qualifications and requirements

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

jobs.title: Fire Alarm System Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Fire Alarm System Engineer

Reports to: Sales Support Manager

Salary Range: $62,400 – $83,200

*Salary based on experience and qualifications. Higher compensation may be considered for exceptionally qualified candidates with extensive fire alarm estimating experience and demonstrated industry expertise.

Job Overview:

Electronic Contracting Company (ECC) is seeking a knowledgeable and detail-oriented Fire Alarm System Engineer to develop accurate, competitive estimates and proposals for our growing Fire/Life Safety business. This position reviews project drawings, specifications, and customer requirements while working closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, and industry partners to ensure solutions are code-compliant, properly scoped, and competitively priced. Candidates with fire alarm estimating, field, design, or project management experience are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

• Review architectural, electrical, fire alarm, and life safety drawings, specifications, bid documents, addenda, and other project requirements.

• Develop detailed material, equipment, labor, subcontractor, and other project cost estimates for fire alarm projects.

• Perform accurate device counts and system takeoffs from construction drawings.

• Determine required fire alarm equipment, devices, modules, power supplies, notification appliances, initiating devices, control equipment, and other system components.

• Review specifications for system performance requirements, approved manufacturers, testing requirements, documentation requirements, and other project-specific obligations.

• Evaluate existing systems and determine requirements for additions, upgrades, replacements, and migrations.

• Identify scope gaps, conflicts, exclusions, assumptions, and project risks prior to proposal submission.

• Obtain and evaluate manufacturer, distributor, subcontractor, and specialty vendor pricing.

• Develop labor estimates based on scope, system complexity, installation, programming, testing, commissioning, and closeout requirements.

• Prepare complete scopes of work, inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, and clarifications for customer proposals.

• Review estimates with Sales and appropriate operational leadership prior to final proposal submission.

• Participate in pre-bid meetings, site surveys, project walkthroughs, and scope-review meetings as required.

• Assist Sales with technical questions and customer discussions during the proposal process.

• Support value-engineering efforts while maintaining code compliance and project requirements.

• Maintain accurate estimating documentation, pricing information, manufacturer information, and historical project data.

• Assist with estimate-to-operations handoff following project award.

• Stay current on fire alarm technologies, manufacturer products, applicable codes, and industry standards.

• Manage multiple estimates and opportunities simultaneously while meeting bid deadlines.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or technical education in electronics, electrical systems, construction, engineering technology, or a related field preferred.

• Minimum 2-3 years of experience in fire alarm systems, fire/life safety, electrical construction, estimating, design, project management, or a related field preferred.

• Working knowledge of commercial fire alarm system components and system operation.

• Ability to read and interpret architectural, electrical, and fire alarm drawings and specifications.

• Understanding of construction plans, specifications, bid documents, and project scopes.

• Strong mathematical and analytical skills with the ability to develop accurate material and labor estimates.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and standard business applications.

• Ability to learn and effectively use ECC estimating, CRM, quoting, and project-management systems.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and ability to collaborate across departments.

Fire Alarm Code Knowledge:

The successful candidate should possess or develop a working knowledge of codes and standards applicable to fire alarm and life safety systems, including:

• NFPA 101 Life Safety Code

• NFPA 72 - National Fire Alarm and Signaling Code.

• NFPA 70 - National Electrical Code (NEC).

• Applicable International Building Code (IBC) and International Fire Code (IFC) requirements.

• ADA requirements applicable to fire alarm notification.

• Local and state fire alarm codes and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements.

Certification Expectations:

Preferred at Hire

• NICET Level I or Level II certification in Fire Alarm Systems is strongly preferred.

• Candidates with significant fire alarm estimating, design, installation, programming, or project-management experience may be considered without current NICET certification.

Expected Career Development

• Employees without NICET certification will be expected to begin working toward NICET Level I after joining ECC.

• Progression toward NICET Level II in Fire Alarm Systems is expected as experience and eligibility requirements are met.

• Continued professional development and advancement toward higher NICET certification levels is encouraged based on responsibilities and career path.

• Manufacturer-specific fire alarm certifications and training may be required based on the systems supported by ECC.

• ECC may provide or coordinate appropriate training and certification opportunities based on position requirements and business needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

• NICET Level II or higher in Fire Alarm Systems.

• Previous fire alarm estimating experience with a systems integrator, electrical contractor, fire alarm contractor, or fire/life safety provider.

• Experience estimating both new construction and retrofit fire alarm projects.

• Experience with fire alarm system design and layout.

• Experience performing site surveys and evaluating existing fire alarm systems.

• Familiarity with commercial, healthcare, education, government, industrial, and other complex facilities.

• Experience with electronic takeoff or estimating software.

• Experience working with fire alarm manufacturers, distributors, electrical contractors, and Authorities Having Jurisdiction.

• Knowledge of fire alarm inspection, testing, programming, commissioning, and documentation requirements.

Core Competencies:

Accuracy & Attention to Detail - Produces complete estimates and identifies scope requirements that could materially affect project cost or execution.

Technical Knowledge - Understands fire alarm system operation, equipment, installation requirements, and applicable codes.

Commercial Awareness - Balances technical compliance with competitive pricing, labor requirements, project risk, and ECC margin expectations.

Organization & Prioritization - Effectively manages multiple estimates and deadlines in a fast-paced sales environment.

Communication - Clearly communicates scope, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and technical requirements to internal and external stakeholders.

Collaboration - Works effectively across Sales, Pre-Sales Engineering, Operations, Project Management, and other ECC departments.

Physical & Work Requirements:

• Ability to work primarily in an office environment while periodically visiting active construction sites and customer facilities.

• Ability to walk project sites, climb stairs, and access areas necessary to perform site surveys and scope reviews.

• Ability to travel within ECC's service territory as required for site surveys, pre-bid meetings, and customer meetings.

• Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record may be required.

Performance Expectations:

Success in this position will be measured by the estimator's ability to consistently produce accurate, complete, competitive, and timely fire alarm estimates that meet customer requirements, applicable codes, ECC standards, and targeted gross profit expectations. The Fire Alarm Estimator is expected to help ECC reduce estimating risk, improve proposal consistency, increase sales effectiveness, and ensure projects are properly scoped before transitioning from Sales to Operations.

Why ECC:

• Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• 401(k) with Profit Sharing

• Training and Development opportunities

• Dynamic company culture

• Merch stipend twice a year

• Laptop/tech provided

• Every Friday is payday!

Job Type: Full-time

Schedule:

• 8-hour shift

• 7:30 am – 4:30 pm (1 hour lunch)

• Day shift

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Security Systems Project & Integration Specialist
jobs.description:
Pay Range: $60-$70k annually

About Carvana

If you like disrupting the norm and are looking to join a company revolutionizing an industry then you will LOVE what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. Buying a car the old fashioned way sucks and we are working hard to make it NOT suck. I mean, have you seen our vending machine?!

We are looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and everyday we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories! We’ve been changing the game since 2013, and we’re not taking our foot off the gas now. Want more of the story? Check out our background here.

About the team and position

As a Specialist, Safe and Secure Operations Strategy, you will be an integral part of the Safe and Secure Team, executing programs and processes at our facilities to ensure our associates and assets are protected. This position is a problem solving role that focuses on technology health, operational influence, and cross functional collaboration. You will support the Manager, Safe and Secure Operations Strategy in ensuring that technology is functioning properly and that Safe and Secure processes add value and support critical business processes and objectives.  You will support the Safe and Secure Team in overseeing the piloting and implementation of strategic solutions and analyzing their effectiveness, and leading post-pilot deployment efforts.  This is a client-facing support role. The qualifying candidate must be enthusiastic, energetic and must take pride in helping people solve their Safe and Secure technology problems. Service with a smile is a requirement!

What you’ll be doing

• Execute the Safe and Secure Operations Strategy.

• Ensure support of Safe & Secure standard operating procedures to maximize efficiency and effectiveness.

• Manage multiple priorities and escalate significant issues to senior-level management as necessary and provide recommendations to ensure solutions are developed and implemented.

• Implement Operations technology capabilities, optimizing speed to get equipment fully operational.

• Monitor KPI’s to evaluate performance and institute action plans to address lagging KPI performance.

• Implement and execute solutions centered on tactical/actionable information and data.

• Utilize data to assess the Safe & Secure business reporting key wins and opportunities to the leader. As directed, provides support to specific tasks that need to be completed to drive metric improvement.

• Deliver exceptional customer service to our internal and external customers.

• Support everything related to our Safe and Secure technology!

• Develop functional knowledge of the installation, programming and configuration of commercial electronic security systems/accessories (access control, IP video, intrusion detection, low voltage communication, electronic locks, etc.).

• Participate in and contribute to projects, Develop Evaluation Criteria, Data Analysis in support of the deployment of current Safe and Secure physical security solutions as well as the Piloting of alternative solutions to measure their effectiveness and ability to address specific Safe and Secure business needs, practices and processes.

• When required, travel to sites performing pilot installations, supporting our Vendor/Partner/Suppliers and Carvana Safe and Secure associates, providing ongoing oversight, confirming the systems are operating per specifications and meet company requirements.

• Review, create and escalate Help Desk tickets, email inquiries, and incoming calls to diagnose problems, gather additional information, work with solution providers, identify solutions and document all associated processes.

• Document process standards, naming standards, how-tos, equipment information, solutions to new problems and share them with the rest of the team.

• Read and interpret blueprints, diagrams, and schematics in addition to understanding system specifications, software/system programs, and operational/product manuals.

• Complete and submit all required task-related activity, productivity, sign-offs and other documentation in a timely manner.

• Attentively listening to the voice of our customer - serve as a business partner to other departments within Safe and Secure.

• Provide remote and phone support to internal customers and alternate technicians as needed.

What you should know/have

• Bachelor’s degree (ideally in business, finance or criminal justice) from an accredited college or university.

• 5+ years of experience in corporate, public or military security systems operations, installation and/or management; including physical security access control, video surveillance, and intrusion detection systems.

• 2+ years of experience in project and/or program management.

• Proficiency in performing Data Analysis and Reporting using tools such as Excel, Google Sheets and Tableau

• Strong experience with IP Video Management Solutions, Access Control and Alarm Monitoring systems.

• Demonstrated ability to deliver a consistent, top-notch customer service experience.

• The ability to effectively communicate with remote users via phone or email and troubleshoot problems using remote connectivity tools or sometimes in the blind.

• Ability to meet deadlines working in a fast-paced environment with minimal direction.

• Strong understanding of basic TCP/IP and Windows networking with the ability to verify network connectivity.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• Ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Self-starter’s mentality.

We’d love it if you also had

• Experience with Wrike and/or MS Project project management software.

• Current Internet Protocol (IP) video certification(s)/system knowledge.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time hourly position with a competitive rate.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

• 401K with company match.

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.

• Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development.

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Central Technology Center Operator - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Summary:

Our Security Officers protect the Industrial or Commercial property of our clients against fire, vandalism, and illegal entry. Our clients range from Class-A Office Buildings, Luxury Residential Properties, Distilleries, Fortune 500 Companies, Financial Institutions, Telecommunications, Manufacturing/Industrial Factories, Hospitals, and many others. The successful candidate will be a problem solver, possess critical thinking skills, and be detail-oriented. This position is responsible for using best practices for communicating information surrounding those incidents to leadership as appropriate. The CTC Operator 1 will monitor cameras and alarms, dispatch associated calls via telephone and radio, and provide general assistance to both employees and guests.

The CTC Operator 1 is responsible for answering routine and emergency calls, monitoring alarms and video equipment including video alarms, door alarms, and duress alarms, and providing general assistance to employees, vendors, and guests.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• The CTC Operator 1 is responsible for monitoring various tools to assist in identifying threats and/or risks to the organization.

• The CTC Operator 1 will coordinate response to life safety incidents (medical, safety, natural disasters, etc.) and dispatch security officers, CRT, facilities, police, fire, and EMS personnel as required via telephone, radio and/or software systems provided by Walden Security.

• The CTC Operator 1 maintains various records of communications and events.

• Able to manage and handle situations of a sensitive nature and maintain the company’s confidentiality and information security practices (personnel issues, investigations, public relations incidents, emergency personnel contact information, etc.).

• Conduct investigative video reviews and report findings; Assist in conducting investigations and update requestors promptly

• Properly document all reported incidents, notifying appropriate parties for information, escalation, or other business-required actions

• Ensure all systems within the CTC are functioning properly and report deficiencies as necessary.

• Coordinate the response of on-site security personnel utilizing surveillance tools equipped with intrusion detection to identify individuals in restricted areas.

• Proactively monitor developments of extreme or adverse atmospheric conditions such as hurricanes, tornadoes, floods, blizzards, severe thunderstorms, and other weather phenomena that can cause damage, disruption, or threats to life and property.

• In the event of an ongoing police or fire emergency in proximity to an asset, you will be expected to promptly collect real-time information and alert the relevant offices or employees affected.

• Maintain situational awareness during planned and unplanned civil demonstrations near assets, identifying signs of unruly behavior or clashes with external security forces using news sources and subscribed intelligence tools.

• Manage and prioritize employee security concerns through email, phone, and internal messaging platforms to ensure efficient support and resolution of requests.

• Strong understanding and troubleshooting capabilities for CCTV, Physical Access Control, and various Security Software Platforms utilized by the organization.

• Must be detail-oriented, organized with the ability to multitask in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

• Ability to analyze problems, identify causes, and implement results-oriented solutions.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills.

• Must possess strong computer skills with a high proficiency in the Microsoft workspace and an ability to find information fast.

• A professional demeanor, along with excellent customer service skills

• Ability to work independently while also being a team player.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Fluency in other languages is a plus.

• Conduct routine alarm testing and remote audits.

• Maintain daily logs and prepare and provide reports as required.

• An analytical mindset with the ability to identify and escalate critical issues.

• Position requires sitting and screen exposure for extended periods.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

• This job has no supervisory responsibilities.
• This job is subject to the supervision of CTC Shift Supervisors

Competency
To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies (minimum of 5):

• Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems promptly; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem-solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.

• Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others.

• Customer Service - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.

• Interpersonal Skills - Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.

• Oral Communication - speaks very clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations; listens and gets clarification; responds well to questions; demonstrates group presentation skills; participates in various meetings.

• Written Communication - Writes clearly and informatively; Edits work for spelling and grammar; Varies writing style to meet needs; Presents numerical data effectively; Able to read and interpret written information.

• Diversity- Demonstrates knowledge of EEO policy; Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences. Educates others on the value of diversity, promotes a harassment- free environment, and builds a diverse workforce.

• Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethically; Upholds organizational values.

• Judgement – Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgement; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events; adapts to new product introduction, emergent business needs, and business evolution.

• Attendance/Punctuality - Is consistently at work and on time; Ensures work responsibilities are covered when absent; Arrives at meetings and appointments on time.

• Dependability - follows instructions, responds to management direction; takes responsibility for own actions; keeps commitments; commits to long hours of work when necessary to reach goals; completes tasks on time or notifies appropriate person with an alternate plan. Goal and detail-oriented.

Qualifications

Graduate of an accredited registered nursing program.

Graduate of an accredited registered nursing program. Eligible to sit for NCLEX – A nursing graduate shall cease practice as a nursing graduate immediately if the nursing graduate fails two attempts at the NCLEX exam or has not successfully taken and passed the NCLEX exam within 120 days of application to the board of nursing.

A nursing graduate shall cease practice as a nursing graduate:

(a) No later than 120 days after the date the nursing graduate submitted an application to the Board; or

(b) Immediately if the nursing graduate fails the second NCLEX examination.

A nursing graduate may not:

(a) Work without the physical presence of and direct supervision by a registered nurse;

(b) Refer to oneself or practice as a registered nurse (RN) or licensed practical nurse (LPN);

(c) Be considered a staff person for purposes of a staffing pattern;

(d) Accept charge responsibilities; or

(e) Perform initial patient assessment or the first patient assessment of a shift, develop patient plans of care, evaluate or document patient discharge, or independently administer medications or intravenous therapy.

jobs.title: Dermatologist (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced part-time Dermatologist to provide medical dermatology services to our patient population in Starbase, TX. This role involves traveling to our clinic two times per month to deliver expert consultative care for a broad range of skin, hair, and nail conditions. You'll work alongside our primary care team to ensure patients receive timely, high-quality dermatologic care.

Here's what you'll do:

• Provide episodic, consultative medical dermatology care

• Diagnose and manage a wide range of dermatologic conditions including inflammatory skin diseases, infections, autoimmune conditions, acne, hair and nail disorders, and skin cancer screening

• Collaborate and consult with local primary care physicians.

• Potential to serve as a clinical resource for our virtual team, including “curbsides” on complex dermatologic cases and helping create patient-facing medical resources.

• Contribute to quality improvement initiatives and clinical protocols that enhance dermatologic care delivery

About You

We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:

• Board Certified in Dermatology

• Active medical license in Texas

• ≥ 3-5 years of clinical experience in medical dermatology

• Expertise managing complex dermatologic conditions across diverse patient populations, including pediatrics

• Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams

• Comfort with biopsies and ability to follow up on results remotely.

• Willingness to travel to Starbase, TX up to two times per month; travel and lodging expenses covered

• For the safety of our patients and staff, employees in this role must be fully vaccinated with all necessary vaccinations. This includes a booster for a completed COVID-19 vaccination.

Compensation Range: $225-275/hour based upon prior experience, performance, and market dynamics

How We Hire

Galileo Health is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

We have recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. We will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments or access to any financial accounts; and/or conduct text-only interviews. If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

We are looking for a Talent Operations Coordinator to help enable Anduril's Talent Acquisition (TA) team to scale effectively. As a member of the TA Operations team, you will support data integrity and day-to-day system upkeep across our TA tech stack (including Greenhouse and ChartHop), serving as a first line of support for TA team stakeholders with questions or issues.

This role sits at the heart of a large, rapidly scaling recruiting team, giving you outsized impact on the smooth day-to-day operations of TA. You'll get hands-on exposure to a wide range of TA tools, systems, and processes, with the opportunity to learn quickly and grow within Talent Operations. We're looking for someone detail-oriented and customer-focused who enjoys helping others, stays organized amid a lot of moving pieces, and is excited to build a foundation for a career in TA Ops.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Support data cleanliness across the TA tech stack:

• Assist with regular audits of Greenhouse and ChartHop data

• Flag data discrepancies and partner with stakeholders to get them corrected

• Help maintain documentation on data entry standards and processes

• Answer questions and support stakeholders:

• Serve as a first point of contact for TA team questions on Greenhouse, ChartHop, ContactOut, TextExpander, and LinkedIn Recruiter

• Troubleshoot common issues, escalating more complex or technical issues to senior TA Ops team members

• Help field and triage requests coming through the TA ticketing system / Slack channels

• Support systems operations:

• Help manage user access and basic account administration across TA tools

• Own regular workflows across systems, such as processing backfills, resolving system integration errors, and other recurring data/system maintenance tasks

• Additional projects, documentation, and tool exploration as needed â there's always something new to learn!

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 1+ years of experience in a fast-paced Talent Acquisition, HR, or Operations function (Recruiting Coordinator experience a plus)

• Experience using an ATS (Greenhouse preferred) or similar HR/recruiting systems

• Customer-service mentality: enjoys working with stakeholders to solve problems and answer questions

• Detail-oriented: strong attention to accuracy and consistency, especially with recruiting and headcount data

• Communicative: clear, proactive communication with cross-functional stakeholders

• Organized and action-oriented: able to juggle multiple requests and follow through on the details

• Eager to learn: comfortable in an undefined, fast-changing environment, and motivated to grow within Talent Operations

• Self-sufficient problem-solver who also knows when to ask for help or escalate

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience using a headcount management tool or HRIS (ChartHop or Workday preferred)

US Salary Range

$69,000—$89,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.
