jobs.title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
Built's Mission: Connect and simplify doing business in real estate.

Built is the AI-powered platform transforming the way real estate is financed, developed, and managed. Purpose-built for real estate and construction, Built began by fixing construction draw management for lenders and has grown into a comprehensive operating system addressing some of the industry’s most complex challenges. Today, Built is a partner to more than 350 lenders, over 80,000 borrowers and owners, and thousands of contractors, powering 86,000 active projects valued at more than $300 billion. Learn more at getbuilt.com.
__________________________

About the Role

As Manager of Talent Acquisition, you’ll lead and develop our team of TA Partners while managing a recruiting desk of your own. You’ll own hiring delivery, team operations, vendor relationships, and the candidate experience. This is a player-coach role: you’ll take on critical searches, advise leaders on hiring, and build AI-enabled tools and workflows that help a lean team work with greater speed and quality.

Our Guiding Principles

• Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.

• Help Customers Win. We learn our customers' businesses deeply, treat their capital like our own, and measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.

• Move with Urgency and Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds.

• Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it.

• Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop the TA Team

• Manage two Senior Talent Acquisition Partners. Set clear expectations, coach on recruiting craft, provide regular feedback, and create growth paths for each team member.

• Own recruiting delivery quality across your team: pipeline health, interview-to-offer ratios, time-to-fill, and candidate experience metrics.

• Foster a high-performance, high-accountability culture where the team ships fast, iterates openly, and holds each other to a high bar.

Recruit Directly

• Maintain a direct recruiting desk for senior, strategic, and hard-to-fill roles. Model best practices in sourcing, assessment, and candidate management for the team.

• Provide backfill and overflow capacity when volume spikes or critical searches require additional attention. You are not above doing the work.

Own TA Operations and Vendor Management

• Own the TA tech stack: Greenhouse (ATS), BrightHire (interview intelligence), LinkedIn Recruiter, and any sourcing or scheduling tools. Drive configuration, optimization, adoption, and renewal decisions.

• Manage vendor relationships and contracts. Evaluate new tools, negotiate terms, and hold vendors accountable to SLAs and value delivery.

• Own ATS hygiene, offer approval workflows, background check processes, and TA reporting. The operational backbone of recruiting runs through you.

• Manage TA vendor spend (tools, job boards, agencies, recruiting events) against budget parameters set by the VP, People.

Own Candidate Experience (First Touchpoint through Day 1)

• Own the full candidate journey from first outreach through offer acceptance and Day 1 start. Every touchpoint reflects Built's brand: professional, responsive, human, and fast.

• Own the TA-to-onboarding handoff: ensure role-specific context, hiring manager expectations, and candidate background transfer cleanly to the People Operations team, who owns the experience from Day 1 forward.

• Monitor candidate experience data (survey feedback, offer acceptance rates, candidate NPS) and drive improvements.

TA Compliance

• Serve as the compliance liaison for the TA function: OFCCP, EEO, offer letter compliance, background check processes, and hiring-related regulatory requirements.

• Partner with Legal and the People Operations team on hiring compliance, employment law changes, and audit readiness.

• Ensure all recruiting practices meet federal, state, and local requirements across a multi-state hiring footprint.

Build with AI

• Build with Claude Code: design, test, and deploy AI-powered recruiting tools including applicant screening prompts, sourcing automation, candidate evaluation frameworks, debrief preparation packages, feedback collection workflows, and pipeline analytics.

• Reshape the TA team's workflows around AI capability. Build prompt libraries, agent patterns, and automated checks that scale team output beyond headcount. The goal: a two-person TA team performing like four.

• Own applicant screening calibration: set and refine auto-advance, auto-reject, and human-review thresholds. Audit screening decisions for accuracy and bias.

• Drive adoption of AI sourcing tools and auto-scheduling across the team. Manual work is the exception, not the norm.

• Know when AI gets to a defensible answer faster and when the problem requires human judgment. Set that standard for the team.

• Share effective AI use cases and best practices across the broader People team.

What You'll Bring

• 5-9 years of full-cycle recruiting experience with 1-3 years of direct people management in a TA function.

• Strong recruiting practitioner: experienced across a variety of role types and seniority levels in a SaaS or fintech environment.

• Proven people manager: develops talent, coaches on craft, delivers clear feedback, and retains strong performers.

• Hands-on experience building with AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or equivalent) in a professional context. You build solutions on top of these tools, not just use them for search. This is non-negotiable.

• Data-driven approach to recruiting operations; comfortable working with TA metrics and using data to improve team and individual performance.

• Experience managing TA vendor relationships, including tool evaluation, contract negotiation, and renewal recommendations.

• Experience with Greenhouse or comparable ATS, including configuration and optimization. Familiarity with BrightHire, LinkedIn Recruiter, and AI-powered sourcing tools.

• Knowledge of hiring-related compliance: OFCCP, EEO, background check regulations, and multi-state employment law.

• Strong communicator and relationship builder; trusted by hiring managers and respected by the team.

• Experience in a high-growth SaaS or fintech company is required.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

• Recruiting delivery across your team is reliable: pipelines are healthy, time-to-fill is tracked and trending in the right direction, and hiring managers trust the process.

• You have driven at least one meaningful improvement to TA process, tooling, or candidate experience that is already showing measurable results.

• Your hands-on recruiting work is strong enough that your team learns from it. You are modeling the standard, not just enforcing it.

• Hiring managers across your team's desks describe their recruiting experience as high-quality, proactive, and well-organized.

• At least one AI-powered tool or workflow you built is in production and demonstrably saving time or improving quality.

• The TA-to-onboarding handoff is clean, consistent, and requires zero manual chasing from the People Ops team.

• Vendor relationships (Greenhouse, BrightHire, LinkedIn) are actively managed with clear ROI tracking.

Key Competencies

• Expertise and Business Acumen: Deep TA expertise with strong knowledge of Built's construction finance ecosystem and talent market. Reshapes team workflows around AI capability. Builds prompt libraries, agent patterns, or automated checks that scale team output beyond headcount. Connects recruiting outcomes to downstream business impact.

• Scope and Autonomy: Owns multi-workstream outcomes across TA execution, operations, compliance, and AI tooling. Defines milestones and allocates resources. jobs.title: Flex Officer - Umatilla, FL
Regulatory Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
About Re:Build Manufacturing and Re:Build Tekna:

Re:Build Manufacturing is a growing family of industrial and engineering businesses combining enabling technologies, operational superiority, and strategic M&A to build America’s next generation industrial company. At Re:Build we deploy deep expertise in engineering, operations management, and technology to supercharge the performance of our member companies. We leverage deep professional expertise and a candid, principled operating culture to drive differentiated outcomes. Ours is a fast-paced environment where individuals can stretch and be challenged to pursue their fullest potential.

Re:Build was founded to pioneer a profitable model for the revitalization of US manufacturing. We’ve assembled a powerful set of complimentary capabilities and lines of business that enable us to pursue a wide range of end markets. Our acquired businesses are grounded in build-to-print and by-the-hour engineering and design services, and we’re leveraging their combined expertise to migrate to increasingly sophisticated program development and production, as well as the generation of our own products. Our unique set of capabilities lend themselves to highly complex systems and products, and we offer customers a range of services including product and systems design, automation, fabrication, assembly, and large volume contract manufacturing. Our customers span a wide array of industries including aerospace, defense, mobility, healthcare, pharma, biotech, clean tech, chemicals, energy, lifestyle, food production, and industrial equipment.

Tekna was founded in 1988 in the heart of Southwest Michigan where creative vision and hard work laid the foundation for a business that continues to grow in a rapidly evolving industry. The rigor and attention to detail that comes with designing for the medical industry has awarded us success in supporting both major companies and start-ups from early stage development to commercialization. The same principles apply as we’ve expanded to serve customers in a wide variety of other industries including consumer and industrial goods, electronics, and appliances. Tekna’s project portfolio is incredibly diverse covering medical, life science, consumer and industrial product categories. Tekna is largely client focused offering design consulting, contract manufacturing and original equipment manufacturing services. Tekna’s cross functional teams include Design Engineering, Industrial Design, CAD, Procurement, Production and Quality which offers a friendly and supportive team atmosphere.

Who we are looking for

If you like a dynamic setting where individuals can grow and face diverse projects, we offer great variety. We empower staff to take on as much responsibility as they can handle. We provide mentorship and support from a highly proficient team. Our goal is to enable our employees to reach their highest capabilities, and through our association with Re:Build, provide avenues for personal and professional growth.

The Regulatory Compliance Engineer is responsible to complete tasks as directed by Tekna’s quality assurance framework. This supports New Product Development and ensures product safety, efficacy, reliability, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.

What you'll get to do

• Support the Core Leadership role on NPD projects. Delegate and provide mentorship of other compliance engineers assigned to your NPD projects.

• Support the Project Manager in the creation of a Design History File and ensure conformance/compliance with the Quality Management System.

• Initiate and maintain project plans that optimize product quality, project schedule, and project/product cost per the Master Project Plan.

• Conduct necessary research and establish product requirements.

• Lead risk management and coordinate the Risk Management Board review. Complete the Risk Management report required to achieve product launch.

• Support the Production Engineer, typically an Advanced Manufacturing Engineer (AME), with 6M analysis as part of developing the production process.

• Support the Procurement Specialist with supply chain management and PPAP.

• Support the Design Engineer and Production Engineer with Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMECA).

• Overwatch design for basic safety requirements ensuring compliance with applicable safety standards.

• Conduct Design for Manufacturing Analysis.

• Support the Production Engineer in completing Process Flow and Layout Diagrams.

• Design and develop verification processes/procedures for incoming, in-process, and final inspection in support of the established production process.

• Support the Production Engineer in completing the Process verification and validation matrix.

• Support the Production Engineer in completing process qualification (installation qualification, operational qualification, and performance qualification) achieving Cpk/Ppk objectives.

• Support the Design Engineer in setting up and qualifying in-house verification test methods and coordinating 3rd party certification testing in compliance with applicable standards/regulations.

• Support design transfer from NPD DHF to Operations PDM.

What you bring to the team

• Bachelor of science degree in engineering preferred.

• 1 to 3 years’ experience in Regulatory Compliance or Advanced Quality and/or 5 or more years’ experience in new product development preferred.

• Proficiency in statistical analysis and control preferred.

• Read blueprints

• Computer literacy

• Problem solving skills

• Communication skills

• Organizational skills

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

Re:Build Manufacturing is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at accommodations.ta@ReBuildmanufacturing.com or you may call us at 617.909.6275.

jobs.description:
Key Details:

We’re looking for Auto Painters with a minimum of 1 year of professional automotive painting experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As a Painter, you’ll be expected to prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of paint roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see other roles available to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing

• Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Outbound Sales Development Representative, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.

Our AI-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action.

Founder-controlled and growing  profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives.

We're growing quickly, and we're looking for a driven, intellectually curious, and professionally persistent Strategic Accounts SDR to join our team and focus on breaking into net-new enterprise accounts.

Why this role exists:

Breaking into net-new enterprise accounts requires a different motion than traditional outbound — it takes time, research, and a coordinated strategy that a closing AE simply can't own alone. This role exists to build the top of the funnel for our most important prospects: identifying the right stakeholders, creating the first meaningful touchpoints, and generating qualified pipeline in accounts that could become some of our largest customers.

What you’ll do:

• Deep account research before outreach — build org charts, identify key stakeholders across multiple levels and functions, and track trigger events (earnings calls, leadership changes, press releases, industry shifts) to find the right moment and angle to engage

• Craft highly personalized, custom outreach — sequences are tailored to each stakeholder and account, not templated; a single email may reference a specific company announcement or strategic initiative relevant to that contact

• Multi-thread into accounts — engage multiple stakeholders simultaneously rather than pursuing a single contact, and leverage internal resources like executive sponsors, events, and other channels to open doors and build familiarity across the organization over time

• Partner closely with a Strategic/Enterprise AE — work in a true team structure, collaborating regularly on account strategy, prioritization, and how to position conversations with prospects

• Drive toward pipeline, not just activity — success is measured by S2 [qualified] pipeline generated, with an emphasis on quality over volume and an understanding that breaking into a single account can take months

How success will be measured in this role:

• S2 opportunities generated across assigned accounts

• Account penetration — number of meaningful threads opened within priority accounts

• Quality and conversion rate of outbound activity, not raw volume

If the details below describe you, you could be a great fit for this role:

• PR or communications experience (strongly preferred) — understands how to craft a narrative, read the media landscape, and engage with sophisticated buyers who are often PR-savvy themselves

• Facility with technology — comfortable picking up new tools quickly (Gmail, Salesforce, Sales Navigator, Outreach, Nooks etc.) without heavy hand-holding

• Self-starter — has a track record of taking something on independently and excelling at it, whether that's a sport, instrument, leadership role, or extracurricular

• Coachable — actively seeks feedback, applies it quickly, and doesn't get defensive

• Passion and curiosity — gets genuinely excited about new ideas, industries, and problems; brings energy to conversations that prospects can feel

• Professionally persistent — knows how to stay in front of a prospect without burning the relationship; finds creative ways back in when doors close

• Fearless — comfortable reaching out to senior executives, navigating ambiguity, and trying approaches that don't have a guaranteed outcome

• High emotional intelligence — reads people well, adapts their communication style, and knows when to push and when to pull back

• Strong research skills — naturally curious and thorough; can synthesize information from multiple sources into a clear, actionable point of view

• Leadership and ability to manage up — takes ownership of their accounts, proactively communicates with their AE and manager, and isn't waiting to be told what to do next

• Alignment with Muck Rack's core values: Customer Devotion, Resilience, Transparency, Ownership

• Proactively incorporates AI tools into day-to-day work to improve productivity and accelerate delivery

Interview Overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for this role. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

• Intro call with a member of our Talent Team

• A video interview with the Hiring Manager

• Live working session

• Panel interviews with executive team members

• 30-minute Bar Raiser

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary

In the US, the base salary for this role is $29.25 an hour, with $80,840+ in OTE. Note that we typically build 1-3 quarters of ramp time with lower goals and thus lower earnings from commissions. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location. For all other countries, we have competitive pay bands based on market standards.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Why Muck Rack?

Remote Work, Forever

• Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup

• Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership

• Virtual and in-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions)

Transparent & Fair Compensation

• Competitive geo-neutral pay in the U.S.

• Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment

• Standardized bonus or commission structure

• 401(k) with employer contributions

• Equity opportunities

Health & Wellness

• Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents

• 100% premium coverage for individuals on high-deductible plans

• 24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program

• Employer-funded HSA contributions and other pre-tax benefits

• Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription

Time Off & Family Benefits

• 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days

• 13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days

• Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

Learning and Development

• Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion

• Bi-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training

• Unlimited access to Coursera and O’Reilly

• 2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

• Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives

• Agile, founder-led company focused on collaboration and innovation

• Trusted by 3,000+ companies worldwide

Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.

While we are a fully distributed team, we do have limitations on where we can hire and maintain a list of acceptable working locations based on job function. If we are unable to hire in your current location for the role for which you applied, you will be notified via email. While we enjoy many benefits as a permanently distributed and remote company, we cannot always support relocation or extended travel and have guidelines in place to ensure compliant work away from your designated permanent residence.

#LI-Remote

Please note: For detailed information regarding our GDPR and/or CCPA compliance policies, including how we handle personal data and privacy rights, kindly refer to the email correspondence accompanying this application.

Muck Rack does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or any other third parties. Any unsolicited resume sent to Muck Rack will be considered Muck Rack property, and Muck Rack will not pay a fee should it hire the subject of any unsolicited resume.

Muck Rack considers applicants for all positions on the basis of merit, qualifications, and business needs, and without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, alienage or citizenship status, ancestry, marital status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, familial status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other status or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you are contacted by anyone from a different domain who claims to be from Muck Rack, please forward the communication to legal@muckrack.com.

jobs.title: Director of Business Development - Airlines
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com.

We are hiring a Director of Business Development to win new airline customers and expand AeroVect’s commercial presence globally. You will identify and develop opportunities, build relationships with customer decision-makers, and lead the commercial process from initial engagement through signed, funded agreements.

You will work directly with AeroVect’s leadership and our Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Legal teams. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will personally lead customer conversations, develop proposals and business cases, and manage the details required to move complex opportunities forward.

You Will

 - Build and execute a focused business development plan for new airline customers. Prioritize opportunities based on fleet potential, customer readiness, commercial value, and fit with AeroVect’s deployment capabilities.

 - Develop new relationships and advance existing prospects through direct outreach, introductions, industry events, and customer visits.

 - Build relationships across airline operations, ground support equipment, finance, procurement, and executive leadership.

 - Understand customer workflows, operations, and deployment requirements. Work with internal teams to develop business cases that connect AeroVect’s solutions to measurable customer value.

 - Lead proposals, paid feasibility engagements, tenders, and commercial negotiations with support from AeroVect’s leadership, Finance, and Legal. Establish a clear path from initial deployment to fleet expansion.

 - Qualify funding, executive sponsorship, procurement timelines, and customer commitments early. Establish clear success criteria and commercial next steps for each engagement.

 - Work with Product, Engineering, and Operations to assess technical fit, implementation effort, and delivery capacity. Align scope and timing internally before making customer commitments.

 - Maintain accurate opportunity plans and forecasts, including next steps, owners, decision dates, expected revenue, and commercial risks.

You Have

 - 10+ years of experience in business development, enterprise sales, or commercial roles, with direct responsibility for winning new enterprise customers.

 - A track record of personally originating and closing complex agreements involving multiple stakeholders, complex buying processes, and significant implementation requirements.

 - Experience navigating customer budgets, procurement processes, business cases, and contract negotiations.

 - The ability to build credibility with frontline operating teams and senior executives, and lead substantive discussions about operational performance and investment decisions.

 - Strong financial and commercial judgment. You can evaluate customer economics, develop an ROI case, and distinguish early interest from an opportunity with a credible path to funding.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, including executive presentations, commercial proposals, and negotiation.

 - Strong follow-through and the ability to manage several complex opportunities independently. You are comfortable personally preparing materials and handling the details needed to advance a deal.

 - Willingness to travel regularly, domestically and internationally.

We Prefer

 - Experience selling to airlines and airports, with an established network in aviation.

 - Experience commercializing robotics, industrial automation, or other technology deployed in industrial operations at scale.

 - VC-backed startup experience.

jobs.title: Automotive Lead Service Advisor/Manager | Up to $150k/yr & Weekends Off | Gretna
jobs.description:

Automotive Lead Service Advisor/Manage

Location:

17875 Oakmont Drive, Omaha, NE, 68136

For these reasons, you play a key role in building relationships with our guests. jobs.title: Accounts Payable / General Cashier
jobs.description:
The Accounts Payable Analyst and General Cashier is a full-time, on-site role based at Sofitel New York in New York, NY.

• This role is responsible for processing vendor invoices, verifying approvals, coding expenses, and ensuring timely and accurate payments in compliance with hotel and Accor financial policies.
• The position manages daily cashiering operations, including counting and balancing cash, preparing bank deposits, reconciling house banks, and monitoring cash variances.
• Daily tasks include maintaining vendor files, resolving invoice and payment discrepancies, supporting month-end closing activities, and preparing account reconciliations and financial reports as needed.
• The role collaborates closely with Operations teams, responds to internal and external inquiries in a professional manner, and supports internal controls and audit requirements to safeguard hotel assets.

The position will pay between $32.00-$35.00/hour.

Your experience and skills include:

• Strong foundation in Finance and Accounting, with experience in accounts payable processes and general ledger entries.
• Demonstrated Analytical Skills and proficiency in Account Reconciliation, including identifying and resolving discrepancies.
• Effective Communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments and interact professionally with vendors and colleagues.
• Proficiency with spreadsheets and accounting or property management systems; experience in hospitality is prefered.
• High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and integrity in handling cash and financial data.
• Ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and work on-site in a fast-paced, service-oriented environment.
• Associate or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

Ideally, situated steps away from Fifth Avenue, Times Square and Grand Central Station, Sofitel New York’s 398 spacious guest rooms and suites provide a haven in the midst of the hustle and bustle of the city.  With French inspiration, our ambassadors deliver service from the heart and lifelong memories one guest at a time.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

We’re looking for Autobody Preppers with a minimum of 1 year of professional automotive bodywork experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Auto Body Repair Technician, you’ll be expected to perform light bodywork, including:

• Prepping, sanding, and buffing vehicles

• Removing and installing bumpers

• Minor plastic welding

• Small area bodywork (including Bondo repair)

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of prep roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Entry-Level Prepper (min 1 year professional experience): perform light bodywork, including prepping, sanding, and buffing vehicles, removing and installing bumpers, single panel repair (including Bondo repair), and minor plastic welding

• Mid-Level Prepper (min 3-5 years professional experience): perform bodywork on multiple panels, including heavy plastic welding, minor metal pulling, roof and rocker panel repair, stud welding, and large area heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

jobs.description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Location: Remote US

What You'll Do:

You are the person who brings Huntress to life in the room. You travel to roadshows, tradeshows, and other events, meet people who didn't plan to meet you, and turn genuine conversations into momentum for the business. Give More Than We Take shows up in the way you create value first, listen closely, and build relationships that feel human rather than transactional.

jobs.title: Technicien.ne éclairage | Lighting Technician - OVO
jobs.description:
Technicien en éclairage - Spectacle en tournée
Éclairage de scène
 
* Il s’agit d’un poste à temps plein impliquant des tournées internationales. La personne retenue travaillera et voyagera dans plusieurs pays au sein d’une compagnie de tournée internationale où l’anglais est la langue de travail de la production — une maîtrise parfaite de l’anglais est donc requise pour exercer les fonctions liées à ce poste*
 
Nous recherchons un technicien en éclairage pour rejoindre l’une des tournées du Cirque du Soleil. Relevant du directeur de production et travaillant sous la supervision du chef du département Visuels, le titulaire de ce poste est responsable de l’installation, de l’exploitation et de l’entretien de tous les systèmes d’éclairage et de vidéo, afin d’assurer la qualité, la cohérence et la sécurité du spectacle tout au long des représentations.
Le candidat idéal est un technicien polyvalent possédant une expérience avérée en éclairage, en vidéo/projection et en effets spéciaux dans le cadre de spectacles de grande envergure, doté de solides compétences en dépannage et de la souplesse nécessaire pour gérer les séquences de spectacle dans plusieurs disciplines visuelles.
 
Le technicien en éclairage aura l’occasion de :
Commander et gérer les séquences d’éclairage pendant les répétitions, les représentations et les séances de formation des artistes.
Participer au chargement, à l’installation, au démontage et au déchargement des systèmes du service, y compris en apportant un soutien interdépartemental lors des transferts entre villes; diriger ou superviser l’équipe locale au besoin.
Contribuer à l’intégration des systèmes visuels avec les services de suivi des artistes, d’automatisation et d’autres services techniques.
Participer aux préréglages, au réglage des signaux et à la mise au point des équipements d’éclairage et de projection.
Manœuvrer les projecteurs de poursuite, les consoles d’éclairage, les serveurs vidéo et les systèmes d’effets spéciaux pendant les représentations.
Participer à l’entretien préventif régulier, aux inspections et au dépannage en temps réel de tous les équipements d’éclairage, de vidéo et d’effets spéciaux afin d’assurer un fonctionnement sécuritaire et constant.
Former et superviser les opérateurs de projecteurs de poursuite et les techniciens locaux au besoin.
Lancer et exécuter les signaux de projecteurs de poursuite pendant les représentations, en veillant au respect des délais et à la précision.
Tenir des registres précis des inspections, des modifications, des réparations, des registres d’entretien, des feuilles de repères et des registres d’inventaire.
Collaborer avec le chef de service pour élaborer des systèmes d’exploitation sécuritaires, des routines d’entretien préventif et des procédures départementales.
Contribuer à des projets spéciaux, notamment l’intégration de nouveaux équipements, les mises à niveau et les initiatives techniques.
Préserver l’intégrité artistique du spectacle en collaboration avec le chef de service, le service artistique et les concepteurs.
Collaborer avec les autres services techniques lors du chargement, de l’installation, du démontage, du déchargement, des répétitions, des représentations et en cas d’urgence.
Participer à la gestion des stocks, aux commandes et à l’entretien du matériel, des outils et des consommables du service.
Contribuer à la planification d’urgence et réagir rapidement aux problèmes techniques pendant les spectacles en direct.
Veiller au respect des protocoles du Cirque du Soleil, des normes de l’OSHA et des règlements locaux en matière de sécurité; toujours appliquer des pratiques de travail sécuritaires.
Favoriser un milieu de travail collaboratif, respectueux et sécuritaire, conforme aux valeurs du Cirque du Soleil.
Accomplir toute autre tâche connexe qui lui est confiée.
 
Le candidat idéal devra posséder les qualifications suivantes :
Obligatoire : disponibilité pour effectuer des tournées internationales à temps plein et travailler à l’étranger.
Diplôme d’études collégiales en arts de la scène, en production théâtrale ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.
Au moins 3 ans d’expérience professionnelle dans le domaine des arts de la scène, avec des compétences en éclairage, en vidéo/projection et/ou en effets spéciaux.
Solides connaissances techniques dans les domaines suivants :

Systèmes d’éclairage (consoles, appareils intelligents, systèmes de gradation, projecteurs de poursuite).
Systèmes vidéo/de projection (projecteurs grand format, lentilles, serveurs vidéo tels que Disguise ou Watchout, capture/lecture vidéo, réseaux).
Systèmes d’effets spéciaux (effets d’ambiance, pyrotechnie ou autres effets).
Protocoles de réseau (TCP/IP, VLAN, DMX, MIDI, timecode).
Systèmes de suivi des artistes (VYV, Blacktrax, Zactracks)
Électricité et électronique liées aux systèmes de spectacle.
Expérience en dépannage et en réparation de systèmes visuels sous pression dans un environnement en direct.
Capacité à travailler en hauteur; une certification en escalade et en protection antichute constitue un atout.
Bonne compréhension générale de tous les aspects techniques d’une production à grande échelle; des connaissances interdépartementales constituent un atout.
Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office; la connaissance des logiciels de CAO (AutoCAD, Vectorworks, SOLIDWORKS) constitue un atout.
Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit et parlé); la connaissance d’autres langues est un atout.
Capacité à accomplir les fonctions essentielles du poste, notamment, mais sans s’y limiter : s’accroupir, s’agenouiller, rester debout, soulever des charges, parfois pendant de longues périodes; soulever de l’équipement lourd sans aide, etc. Des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables peuvent être prises pour permettre aux personnes ayant un handicap d’accomplir les fonctions essentielles du poste.
 
 
Le Groupe Cirque du Soleil s’engage à créer et maintenir un milieu de travail accessible et inclusif. Fièrement ambassadeur de l’égalité en emploi, Le Groupe Cirque du Soleil s’est engagé à enrayer la discrimination fondée sur l’âge, la couleur de la peau, les origines, la religion, le sexe, l’orientation sexuelle et toute autre caractéristique. La rédaction neutre et inclusive est dorénavant privilégiée pour tous les nouveaux affichages de postes.

jobs.title: Director, Strategic Accounts
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations. We are a Series A company backed by top-tier venture capital investors in aviation and autonomous driving. Our customers include some of the world’s largest airlines and ground handling providers. For more information, visit www.aerovect.com http://www.aerovect.com.

We are hiring a Strategic Account Director to own and grow one of AeroVect’s largest airline accounts. You will lead the day-to-day customer relationship, secure funding for deployments, and manage commercial agreements. You will work directly with AeroVect’s leadership and the customer’s operations, finance, procurement, and executive teams.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role dedicated to a single strategic customer. You will personally lead business reviews, negotiate commercial agreements, and follow through on the customer decisions needed to keep deployments moving.

You Will

 - Own the account plan, including revenue targets, expansion opportunities, budget timelines, and key customer decisions.

 - Build relationships across the customer’s operating teams, budget owners, procurement, and senior leadership. Develop executive sponsorship beyond individual contacts.

 - Build business cases using deployment results, operating costs, and expected returns. Work with the customer to secure budget approval and purchase orders for implementation and fleet expansion.

 - Lead pricing, contract negotiations, and renewals with AeroVect’s leadership, Finance, and Legal. Work with Product, Engineering, and Operations to validate scope and service commitments.

 - Run customer business reviews covering operating results, deployment progress, commercial opportunities, and decisions required.

 - Maintain an accurate account forecast and track contractual milestones, payment status, and commercial risks. Evaluate expansion requests against delivery capacity, support costs, and margins.

You Have

 - 10+ years of experience in strategic account management, enterprise sales, or commercial leadership, with direct responsibility for large enterprise customers.

 - A track record of growing accounts through signed, funded agreements and deployed products or services.

 - Experience navigating complex buying organizations, capital budgets, procurement processes, and contract negotiations.

 - The ability to build relationships with frontline operators and senior executives, and lead substantive discussions about business performance and investment decisions.

 - Exceptional financial and commercial judgment.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including executive presentations.

 - Strong follow-through across customer and internal teams. You are comfortable personally handling the details needed to move an account forward.

We Prefer

 - Experience selling and deploying robotics, industrial automation, or other technology used in industrial operations.

jobs.title: Regional Merchant Lead (Northwest)
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Outside Sales team has been the face of DoorDash to our merchant partners since our founding in 2013. Based locally within assigned markets, our team builds deep relationships with the most coveted local and regional restaurants. As the revenue-driving arm of DoorDash, we fuel the growth of SMB partnerships that strengthen operations, accelerate consumer growth, and improve our bottom line.

This is a field sales opportunity based out of the cities specified above. You will need to live in or in proximity to the cities listed.

About the Role

As a Regional Merchant Lead (Outside Sales Representative), you will own the full sales cycle for bringing new restaurant partners onto DoorDash. This is a fast-paced, transactional sales role where you will prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close deals with local and regional merchants across your assigned market.

You will meet with restaurant owners – walking into businesses, running pitches, and building strong local relationships – while introducing them to DoorDash’s suite of offerings, negotiating revenue share agreements, selling multi-product solutions, and helping them understand how partnering with DoorDash will grow their business.

This is a field sales role with travel within the region. You will spend 50-75%+ of your time in-field meeting with merchants (typically 2-3 days per week) with additional flexibility to work remotely or from a DoorDash office. In addition, this role will require the ability to travel as needed for in-person collaboration through training, offsites, team-building events, and other business related necessity.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Have a passion for SMB businesses and the restaurant industry

• Sell restaurant owners on the value of partnering with DoorDash and negotiate revenue share agreements

• Excel in a transactional deal cycle and closing new business within days

• Use creative strategies in sales processes and prospect outreach

• Share on-the-ground insights with sales leadership and operations team

• Mentor teammates on how to be the best version of themselves after establishing yourself in the role

• Travel into different markets and meet with restaurant owners (hybrid role with up to 50% travel)

We're excited about you because you have…

• 2+ years of experience in a closing sales role, preferably in an outside sales or field-forward environment

• The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, transaction sales cycle – typically closing deals within days

• Consistently exceeded KPIs and sales target through disciplined activity and strong execution

• Experience selling multi-product solutions and tailoring your pitch to each merchant

• Approach challenges from the fundamentals - clear discovery, strong communication, and merchant-first thinking

• Demonstrated creative and resourceful outreach tactics to open doors and engage with prospects

• Technical proficiency with CRM and sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Chorus, Google Apps)/AI tools. You're comfortable leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, and problem-solving. You actively explore and apply AI in your day-to-day work, bringing a beginner’s mindset and curiosity as you continuously learn and adapt alongside evolving technology.

• Growth mindset with a fast paced and dynamic environment and able to be adaptable with consistent change.

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for sales commission. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$28.98—$42.60 USD

The total on-target earnings (base + commissions) for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$48.30—$71 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.description:
Position: Director, Product Management

Department: Marketing

Position Type: Full-time

Location: Boulder, CO (preferred) or remote

Experience: MS degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, or a related scientific discipline required; PhD or MBA preferred. 15+ years of relevant industry experience in life sciences, biotechnology, genomics, or molecular diagnostics. 5+ years of product management experience, including demonstrated ownership of product strategy, roadmaps, and commercial performance. 5+ years of people management experience, with a proven ability to lead, develop, and mentor Product Managers.

Position Summary

Watchmaker Genomics is seeking a strategic and commercially minded Director of Product Management to lead product strategy across our next-generation sequencing (NGS), molecular diagnostics (MDx), and enzyme portfolios. This role will guide portfolio investments, product development, and lifecycle strategies to drive innovation and sustainable growth, reporting to the VP of Marketing.

The Director will lead and develop a team of Product Managers while partnering closely with R&D, Commercial, Marketing, and executive leadership to align customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise, commercial acumen, and proven leadership in bringing innovative life science products to market.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Business Leadership

• Partner with R&D and executive leadership to define and drive the overarching product strategy and multi-year roadmap across Watchmaker's NGS, MDx, and enzyme portfolios.

• Lead portfolio business planning, investment decisions, and resource prioritization, balancing near-term commercial opportunities with longer-term innovation.

• Establish portfolio performance objectives and guide pricing and growth strategies to drive revenue, market penetration, profitability, and product differentiation.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers, establishing clear priorities, accountability, and performance expectations.

• Serve as a strategic sponsor for portfolio initiatives, empowering Product Managers while ensuring cross-functional alignment and execution.

Product Innovation & Development

• Guide market assessment, competitive intelligence, and customer discovery to identify unmet needs, evaluate new product opportunities, and inform portfolio priorities.

• Provide strategic leadership and oversight of product development initiatives, ensuring alignment across Product Management, R&D, and Applications on priorities, customer requirements, and business objectives.

Commercialization & Lifecycle Management

• Provide strategic oversight of product commercialization, partnering with Product Marketing, Sales, and Applications to ensure successful transitions from development through launch and market adoption.

• Partner with Commercial to support strategic accounts and key partnerships, aligning product strategies and development priorities with customer needs and business opportunities.

• Monitor product performance and market feedback to identify opportunities for portfolio optimization, lifecycle management, and sustained growth.

Education and Experience

• MS degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, or a related scientific discipline required; PhD or MBA preferred.

• 15+ years of relevant industry experience in genomics, or molecular diagnostics.

• 5+ years of product management experience, including demonstrated ownership of product strategy, roadmaps, and commercial performance.

• 5+ years of people management experience, with a proven ability to lead, develop, and mentor Product Managers.

• Demonstrated success bringing innovative life science products from concept through commercialization and lifecycle management.

• Demonstrated commercial and financial acumen, including experience with business case development, pricing strategies, revenue forecasting, and product profitability.

• Strong technical understanding of NGS workflows and molecular diagnostic applications, with the ability to lead across a diverse technical portfolio.

• Experience leading cross-functional new product development teams and making strategic product investment decisions.

• Experience supporting strategic accounts, OEM relationships, partnerships, or customized product solutions strongly preferred.

• Customer-facing experience and a demonstrated ability to translate market insights into actionable product strategies.

• Familiarity with quality and regulatory considerations relevant to molecular diagnostics, including experience collaborating with Quality and Regulatory teams.

Skills and Requirements

• Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to evaluate complex market opportunities and make sound portfolio investment decisions.

• Proven ability to lead and develop teams while empowering individual ownership and accountability.

• Excellent cross-functional leadership and influencing skills, including the ability to navigate competing priorities and drive alignment without direct authority.

• Strong scientific and technical aptitude, with the ability to connect emerging technologies to customer needs and commercial opportunities.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage customers, technical teams, and executive leadership.

• Sound judgment, organizational discipline, and the ability to make decisions in an environment of ambiguity and changing priorities.

• Entrepreneurial mindset with a balance of strategic vision and execution.

• Willingness to travel up to 30%, domestically and internationally.

Compensation

The base compensation for the Director, Product Management role starts at $180,000 - $210,000 + bonus + equity; actual pay will be adjusted based on skills and experience. Employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off, Holidays, employer covers 75% of base medical plan with buy-up options, EAP (employee assistance program), employer paid dental with a buy-up option, employer paid vision, employer paid $25,000 life/AD&D policy, paid parental leave, and a 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% match.

Application Requirements

To apply for the position, please submit the following in a PDF format on watchmakergenomics.com:

• Letter of motivation (upload where it says cover letter)

• Resume or Curriculum vitae, highlighting relevant qualifications and experience

Applications without a Letter of Motivation will not be considered. Local candidates preferred.

Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis and the position will remain open until filled; however, early submission is encouraged as review will begin immediately.

If selected to participate in the interview process, the names and contact information of three professional references who are able to assess your suitability for the position in terms of the specified requirements will be requested.

*** NO RECRUITMENT AGENCIES PLEASE

We are only accepting direct applications for this position. We are not working with external recruiters or agencies at this time. Unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from third-party recruiters will not be considered and will be deemed the property of Watchmaker Genomics.

*** WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY/AFFIRMATIVE ACTION EMPLOYER

Watchmaker Genomics is committed to being an equal opportunity employer and creating a culturally diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics as protected by applicable law.

All applicants will be asked if currently eligible to work in the United States of America; and if now or in the future will require visa sponsorship to continue working in the United States.

This position may be subject to pre-employment checks, including driving history check, drug screening and a background check for any convictions directly related to its duties and responsibilities. All pre-employment checks will comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Manager, Inbound Sales Development (CHI)
jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

*This role will sit in the CHI office hybrid (3x per week).

At Rippling, Sales Development is the driving force behind two main functions: pipeline creation and career development. We execute with a high level of urgency to partner with marketing and our sales partners to drive demand and create new business opportunities. Simultaneously we double down on the development of our people; creating career paths that allow reps to move through the SDR org and into more strategic roles that align with their future career aspirations.

As an SDR Manager, you’re focused on coaching and developing your regional reps. Building pipeline, managing processes, and focusing on per rep production is vital. This Inbound Manager will be overseeing an entire Inbound SDR team which generally consists of 6-10 reps. Our overall org is specialized in IB, OB, and Special Projects that allow managers to be very strategic with the type of funnel they’re managing.

We're bullish on the SDR function being the third pillar within the GTM function. An age old tale of whether SDR should report to Marketing or Sales allows for a new opportunity at Rippling. Not to mention the chance to develop your people, promote from within and lead an upper echelon organization.

What you will do

• Top of funnel leader that can execute on business needs.
• Able to leverage data to ensure that SLA’s and KPI’s are hit daily.
• Working side by side with your reps and coaching them how to handle objections and pitch Rippling in order to book demos with prospects.
• Motivates your reps to learn and grow daily preparing them for their next sales role.
• Strong leader that owns a specific function and is able to translate the needs of the business throughout their org.
• Heavily involved in hiring top talent for the SDR organization
• Displaying cross functional empathy and able to deliver high level and tactical feedback across the orgs.

What you will need

• Proficiency in SDR Tech Stack: Outreach, Salesloft, Mixmax, Salesforce, LI Sales Navigator, Zoominfo, Lusha, LeadIQ, SalesIntel, Gong/Chorus, Guru/Highspot
