jobs.title: Sr. Digital Tools Engineer, Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Supply Chain Sr. Digital Tools Engineer role will act as a Business Systems and Optimization partner for Anduril's Supply Chain team and will own parts of the end-to-end Supply Chain Digital and Process ecosystem. As such, the role will collaborate with internal Supply Chain teams (Procurement, Purchasing, Planning, Program Management) and external teams (IT, Engineering, Business Systems, Strategy, Legal, People, etc.) to develop system implementation plans intended to enhance our digital landscape and increase efficiencies throughout our end-to-end processes, all with a focus on introducing scale and resiliency into our growing people and tools footprint. As a Supply Chain Systems Analyst, you will have two primary responsibilities:

• Optimizing Supply Chain Systems & Processes: You will work across procurement, purchasing, planning, and program management functions to improve the systems and data infrastructure that power our supply chain operations. You will build out data-capture capabilities, design analytics reporting, and drive system enhancements that enable scalable, sustainable growth.

• Solving Complex Cross-Functional Problems: You will be frequently pulled into high-priority initiatives that span multiple teams and systems—problems that are critical to solve but don't fall neatly into any single team's domain. You bring structure to ambiguity and drive solutions where others see only complexity.

Much of the time, both of these go hand-in-hand. You will be embedded in the business, working cross-functionally with supply chain leaders, IT, engineering, business systems, strategy, legal, people, and other stakeholders to solve our messiest systems and data problems, translate operational needs into technical requirements, and equip teams with the tools and insights they need to perform at their best.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own supply chain systems projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering, to solution design, to implementation and user adoption—navigating ambiguous problems with little prescription on how to solve them.

• Develop and execute system implementation plans that enhance our digital landscape and increase efficiencies across end-to-end supply chain processes (sourcing, procurement, inventory, planning, payment), with a focus on introducing scale and resiliency.

• Serve as the bridge between supply chain operations and technical teams, translating business requirements into system specifications and ensuring solutions actually solve the problems they were designed for.

• Work deeply within our supply chain technology stack (ERP, MRP, WMS, TMS, PLM, etc.), leveraging data to execute analyses on short timelines, identify bottlenecks, and surface insights that drive operational improvement.

• Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics tools that give supply chain leaders real-time visibility into KPIs such as on-time delivery, inventory turns, supplier performance, and lead times.

• Project manage across large, cross-functional groups of stakeholders—leading meetings, managing communications, and driving alignment toward solutions amid challenging deadlines and moving milestones.

• Support system implementations, upgrades, and migrations by leading user acceptance testing, developing training materials, and championing change management across the organization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelors Degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in supply chain systems, business systems analysis, ERP/MRP administration, management consulting, or a related operations/technology role, with hands-on experience in one or more supply chain platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Coupa, or similar).

• Strong project management capabilities—proven record of getting difficult projects over the finish line while juggling challenging deadlines, an evolving stakeholder base, and moving milestones. Effort and pursuit of progress should be your default mode.

• Ability to fully immerse yourself in a new domain or knowledge area, absorb critical information and the current set of challenges, and proactively progress initiatives toward resolution without needing to be guided through every step.

• Understanding of core supply chain elements—sourcing, procurement, inventory, and payment—and an eagerness to continuously deepen your knowledge base across these areas.

• Strong analytical aptitude with the ability to quickly execute analyses in Excel, SQL, or BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.). You intuitively think about problems in terms of data models, system logic, and process flows.

• Self-driven and relentlessly proactive. You don't wait on others to solve problems—you step into the gap to offer solutions yourself. We'd rather have to tell you to slow down than to speed up.

• Comfortable communicating broadly—writing requirements documents, presenting recommendations to senior leadership, and facilitating discussions across technical and non-technical audiences.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with ERP and Procurement Software/Tools.

• Experience with system integration tools, APIs, or middleware platforms

• Familiarity with data modeling, ETL processes, or data warehousing constructs

• Experience supporting ERP implementations, major system migrations, and/or continuous enhancement projects

• Experience in working on process optimization projects with both internal and external stakeholders under tight deadlines

• Background in hardware manufacturing, aerospace & defense, or other complex supply chain environments

• Knowledge of process mapping methodologies (BPMN, value stream mapping, etc.)

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Executive Assistant to the CEO (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.




YOUR ROLE

Building a fusion company across two continents takes focus, strong relationships and thoughtful coordination. Our CEO works closely with investors, governments, strategic partners and the leadership team. You create the structure that helps him use his time effectively and arrive prepared.

This is the most senior executive support role at Focused Energy. You will work directly with the CEO as part of a closely coordinated CEO Office, in partnership with and reporting to the Chief of Staff. You will take ownership of the operational infrastructure supporting the CEO, including diary and calendar management, travel coordination, executive administration and stakeholder logistics. The Chief of Staff leads strategic priorities, substantive briefings, executive alignment and follow-through on key decisions. You ensure the practical arrangements and information flow support those priorities effectively.

When a delegation trip with twelve meetings across three countries changes at short notice, you bring the overview and experience to rebuild the plan, coordinate the people involved and keep everyone informed. You enjoy solving complex logistics and creating clarity when plans change.

You will exercise sound judgment and make day-to-day decisions independently within agreed parameters, knowing when to escalate strategic conflicts or sensitive matters. You will help establish reliable, efficient ways of working as the CEO Office develops.

You represent the CEO Office to investors, ministries, partner companies and board members. As the most experienced EA in the company, you also help shape how executive support works across Focused Energy.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Plan and coordinate the CEO’s domestic and international travel, including complex delegations, conferences and investor or government engagements.

 - Own itineraries, participants, visas, invitations, registrations, protocol requirements, ground logistics, contingency arrangements and live coordination during trips.

 - Be willing to accompany the CEO internationally when needed, independently or alongside the Chief of Staff, while providing effective remote support on trips you do not attend.

 - Maintain a clear overview of upcoming commitments and what each requires. Anticipate conflicts, preparation needs and logistical dependencies, and act early.

 - Coordinate the timely preparation, collation and distribution of briefing materials, working with the Chief of Staff and relevant content owners.

 - Maintain clear administrative follow-up and ensure decisions, commitments and emerging priorities are promptly communicated to the Chief of Staff for strategic follow-through.

 - Build trusted relationships with investors, ministries, agencies, partner companies, board members and their offices.

 - Keep the CEO Office running effectively, including expenses, approvals, signatures, tools, records and contact management.

 - Help develop shared standards for calendar management, travel, tools and confidentiality, supporting collaboration and teamwork across the EA team, both locally and internationally.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You bring ten or more years of experience in executive support, including several years supporting a CEO, founder or managing director in an international business with extensive travel and calendar management. Experience in a growing company or investor environment is a plus.

 - You have supported highly driven, fast-moving executives and can bring structure to changing or incomplete requests.

 - You have managed complex delegation trips involving multiple participants, countries and official meetings.

 - You combine strong organisation, judgment and emotional intelligence with a calm, adaptable style and are comfortable partnering with a Chief of Staff while maintaining a direct, trusted relationship with the CEO.

 - You understand competing priorities and can make confident decisions within your remit.

 - You protect an executive’s time with diplomacy and build constructive relationships with the people seeking it.

 - You are comfortable working with board members, investors, ministries and senior executives, as well as the teams supporting them.

 - You work proactively, identifying scheduling conflicts, travel requirements and preparation needs before they become urgent.

 - You stay composed when plans change, communicate clearly and know when to bring others into a decision.

 - You handle sensitive board, investor, M&A and personnel matters with discretion.

 - You use modern scheduling and collaboration tools confidently and are interested in using AI thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work.

 - You are fluent in English and German.

 - You are based in Berlin, or willing to relocate, and comfortable travelling with the CEO when needed.




A WORD ON PACE

This is a demanding role, with a strong emphasis on complex calendar management, exceptional attention to detail and the delivery of high-level, hands-on executive support to the CEO of a rapidly growing international company. Priorities can shift quickly and some trips or commitments require flexibility at short notice. It calls for someone who enjoys responsibility, stays calm under pressure and communicates clearly about priorities and capacity.

In return, you can expect meaningful ownership, a close working partnership with the CEO and Chief of Staff, and the opportunity to help shape how the CEO Office operates. You will be trusted to exercise judgment within agreed responsibilities and escalation parameters.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 - Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 - Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

 - Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Utility Officer - Greenville, SC
Senior Solutions Consultant- Banking
jobs.description:
Why Choose Bottomline?

Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!

The Role:

The Senior Solutions Consultant is a business-focused pre-sales professional who supports sales opportunities across Bottomline’s Banking Solutions portfolio, with primary responsibility for Digital Banking Solutions and secondary support for Fraud and Risk Solutions (CFRM).

Partnering closely with Sales Executives, Account Managers, Product Management, Product Marketing, Technical Solutions Consulting, and Implementation, this role helps financial institutions identify their needs, evaluate solutions, and connect Bottomline’s capabilities to meaningful business outcomes. The Senior Solutions Consultant leads consultative discovery, software demonstrations, RFP and RFI responses, and solution storytelling throughout the sales process.

The ideal candidate understands how banks deliver commercial digital banking and treasury management services to their business customers. They are comfortable engaging executives, commercial banking and treasury management leaders, product teams, operations, and technology stakeholders, and can translate complex requirements into clear, compelling solution narratives.

This person is commercially minded, curious, and confident guiding customers through complex buying decisions while establishing themselves as a trusted banking technology advisor.

How you'll make an impact:

Consultative Sales Support

• Serve as a primary business and solution resource throughout a financial institution’s evaluation and buying process.

• Partner with Sales Executives and Account Managers on discovery to understand the institution’s strategy, commercial customer needs, business priorities, current challenges, desired outcomes, and decision criteria.

• Apply consultative selling practices to uncover needs, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and connect Bottomline solutions to measurable business value.

• Help develop opportunity strategy, value messaging, competitive positioning, and customer-specific presentation plans.

• Lead end-to-end RFP and RFI responses, coordinating across Sales, Product, Technical Solutions Consulting, Security, Legal, Implementation, and other subject matter experts to deliver accurate, consistent, and differentiated submissions.

• Identify business risks, gaps, dependencies, and customer expectations early in the sales cycle.

Solution Demonstrations & Storytelling

• Plan, configure, and deliver compelling demonstrations of Bottomline Banking Solutions, with a primary focus on Digital Banking.

• Tailor demonstrations to each financial institution’s business model, commercial customer segments, treasury management priorities, and desired digital experience.

• Use clear, outcome-focused storytelling to demonstrate how Bottomline can help banks improve the customer experience, support growth, increase operational effectiveness, and address fraud and risk.

• Provide secondary demonstration and sales support for CFRM opportunities in partnership with the lead CFRM Solutions Consultant.

• Deliver executive presentations, capability overviews, workshops, and other customer-facing sessions both virtually and in person.

• Partner with Technical Solutions Consulting when opportunities require deeper architecture, integration, security, data, or technical validation.

Banking & Market Expertise

Maintain strong working knowledge of:

• Commercial banking business models and the needs of small business, middle-market, and corporate customers.

• Commercial digital banking, cash management, and treasury management services.

• Core commercial banking capabilities including account information, payments, entitlements, approvals, reporting, alerts, administration, onboarding, and servicing.

jobs.title: Operator I (Mixer) $21.23 hr
jobs.description:

Qualified Mixer candidates are responsible for performing a variety of production and support duties, including general housekeeping, rework activities, packaging preparation, product packaging, and food manufacturing operations, as well as other tasks assigned by supervision.

Employees must comply with all plant policies and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), including attendance requirements, and adhere to all safety rules and procedures. This includes the proper use of required personal protective equipment (PPE), such as safety glasses, safety footwear, hearing protection, gloves, and fall protection when applicable.

Employees are responsible for following mix instructions and accurately documenting production activities in a clear and concise manner.

• Operate the kombinator, votators, and all related processing equipment in accordance with established operating procedures.
• Operate and monitor equipment used to mix and blend food products, including edible oils, dressings, margarines, spreads, shortenings, cooking sherries, vinegars, and cooking wines.

• Understand process flow and trace product movement throughout the production system and processing lines.

• Confirm production schedules with the Supervisor, determine which oils are required, and transfer oils between tanks to supply production lines using computerized controls.

• Follow all chemical handling procedures and use required personal protective equipment (PPE).

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area at all times.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager, Custom Silicon and Semiconductor (Starlink)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

GLOBAL SUPPLY MANAGER, CUSTOM SILICON AND SEMICONDUCTOR (STARLINK)

SpaceX is leveraging our experience building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s largest satellite constellation and most advanced broadband internet system. We provide reliable and fast internet to millions of users worldwide, including populations with little or no connectivity, rural communities, aircraft, watercraft, and places where existing services are unreliable, too expensive, or disconnected by natural disasters. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system, thousands of satellites and consumer antennae that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing. The Starlink team is seeking out the best-in-class professionals to maximize Starlink’s potential for communities and businesses around the globe.

As a Global Supply Manager, you will be part of an agile, yet robust, supply chain team that will enable a competitive advantage for the company. The functions within the department include procurement, planning and fulfillment, supplier development and quality, and logistics and inventory. SpaceX supply chain plays a key role in enabling SpaceX to meet these ambitious growth targets and contribute to making us a multi-planetary species

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Conduct comprehensive supplier analysis to formulate a strategic sourcing plan that identifies new/suitable suppliers, optimize cost structures, and proactively ensures continuity of supply based on macro market or industry trends

• Manage the supply base by implementing a precise supplier stratification model and executing on a documented supplier management playbook

• Ensure health of supply base by evaluating and selecting suppliers based on capability, quality, reliability, and price competitiveness and ensure that suppliers meets all critical measures of performance by consistently executing operating and control plans

• Analyze supplier operations to assess technical capability, equipment, and capacity for rapid deployment of new product development and long term production to implement a successful E2E product life cycle management strategy and process

• Direct and execute initiatives that support aggressive improvements in supplier quality, total cost effectiveness, enhanced service levels, improved coordination, delivery, pricing, lead-times, payment, risk compliance, and other areas as identified

• Develop supplier scorecard to measure supplier performance against agreed upon key performance indicators and report findings to leadership

• Develop strong relationships with internal stakeholders, understanding their needs and consulting with them to build quality procurement strategies aligned to business requirements

• Push engineering to make sound design decisions that are conducive to a high performing supply plan

• Coordinate with engineering and quality organizations to determine cause of rejected material and to drive appropriate changes to ensure elimination/reduction of those quality issues

• Administer moderate to large contracts and independently negotiate with supplier’s contract terminology, pricing, technical requirements, scope, and terms involving responsibility, liability, indemnification, intellectual property, and export compliance

• Execute purchasing transactions within scope area by issuing purchase orders for SpaceX programs and ensure delivery with materials requirement planning (MRP) to ensure accurate and complete information at all times

• Consult and advise buyers and planners on strategies and tactics to ensure their success and development by providing high-level oversight and support to ensure operational success in tactical procurement execution

• Procure passive, active, and electro-mechanical components via material requirements planning (MRP)

• Keep up with industry and commodity market trends while developing and maintaining strategic partnerships with major component distributors and manufacturers

• Source, support, and drive alternate material and supplier qualification through engineering and quality teams

• Coordinate and drive alignment between SpaceX future designs and preferred supplier technology road maps

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree and 6+ years of experience working in a supply chain, production, or engineering function; or advanced degree and 4+ years of experience working in a supply chain, production, or engineering function; or 10+ years of experience working in a supply chain, production, or engineering function in lieu of a degree

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 6+ years procurement experience in Custom Silicon and OSAT (Outsource and Semiconductor Assembly and Test) sourcing

• Strong understanding Silicon Foundry and OSAT manufacturing supply chain, global commodity market and pricing trend

• Experience in managing product development (EVT), new product introduction (NPI) and mass production (MP) processes

• Experience working with global foundry service vendors (advanced, RF/analog) or OSAT vendors

• Technical knowledge in a commodity (e.g. OSAT manufacturing, processes, etc.)

• Experienced in sourcing from a global supply base and managing sourcing phases from market research, supplier evaluation and selection, negotiations and supplier onboarding

• Proven success working on cross-functional new product introduction projects, completing cost models, benchmarking, and negotiations

• Familiarity with ERP systems and purchasing/planning functions

• Exceptional written, verbal and presentation communication skills

• Ability to identify and resolve technical, operational and organizational problems

• Detail-oriented, self-motivated and able to respond quickly to a fast-moving and ever-changing environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to travel up to 25%

• Willingness to communicate outside of work hours

• Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed to meet critical deadlines

• Must be willing to work onsite, remote work not considered

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay range:
Global Supply Manager: $130,000.00 - $180,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

jobs.title: HR Manager, Facilities
jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Grüns is opening a second warehouse facility and we need a sharp, people-first HR Manager to help us do it right. This role is the on-the-ground HR presence across two facilities: our Pennsylvania site (home base) and our Roanoke, TX location. You'll own the full employee lifecycle, from onboarding and payroll to employee relations and recruiting, while building the systems that help both facilities run at a high level as we scale.

You'll support a diverse, fast-moving population of both salaried and hourly employees. You need to be bilingual in English and Spanish, fluent in both the administrative and human sides of HR, and comfortable making judgment calls in real time. You'll bring our values and culture into every interaction at both sites.

This role is part of our HQ people team and sits on-site at our Pennsylvania facility with quarterly travel to our Roanoke, TX location. We come together twice a year for off-sites where the whole team connects IRL.

In this role, you will:

• Build and run a scalable onboarding process, including paperwork, E-Verify, and culture training aligned to the Grüns way of operating, plus a smooth, repeatable path for converting high-performing temps to employees

• Own payroll processing, HRIS changes, compliance, and offboarding, including performance documentation, exit interviews, and support on terminations

• Co-lead recruiting for the Pennsylvania facility, hiring hourly teams and supervisors in partnership with Operations leadership as the site grows

• Serve as first-line employee relations partner to supervisors and hourly employees, running investigations and documenting with care

• Build and deliver a quarterly competitive comp analysis for both facilities, and run the programs that keep people engaged and reduce turnover

• Earn the trust of Spanish-speaking team members, so information and expectations flow clearly between HQ, supervisors, hourly, and temp staff

• Improve the systems and reporting we use today so they work for a warehouse environment

• Travel to Roanoke at least once per quarter to maintain presence, relationships, and compliance across both sites

We're looking for someone who:

• Has 5+ years of progressive HR experience, with direct experience supporting hourly, warehouse, or manufacturing populations

• Is fully bilingual in English and Spanish, and can give hard feedback in both

• Has run employee relations in practice: investigations, performance documentation, and difficult conversations where the answer wasn't obvious

• Has hands-on command of people operations: payroll, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance

• Has recruited hourly and supervisory roles at volume and can point to the results

• Is proficient in HR tools, including an HRIS, E-Verify, Greenhouse, Indeed, and LinkedIn

• Has handled sensitive, confidential information with discretion and strong judgment

Approach to the role:

• Is people-first: warm, direct, and respected on the floor and by leadership

• Holds a high bar for talent and for process, and doesn't settle for good enough

• Surfaces issues early and arrives with a solution, not just the problem

• Has strong judgment and makes the call when there's no handbook page to point to

• Sweats the details that matter most, like pay accuracy, documentation, and compliance, and keeps improving what they build

• Is equally comfortable having direct conversations with a line associate and partnering with Ops leadership on a complex termination

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $100,000-$130,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.title: High School Special Education Teacher
jobs.description:
Uncommon Special Education teachers are passionate about developing and monitoring accommodations for students with special needs. Special Education teachers advocate for students and believe that specialized instruction and related services increase academic achievement. Special Education teachers offer academic, emotional, and physical support while maintaining high expectations.

Responsibilities

1.     Instruction

• You'll modify, differentiate, and teach an inclusive curriculum that emphasizes diversity.
• You'll collaborate with families and Special Education teams to develop 504 and Individualized Education Plans (IEPs) that offer appropriate accommodations and modifications.
• You'll create an inclusive and safe environment where students feel empowered to become self-guided learners.

2.     Special Education Specific Responsibilities

• You'll collaborate with general education teachers, school leaders, and families to analyze and respond to trends in student work samples and assessments and ensure compliance with Individualized Education Plans.
• You will gather academic growth data and write goals to prepare for annual IEP meetings.
• You will teach pull-out, push-in, small group, and one-on-one instruction and implement strategies to differentiate instruction for all learners in your classroom.

3.     School Culture

• You’ll build positive relationships with students to ensure they feel seen, loved, and heard.
• You’ll partner with students’ families to ensure appropriate resources are available to support their child's learning needs.
• You'll engage in practice-based professional development, mentorship, and coaching sessions.
• You'll participate in weekly, school-wide meetings to cultivate community, model our core values, and encourage student achievement.
• You'll partner with your grade level team to develop academic goals and practice instructional strategies.

• A demonstrated commitment to supporting students’ social emotional and academic development
• An enthusiasm for collaborating with internal and external partners in the best interest of students
• A self-directed learner who solicits and implements feedback to improve outcomes and achieve objectives
• Required Experience:A demonstrated interest in impacting K-12 students in urban schools and communities (1-2 years experience preferred).Academic expertise in Special Education, the Humanities, Social Sciences, STEM, or related fields of study. Prior to the start of employment, you must have a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university. Teacher certification is not a prerequisite for consideration at Uncommon Schools in the state of NJ, but you do need to meet NJ state certification eligibility requirements (a final undergraduate or graduate cumulative GPA of 3.0 for graduates on or after 9/1/16, or 2.75 if you graduated prior to 9/1/16). All instructional staff are required to become certified in the state of New Jersey within a reasonable period after beginning employment.

Our people are what make us Uncommon. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support the personal health, wellness, and finances of our staff and their families. Our compensation philosophy values equity & fairness and attracting & retaining top talent.

Our Approach to AI and Your Application

At Uncommon Schools, we value thoughtful use of technology. Your responses should begin with your own thinking and reflect your authentic voice, experiences, and commitment to our mission. Generative AI can be used to refine or organize writing, but not to generate initial responses or replace your ideas. Every application is reviewed by a member of our Recruitment Team, and we are committed to understanding the person behind the application.

Compensation

Compensation for this role is between $56,000 to $77,000.

Starting pay is determined using various factors including but not limited to relevant full-time teaching experience, education certifications, and tenure with Uncommon Schools. Candidates without full-time Teaching experience will likely have a starting salary of $56,000.

Benefits

• Extensive, best-in-class training and development
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans + pre-tax flexible spending (FSA), dependent care (DCFSA), and health saving accounts (HSA)

• Paid leave of absence options (parental, medical, disability, etc.)

jobs.title: Maintenance Lead - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
Address: 10462 Hickory Hill Road Ashland, VA 23005

Shift: Monday through Friday 2:30 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.

What's the Short Version?

The Facilities Group Lead, Autostore provides support to daily warehouse operations and system processes. The Facilities Group Lead, Autostore is responsible for effectively planning and coordinating workflow for assigned area. They ensure the efficient and safe operation of all material handling equipment, electrical systems and Autostore technology.

What Will You Be Doing?

· Coordinate and execute a daily preventive maintenance program for all material handling equipment, including AutoStore systems.

· Ensure the efficient operation of AutoStore robots and grid systems.

· Collaborate with material handling vendors for technical support and spare parts procurement.

· Perform routine inspections and troubleshoot to ensure the continuous and reliable operation of material handling equipment.

· Delegate tasks and ensure that the team is operating efficiently.

· Ensure that all maintenance activities are performed in compliance with safety regulations and company policies.

· Lead safety training initiatives for the maintenance team and enforce a strong safety culture.

· Maintain a spare parts inventory to ensure quick replacement of critical components, including those specific to material handling.

· Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to secure necessary parts and materials.

· Maintain detailed records of equipment maintenance including lockout/tagout, repairs, and spare parts usage, with a specific focus on material handling.

· Generate reports on equipment performance and maintenance activities for management.

· Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiency enhancements within the maintenance department.

· Implement best practices to optimize the performance of AutoStore systems and other material handling equipment.

· Perform other duties as assigned.

· Comply with all policies and standards.

What Are We Looking For?

· High School Diploma or equivalent.

· 5+ years of experience in conveyor maintenance and repairs or similar equipment.

· 5+ years of experience operating powered lift equipment.

· Bilingual a plus.

· Detail-oriented, ability to follow through on projects, prioritize, and handle multiple tasks at once.

· Knowledge of Internal Operating System(s) and Microsoft Office.

· Demonstrated ability to lead a team by setting a good example (i.e., exemplary performance, strong initiative, and strong attention to detail).

· Ability to read, write and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information.

· Comprehend verbal and written instructions.

· Able to work both independently and within a team.

· Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills.

· Strong attention to detail.

· Ability to work in high-demand, high-volume environment and meet deadlines.

· Ability to handle confidential and business matters in a professional manner and defuse employee related situations appropriately.

· May be required to complete and maintain SanMar’s Lift Operator Certification.

· Essential days or overtime may be required.

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment such as a protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced. The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.title: Executive Operations and Office Manager
jobs.description:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 3.6 million patients!

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.


THE ROLE

Our executives spend their days building the product and closing deals with the biggest names in healthcare and life sciences. You'll keep everything around them running smoothly, while also ensuring our offices are productive, collaborative places to work that celebrate our team.

65% of your time goes to supporting our CEO, CTO and Chief Commercial Officer: their calendars, travel, meetings and relationships, plus the culture work that keeps our team connected. The other 35% goes to employee engagement and running our core office in San Francisco and satellite office in Menlo Park. You'll report to our Senior Manager, Strategy & Finance.

You’ll be the first full-time partner to our leaders, able to unlock a new level of focus and support. You’ll help us optimize our Menlo office, including transitioning it to a smaller satellite space in mid-2027, while helping us open and optimize our new, San Francisco office in January 2027.

The role is a match for someone who solves problems creatively, keeps finding better ways to do things, and has a gift for hospitality. As the company scales, special projects and increased responsibilities are likely. This is a great entry point into the company, and will give you visibility into the full business.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Support our C-Suite

 - Own their calendars. Expect lots of external meetings, tricky scheduling and plans that change daily.

 - Work with our Sr. Manager of Strategy and Finance to build agendas for team and leadership meetings, help run them, and capture notes and action items.

 - Plan on-site and off-site meetings, dinners and team events.

 - Book complex travel for our executives, arrange travel and accommodation for visitors coming to Develop Health, and prepare expense reports.

 - Be the face and voice of Develop Health as you reach out on behalf of our team, and help us build great relationships with senior leaders at our partners and customers.

Build our culture

 - Company-Wide: Nurture our fast-paced, collaborative, and active culture with team gatherings, lunches, and celebrations.

 - For Individuals: Partner with our People and Talent team to bring the magic to onboarding, work anniversaries, birthdays, and special milestones.

Run our offices

 - Set up both offices to be productive, collaborative workspaces that folks are excited to come into each week: choose and manage vendors, organize the spaces, and create our office manual, routines and protocols.

 - Keep the SF office clean, organized and ready for the team. That means non-janitorial tidying of common areas, meeting rooms, the kitchen and storage.

 - Keep us stocked with everything from stationery to snacks, drinks and coffee.

 - Coordinate team lunches, and set up for special events and All Hands.

 - Troubleshoot Zoom and Google Meet room devices, room booking tablets, and AirPlay or cable connections for all hands meetings.

 - Handle mail, packages and shipping for the team.

 - Be the main contact for office vendors, including catering, building management and maintenance.


ABOUT YOU

 - You’re excited to work onsite in San Francisco, Tuesday through Thursday each week, with a day in Menlo Park every other week to ensure that office is flowing. Time in Menlo may decrease as we transition this to a satellite office.

 - You have 3+ years supporting a senior executive at a fast-paced company

 - You've worked in office management, workplace experience or operations.

 - You can juggle many requests that each feel urgent to the person asking. You prioritize, keep people updated, and get it all done without losing your cool.

 - You move fast and make decisions on the spot without missing details. When things are ambiguous or changing, you stay calm and keep your sense of humor.

 - You set a high bar. Nothing gets dropped, and our executives trust your work completely.

 - You're AI-native. You use Claude to work faster, and you bring the judgment, taste and human touch that make every message feel thoughtful and polished.

 - You're a straight shooter. If you disagree, you say so up front. If the answer is still no, you commit and make it happen.

 - You spot needs before anyone asks and find solutions on your own.

 - You're warm and welcoming, communicate clearly, and work well with all kinds of personalities.

 - You're strong in Gmail, Google Calendar, Sheets, Slides, Excel and PowerPoint, and you can set up basic office A/V with confidence.

 - You're reliable and punctual. You're online and responsive during business hours, closing loops to keep the team’s work flowing.


BONUS POINTS

 - You already have a system for supporting a busy executive team and running an office.

 - You have experience in business operations, recruiting or HR and can help support the other biz ops staff

jobs.title: AI Enablement Analyst
jobs.description:
Why Choose Bottomline?

Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without restriction. Visa sponsorship or transfers are not available for this position.

Role Summary

The AI Enablement Analyst will support Revenue Operations by helping bring AI-powered tools, agents, analytics, and automation into the day-to-day workflows of Paymode's Sales organization.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of Sales, Revenue Operations, data, and AI. You will help identify high-impact AI use cases, prepare and structure trusted data, deploy and test AI-enabled solutions, and drive adoption across revenue-generating teams.

You will serve as a bridge between Sales stakeholders, Revenue Operations, data teams, and AI technologies, translating business needs into practical, scalable solutions. Your work will help ensure the data powering AI models and automations is accurate, governed, and reliable while enabling faster insights, reducing manual work, and improving how our teams operate.

This is an opportunity to directly influence how people, data, AI, and technology come together to support revenue growth.

How you'll make an impact:

• Identify and implement AI and automation use cases that improve Sales and Revenue Operations workflows, reporting, and efficiency.

• Support the end-to-end deployment of AI agents for Sales teams, including use-case definition, requirements gathering, testing, deployment, and adoption.

• Prepare, structure, and maintain data used by AI applications, including reusable datasets and semantic models.

• Monitor and improve data quality, consistency, and governance to support trusted AI-driven insights.

• Enable AI-powered and self-service analytics that help business users access insights and make decisions more quickly.

• Partner with Sales, Revenue Operations, and technical teams to translate business challenges into scalable data and AI solutions.

• Evaluate and prioritize AI opportunities based on business need, feasibility, and potential impact.

• Evaluate and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on business need, feasibility, and potential impact, with a focus on reducing manual processes and scaling Revenue Operations capabilities.

• Ensure AI initiatives align with enterprise governance, risk, security, and compliance standards.

• Validate AI-generated outputs and help establish processes for monitoring accuracy, reliability, and business value.

What will make you successful:

• 0–3 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, Revenue Operations, business analysis, or a related field.

• Strong SQL skills and foundational knowledge of data modeling.

• Hands-on experience working with structured datasets and building or supporting scalable data solutions.

• Experience with business intelligence and data platforms such as Power BI, Snowflake, or similar technologies.

• Exposure to AI tools and technologies, including generative AI, natural-language querying, AI-assisted analytics, or AI-powered workflow automation.

• Understanding of how AI solutions move from business use case through testing, deployment, and adoption.

• Familiarity with data quality, AI governance, risk, security, and compliance considerations within a business environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

• Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience supporting Sales, Revenue Operations, or other revenue-generating teams.

• Experience enabling self-service analytics or working with semantic models.

• Familiarity with enterprise data architecture and data governance frameworks.

• Experience piloting, testing, or scaling AI and automation use cases within business operations.

• Experience working in a business analyst or data analyst capacity within SaaS, FinTech, or Payments.

• Exposure to sales technology, CRM, or Revenue Operations platforms.

Core Competencies:

• Data-driven: Strong focus on data quality, accuracy, and scalability.

• Business-minded: Able to connect AI and data capabilities to meaningful business outcomes.

• Curious and innovative: Eager to explore new ways AI can improve how Sales teams work.

• Collaborative: Comfortable partnering across Sales, Revenue Operations, data, and technology teams.

• Execution-oriented: Able to move from idea and experimentation into practical, usable solutions.

• Adaptable: Comfortable working in a quickly evolving AI and technology landscape.

What Success Looks Like
Success in this role will be reflected through:

• Increased adoption of AI-enabled workflows across Paymode Sales teams.

• Reduced manual reporting, analysis, and operational work.

• Faster access to reliable insights for Sales and Revenue Operations.

• Improved quality and reliability of the data supporting AI-driven tools and automations.

• Measurable improvements in Revenue Operations efficiency and scalability.

• AI use cases that move beyond experimentation and deliver practical business value.

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
Momentic is building the definitive verification layer for software: an AI-native testing platform that helps engineering teams catch bugs before they ship. As AI accelerates software development, teams need a reliable way to verify that their products work. Engineering teams at Notion, Webflow, Xero and Whatnot use Momentic to ship with confidence.

We’re hiring a Customer Success Engineer to own strategic relationships, customer success, and renewal readiness for our enterprise and selected medium-touch customers. We’re looking for someone who combines technical depth with strong strategic account judgment: you can earn an engineer’s trust, lead a conversation with an executive sponsor, and turn an ambiguous customer problem into a plan that gets delivered.

You’ll report to the CEO and work closely with customer engineering organizations, our Solutions Engineers, Sales, and Engineering to help customers realize measurable value from Momentic. From post-implementation adoption through renewal, you’ll own the account plan, build relationships across the organization, and keep the right people aligned on what success looks like. You’ll keep a clear, current view of each account’s adoption, delivered value, and risks so customers and teammates can make informed decisions.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own our most strategic customer relationships. Build trust with executive sponsors, engineering leaders, technical champions, and day-to-day users. Understand their priorities and decision-making process, and keep stakeholders aligned.

 - Turn adoption into measurable value. Create success plans with clear goals, milestones, and owners. Lead quarterly business reviews and annual planning sessions that connect testing coverage, suite health, and adoption to customer objectives.

 - Lead technical adoption and customer projects. Translate customer needs into requirements and execution plans. Get hands-on to identify blockers and guide customers, coordinate with Solutions Engineering and Engineering to resolve issues, and bring actionable customer feedback into the product.

 - Own renewal readiness and customer risk. Identify changes in usage, engagement, sponsorship, or delivered value early. Lead plans to address risk, demonstrate customer value, and partner with Sales on the commercial renewal process.

 - Build the tools to run strategic accounts. Connect customer, contract, and product usage data into practical dashboards and workflows. Use AI to automate reporting, surface risks, and identify where to act, so you can spend more time driving customer outcomes. Build scalable workflows for smaller, low-touch accounts rather than relying on manual account management.

 


YOU’RE PERFECT FOR THIS ROLE IF…

 - You’ve owned complex strategic accounts for a technical product, built trusted relationships from practitioners to executive sponsors, and delivered customer outcomes through difficult conversations.

 - You have an engineering background or, at minimum, a computer science degree, with demonstrated hands-on coding and debugging ability. You can work credibly with engineers and engineering leaders, learn an unfamiliar product, and reason through testing, CI/CD, and adoption challenges. Experience working with developer-tools customers is strongly preferred.

 - You’re strategic and numbers-oriented. You can turn usage and technical results into a business case and account plan, and use that evidence to identify and manage renewal risk.

 - You’re organized, proactive, and comfortable with ambiguity. You can turn an unclear customer problem into a concrete outcome and lead cross-functional work without formal authority.

 - You’ve built CS tooling, dashboards, templates, or operating processes at an early-stage company. You use AI to build tools and automate workflows that improve account analysis, reporting, and customer management, and apply sound judgment to the outputs.

 - You’re based in San Francisco or willing to relocate, and can work from our office five days a week.

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with automated testing, observability, or infrastructure.

 - Experience in forward deployed engineering, developer success engineering, or field engineering.

 - Consulting experience leading technical projects and managing senior client stakeholders.

 


ABOUT US

 - Raised $18.7M, including a $15M Series A, with backing from Standard Capital, Y Combinator, FCVC, Transpose Platform, and Dropbox Ventures.

 - A team of 17 and growing.

 - Based in San Francisco at 650 5th Street.

 


BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k).

 - Unlimited PTO and sick days, plus company-observed US holidays.

 - Daily lunch and a fully stocked kitchen.

 - Commuter benefits.

 - Team offsites and events.
