jobs.title: Digital Optimization Lead
jobs.description:
As a Digital Optimization Lead, you will drive measurable commercial growth by evaluating and improving the end-to-end customer journey across H&M US digital channels. Acting as a key partner between US Commercial teams and Global Product, UX, Analytics, and Development teams, you will identify opportunities to enhance the customer experience from discovery and consideration through purchase and retention, ensuring customer needs, business priorities, and digital investments are supported by data-driven insights and measurable outcomes.

As a key stakeholder for digital development, you will represent the voice of the US customer, guide prioritization through customer insights, performance data, and strategic relevance. Success in this role requires the ability to build alignment, influence decision-making, and drive action across global and local stakeholders to ensure US customer and business needs are effectively represented within development roadmaps.

This on-site role reports into our Digital Experience Manager and is based out of our Support Office in New York, New York.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

• Lead the evaluation and optimization of the end-to-end customer journey across H&M US digital channels, leveraging customer insights, behavioral data, and performance metrics to identify opportunities, uncover root causes, and drive measurable improvements in engagement, conversion, retention, and commercial performance.

• Develop business cases, success metrics, and ROI frameworks that assess the value and impact of digital experience enhancements, guiding prioritization through customer insights, performance data, business impact, and strategic relevance.

• Act as a key stakeholder for digital development, representing US customer and business needs within global product discussions, roadmap planning, and prioritization processes while influencing development roadmaps and the evolution of digital experiences across the US market.

• Collaborate with Product, UX, Analytics, Development, Marketing, and Commercial teams to define requirements, influence solution design, and deliver customer-centric experiences that support business objectives and customer needs.

• Create competitive benchmarks and monitor industry trends to identify emerging opportunities, anticipate evolving customer expectations, and balance short-term optimization initiatives with long-term development priorities.

Who You Are:

• Bachelor's degree and 5-8 years of experience in ecommerce, digital optimization, digital product management, customer experience, or a related field.

• Proven experience leading digital product development initiatives from concept through launch, including business case development, prioritization, requirements definition, implementation, and performance measurement.

• Strong analytical mindset with experience leveraging customer insights, digital analytics, experimentation, and A/B testing to identify opportunities, uncover root causes, and drive measurable business impact across the customer journey.

• Demonstrated success influencing cross-functional and global stakeholders to drive change, secure prioritization, and deliver customer-centric improvements within a regional and global matrix organization. Skilled at building alignment across Commercial, Product, UX, Analytics, and Development teams without direct authority.

Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability

• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years

• You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues

• We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work

• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits

• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match 401k, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community

• You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: salary is $165,760 annually**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: Software and AI Engineer
jobs.location: Livingston, NJ / New York, NY / Sunnyvale, CA / San Francisco, CA / Bellevue, WA
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

What You’ll Do

The Strategy and Transformation team builds intelligent systems and first-party applications that improve how CoreWeave’s internal teams work. The team partners with Finance, Supply Chain, HR, and core business operations to connect workflows across enterprise platforms, including ERP, HRIS, MRP, PDM, and DCIM.

About the Role

As a Software and AI Engineer, IT Systems, you’ll design and build AI agents, copilots, and first-party applications that make CoreWeave’s internal workflows more intelligent, automated, and intuitive. You’ll work across applied AI, product design, and full-stack engineering—from agentic workflows built with integration platforms and AI frameworks to React interfaces and backend services in Node.js and Go.

In this role, you will:

• Develop AI agents and copilots for Finance, Billing, Supply Chain, and other internal teams, using frameworks and APIs such as LangChain, LangGraph, Cohere, OpenAI, Gemini, and Glean.

• Design and build first-party web and mobile applications using React, TypeScript, and modern front-end frameworks.

• Develop scalable backend services in Node.js and Go for data processing, orchestration, and automation.

• Integrate enterprise systems—including ERP, HRIS, MRP, PDM, DCIM, and data warehouses—through native integrations or iPaaS platforms such as Workato or Boomi.

• Build APIs and microservices that support modular, event-driven application architectures.

• Use GenAI development tools such as Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and ChatGPT Codex to accelerate implementation, testing, and documentation.

• Build observability, maintainability, and security into applications across the stack.

• Partner with stakeholders in Finance, Accounting, Security, Engineering, and other business teams to design useful, user-centered workflows.

Who You Are

• You have 3+ years of programming experience in C++, Go, C#, Java, TypeScript, or Python, building production-grade cloud services.

• You have 3+ years of scripting experience in Python or Bash for automation and tooling.

• You have solid experience designing RESTful APIs and event-driven integration architectures.

• You have experience building and deploying production-grade applications and microservices.

• You have experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container orchestration, and DevOps and CI/CD practices.

• You have experience with modern backend and frontend technologies; familiarity with React, TypeScript, Node.js, Go, FastAPI, Next.js, Kestrel, or gRPC is relevant to this role.

• You’re familiar with generative AI frameworks and APIs, such as LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, or Glean, and how they can be applied in products.

• You’re motivated by building user-facing tools that improve business productivity and employee experience.

Preferred Skills

• Experience shipping production-grade AI, ML, or LLM-based applications at scale.

• Experience developing AI-powered or agentic applications integrated with enterprise data.

• Familiarity with machine learning and data engineering platforms such as Ray, Kafka, or Spark.

• Experience with iPaaS platforms such as Workato or Boomi.

• Exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, or other operational domains where intelligent automation can drive efficiency.

• Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT Codex.

• A collaborative approach and an eye for user experience and long-term system maintainability.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds—even if you don’t check every box. Here are a few qualities we’ve found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

• You’re curious about how AI and software can make everyday work simpler and more effective.

• You enjoy turning complex business needs into clear, approachable experiences.

• You communicate well with both technical and non-technical partners and like building solutions together.

• You balance moving quickly with building systems that are secure, maintainable, and dependable.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The base salary range for this role is $153,000 to $204,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

• 401(k) with a generous employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Primary Care Physician (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
About Us

Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

About the Role

Galileo is looking for a culturally sensitive Family Medicine Physician to join our primary care medical group. As a part of our collaborative clinical care team, you will leverage data, technology, and operational rigor to optimize great patient outcomes while offering highly personalized care and shared decision making with patients.

This is an in office role, supporting our clinic in Starbase, TX. Our clinic is open Monday through Friday from 8am-4pm CST, with future plans to be open until 8pm CST. We're open to Physicians who are open to practicing part-time and full-time.

Here’s what you’ll do:

• Act as a key PCP for our patient population, delivering care in the clinic and digitally

• Provide primary care across the full scope of preventive health, chronic disease management, urgent care, and pediatrics.

• Collaborate and partner across care team members including behavioral health, virtual urgent care and triage, and clinical subspecialists

• Educate patients on their health conditions and develop individualized care and treatment plans

• Solve patient problems in an efficient, nimble manner by drawing on resourcefulness, collaborating with team members to leverage their expertise, and a “can-do” approach

About You

You are a Family Medicine Physician with extensive clinical experience. You are comfortable with complex clinical and social needs and eager to care for patients in a modern, technology-enabled practice. You are driven to create systems that enable personalized, empathetic care for individuals and families in the community, and you are eager to find a practice that supports approaching patient care in ways that make a meaningful, real impact on their lives.

We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:

• 3+ years of clinical experience in chronic care and primary care for all ages

• Comfort with basic procedural skills

• Active board certification in Family Medicine with comfort seeing Pediatric patients

• Active licensure in Texas or ability to obtain license by start date with Galileo

• Strong communication skills, especially the ability to translate complex ideas into simple language

• Bi-lingual in English and Spanish is a plus

Physical Requirements: The employee must be able to meet the following requirements with or without reasonable accommodation(s):

• This position requires the ability to stand, sit, and walk for extended periods of time

• Ability to lift and carry objects weighing up to 20 pounds

• The job involves frequent bending, reaching, and kneeling to perform various tasks

Compensation: This is a salaried position. We're flexible part-time and full-time employment ranging from 0.5 to 1.0 FTE. Compensation offered will be prorated based weekly hours worked based off of an annualized salary of $350,000.

Benefits Offered:

• Medical / Dental / Vision insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account + match

• Company paid STD/LTD, AD&D, and Life insurance

• Paid Family Leave

• 401K + match

• Paid Time Off

How We Hire

Galileo Health is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

We have recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. We will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments or access to any financial accounts; and/or conduct text-only interviews. If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

jobs.title: Compliance Senior Associate
jobs.description:
About Us:

Piermont Bank is a boutique specialty commercial bank focused on serving modern businesses with a digital first approach. As the first cloud native bank launched in the United States, Piermont was built on modern infrastructure that allows us to operate with greater flexibility, efficiency, and scalability than traditional banks.

We combine disciplined commercial banking with innovative technology to deliver value added solutions for small and medium sized businesses and our fintech partners. Our team is dedicated to thoughtful risk management, strong client relationships, and building a bank designed for the future of financial services.

The Role:

The Compliance Senior Associate reports directly to the Compliance Officer and supports the execution and maintenance of the Bank's Compliance Management System (CMS). This role assists with compliance monitoring, regulatory risk assessments, policy maintenance, issue remediation tracking, complaint management, and oversight activities across the Bank's products, services, and fintech partnerships. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and interested in building a career in regulatory compliance within a dynamic banking environment.

Responsibilities:

• Assist with execution of the annual Compliance Monitoring and Risk Assessment Plan.

• Perform compliance monitoring reviews and testing across deposit, lending, and operational business functions.

• Support compliance oversight activities related to Banking-as-a-Service (BaaS) and fintech partner programs.

• Review policies, procedures, disclosures, and operational processes to identify potential compliance risks.

• Assist with remediation tracking, issue validation testing, and follow-up activities related to audits and examinations.

• Support the intake, tracking, and resolution of consumer complaints and regulatory inquiries.

• Maintain compliance documentation, testing workpapers, and management reporting.

• Research regulatory requirements and assist in providing compliance guidance to business partners.

• Support compliance training initiatives and awareness programs across the Bank.

• Escalate identified compliance concerns, control gaps, and regulatory risks to the Compliance Officer.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Risk Management, Legal Studies, or a related field.

• 3-5 years of compliance, audit, risk management, banking operations, or related financial services experience.

• Banking, fintech, or financial services experience preferred.

• Experience with compliance monitoring, testing, quality assurance reviews, or regulatory compliance activities preferred.

• Working knowledge of banking regulations and consumer protection requirements such as Regulation E, Regulation DD, UDAAP, and related regulatory guidance is preferred.

• Familiarity with Compliance Management Systems (CMS) and regulatory examination processes is a plus.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

• Demonstrated professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment.

The hiring range for this position is $110,000 to $140,000 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, among other factors. A bonus and/or incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, dental, vision, 401k, and other benefits.

jobs.title: Assistant Restaurant Manager
jobs.description:
Bring Exceptional Dining and Hospitality to Life at Splendido

At Splendido, great dining is about more than what’s on the menu, it’s about the service, teamwork, and personal touches that make every experience memorable. As our Assistant Restaurant Manager, you’ll work closely with the Restaurant Manager to oversee daily operations, support and develop team members, and ensure residents and guests enjoy a welcoming and enjoyable dining experience.

From managing reservations and coordinating service flow to responding to resident feedback and supporting special events, you’ll play an important role in keeping restaurant operations running smoothly.

This is a full-time, hourly position where you’ll have the opportunity to lead by example, support a strong team, and help deliver the high standards of dining and hospitality that make Splendido special.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

• Collaborates with Restaurant Manager in the timely selection, orientation, scheduling and on-going training and performance management of restaurant team members.

• Manages reservation system, assigns server sections at all meal periods that require reservations.

• Ensures the even flow of guests into the restaurant, to provide a positive resident and guest experience and a quality food product.

• Supervises the flow of service to ensure that residents, guests, family members, and staff receive quality dining service.

• Inspects workstations for completion of assigned side work.

• Responds to resident feedback addressing concerns in a timely, professional manner.

• Maintains timely and professional communication with the Restaurant Manager, Director of Food & Beverage and the Executive Chef and shares all food comments and suggestions with the Executive Chef.

• Works with restaurant management to help ensure budgetary compliance.

• Responsible, along with the other members of the restaurant supervisory team, to manage and maintain the equipment necessary to successfully operate the restaurants at or above Mather service standards.

• Coordinates and executes theme meals and/or functions and related billing processes and provides accurate and timely information to the Restaurant Manager so that billing for events/functions can occur and resident satisfaction is ensured.

• Identifies areas for improvement, proposes possible solutions, and participates in data collection and process changes as part of the Quality Assurance Process Improvement process.

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

Required:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Progressive experience in an upscale restaurant and/or Life Plan community.

• Able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment and make independent decisions.

• Proficient in Windows applications including Excel, Word and Outlook.

• Knowledgeable in Point-of-Sale systems.

• Knowledgeable in job related federal, state, and local regulations to ensure safe and clean dining environment.

• Certification in food safety/sanitation and BASSET.

• English language proficiency.

Preferred:

• College degree in culinary or hospitality management.

• Knowledgeable in Online ordering, Online Reservations.

Benefits

Mather offers a competitive benefits package.*

Team members are eligible for:

• A generous paid time off (PTO) program including vacation days/personal days, sick days, and holidays. This is an “earn-as-you-go” plan that rolls over year to year, offering long- and short-term flexibility.

• A 401(k) program with per pay-period employer match and annual employer contribution (available to those age 21 or better)

• Convenient, subsidized parking (or public transportation for certain locations)

• Wellness Spending Account: up to $300 available annually for Wellness related expenses such as gym memberships, financial planning, etc.

Benefits-eligible team members can take advantage of:

• Medical, dental, and vision plans

• Paid Parental Leave

• Adoption Assistance Reimbursement

• Tuition reimbursement for continuing education

• Extended illness benefits

• Employee wellness programs

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

• Life insurance is available to benefit eligible team members.

*Benefits are subject to change without notice. Benefits details dependent on employment status.

Splendido is a Life Plan Community for those age 55 and better. Thanks to our creative and dedicated team members, we offer residents new possibilities each day—along with resort amenities, numerous options for healthy lifestyles, and a breathtaking location in Oro Valley, Arizona. Splendido includes 293 Terrace and Villa Homes, as well as assisted living, memory care, long-term care, and rehabilitation services, along with multiple restaurants, a fitness center, an art studio, a putting green, and more.

Splendido is located at 13500 Rancho Vistoso Boulevard in Tucson.

Mather is one of two parent organizations of Splendido. Based in Evanston, Illinois, Mather is a unique, non-denominational, not-for-profit organization founded in 1941. Dedicated to developing and implementing Ways to Age WellSM, we create programs, places, and residences for today’s young-at-heart older adults. Mather has received a national certification as a Great Place to Work®, and has been selected as a Nation’s Best and Brightest in Wellness Award recipient four years in a row.

Mather is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer committed to an inclusive workforce. Candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Associate Director, NGS Product Management
jobs.description:
Position: Associate Director, NGS Product Management

Department: Marketing

Position Type: Full-time

Location: Boulder, CO (preferred) or remote

Experience: MS degree in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, or a related scientific discipline required; PhD or MBA preferred. 10+ years of relevant industry experience in life sciences, biotechnology, or genomics. 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of product strategy, roadmaps, and commercial performance. 3+ years of people management experience, with demonstrated success leading, coaching, and developing Product Managers or cross-functional teams.

Position Summary

Watchmaker Genomics is seeking a strategic and commercially minded Associate Director of NGS Product Management to lead product strategy and portfolio development across our next-generation sequencing (NGS) business. This role will oversee a diverse portfolio of NGS sample preparation technologies, including DNA and RNA library preparation, amplification, methylation, and related workflow solutions, reporting to the Director of Product Management.

The Associate Director will lead and develop a team of Product Managers, driving portfolio strategy, product innovation, commercialization, and lifecycle management. Working closely with R&D, Applications, Commercial, and Marketing, this individual will translate market opportunities and customer needs into differentiated products and sustainable commercial growth.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in NGS workflows with strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and demonstrated success leading products and teams in a dynamic life sciences environment.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Business Leadership

• Lead NGS portfolio planning, business case development, and product prioritization, balancing market opportunities, technical feasibility, and commercial potential.

• Drive portfolio performance through pricing, forecasting, and growth strategies that support revenue, profitability, market penetration, and product differentiation.

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of NGS Product Managers, establishing clear goals, priorities, accountability, and performance expectations.

• Provide strategic direction and hands-on guidance to Product Managers, supporting effective decision-making, cross-functional collaboration, and execution across product lines.

Product Innovation & Development

• Lead market assessment, competitive intelligence, and customer discovery to identify unmet needs, validate product opportunities, and define differentiated product requirements.

• Partner with R&D and Applications to guide new product development, evaluate technical and commercial tradeoffs, and ensure alignment with customer requirements, portfolio priorities, and development milestones.

Commercialization & Lifecycle Management

• Lead product commercialization and lifecycle strategies, partnering with Product Marketing, Sales, and Applications to ensure successful launches, market adoption, and sustained growth.

• Support strategic accounts and key partnerships, translating customer requirements and market opportunities into product strategies and development priorities.

• Monitor product performance, competitive developments, and customer feedback to guide product improvements, portfolio expansion, and end-of-life decisions.

jobs.title: Scientist
jobs.description:
Eurofins is seeking a Scientist to join our Analytical Testing team in a GMP-regulated laboratory environment. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career scientist to apply their analytical laboratory experience while developing expertise in analytical instrumentation, troubleshooting, and data analysis.

The Scientist will support analytical testing for biologics, cell and gene therapies, vaccines, and other pharmaceutical products. The successful candidate will perform laboratory testing, operate and troubleshoot analytical instrumentation, evaluate scientific data, and maintain accurate documentation in accordance with established quality systems and regulatory requirements.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Perform routine analytical testing using HPLC, Karl Fischer (KF), osmolality, and other analytical techniques.
• Prepare samples, standards, reagents, and controls according to approved methods and procedures.
• Operate, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain analytical instrumentation.
• Review and evaluate analytical data for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with specifications.
• Utilize chromatography data systems and laboratory software to collect, process, and report results.
• Maintain accurate, complete, and GMP-compliant laboratory records and electronic documentation.
• Support investigations involving instrument performance, out-of-specification results, deviations, and atypical findings.
• Support analytical method qualification, validation, verification, and transfer activities.
• Assist with method troubleshooting and laboratory process improvements.
• Perform work in accordance with GMP, GDP, GLP, ALCOA+, and established quality systems.
• Support audits, inspections, and quality initiatives as needed.
• Collaborate with project managers, quality assurance, laboratory management, and scientific teams to support client programs and project timelines.
• Communicate testing status, observations, and analytical findings clearly and effectively.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, or a related scientific field.
• 2 years of hands-on experience with HPLC operation and troubleshooting.
• Experience operating analytical laboratory instrumentation.
• Ability to review and interpret analytical data.
• Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment.
• Experience with Empower or similar chromatography data systems.
• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
• Experience working independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
• Experience interacting with customers, cross-functional teams, and management

Position is full-time, Monday through Friday, 8 am-5 pm, with overtime as needed. Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of San Diego, CA are encouraged to apply.

Pay range is $29.50-33.75 per hour, depending on related experience and background.

• Paid vacation and holidays

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on our Mission

Zocdoc’s most important asset is our people. As a Director of Enterprise Sales you’ll own the strategy and execution to drive revenue and other commercial objectives with large healthcare organizations as they partner with Zocdoc. You will lead a team of individuals from diverse backgrounds, including managers and senior level salespeople. You will create best practices, optimize existing processes, and introduce new innovative workflows to advance the team and make a bigger impact on Zocdoc. Additionally, you will create visibility for leadership about how this team fits into key company goals, performance against company goals both strategically and tactically, and forecast commercial outcomes.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are…

• Personally motivated by coaching and developing senior level sales people with clear metrics and targets

• You genuinely love driving strategy to match the changing needs of the business

• Passionate about leveraging data to create actionable insights that will solve complex problems

• The kind of person who builds a culture of high performance and impact by establishing trust with their teams

Your day to day is…

• Building strategy to drive commercial results at large healthcare providers

jobs.title: Principal Product Management, Enterprise Governance
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

We're seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our Governance team. You'll drive product direction across human, robot, and agent identity, delegated and scoped authorization, guardrails, and audit and attribution for non-human actors, and you'll work the patterns the industry is still standardizing right now: on-behalf-of delegation chains, OAuth flows for autonomous callers, just-in-time elevation, sandboxing, and policy-as-code for tool access.

This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You will be deep in the product: testing, prototyping with coding agents, talking to customers, and turning what you learn into a coherent roadmap to build.

Your north star is an agentic enterprise’ trust translating into adoption: governance with required coverage, and monitoring, for enterprises; and frictionless for builders to code it in.


WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Own the 12–18 months roadmap for identity, auth, and access governance across UiPath's agentic platform, in coherence with company priorities and evolving standards in the ecoystem.

 - Evolve how identity works for agents, robots, and humans at UiPath (provisioning, scoping, delegation, attestation), ship the patterns, and drive their adoption across the product teams that build on them.

 - Drive the auth model for LLM tool-calling (for internal and external agents),  enterprise-managed authorization, scoped consent, least-privilege execution, step-up and just-in-time elevation, and OOTB monitoring views, audit trails that hold up in front of a compliance team.

 - Enhance the guardrail layer around agent action: policy-as-code for tool access, sandboxing boundaries, approval and elevation flows, and the attribution model that answers "which agent, on whose behalf, under which policy" after the fact.

 - Define how UiPath agents present themselves to the outside world and how outside agents present themselves to UiPath: agent identities registered in enterprise directories, on-behalf-of delegation chains that survive multiple hops, and agent-to-agent trust.

 - Partner with our largest and most regulated customers (financial services, healthcare, public sector) on production deployments. Go deep enough to know which specific control failed and ship the fix.

 - Use the platform as a builder. Stand up agents, wire up auth flows, use coding agents aggressively to prototype and ship reference implementations.

 - Instrument and own the metrics that matter (e.g. time-to-grant, audit coverage, policy violations caught, developer friction) and prioritize against them.

 - Present UiPath's governance capabilities and roadmap to customers, partners, and consider authoring any external content that earns CISO trust.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 7+ years in technical PM or engineering roles, with sustained time in the governance space: identity, access, and guardrails for enterprise software. You have shipped infrastructure that enterprises trusted with production traffic.

 - A visible record of innovating in agentic governance specifically: owned capabilities, reference implementations, spec or working-group contributions.

 - Fluency in enterprise identity and access: how users, services, and now agents authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how actions get audited.

 - Working knowledge of the agent auth stack as it stands today: MCP authorization, on-behalf-of delegation, and how IdPs like Okta and Entra now model agents as identities.

 - Working understanding of agentic AI (tool-calling, MCP, RAG, agent design patterns) and a view on how identity, access, and guardrails should evolve to support autonomous actors.

 - First-principles thinker, comfortable in ambiguity. Can produce a defensible direction and can tell the difference between a problem the standards will solve for us.

 - Clear communicator, in writing and in person: you can write a short position doc that frames a decision, explain a concept well to a CISO or auditor, and walk a customer through a working demo without overselling it.


IDEAL BACKGROUND

 - Several years in identity, access, or security-platform product work in enterprise vendors - hyperscaler identity team, IAM vendors, workload-identity or secrets vendor, or as an early PM at a startup in the space, with focus on agents.

 - Has been working on the enterprise agentic governance problem for a while: a product or feature in market, a spec or working-group contribution.

 - Has opinions about where agent identity, access, and guardrails are going in the next 24 months, with receipts.

 - Has shipped into regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector) and has sat through a customer security or compliance review to shape product roadmap.

 - Works closely with engineering and field teams and is trusted by both to make technical trade-offs without a committee.

 - Prototypes before writing: has used code or coding agents to test an idea and brought the working version to the discussion.

#LI-MH1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. jobs.title: Catering and QSR Associate/Specialist (Seasonal)
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Catering & QSR Associate supports daily catering operations and Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) service to ensure an exceptional guest experience and smooth execution across both departments. This role assists with preparing, organizing, and fulfilling catering orders, including high-volume orders during the holiday season, while providing hands-on support to QSR counters as business needs change.

The Catering & QSR Associate works closely with the Catering team, QSR leadership, and other store departments to coordinate orders, prepare food and beverages, maintain product quality, and deliver friendly, efficient service. Responsibilities may shift between catering and QSR depending on business volume, staffing needs, and seasonal demand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Catering Support

• Assist with the preparation, organization, packaging, and fulfillment of daily catering orders, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
• Support high-volume catering orders and seasonal business demands, including holiday catering operations.
• Coordinate catering order details with internal departments to ensure products are prepared and available according to customer requirements.
• Communicate with the Catering team, store departments, and other relevant partners regarding order status, special requests, and fulfillment needs.
• Assist with customer inquiries, order follow-ups, and providing information about catering offerings.
• Help prepare catering materials, labels, and order documentation to ensure accurate fulfillment.
• Support the preparation and organization of catering pickups and deliveries as assigned.
• Maintain organized catering work areas and ensure orders are properly stored, labeled, and ready for fulfillment.
• Provide friendly, professional service to catering customers and help resolve routine order questions or concerns by partnering with the appropriate team members.

Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) Support

• Provide service across Eataly’s various QSR counters, including coffee, gelato, pastries, paninis, and other Italian food and beverage offerings.
• Prepare and serve food and beverages according to established recipes, quality standards, and service procedures.
• Operate espresso machines, drink blenders, juicers, cash registers, and other equipment as needed.
• Complete food preparation assignments neatly, accurately, and in a timely manner.
• Set up service stations, replenish product displays, and maintain appropriate product presentation, including proper separation of allergens.
• Weigh, label, package, and serve products according to department standards.
• Process guest transactions accurately and follow established cash-handling procedures.
• Maintain product freshness and proper rotation by following First In, First Out (FIFO) practices and ensuring items are appropriately dated.
• Assist with receiving, organizing, and replenishing products and supplies as needed.
• Maintain clean, organized, and well-stocked workstations throughout the shift.
• Provide exceptional guest service by answering questions, communicating product information, and supporting an efficient service experience.

Cross-Department Operations & Standards

• Transition between catering and QSR responsibilities based on business volume, seasonal demand, and direction from department leadership.
• Collaborate with the Catering and QSR teams to support daily operational priorities and ensure continuity of service.
• Follow Eataly’s food quality, food safety, health, sanitation, and workplace safety standards.
• Maintain accurate order information and communicate any discrepancies, delays, or operational concerns to the appropriate team members.
• Follow established procedures for food handling, storage, labeling, cleaning, and equipment use.
• Maintain a professional, guest-focused approach when interacting with customers, coworkers, and other departments.
• Perform other duties as required or assigned.

• Previous experience in food service, hospitality, catering, retail, or customer service preferred.
• Experience preparing or fulfilling catering orders is a plus.
• Experience operating a cash register or preparing coffee and other beverages is preferred.
• Strong communication and customer service skills.
• Ability to stay organized, manage multiple tasks, and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to work collaboratively across departments and adapt to changing business needs.
• Commitment to food quality, cleanliness, safety, and exceptional guest service.
• Basic computer skills for reviewing order information and completing assigned administrative tasks.
• High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

• Availability to work onsite with a flexible schedule, often including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
• Ability to exert well-paced mobility for up to 8 hours, including standing, walking, bending, and squatting.
• Ability to operate equipment such as manual espresso machines, drink blenders, juicers, and cash registers.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced food service environment and shift between catering and QSR duties as operational needs require.

Benefits and Perks

• Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
• Paid Time Off
• Paid Parental Leave
• 401K with match
• Free family meal daily
• Discounts at Eataly
• Referral bonus program
• and more!

Compensation: Pay rate is set at $20 - $23 an hour. (Not a commission base position)

Seasonal Opportunity with Potential for Long-Term Growth! This is a seasonal position expected to last approximately three months, through the first week of January 2027, with the opportunity to become a permanent member of our team! Many of our seasonal team members have continued their journey with us beyond the holiday season, and this could be the start of a long-term opportunity with Eataly. Continued employment will depend on business needs, performance, and availability.

Eataly is an equal employment opportunity employer. jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist, Benefits
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

You are focused on and committed to helping people. You are a customer fanatic with a proven track record of going above and beyond for your customers. You treat others with care and empathy, and assume the best intentions in others. You are a great communicator, being able to simplify complex concepts into clear, easy-to-understand terms. In this role you will support our small business customers with inquiries related to benefits and wellness perks , and contribute to internal discussions regarding product enhancements. We believe a positive team is the strongest unit, and we strive to make ourselves and each other better. This is a fast-paced and challenging role, but also incredibly rewarding due to the positive impact we have on our customers and their businesses.

A variety of shifts and hours are available, and we will work with you to find the best fit.

Your Success Profile

What You Will Work On

How You Will Do Your Work

• Consultative - takes an approach that focuses on building relationships with others, understanding their problems, and developing solutions to their challenges through open-ended questions and active listening.

• Openness - Your default is to be open. You're willing to share information, understand other perspectives, and consider new possibilities. You’re curious, ask open questions, and are receptive to thoughts and feedback from others.

• Grit - You demonstrate grit by having the courage to commit and persevere. You’re committed, earnest, and dive in to get the job done well with a positive attitude.

• Integrity - Simply put, do what you say and say what you'll do. You’re honest and forthright, have a strong moral compass, and strive to match your words with your actions while leading by example.

• Simplicity - Be like Einstein: “Everything should be made as simple as possible, but no simpler.”

• A track record of operating in a time-sensitive or deadline-driven environment

• Curiosity and an aptitude for learning new things and understanding how and why things work

• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to break down complex concepts into simple terms

• Excellent at time management, organization, and prioritizing tasks

• (Certified Employee Benefits Specialist (CEBS)? Or also CBP (certified benefits professional)?

jobs.description:
About Snorkel

Snorkel AI is the frontier AI data lab, helping teams build the data and environments behind high-performing frontier and agentic AI. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Perry Ellis International, Inc. represents a diverse portfolio of lifestyle apparel brands. The Company, through its wholly owned subsidiaries owns and licenses nationally and with a brand portfolio of over 40 Brands domestically and internationally recognized brands including: Perry Ellis®, Original Penguin® by Munsingwear®, Laundry by Shelli Segal®, Rafaella®, Cubavera®, Ben Hogan®, Savane®, Grand Slam®, John Henry®, Manhattan®, Axist® and Farah®. The Company enhances its roster of brands by licensing trademarks from third parties, including: Nike®  for swimwear, and Callaway®, PGA TOUR®, and Jack Nicklaus® for golf apparel.

Summary

We are seeking a dynamic Data Analyst with a strong background in planning to join our team for five days onsite in Miami. In this role, you will focus on leveraging Walmart data through the Scintilla platform, serving as a strategic partner to our planning, buying, allocation, inventory, and merchandising teams. We are looking for someone who loves discovering ways to answer new kinds of questions using new kinds of data and teaching others how to do the same. Daily responsibilities include designing dashboards, generating reports, querying our Snowflake data warehouse with SQL to maintain strict data integrity standards, and delivering actionable data-driven recommendations across critical functions such as Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI), Product Lifecycle & Markdown Cadence, Assortment Planning & Hierarchy, Seasonality and Core vs. Fashion, Open-to-Buy (OTB) Logic, Exception-Based Reporting, WSSI Mechanics, and Historical Normalization. As part of our forward-thinking environment, you will also leverage modern AI workflow and vibe coding tools (such as AI code assistants) to accelerate analytics and streamline business intelligence operations.

Responsibilities

• Analyze and interpret Walmart data using the Scintilla platform to support demand planning, merchandise planning, and inventory allocation strategies.

• Proactively discover innovative ways to answer complex business questions using novel datasets, while mentoring and teaching team members to adopt new analytical approaches.

• Develop analytical models and reports to track and evaluate Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) across categories and channels.

• Build tools to analyze Product Lifecycle & Markdown Cadence, Assortment Planning & Hierarchy, Seasonality and Core vs. Fashion, Open-to-Buy (OTB) Logic, Exception-Based Reporting, WSSI Mechanics, and Historical Normalization.

• Write and execute SQL queries in modern cloud data platforms (such as Snowflake) to audit metrics, validate data from the data warehouse, and resolve anomalies (Note: role does not involve data migration tasks).

• Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports (preferably in Looker) to communicate Walmart Scintilla insights to key internal stakeholders.

• Rigorously validate data integrity standards across raw data and audit AI-generated query outputs to ensure absolute metric precision.

• Collaborate directly with business analysts, executive leadership, and departmental stakeholders to translate data into actionable business strategy.

• Schedule, monitor, and deliver executive-level reporting and ad-hoc analytics as required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities (Minimum Requirements)

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Finance, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related business discipline.

• Strong background in merchandise, demand, or inventory planning within retail, wholesale, or consumer goods environments.

• Hands-on experience or deep familiarity with Walmart data ecosystems and the Walmart Scintilla analytics platform.

• Solid proficiency in SQL for querying and validating data stored within cloud data warehouses.

• Hands-on experience working with modern data platforms such as Snowflake.

• Demonstrated experience with modern reporting tools (strong preference for Looker; Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools are acceptable).

• Familiarity with AI tools and modern AI workflows (e.g., code assist, vibe coding for BI) to increase productivity.

• Proven ability to translate complex datasets into strategic commercial insights for planning, allocation, inventory, and executive leadership teams.

• Solid understanding of relational databases, dimensional data models, semantic layers, and metric governance.

• Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem solving skills to audit underlying query logic and resolve data anomalies.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to present data stories effectively to non-technical business partners.

• Curious and collaborative mindset with a passion for uncovering insights from novel data sources and teaching colleagues how to leverage new analytical tools and methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications (Plusses)

• Industry experience in Fashion, Apparel, Retail, E-commerce, Wholesale, or Supply Chain functions.

• Deep understanding of retail and supply chain domain metrics (e.g., sell-through rates, inventory turn, lead times, procurement, wholesale vs. DTC performance).

• Exposure to ERP systems (e.g., Shopify, NetSuite, Jesta, Oracle Retail).

• Knowledge of Python or other scripting languages for data analysis (nice to have / good to know).

Physical Demand

This position requires the normal demands of a standard office role, including sitting, standing, reaching with arms and hands, walking, talking, and hearing.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, 5-day onsite position located at our corporate office in Miami, FL. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

What’s In It For You?

• Comprehensive Health: Premium Medical, Dental, and Vision plans designed to keep you and your family healthy and thriving.

• Financial Security: Secure your future with our 401(k) retirement plan (including a discretionary company match) plus company-provided Basic Life and AD&D Insurance.

• Work-Life Balance: Take the time you need to recharge with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and a full schedule of paid Holidays.

• Growth & Support: We invest in your potential through our Tuition Reimbursement program for continuous learning and provide 24/7 personal support via our Member Assistance Program (MAP).

• Team Culture: Join a community that celebrates your hard work with regular Associate Engagement Events, ranging from seasonal celebrations to on-site wellness activities.

• Exclusive Style Perks: Look your best for less with generous Associate Clothing Discounts across all our company stores and e-commerce sites.

Legal Disclaimer:

Perry Ellis International is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their individual background and characteristics. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, transfer, compensation, and termination. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the company's commitment to equal employment opportunities.

We encourage you to read and understand our Privacy Policy here.

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
About Exegy

Exegy is a global leader in intelligent market data, advanced trading systems, and future-proof technology. Exegy serves as a trusted partner to the complete ecosystem of the buy-side, sell-side, exchanges, and financial services technology firms around the globe. Headquartered in St. Louis with regional offices in North America, the UK/Europe and Asia Pacific, Exegy has the global footprint to deliver world-class support and managed services to its customer base of elite financial market participants.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced System Engineer to join our Managed Services Engineering (MSE) team in St. Louis, MO. You will be our lead specialist in Linux systems, bare-metal provisioning, and infrastructure networking, building and maintaining the automation that turns bare-metal servers into production-ready platforms.

You will own our automated OS provisioning workflows, configuration management frameworks, Linux networking and routing services, and hardware validation tooling, and serve as a senior escalation resource for deployment and operations teams.

Responsibilities

 - Bare-Metal Provisioning & OS Lifecycle: Design, maintain, and evolve automated provisioning workflows, including network boot environments, live boot images, and unattended Linux installations. Lead OS lifecycle work such as package and repository management, service administration, and platform upgrades

 - Configuration Management & Automation: Build and maintain Puppet and Ansible automation, including custom modules, manifests, data hierarchies, and backend data stores

 - Provisioning Tooling: Develop and support Python and Bash applications and scripts for preboot staging, hardware discovery, and automated hardware validation

 - Linux Networking, Routing & Security: Administer, troubleshoot, and modernize Linux network services, including dynamic routing, VPN, proxy services, and SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle management

 - Server Hardware Validation: Define and validate Bills of Materials (BOMs) for enterprise server platforms, manage out-of-band configuration, and resolve hardware discrepancies during bring-up

 - Technical Escalation: Act as the escalation point for deployment and support teams on provisioning failures, hardware mismatches, and complex Linux networking and routing issues

Required Qualifications

 - Enterprise Linux (5+ years): Senior-level systems engineering experience on RHEL and Rocky Linux 9/10. RHCSA or RHCE certification is a strong plus

 - Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Puppet (modules, manifests, Hiera, Facter, Ruby) and Ansible

 - Bare-Metal Provisioning: Practical experience with PXE/iPXE, live boot image generation (dracut/initramfs), unattended installers (Anaconda/Kickstart), and provisioning tools such as Razor or Foreman

 - Python & Bash: Proficiency in systems automation, CLI tooling, REST API integration, and structured data formats (JSON, YAML)

 - Databases: Experience with NoSQL and relational databases (such as CouchDB and PostgreSQL) that store infrastructure and configuration data

 - Linux Networking & Routing: Deep knowledge of IP networking, NIC bonding, VLANs, multiple routing tables, policy-based routing (ip rule/ip route), firewalling (iptables/nftables), and packet analysis (tcpdump)

 - VPN, Proxy & Routing Daemons: Experience configuring and troubleshooting OpenVPN, SSL/TLS certificates (OpenSSL/PKI), proxy services (such as Squid), and routing daemons (such as BIRD)

 - Linux Troubleshooting: Strong command of systemd, dnf/yum/rpm, storage and filesystems, and diagnostic tools (journalctl, strace, lsof, ss, dmesg)

 - Hardware & Out-of-Band Management: Familiarity with enterprise server hardware (Dell, Intel, AMD), BOM verification, and lights-out management tools (iDRAC, IPMI, RACADM, Redfish)

 - Collaboration: Proficiency with Git, clear technical documentation, and effective communication across engineering and deployment teams

Preferred Qualifications

 - Containers & Virtualization: Experience with Docker and virtual machine or hypervisor environments

 - Observability & Service Management: Familiarity with Telegraf, Prometheus, and Grafana, and with ServiceNow and Jira

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Developer Relations Engineering
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

Crusoe is hiring an AI Engineer for our Developer Relations Engineering team: an engineer who builds agentic AI systems and enjoys showing other developers how they work. You will build reference agents, open-source integrations, and sample applications on Crusoe Cloud and Crusoe Managed Inference.



In this role, you will lead technical content creation, community engagement, and developer outreach across AI infrastructure and managed services workloads. You will produce documentation, tutorials, white papers, sample applications, and video guides.



You will partner with the Product, Engineering, Research, and GTM/Solutions Engineering teams and work across the open-source agent ecosystem.



You will spend most of your time building and then sharing what you build.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Agentic Reference Systems: Architect and ship end-to-end reference agents and starter kits on Crusoe that developers can use as a starting point for production, covering tool use, MCP, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, structured outputs, memory, and evals.

jobs.description:

This role will support a major pharmaceutical and consumer health manufacturing expansion program involving the redevelopment and expansion of a large-scale manufacturing campus. The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering cost management services across the full project lifecycle, from planning and design through construction and closeout.

To be successful in this role, you must have excellent communication skills and be comfortable operating in a client-facing environment. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, driven, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively as part of a team. In this significant position, you will provide leadership and direction while promoting the purpose, values, and vision of Turner & Townsend.

Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Senior PLM Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

• And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays

• Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.

*Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

The Senior Systems Admin/Architect is responsible for maintaining and supporting the enterprise PLM system (Siemens Teamcenter) and its connections across the product development and manufacturing landscape. This role ensures the PLM ecosystem remains scalable, secure, and effective in supporting cross-functional workflows including ECAD, mechanical CAD, ERP, manufacturing operations, AI-assisted engineering tools, and developer platforms as part of the Digital Thread.

This hands-on role combines Teamcenter administration, architecture, custom ITK development, cross-system integration support, and production delivery. You will make architectural decisions, merge environments, upgrade systems, write production code, design integrations, deploy templates, and partner with engineering, manufacturing, IT, operations, and cybersecurity teams to deliver scalable solutions that bridge tools, teams, and processes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own Teamcenter architecture including but not limited to deployment, security, data model, modules, environments, configuration, upgrade strategy, templates, and lifecycle governance.

• Lead hands-on Teamcenter ITK development includes but not limited server-side utilities, workflow handlers, BOM logic, queries, batch processes, and integrations.

• Design and implement Teamcenter customizations including but not limited BMIDE extensions, workflows, business rules, forms, preferences, services, SOA/REST APIs, and Active Workspace extensions.

• Develop and maintain Teamcenter data models, object types, attributes, relations, configurations, and lifecycle processes aligned with cross-functional product development needs.

• Support, test, and implement integrations connecting Teamcenter with E3 (Epsilon3), NetSuite, Altium, NX, AI-assisted engineering tools, and internal developer platforms.

• Develop and maintain CAD/ECAD-to-PLM processes with emphasis on robust product structures, metadata synchronization, change management, and configuration control.

• Define data mappings, authentication strategies, error handling, reconciliation processes, monitoring, and operational support models for integrations.

• Explore and implement AI-assisted workflows: intelligent part search, automated classification, generative design, design recommendations, anomaly detection, and natural-language interfaces to PLM data.

• Make timely architectural decisions under ambiguity, document tradeoffs, set development standards, and ensure production quality code.

• Lead production support, root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and corrective actions using modern engineering practices (source control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring).

• Work with cross-functional stakeholders, systems integrators, vendors, and external technology partners to clarify needs, evaluate tools, and deliver solutions.

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to developers, administrators, and solution architects while identifying opportunities to simplify the ecosystem and improve developer experience.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years designing, developing, and supporting enterprise PLM or Teamcenter solutions in complex engineering, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or high-tech environments.

• Strong hands-on Teamcenter ITK development including server-side customization, workflow handlers, utilities, queries, product structure logic, integrations.

• Expert-level Teamcenter administration and architecture including SSO implementation, BMIDE, data modeling, workflows, security, configurations, lifecycle management.

• Experience with Teamcenter Admin and Architect workspaces; ability to diagnose platform and customization issues independently.

• Proven track record designing cross-functional integrations connecting PLM with ERP, manufacturing operations, ECAD, or other enterprise systems.

• Strong integration architecture experience including APIs, middleware, SOA, REST, web services, event-driven patterns, authentication, error handling.

• CAD/PLM integration experience with NX; ECAD/PLM integration experience with Altium or comparable tools.

• Strong knowledge of C/C++, Java, JavaScript, Python; proficiency with SQL, XML, JSON, version control, testing, CI/CD, and production support.

• Deep understanding of EBOM/MBOM, product structures, item/revision management, datasets, configurations, effectivity, and engineering change management (ECR, ECO, ECN).

• Cross-functional systems thinking including how PLM, ERP, CAD, ECAD, manufacturing, and operations systems interact across the product development lifecycle.

• Decisive, pragmatic, and delivery-oriented; comfortable with ambiguity; strong communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Multidisciplinary Engineering, or related technical field. Equivalent experience accepted for candidates with proven PLM architecture and delivery record.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Experience with E3 (Epsilon3), NetSuite ERP, Altium, Siemens NX, Active Integration Gateway (AIG), or EDA Gateway.

• Experience with Siemens AI products, AI-assisted engineering/PLM use cases, MCP server integration, or intelligent automation.

• Experience with cloud platforms, containers, API management, message queues, observability platforms, or modern integration architectures.

• Background in aerospace, defense, space, or regulated manufacturing industries.

• Siemens Teamcenter certification, Technical Practitioner training, Genesis, Inceptor, or formal Teamcenter training.

• Experience with Agile, configuration management, developer platforms, or enterprise software deployments.

COMPENSATION

• Base Salary: $95,000 - $170,000

• Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Denver, CO or Long Beach, CA.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below. #LI-Onsite

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.
